name: 2WikiMultihopQA
intro: 2WikiMultiHopQA是一个多跳问答数据集，旨在通过要求模型阅读多个段落以回答问题来测试推理和推断能力。该数据集的独特之处在于它为多跳问题提供了包含推理路径的证据信息，这既能为模型的预测提供全面的解释，也有助于评估模型的推理能力。数据集的构建利用了结构化（Wikidata）和非结构化数据，并通过精心设计的流程和模板来保证问题的质量和多跳推理的必要性。
build_method: 混合, 自动生成
eval_feature: Multi-hop, 长文本, 过程导向
build_method_en: Hybrid, Automated Generation
eval_feature_en: Multi-hop, Long Context, Process-oriented
intro_en: 2WikiMultiHopQA is a multi-hop question answering dataset designed to test reasoning and inference abilities by requiring models to read multiple paragraphs to answer questions. Its uniqueness lies in providing evidence containing reasoning paths for multi-hop questions, which not only offers comprehensive explanations for model predictions but also helps evaluate the model's reasoning capabilities. The dataset is constructed using both structured (Wikidata) and unstructured data, with carefully designed processes and templates to ensure question quality and the necessity of multi-hop reasoning.

name: AA-LCR
intro: AA-LCR 是一个由 100 道人工题目组成的长上下文基准，覆盖 30 个真实世界多文档集、234 篇文档和 2,979,757 tokens，完整提示平均 99,325 tokens。题目要求跨文档进行通用或数学推理，不能靠直接检索作答；每道保留题都经过非前沿模型难度检查和至少一名人工验证者解答。
build_method: 真实多文档集整理、人工出题、非前沿模型难度检查、人工答案验证
metric: 准确率（Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 等价性判定）
eval_feature: 长上下文推理, 多文档推理, 多步推理
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Knowledge QA, Math Reasoning
build_method_en: Real multi-document curation, human question writing, non-frontier-model difficulty checks, human answer validation
eval_feature_en: Long-context reasoning, multi-document reasoning, multi-step reasoning
intro_en: AA-LCR is a 100-question long-context benchmark built over 30 real-world multi-document sets, 234 documents, and 2,979,757 tokens, with completed prompts averaging 99,325 tokens. Its general and mathematical questions require cross-document reasoning rather than direct retrieval; every retained item passes non-frontier-model difficulty checks and is solved by at least one human validator.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official Artificial Analysis AA-LCR methodology and public dataset card because no standalone paper exists. The diagram preserves the 30 document sets, 234 documents, 2,979,757 total tokens, 99,325-token average completed prompt, seven source-document types, human question authors, three non-frontier difficulty-check models, revise/discard human validation with at least one solver per retained item, the 100-question release, filename-ordered prompt contract, Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 non-reasoning equality judge, binary verdict, and accuracy.

name: AA-Omniscience
intro: AA-Omniscience 用 6 个领域、42 个经济相关主题的 6,000 道精确短答题评估模型的事实召回与知识校准。问题由自动化智能体从权威、较新的信源生成、过滤和修订，再经人工复核。模型在无上下文、无工具条件下回答或弃答，由 Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview 四分类判分；公开集仅为 600 题代表性子集。
build_method: 权威信源筛选, 自动化问题生成/过滤/修订, 人工复核
eval_feature: 闭卷知识召回, 知识校准, 弃答与幻觉
build_method_en: Authoritative source selection, automated question generation/filtering/revision, human review
eval_feature_en: Closed-book factual recall, knowledge calibration, abstention and hallucination
intro_en: AA-Omniscience evaluates factual recall and knowledge calibration with 6,000 precise short-answer questions spanning 42 economically relevant topics in six domains. An automated agent generates, filters, and revises questions from authoritative recent sources before human review. Models answer or abstain without context or tools, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview assigns four-way grades. Only a representative 600-question subset is public.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.13029 Sections 2.1-2.4 and Appendix B plus the official AA-Omniscience-Public dataset card. The diagram distinguishes the 6,000-question full evaluation from the representative 600-question public subset, and covers authoritative recent sources, 6 domains/42 topics, automated generation/filtering/revision, human review, no-context/no-tool answering, one-pass Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview grading into four classes, and the exact OI/accuracy/hallucination metrics.

name: AbstentionBench
intro: AbstentionBench 是面向模型选择性拒答能力的综合基准。作者从 82 个候选数据集系统筛选出 16 个通用数据集，并加入 3 个删除关键上下文的推理变体和 UMWP，形成覆盖 6 类拒答场景、超过 35,000 个不可回答问题的 20 数据集套件。评测用经人工验证的 Llama 3.1 8B 判分器识别拒答并判断非拒答回答的正确性。
build_method: 82个候选系统筛选, 16个通用集整理, 3个缺失上下文变体+UMWP
metric: Abstention Recall（核心）, Precision, F1, Response Accuracy
task_type: 拒答评测, 不确定性推理
eval_feature: 拒答能力, 不确定性推理, 不可回答问题
scale: 20个数据集, 超过35,000个不可回答问题, 6类场景
build_method_en: Systematic screening of 82 candidates, 16 curated general sets, 3 context-removed variants plus UMWP
eval_feature_en: Abstention, uncertainty reasoning, unanswerable questions
intro_en: AbstentionBench is a holistic benchmark of selective abstention. The authors systematically screen 82 candidate datasets, retain 16 general-domain datasets, and add three reasoning variants with key context removed plus UMWP, yielding a 20-dataset suite with more than 35,000 unanswerable questions across six scenarios. Human-validated Llama 3.1 8B judges detect abstention and score the correctness of non-abstention responses.
scale_en: 20 datasets, more than 35,000 unanswerable questions, 6 scenarios
metric_en: Abstention Recall (primary), Precision, F1, Response Accuracy
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.09038 Sections 3.1-3.4 and Appendix E plus the official facebookresearch/AbstentionBench repository. The diagram preserves the 82-candidate search, 16 retained general datasets, GPQA/GSM8K/MMLU-Math context-removal construction, UMWP addition, 20-dataset and six-scenario boundary, more-than-35,000-question scale, default 4k/temperature-0.8 inference, Llama 3.1 8B abstention judge with 88% manual accuracy, conditional correctness judging, and recall/precision/F1/accuracy metrics.

name: ACEBench
intro: ACEBench 是 Kimi、ERNIE、LongCat 等报告引用的工具使用评测，用于衡量 agent 在复杂工具调用场景中的表现。
build_method: 工具场景构造, 函数调用任务, 多轮Agent模拟
eval_feature: 工具调用, 多轮对话, 模糊指令, 细粒度错误分析
build_method_en: Tool scenario construction, function-call tasks, multi-turn agent simulation
eval_feature_en: Tool use, multi-turn dialogue, ambiguous instructions, fine-grained error analysis
intro_en: ACEBench is a tool-use benchmark referenced by Kimi, ERNIE, and LongCat reports to evaluate agents in complex tool-calling scenarios.

name: ACPBench Hard
intro: ACPBench Hard 将 ACPBench 的动作、变化与规划能力改写为开放式生成任务，并新增“下一动作”，共覆盖 13 个 PDDL 领域与 8 类任务。数据由 PDDL 问题、Top-K 规划、计划/状态采样、符号化问答和领域模板翻译构建；模型回答经任务专用语法解析器和符号规划验证器判分，而不是交给 LLM 裁判。
build_method: 13领域PDDL生成, Top-K规划与状态采样, 8类符号问答, 模板翻译
eval_feature: 多步推理, 规划
build_method_en: 13-domain PDDL generation, Top-K planning and state sampling, 8 symbolic QA tasks, template translation
eval_feature_en: Multi-step reasoning
intro_en: ACPBench Hard converts ACPBench's action, change, and planning capabilities into open-ended generation tasks and adds next-action prediction, covering 13 PDDL domains and eight task families. It is built from PDDL problems, Top-K plans, sampled plans/states, symbolic QA, and domain-template translation. Task-specific grammar parsers and symbolic planning validators score model answers instead of an LLM judge.
scale_en: 320 development examples; 1,040 test questions (13 domains × 8 tasks × 10)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.24378 Sections 5-7 and Appendix A.3-A.5 plus the official IBM ACPBench page. The diagram follows the paper's six-step generation workflow, distinguishes the 320-example dev set from the 1,040-question test set, includes all 13 domains and eight open-ended tasks, captures reachability-certainty skips and retained validation artifacts, and separates stored/simulated checks from planner-backed validators after two-shot temperature-0 inference and grammar parsing.

name: ActivityNet-QA
intro: ActivityNet-QA 是面向长视频时空推理的全人工标注视频问答基准。它从 ActivityNet 采样 5,800 个复杂网络视频，每个视频众包编写 10 对问答，共 58,000 对；问题与答案由不同标注者处理，并通过不可答题返工、随机多人多数投票和四引擎翻译一致性检查保证质量。数据提供中英对齐版本。
build_method: ActivityNet分层采样, 众包问答, 独立答案复核, 多引擎翻译质检
eval_feature: 视频问答, 长视频理解, 时空推理
build_method_en: Stratified ActivityNet sampling, crowdsourced QA, independent answer review, multi-engine translation QA
eval_feature_en: Video QA, long-video understanding, spatio-temporal reasoning
intro_en: ActivityNet-QA is a fully human-annotated benchmark for spatio-temporal reasoning over long videos. It samples 5,800 complex web videos from ActivityNet and crowdsources exactly ten QA pairs per video, yielding 58,000 pairs. Separate question and answer annotators, regeneration of unanswerable items, random multi-annotator majority votes, and four-engine translation agreement checks provide quality control. Chinese and English versions are aligned.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.02467's dataset and evaluation sections plus the official MILVLG/activitynet-qa evaluation script. The diagram preserves the 3,200/1,800/800 video and 32k/18k/8k QA splits, exactly ten QAs per video, 1+1+1+7 question composition, separate question/answer annotators, regeneration and majority-vote checks, four-engine CIDEr translation QA, bilingual release, exact-equality accuracy used by the official script, paper WUPS criteria, and per-type aggregation.

name: ADR-Bench
intro: ADR-Bench 是面向真实中文深度研究场景的 110 题内部基准。作者调研实际用户与业务需求，由领域专家起草并经多轮测试、过滤和修订，形成 70 个通用题与 40 个金融/法律专业题。通用轨采用盲审人工两两对比和四维质量判断；专业轨采用经专家交叉验证、含负向风险项的枚举式 rubric 自动评分。
build_method: 真实场景调研, 专家起草与多轮修订, 专业Rubric交叉验证
metric: 通用：人工成对偏好/Elo风格评级；专业：Rubric得分
eval_feature: 盲审人工成对偏好, 多维质量, 专业Rubric评测
build_method_en: Real-scenario study, expert drafting and multi-round revision, professional-rubric cross-validation
eval_feature_en: Blind human pairwise preference, multidimensional quality, professional rubric evaluation
intro_en: ADR-Bench is an in-house 110-query benchmark for realistic Chinese deep-research scenarios. The authors study real user and business needs, then have domain experts draft, test, filter, and revise queries into 70 general tasks and 40 finance/law professional tasks. The general track uses blind human pairwise comparison with four quality dimensions; the professional track uses automated scoring against enumerated, expert-cross-validated rubrics with negative risk criteria.
metric_en: General: human pairwise preference/Elo-style rating; professional: rubric score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.20491 Sections 6-7.2. The diagram preserves the 9-domain, 110-query distribution; expert drafting and multi-round filtering/revision; 70 general and 40 finance/law split; five-principle expert rubric construction; 30-turn/16k ReAct limit versus default commercial web settings; blind human five-category comparison across four dimensions; automated professional rubric scoring with negative-risk criteria; and track-specific win/tie/loss, Elo-style, dimension, and rubric outputs.

name: AdvancedIF
intro: AdvancedIF 含 1,645 个人工编写对话及人工量规，覆盖显式复杂指令、多轮上下文延续和系统提示可控性。提示只在模型末轮出现指令遵循失败时保留；o3-mini 逐条判断量规，回答必须满足全部准则才算通过。
build_method: 专家人工提示与量规, 对抗式失败筛选
metric: 全准则严格通过率（CIF、CC、SS及三类平均）
task_type: 生成, 对话, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 6+复杂约束, 多轮上下文延续, 系统提示可控性, 逐量规二元判断
scale: 1,645个对话（复杂指令402、多轮上下文736、系统提示507）
build_method_en: Expert-written prompts and rubrics, adversarial failure filtering
eval_feature_en: 6+ complex constraints, carried multi-turn context, system-prompt steerability, criterion-level binary judging
intro_en: AdvancedIF contains 1,645 human-written dialogs and human-written rubrics spanning explicit complex instructions, carried multi-turn context, and system-prompt steerability. A prompt is retained only when the model fails instruction following at the final turn; o3-mini judges every rubric criterion and the response passes only if all criteria are satisfied.
metric_en: Strict all-criteria pass rate for CIF, CC, SS, and their three-category average
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.10507 Section 3 and the official Meta dataset. The workflow preserves the three human-written categories and exact 402/736/507 counts; their average criteria and turn counts; 6+ explicit constraints; carried context and system-prompt specifications; exclusion of ambiguous/factuality-overlap prompts; adversarial retention only after a final-turn failure; same-annotator rubrics with up to 20 separately verifiable criteria; final-turn-only rubrics for multi-turn dialogs; o3-mini criterion verification; strict all-criteria TRUE scoring; and CIF/CC/SS plus average reporting.

name: AdvBench
intro: AdvBench 由 500 个有害字符串和 500 个有害行为指令组成，用于评测对抗后缀能否绕过对齐模型护栏。论文以贪心坐标梯度（GCG）优化单题、通用和跨模型迁移后缀，并按攻击成功率判定精确字符串诱导或有害行为遵从。
build_method: 有害字符串与行为双集合构建, GCG对抗后缀优化, 多模型迁移
metric: 攻击成功率（ASR）, 目标交叉熵损失
task_type: 安全评测, 对抗提示
eval_feature: 精确字符串诱导, 有害行为遵从判定, 通用攻击, 跨模型迁移
build_method_en: Dual harmful-string/behavior sets, GCG adversarial-suffix optimization, multi-model transfer
eval_feature_en: Exact string elicitation, harmful-behavior compliance judging, universal attacks, cross-model transfer
intro_en: AdvBench contains 500 harmful strings and 500 harmful-behavior instructions for testing whether adversarial suffixes bypass aligned-model guardrails. The paper optimizes individual, universal, and cross-model transfer suffixes with Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) and scores exact string elicitation or attempted harmful compliance by attack success rate.
metric_en: Attack Success Rate (ASR), target cross-entropy loss
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.15043 Sections 2-3 and the official llm-attacks repository. The workflow preserves both 500-item AdvBench settings; harmful-string lengths of 3-44 LLaMA tokens with mean 16; exact-string versus attempted-compliance success rules; a 20-token suffix; GCG top-k 256, batch 512, and 500-step search; first-100 individual tests; 25-behavior universal training with 100 held-out tests; 2/4-source-model transfer optimization; 388 transfer test behaviors; human review when refusal versus compliance is ambiguous; ASR; and target cross-entropy loss.

name: AetherCode
intro: AetherCode v1收录456道来自OI与ICPC系列顶级竞赛的题目，其中2024年400题、2025年1至5月56题。它以超过3万份人类正确与错误提交验证测试套件，并结合Generator-Validator自动构造、67名竞赛编程专家定向补充及顶尖团队人工审计，在收集的解答集上达到100% TPR与100% TNR。
build_method: 顶级竞赛题整理, 自动测试生成, 67名专家定向补充, 人工质量审计
eval_feature: 专家构建
build_method_en: Premier-contest curation, automatic test generation, targeted cases from 67 experts, manual quality audit
eval_feature_en: Expert Curation
intro_en: AetherCode v1 contains 456 problems from premier OI- and ICPC-series competitions: 400 from 2024 and 56 from January-May 2025. It validates test suites against more than 30,000 correct and incorrect human submissions, combining Generator-Validator construction, targeted cases from 67 competitive-programming experts, and an elite manual audit to reach 100% TPR and 100% TNR on the collected solution set.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.16402 Sections 2.1-2.4 and 3: premier OI/ICPC/CCPC problem collection; PDF-to-Markdown+LaTeX conversion and proofreading; more than 30,000 human solutions with at least five correct and twenty incorrect solutions per problem; Generator-Validator test construction; targeted cases from 67 experts; elite manual audit and checker review; 100% TPR/TNR on the collected solutions; the 456-problem v1 split of 400 problems from 2024 and 56 from January-May 2025; and four-sample Pass@1/2/4 evaluation with a 32,768-token output limit.

name: AfriMed-QA
intro: AfriMed-QA 是通过社区参与构建的泛非英文多专科医学问答基准，含 15,275 道专家/众包选择题、简答题与消费者问题，来自 16 个国家、60 多所医学院和 32 个专科，并结合自动指标与双盲临床/消费者评价。
org: Intron Health, Georgia Institute of Technology, Google Research, and collaborators
build_method: 泛非社区参与式收集, 临床质量审核, 专家/学员/消费者三路线
metric: 选择题准确率, BERTScore, QuestEval, ROUGE-Lsum, 五点人工评分
eval_feature: 非洲本地临床语境, 国家/专科拆分, 自动与双盲人工评测
build_method_en: Pan-African community-participatory collection, clinical quality review, expert/trainee/consumer tracks
eval_feature_en: Localized African clinical context, country/specialty breakdowns, automated and double-blind human evaluation
intro_en: AfriMed-QA is a community-participatory Pan-African English multi-specialty medical QA benchmark with 15,275 expert and crowdsourced MCQs, short-answer questions, and consumer queries from 16 countries, more than 60 medical schools, and 32 specialties, evaluated with automated metrics and blinded clinician/consumer ratings.
scale_en: 15,275 items (4,269 expert, 11,006 crowdsourced), 16 countries, 60+ medical schools, 32 specialties
metric_en: MCQ accuracy, BERTScore, QuestEval, ROUGE-Lsum, five-point human ratings
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.15640v4 Sections 3-5 and the official dataset. The workflow preserves 621 contributors, a 300-item cap, verified clinician access, 16 countries, 60+ medical schools, 32 specialties, 472 consumer-condition prompts, exact expert 3,910 MCQ + 359 SAQ and crowdsourced 129 MCQ + 877 SAQ + 10,000 CQ counts, the 80% contributor-quality threshold, 5,444 human answers/explanations, 30 models (17 open/13 proprietary), MCQ and open-answer metrics, a random 3,000-response human subset, 379 raters, 37,435 five-point ratings, double blinding, role-specific axes, and country/specialty/subset reporting.

name: Agent Red Teaming Benchmark
intro: Agent Red Teaming（ART）Benchmark 从 Gray Swan 公开挑战赛的 180 万次攻击提交中，经更严格的 LLM 评审与按行为-模型组合采样，筛选出覆盖 44 个部署场景的 4,700 条高质量提示注入，用于评估 Agent 的策略违规风险与攻击迁移性。
org: Gray Swan AI, UK AI Security Institute
build_method: 公开红队挑战赛采集, 严格LLM评审筛选, 分层采样
metric: 行为级攻击成功率 ASR@k（k=1/10/100）, 攻击迁移率
eval_feature: 直接与间接提示注入, 多查询预算, 跨模型迁移与通用性分析
scale: 4,700条精选攻击, 44个目标行为（源自180万次提交与6万+成功违规）
build_method_en: Public red-team challenge collection, stricter LLM-judge filtering, stratified sampling
eval_feature_en: Direct and indirect prompt injection, multi-query budgets, cross-model transfer and universality analysis
intro_en: The Agent Red Teaming (ART) Benchmark filters 1.8 million submissions from Gray Swan's public challenge with a stricter LLM judge, then samples by behavior-model pair to produce 4,700 high-quality prompt injections across 44 deployment settings for evaluating policy violations and attack transferability.
scale_en: 4,700 selected attacks across 44 target behaviors (from 1.8M submissions and 60K+ successful violations)
metric_en: Behavior attack success rate ASR@k (k=1/10/100), attack transfer rate
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Deploy 22 frontier AI agents across 44 realistic deployment scenarios for public competition"] --> B["Collect 1.8 million prompt-injection attacks submitted by competition participants"]
    B["Collect 1.8 million prompt-injection attacks submitted by competition participants"] --> C["Identify over 60,000 successful attacks eliciting policy violations like unauthorized access and financial misconduct"]
    C["Identify over 60,000 successful attacks eliciting policy violations like unauthorized access and financial misconduct"] --> D["Curate high-impact attacks from competition results to construct ART benchmark"]
    D["Curate high-impact attacks from competition results to construct ART benchmark"] --> E["Evaluate 19 state-of-the-art models using the curated benchmark"]
    E["Evaluate 19 state-of-the-art models using the curated benchmark"] --> F["Measure policy violations within 10-100 queries and assess attack transferability across models"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["在44个真实部署场景中部署22个前沿AI代理"] --> B["收集参赛者提交的180万次提示注入攻击"]
    B["收集参赛者提交的180万次提示注入攻击"] --> C["识别超6万次成功引发策略违规的攻击"]
    C["识别超6万次成功引发策略违规的攻击"] --> D["从竞赛结果中筛选高影响攻击构建ART基准"]
    D["从竞赛结果中筛选高影响攻击构建ART基准"] --> E["使用筛选后的基准评估19个最先进模型"]
    E["使用筛选后的基准评估19个最先进模型"] --> F["测量10-100次查询内的策略违规及跨模型迁移性"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.20526 Sections 2-3: 44 manually curated agent/tool/adversarial-goal/success-criteria scenarios across four policy-violation categories; the March 8-April 6, 2025 four-wave Gray Swan challenge over 22 anonymized frontier agents; 1.8M direct and indirect prompt-injection submissions; automated success judging with a human appeal path and 60K+ successful violations; stricter LLM-judge filtering followed by up to five attacks per behavior-model pair; the final 4,700-attack ART subset; evaluation of 19 challenge and unseen models at k=1/10/100; behavior ASR, cross-model transfer, and universal attack-cluster analysis.

name: Agent-SafetyBench
intro: Agent-SafetyBench是一个综合性安全评测基准，旨在评估大型语言模型代理的安全性。该基准包含349个交互环境和2000个测试用例，覆盖8类安全风险和10种常见的失败模式。研究发现，现有主流代理的安全性堪忧，凸显了该领域巨大的提升空间。
build_method: 已有数据精炼, 风险定向生成, 人工与自动质检
metric: Safety Score（安全轨迹占比）, 风险与失败模式拆分
eval_feature: 动态工具交互, 轨迹级安全评分, 风险与失败模式分析
scale: 349个动态交互环境, 2,000个测试用例（8类风险各250个）
build_method_en: Existing-data refinement, risk-controlled generation, manual and automated quality control
eval_feature_en: Dynamic tool interaction, trajectory-level safety scoring, risk and failure-mode analysis
intro_en: Agent-SafetyBench is a comprehensive safety evaluation benchmark designed to assess the safety of large language model agents. It includes 349 interactive environments and 2000 test cases, covering 8 categories of safety risks and 10 common failure modes. Research shows that the safety of current mainstream agents is concerning, highlighting significant room for improvement in this field.
mermaid_flowchart:

name: AgentDAM

metric: 隐私泄露率, 隐私表现（1-泄露率）, 任务成功率
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 领域特定, 对抗性
scale: 246个任务（123个人工数据种子，每个采样2次）
build_method_en: Human data seeds, LLM-synthesized long-form user data, isolated web-environment execution
eval_feature_en: End-to-end data minimization, trajectory-level privacy judging, privacy-utility trade-off
intro_en: AgentDAM is a 246-task end-to-end privacy benchmark that tests whether web-navigation agents follow data minimization: potentially sensitive information should be used only when necessary for the task, while both task utility and unnecessary disclosure are measured.

name: AgentHarm
intro: AgentHarm 用于衡量 LLM Agent 完成恶意多步骤任务的倾向与能力：110 个基础行为覆盖 11 类危害，扩展为 440 个有害任务，并配有良性对应集、104 个无副作用合成工具和细粒度评分规则。

eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Multi-turn, Result-oriented

    G["Integrate proxy tools into evaluation framework for multi-step agent execution"] --> H["Evaluate LLMs with and without jailbreaks on harmful and benign tasks measuring compliance and capability"]

    B["为每个有害任务创建良性对应版本以测量基线能力"] --> C["将110个独特任务增强为330个变体，共440个任务"]

    F["编写人工评分标准，指定LLM评判的细分子任务"] --> G["将代理工具集成到评估框架以执行多步骤任务"]
    G["将代理工具集成到评估框架以执行多步骤任务"] --> H["在有害和良性任务上评估LLM，测量服从性和能力保持"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.09024 Sections 3-4: 11 harm categories and 110 manually written base behaviors; independent review by a non-author; detailed/open-ended variants with and without first-tool hints for 440 harmful tasks; matched benign counterparts; 104 side-effect-free Inspect tools; human-written checks for target calls, order, and arguments with narrow semantic judges only where needed; 44/264/132 validation/public/private splits; and direct, forced-tool, and universal-template evaluation using partial-credit Harm Score, refusal rate over all messages, non-refusal performance, and benign capability controls.

name: AGIEval
intro: AGIEval是一个以人为中心的基准测试，旨在评估基础模型在人类水平任务上的通用能力。它通过使用标准化考试（如高考、法学院入学考试和数学竞赛）来评估模型，以反映模型在现实世界场景中的表现。该基准测试揭示了模型的优势和局限性，为提升其通用能力提供了有价值的见解。
build_method: 考试题改编
eval_feature: 思维链, 零样本
build_method_en: Exam Adaptation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot
intro_en: AGIEval is a human-centered benchmark designed to evaluate the general capabilities of foundation models on human-level tasks. It assesses models using standardized exams such as the Gaokao, law school entrance exams, and math competitions to reflect their performance in real-world scenarios. This benchmark reveals the strengths and limitations of models, providing valuable insights for improving their general abilities.

name: Aider Polyglot
intro: Aider Polyglot 从 C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、Python 和 Rust 六种语言的 697 道 Exercism 练习出发，让 7 个模型尝试全部题目，并保留仅被 0-3 个模型解出的 225 道难题。评测在 Docker 中运行 Aider 的端到端文件编辑与语言专用单元测试，同时报告正确完成题目百分比和正确编辑格式率。
build_method: Exercism 题库筛选、七模型难度预试、Docker 单元测试
metric: Percent Completed Correctly, Correct Edit Format Rate
task_type: 代码编辑, 代码生成
eval_feature: 多语言端到端代码编辑、编辑格式有效性、隔离单元测试
scale: 225 道困难编程练习，6 种语言（来自 697 道候选）
build_method_en: Exercism Task Filtering, Seven-Model Difficulty Probing, Docker Unit Tests
eval_feature_en: Multilingual End-to-End Code Editing, Edit-Format Validity, Isolated Unit Tests
intro_en: Aider Polyglot starts from 697 Exercism exercises in C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust, has seven models attempt every task, and retains the 225 exercises solved by only zero to three models. Evaluation runs Aider's end-to-end file editing and language-specific unit tests in Docker, reporting percent completed correctly and correct edit-format rate.
language_en: Multilingual Code (C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust)
metric_en: Percent Completed Correctly, Correct Edit Format Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official Aider Polyglot announcement and the official Aider benchmark-harness README because no standalone paper exists. The diagram records all 697 Exercism exercises across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust; every one of seven models attempting every exercise; selection of the 225 tasks solved by zero to three models; exact per-language counts of 26, 39, 47, 49, 34, and 30; natural-language-to-file editing through Aider; isolated Docker execution; language-specific unit tests; and reporting of percent completed correctly plus correct edit-format or well-formed rate.

name: AIGCBench
intro: AIGCBench 是面向图生视频生成的综合评测，结合真实视频-文本、真实图像-文本和经文本组合、GPT-4扩写及SDXL生成筛选得到的数据，共3,928个测试样本，并以4个维度下的11项指标和人工研究验证评测标准。
org: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
build_method: 真实数据采样, 文本组合, GPT-4扩写, SDXL生成与筛选
eval_feature: 控制-视频对齐, 运动效果, 时序一致性, 视频质量, 人工验证
build_method_en: Real-data sampling, text combination, GPT-4 enrichment, SDXL generation and filtering
eval_feature_en: Control-video alignment, motion effects, temporal consistency, video quality, human validation
intro_en: AIGCBench is a comprehensive image-to-video benchmark combining real video-text pairs, real image-text pairs, and generated image-text data built with a text combiner, GPT-4 enrichment, and filtered SDXL images. It contains 3,928 test cases and validates 11 metrics across four dimensions with a user study.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2401.01651 Sections 3-4 and the official AIGCBench project page. The diagram separates 1,000 subtype-sampled WebVid10M video-text pairs, 925 random LAION-Aesthetics image-text pairs, and a generated branch of 3,000 four-part prompts enriched by GPT-4, rendered by SDXL at 1280×720/16:9, and filtered to 2,003 pairs with T2I-CompBench. It preserves the 3,928-case total, reference-video and reference-free paths, first-16-frame standardization, four reference keyframes where required, all four evaluation dimensions and 11 metrics, and the 42-person study over 30 results from each of five methods.

name: AIME
intro: 本目录的AIME条目对应MathArena论文基准，而非单一年度AIME题集。MathArena从刚发布的高难度数学竞赛中提取并标准化题目，尽快评测模型以降低污染；论文快照覆盖7项竞赛共162题，同时评估最终答案与证明写作。
build_method: 动态竞赛选取, 原始赛题提取与标准化, 人工核验
metric: 答案准确率, 证明部分分, 排名与准确率置信区间
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 竞赛发布后近实时评测, 防污染, 答案与证明双轨评分
build_method_en: Dynamic competition selection, source extraction and standardization, manual verification
eval_feature_en: Near-release evaluation, contamination resistance, answer and proof grading
intro_en: The AIME catalog entry represents the MathArena paper benchmark rather than a single-year AIME dataset. MathArena extracts and standardizes newly released problems from challenging mathematics competitions, evaluates models quickly to reduce contamination, and in the paper snapshot covers 162 problems from seven competitions with both final-answer and proof-writing tasks.
metric_en: Answer accuracy, proof partial credit, rank and accuracy confidence intervals
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.23281 and the official MathArena site. The paper snapshot contains 162 problems from AIME (30), HMMT (30), BRUMO (30), CMIMC (40), USAMO (6), IMO (6), and Project Euler (20). The diagram preserves source extraction and manual checks, model selection and near-release four-response evaluation, boxed-answer parsing with a custom LaTeX-to-SymPy pipeline plus Gemini 2.5 Flash cross-check and manual disagreements, expert-rubric proof grading by two independent anonymized graders, paired-permutation rank intervals, Bernoulli accuracy intervals, and public outputs.

name: AIME-24
intro: AIME-24把2024年AIME I与AIME II各15题封装为30题公开评测。MAA将两场设为主日期与备用日期，每位真实参赛者只能参加一场；合并两场是基准数据集做法。每题答案为000至999的整数，模型答案解析后做精确匹配。
build_method: MAA AIME I/II赛题与答案键整理, 两场30题公开数据集封装
metric: 精确匹配准确率；评测框架可聚合Avg@k/Mean@k
eval_feature: 竞赛数学, 000-999整数答案, 精确匹配, 污染敏感
build_method_en: MAA AIME I/II problem and answer-key collection, public 30-item packaging
eval_feature_en: Competition mathematics, 000-999 integer answers, exact match, contamination-sensitive
intro_en: AIME-24 packages the 15 problems from each of the 2024 AIME I and AIME II exams into a public 30-item evaluation. MAA treats the two forms as primary and alternate dates and each real contestant may take only one; merging both forms is a benchmark-dataset convention. Each answer is an integer from 000 to 999 and parsed model answers are graded by exact match.
scale_en: 30 problems (15 each from AIME I and II)
drawio_review_note: No standalone benchmark paper exists for this annual packaging. The diagram is aligned with the MAA invitational-competition specification and the HuggingFaceH4/aime_2024 dataset card: AIME is a 15-question, three-hour exam with integer answers from 000 to 999; AIME I is the primary date, AIME II is the alternate date, and each student may take only one. The public benchmark merges both forms into 30 problem/answer records. Answer extraction, exact matching, repeated sampling, and Avg@k/Mean@k are evaluation-harness conventions rather than MAA competition rules.

build_method_en: MAA AIME I/II problem and answer-key collection, two 15-item JSONL files
eval_feature_en: Competition mathematics, 000-999 integer answers, exact match, low contamination at release
intro_en: AIME-25 packages the 15 problems from each of the 2025 AIME I and AIME II exams into a public 30-item evaluation. MAA treats the two forms as primary and alternate dates and each real contestant may take only one; merging both forms is a benchmark-dataset convention. Each answer is an integer from 000 to 999 and parsed model answers are graded by exact match.
scale_en: 30 problems (15 each from AIME I and II)
drawio_review_note: No standalone benchmark paper exists for this annual packaging. The diagram is aligned with the MAA invitational-competition specification and the opencompass/AIME2025 dataset card: AIME is a 15-question, three-hour exam with integer answers from 000 to 999; AIME I is the primary date, AIME II is the alternate date, and each student may take only one. The public benchmark provides two 15-item question/answer JSONL files and commonly combines them into 30 evaluation items. Answer extraction, exact matching, repeated sampling, and Avg@k/Mean@k are evaluation-harness conventions rather than MAA competition rules.

name: AInsteinBench
intro: AInsteinBench 用 244 道可执行任务评测编码 Agent 在科学计算软件中的端到端开发能力。任务来自 PySCF、Qiskit、Einstein Toolkit、AMReX、OpenMM 和 RDKit 六个代码库，结合真实 Issue/PR 修复与模块消融合成功能任务，并通过历史 Docker 环境、Fail-to-Pass 测试和领域专家审核。
build_method: 真实Issue/PR挖掘、功能消融合成、历史环境重建、专家审核
eval_feature: 科学代码执行、Fail-to-Pass测试、CodeAct Agent
build_method_en: Hybrid, Web Crawling, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Result-oriented
intro_en: AInsteinBench evaluates coding agents on 244 executable scientific-software tasks from PySCF, Qiskit, Einstein Toolkit, AMReX, OpenMM, and RDKit. It combines real issue/PR repair with module-ablation feature synthesis, then reconstructs historical Docker environments and applies fail-to-pass tests plus domain-expert review.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.21373 Sections 2-4 and the official ByteDance-Seed/AInsteinBench repository. The diagram preserves the exact six repositories; separate issue-resolution and feature-ablation pipelines; issue, base, fix, and test artifacts; test-used Minimal API supplementation; isolated historical Docker reconstruction; the base-PASS/test-patch-FAIL/gold-fix-PASS transition; expert checks for scientific relevance, clarity, test false positives/negatives, and combined scientific/engineering difficulty; the 244-problem release; CodeAct plan-act execution; reproduction and repository tests; and resolved-rate breakdowns by repository, domain, task type, and difficulty.

name: AIRS-Bench
intro: AIRS-Bench 用 20 项任务评测科研 Agent 的端到端机器学习研究能力。这些任务从约 100 个候选中筛出，来自 17 篇论文和 16 个数据集，覆盖 7 类问题；Agent 在隐藏测试标签、无基线代码、24 小时单张 H200 的条件下完成开发、训练、验证与预测。
build_method: PapersWithCode与论文任务筛选、人工SOTA核验、任务脚本封装
metric: 平均归一化分数、有效提交率、Elo评级
eval_feature: 端到端科研、隐藏测试标签、跨Scaffold评测
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Process-oriented, Result-oriented, Domain-specific
intro_en: AIRS-Bench evaluates end-to-end machine-learning research agents on 20 tasks down-selected from roughly 100 candidates. The final suite comes from 17 papers and 16 datasets across seven categories; agents develop, train, validate, and predict with hidden test labels, no baseline code, and a 24-hour single-H200 budget.
metric_en: Average normalized score, valid submission rate, and Elo rating
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.06855 Sections 2-4 and the official facebookresearch/airs-bench repository. The diagram preserves PapersWithCode/SOTA sourcing, 2020-2025 preference, data and split eligibility, manual metric/split/SOTA verification, the approximately 100-task pool from approximately 85 papers and datasets, fidelity-based selection of 20 tasks across seven categories, the 17-paper/16-dataset boundary, all five task-definition file roles, hidden test labels and no-baseline-code setting, AIRA-dojo/MLGym execution for 24 hours on one H200, task-specific raw scoring, φ(s)=−log10|s−optimal| normalization with worst observed run 0 and literature SOTA 1, and average normalized score, valid submission rate, and Elo reporting.

name: ALERT
intro: ALERT 是一个与模型无关的推荐解释评估基准，包含 Amazon Reviews 2023 的 15 个电商类别、2,761 个用户–商品交互，以最近购买为目标商品、此前购买为隐式偏好画像。ALERT-Gen 与 ALERT-Disc 按四项准则分别判断并多数投票，最终报告候选解释相对 PreferenceLogic 的胜率。
org: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Amazon.com, Northwestern University, University of Notre Dame, Univ
build_method: Amazon购买记录筛选、购买历史画像、编辑团队与用户研究准则设计
eval_feature: 领域特定, LLM-as-Judge
build_method_en: LLM Generation, Human review
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, LLM-as-Judge
intro_en: ALERT is a model-agnostic recommendation-explanation benchmark with 2,761 user-item interactions from 15 Amazon Reviews 2023 categories. It treats the latest purchase as the target item and earlier purchases as an implicit-preference profile. ALERT-Gen and ALERT-Disc judge four criteria separately, majority-vote the preferences, and report candidate win rate against PreferenceLogic.
metric_en: Win rate against the PreferenceLogic baseline
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the NAACL 2025 paper (ACL Anthology 2025.naacl-long.137) Sections 3-5 and the official bigheiniu/ALERT-LLMRecomBenchmark repository. The diagram preserves Amazon Reviews 2023, 15 categories, latest-purchase target context, earlier-purchase history without demographics or user IDs, title/user/5-star/max-200 quality filters, 2,761 interactions, the editorial and user-study-derived four criteria, PreferenceLogic baseline, Claude-3-Sonnet ALERT-Gen with A/B/C and position swaps, ArmoRM ALERT-Disc, criterion-by-criterion divide-and-majority-vote aggregation, win rate, controlled data/prompt interruptions, three expert annotators, and about 70% expert concordance.

name: AlignBench
intro: AlignBench是一个多维度中文大语言模型对齐评测基准。它采用人机协同的数据构建流程，包含683个源于真实场景的查询，并为知识密集型问题提供了可靠的网络证据。该基准利用结合思维链的规则校准多维LLM评审机制进行自动化评估，以确保结果的高可靠性和可解释性。
build_method: 真实场景查询筛选, GPT-4参考答案草拟, 人工证据核验, 难度过滤
task_type: 开放式问答, 生成, 对话
eval_feature: 思维链, 多轮
build_method_en: Real-scenario query filtering, GPT-4 reference drafting, human evidence verification, difficulty filtering
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Multi-turn
intro_en: AlignBench is a multidimensional Chinese large language model alignment benchmark. It uses a human-AI collaborative data construction process, containing 683 queries derived from real-world scenarios, and provides reliable web evidence for knowledge-intensive questions. The benchmark employs an automated evaluation mechanism combining chain-of-thought reasoning with rule-based calibration for multidimensional LLM review, ensuring high reliability and interpretability of results.

name: AlignmentBench
intro: Hunyuan-TurboS结果表中的“AlignmentBench”在方法段被明确写为AlignBench v1.1。本条目因此映射到AlignBench论文：通过人机协同整理683个真实场景中文查询、人工参考答案与知识型问题网页证据，并用规则校准的多维LLM裁判给出1至10分。
build_method: 真实场景查询, 人机协同整理, 人工参考答案与网页证据
task_type: 开放式问答, 对齐评测
eval_feature: 规则校准多维LLM裁判, 思维链解释, 人工参考答案
build_method_en: Real-scenario queries, human-in-the-loop curation, human references and web evidence
eval_feature_en: Rule-calibrated multidimensional LLM judge, chain-of-thought explanations, human references
intro_en: The Hunyuan-TurboS results table labels this evaluation “AlignmentBench,” while its methodology section explicitly identifies it as AlignBench v1.1. This entry therefore maps to the AlignBench paper: 683 real-scenario Chinese queries, human-verified references and web evidence, and a rule-calibrated multidimensional LLM judge scoring responses from 1 to 10.

name: AlimentBench
intro: “AlimentBench”仅在Hunyuan-TurboS方法段出现一次，结合该段前文的AlignBench v1.1与结果表中的AlignmentBench，可判定为同一评测的拼写变体。本条目映射到AlignBench论文流程，而不把它当作独立benchmark。
build_method: 真实场景查询, 人机协同整理, 人工参考答案与网页证据
task_type: 开放式问答, 对齐评测
eval_feature: 规则校准多维LLM裁判, 思维链解释, 人工参考答案
build_method_en: Real-scenario queries, human-in-the-loop curation, human references and web evidence
eval_feature_en: Rule-calibrated multidimensional LLM judge, chain-of-thought explanations, human references
intro_en: “AlimentBench” appears once in the Hunyuan-TurboS methodology text. The same passage names AlignBench v1.1 and the results table uses AlignmentBench, so this entry is treated as a spelling variant of the same evaluation and mapped to the AlignBench paper rather than presented as an independent benchmark.

name: All-Angles
intro: All-Angles Bench 包含 90 个真实多视角场景与 2,132 个三选一问答对，通过计数、属性、相对距离、相对方向、物体操作和相机姿态六类任务评估 MLLM 的跨视角对应与几何一致性，并用配对问题诊断预测不一致。
org: UC Berkeley, HKU, NYU, University of Oxford, UC Davis, TranscEngram, SLAI
build_method: 场景与视角人工筛选, GPT-4o问题起草, 八名标注员全量复核
metric: 准确率, 配对问题不一致率
task_type: 多视角三选一视觉问答
eval_feature: 多视角, 几何一致性, 跨视角对应
build_method_en: Human scene and view selection, GPT-4o question drafting, full review by eight annotators
eval_feature_en: Multi-view, Geometric Consistency, Cross-view Correspondence
intro_en: All-Angles Bench contains 2,132 three-option QA pairs over 90 real multi-view scenes. Six tasks—counting, attributes, relative distance, relative direction, object manipulation, and camera pose—test cross-view correspondence and geometric consistency, while paired questions diagnose prediction inconsistency.

flowchart LR

    B --> C(Selected Scenarios Data)

flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select 90 multi-view scenes from Ego-Exo4D and EgoHumans with at least three viewpoints per scene"] --> B["Design six task categories targeting multi-view reasoning: counting, attributes, distance, direction, manipulation, and camera pose"]
    B["Design six task categories targeting multi-view reasoning: counting, attributes, distance, direction, manipulation, and camera pose"] --> C["Use an MLLM to generate initial questions from multi-view data, three per category except one for camera pose"]
    C["Use an MLLM to generate initial questions from multi-view data, three per category except one for camera pose"] --> D["Eight human annotators review questions with images, remove invalid entries, and refine question phrasing"]
    D["Eight human annotators review questions with images, remove invalid entries, and refine question phrasing"] --> E["Annotators revise incorrect answer choices and label the single correct answer for each multiple-choice question"]
    E["Annotators revise incorrect answer choices and label the single correct answer for each multiple-choice question"] --> F["Create paired questions by rephrasing or altering view order while preserving underlying visual correspondences"]
    F["Create paired questions by rephrasing or altering view order while preserving underlying visual correspondences"] --> G["Benchmark 27 MLLMs against human evaluators on a 250-question subset across all six task categories"]

flowchart LR
    A["从Ego-Exo4D和EgoHumans选取90个多视角场景"] --> B["设计六类任务评估多视角推理能力"]

    C["用MLLM从多视角数据生成初始问题"] --> D["八名标注员审查问题并优化表述"]
    D["八名标注员审查问题并优化表述"] --> E["标注员修正错误选项并标注正确答案"]
    E["标注员修正错误选项并标注正确答案"] --> F["创建配对问题以改变措辞或视角顺序"]
    F["创建配对问题以改变措辞或视角顺序"] --> G["在250题子集上对比27个模型与人类表现"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.15280 Sections 3-4 and Figure 3: 83 Ego-Exo4D plus seven EgoHumans scenes; manual selection of 90 scenes with at least three useful views and final sets of four to five spatially dispersed 796x448 images; six task categories; GPT-4o drafting with three questions per task/scene except one camera-pose item; all-view use for counting/camera pose and two random views otherwise; full review by eight STEM PhD annotators; three choices with exactly one correct answer; paired rephrasing, orientation swaps, or view changes that preserve correspondence; final human QC; 2,132 QA pairs with 85.3% paired coverage excluding counting; 27-model accuracy and paired inconsistency evaluation; and a stratified 250-question human reference.

name: AlpacaEval
intro: AlpacaEval 使用来自Alpaca交互场景的805条指令，分别收集被测模型与基线模型回答，经顺序随机化后由自动裁判进行成对比较；长度控制版本再通过广义线性模型消除回答长度差异的影响并计算胜率。
build_method: Alpaca交互指令整理, 模型与基线成对生成, LLM自动裁判
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 成对偏好, LLM-as-Judge, 顺序随机化, 长度去偏
build_method_en: Alpaca interaction instruction curation, evaluated and baseline response generation, automatic LLM judging
eval_feature_en: Pairwise preference, LLM-as-Judge, order randomization, length debiasing
intro_en: AlpacaEval uses 805 instructions representative of Alpaca interactions, collects responses from the evaluated and baseline models, randomizes their presentation order for pairwise automatic judging, and fits a generalized linear model to remove response-length effects for the length-controlled win rate.

name: AlpacaEval 2.0
intro: AlpacaEval 2.0是一个自动化评估框架，利用基于GPT-4的成对比较生成模型胜率。引入长度控制胜率，减少模型偏好长回答的偏差，提高与人类偏好的相关性和评测鲁棒性。
task_type: 排序, 对话, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 结果导向, 思维链
build_method_en: LLM Generation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Result-oriented, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: AlpacaEval 2.0 is an automated evaluation framework that uses GPT-4-based pairwise comparisons to generate model win rates. It introduces length-controlled win rates to reduce bias toward longer responses, enhancing correlation with human preferences and evaluation robustness.

name: AMEGA-LLM
intro: AMEGA-LLM以临床指南为依据，由资深医生构建跨13个医学专业的20个虚构病例、135个顺序开放问题和1337个加权评分元素。候选模型接受零样本口试，GPT-4-0613逐准则判断，并通过条件重问、11次并行多数投票和加权汇总评估指南依从性。
org: DATEXIS, Beuth University of Applied Sciences Berlin
build_method: 现行临床指南选取, 资深医生病例与问题编写, 加权准则及同行复核
metric: 加权指南依从分, 50分病例均值, 归一化缺陷与成本
eval_feature: 零样本临床口试, GPT-4逐准则评估, 条件重问, 11次多数投票
scale: 20个诊断场景，135个问题，1337个评估标准
build_method_en: Current guideline selection, experienced-physician case and question authoring, weighted rubrics and peer review
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot clinical oral exam, criterion-level GPT-4 judging, conditional reasks, 11-run majority voting
intro_en: AMEGA-LLM is grounded in clinical guidelines and was built by experienced physicians as 20 fictional cases across 13 specialties, 135 sequential open-ended questions, and 1,337 weighted scoring elements. Candidate models take a zero-shot oral exam; GPT-4-0613 checks every criterion, followed by conditional reasks, 11 parallel majority votes, and weighted aggregation of guideline adherence.
scale_en: 20 diagnostic scenarios, 135 questions, 1337 weighted scoring elements
metric_en: Weighted guideline-adherence score, 50-point case mean, normalized deficiencies and cost
drawio_review_note: Aligned with npj Digital Medicine 7:358 (2024), especially the benchmark-construction, reask, evaluator-reliability, and scoring sections. The diagram preserves the paper snapshot of 20 cases, 135 questions, and 1,337 weighted elements across 13 specialties; physicians with more than five years of experience; at least one additional physician review; 20-30 hours per case and more than 400 hours total; GPT-4-0613 criterion vectors; critical-error reask suppression; 11-run majority voting and confidence; weighted 50-point scoring; and the 50-run plus clinical-expert validation. The current repository later expanded to 24 cases, 163 questions, and 1,497 criteria, but those later counts are deliberately not substituted for the paper snapshot.

name: AMO-Bench
intro: AMO-Bench由数学专家原创并给出逐步解答，经至少3名专家盲审、10-gram与网页原创性检查，以及人类IMO难度确认和多模型失败筛选，最终保留50题。每题生成32个回答；39题由解析器评分，11题由o4-mini五次裁判多数投票评分，混合评分器在1000个回答上达到99.2%准确率。
org: Meituan, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Harbin Institute of Technology
build_method: 数学专家原创出题, 三人以上盲审, 原创性与难度复核
metric: AVG@32, Pass@32, 输出长度与类别分解
eval_feature: IMO级难度, 原创防泄漏, 解析器与LLM混合评分
build_method_en: Expert-authored original problems, three-or-more-expert blind review, originality and difficulty review
eval_feature_en: IMO-level difficulty, original leakage-resistant tasks, parser and LLM hybrid grading
intro_en: AMO-Bench starts with original problems and step-by-step solutions written by mathematics experts, then applies blind review by at least three experts, 10-gram and web originality checks, human IMO-level difficulty confirmation, and multi-model failure filtering to retain 50 problems. Each model produces 32 responses per problem; 39 items use parser grading and 11 use five-vote o4-mini judging, with the hybrid grader reaching 99.2% accuracy on 1,000 responses.
metric_en: AVG@32, Pass@32, output length and category breakdowns
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.26768 and the official AMO-Bench project page. The diagram preserves the four construction stages: expert-authored problems with worked solutions; blind review by at least three experts; originality review using 10-gram matching against existing sets including AIME 2024/2025, web search, and expert memory; and difficulty review requiring human IMO-level-or-harder agreement plus consistent failure by at least two advanced models, where each model gets three samples and all three must be correct to count as a consistent solve. It also preserves the five category counts, 32 responses per model/problem, temperature 1.0 for reasoning models and 0.7 otherwise, top-k 50, top-p 0.95, maximum available length, 39 parser-graded items, 11 five-vote o4-mini (Low) items, 99.2% grader accuracy on 1,000 responses, AVG@32, Pass@32, and AMO-Bench-P.

name: AndroidWorld
intro: AndroidWorld在20个真实Android应用上提供116个人工编写的TaskEval任务模板；每个模板用受控随机参数动态生成自然语言目标和初始状态，并通过初始化、成功检查与清理逻辑保证可复现。评测在固定Pixel 6/Android 13环境中运行，主要从文件、数据库和系统设置计算持久功能奖励。
build_method: 人工任务模板构建, 受控随机参数化, 设备状态验证
metric: 任务成功率, 跨随机种子与参数鲁棒性
eval_feature: 在线环境交互, 持久功能奖励, 参数化变体, 可复现设备状态
scale: 20个应用中的116个任务模板，可生成数百万参数化实例
build_method_en: Human-authored task templates, controlled random parameterization, device-state validation
eval_feature_en: Online environment interaction, durable functional rewards, parameterized variants, reproducible device state
intro_en: AndroidWorld provides 116 human-authored TaskEval templates across 20 real Android apps. Each template uses controlled random parameters to dynamically generate a natural-language goal and initial state, with initialization, success checking, and teardown for reproducibility. Evaluation runs on a fixed Pixel 6 / Android 13 environment and derives durable functional rewards primarily from files, databases, and system settings.
scale_en: 116 task templates across 20 apps, yielding millions of parameterized instances
metric_en: Task success rate, robustness across seeds and parameterizations
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2405.14573 Sections 3-5 and the official google-research/android_world repository. The diagram preserves 116 human-authored TaskEval templates across 20 open-source or system apps; offline/no-login/on-device selection; annotator difficulty, category, step, and duration labels; Pixel 6 / Android 13 with fixed app versions and timestamp; seeded parameter generation; initialize/is_successful/teardown; screenshot and accessibility-tree observations; gestures, typing, navigation, and limited function APIs; ADB-backed durable rewards with UI fallback and composite partial rewards; M3A, M3A-Simple, SeeAct, and human success rates; three-seed and same/different-parameter robustness tests; Wilson intervals; and the Pixel 5 / Android 12 cross-check.

name: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge)
intro: ARC（AI2推理挑战）包含7,787道为3–9年级人类考试命制的自然、无图表科学选择题。Waterloo语料检索求解器与PMI词共现求解器均答错的2,590题组成Challenge集，其余5,197题组成Easy集；项目同时发布1400万科学句子的ARC Corpus和公开基线。
build_method: 公版科学考试题收集, IR+PMI双失败难度筛选, 语料库构建
metric: 选择题准确率；求解器并列选择时按比例给分
eval_feature: 自然科学问答, 算法难度门禁, Easy/Challenge双集, 公开语料与基线
build_method_en: Public-domain science exam collection, IR-plus-PMI dual-failure filtering, corpus construction
eval_feature_en: Natural science QA, algorithmic difficulty gate, Easy/Challenge sets, public corpus and baselines
intro_en: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge) contains 7,787 natural, non-diagram multiple-choice science questions authored for human tests in grades 3-9. The 2,590 questions missed by both a Waterloo-corpus retrieval solver and a PMI word-co-occurrence solver form the Challenge Set; the remaining 5,197 form Easy. ARC also releases a 14-million-sentence science corpus and public baselines.
metric_en: Multiple-choice accuracy; fractional credit for tied solver selections
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1803.05457. ARC collects 7,787 natural, non-diagram, typically four-choice science questions authored for grades 3-9. A Waterloo-corpus information-retrieval solver and a PMI word co-occurrence solver answer every item: the 2,590 questions missed by both form the Challenge Set, while the remaining 5,197 form Easy. Challenge train/dev/test counts are 1,119/299/1,172; Easy counts are 2,251/570/2,376. The optional ARC Corpus uses about 100 hand-written search templates over 80 science topics plus AristoMini to produce 14M sentences, with sampled knowledge coverage near 95% of Challenge questions. IR, PMI, BiDAF, DecompAttn, and DGEM baselines are scored by one point for a correct option with fractional credit for tied selections, and the dataset, corpus, models, and leaderboard are publicly released.

name: ARC-AGI
intro: 本条目对应《ARC Prize 2025技术报告》的ARC-AGI系列总览，而不是单一数据集版本。报告总结ARC-AGI-2全球竞赛的1,455支队伍、15,154次提交和24.03%私有集最高分，分析逐题refinement loop成为主导方法、知识覆盖与新型污染限制，并预告转向交互式推理的ARC-AGI-3。
build_method: 年度基准演进, 全球开放竞赛, 获奖方法与污染风险分析
metric: 私有集Pass@2准确率, 每题成本
task_type: 抽象推理, 交互式任务
eval_feature: 少样本新任务泛化, Refinement Loop, 私有集验证, 成本效率
scale: ARC Prize 2025：1,455支队伍，15,154次提交，240道竞赛评测题
build_method_en: Annual benchmark evolution, open global competition, winning-method and contamination-risk analysis
eval_feature_en: Few-shot novel-task generalization, refinement loops, private-set verification, cost efficiency
intro_en: This entry is the ARC-AGI series overview from the ARC Prize 2025 technical report, not a single dataset version. The report covers 1,455 teams, 15,154 submissions, and a 24.03% top private-set score on ARC-AGI-2; analyzes per-task refinement loops as the dominant method and knowledge coverage plus new contamination risks; and previews ARC-AGI-3's move to interactive reasoning.
scale_en: ARC Prize 2025: 1,455 teams, 15,154 entries, 240 competition evaluation tasks
metric_en: Private-set Pass@2 accuracy, cost per task
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.10904, the ARC Prize 2025 technical report. This umbrella diagram deliberately uses the report's competition and method-analysis lens rather than duplicating ARC-AGI-2 construction. It preserves human-created unique tasks, Core Knowledge, two attempts, the report's 400 imported public-training plus 120 semi-private and 120 private competition view, 1,455 teams, 15,154 entries, 90 paper submissions, NVARC's 24.03% private score at $0.20 per task, evolutionary-program, weight-space, and application-layer refinement loops, exploration-verification feedback, knowledge-coverage dependence, contamination risk, and the ARC-AGI-3 exploration/planning/memory/goal/alignment preview.

name: ARC-AGI-1
intro: ARC-AGI-1依据对象性、目标导向、数量和初等几何/拓扑等核心知识先验，人工设计每题逻辑独立的彩色整数网格任务。原始公开集含400个训练和400个评测任务，后续ARC Prize增加100个半私有与100个私有任务；2019论文允许每个测试输入3次尝试，后续排行榜常用Pass@2。
build_method: 核心知识先验定义, 人工设计抽象网格任务, 公开与私有划分
metric: 像素级精确任务准确率；2019论文3次尝试，后续ARC Prize Pass@2
eval_feature: 少样本归纳, 抽象网格推理, 未见任务适应, 防泄漏私有评测
scale: 原始公开集800题（400训练+400评测）；后续增加100半私有+100私有
build_method_en: Core-knowledge-prior definition, manually designed abstract grid tasks, public and private splits
eval_feature_en: Few-shot induction, abstract grid reasoning, adaptation to unseen tasks, private anti-leakage evaluation
intro_en: ARC-AGI-1 manually designs colored integer-grid tasks with independent logic around Core Knowledge priors such as objectness, goal-directedness, numbers, and elementary geometry/topology. The original public corpus has 400 training and 400 evaluation tasks; ARC Prize later added 100 semi-private and 100 private tasks. The 2019 paper allows three trials per test input, while later leaderboards commonly use Pass@2.
scale_en: Original public 800 (400 train + 400 eval), later plus 100 semi-private and 100 private
metric_en: Pixel-exact task accuracy; 3 trials in the 2019 paper, later ARC Prize Pass@2
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1911.01547 Part III, the official fchollet/ARC-AGI repository, and the ARC Prize 2024 evaluation layers. The diagram preserves skill-acquisition efficiency and developer-aware generalization; the four Core Knowledge prior groups; majority-manual, non-shared-generator task authorship; 1×1 to 30×30 grids with values 0-9; typically three demonstrations and one test pair; the original 400 training plus 400 evaluation tasks; later 100 semi-private plus 100 private tasks; program-synthesis interpretation; construction of dimensions and every cell; all-test-pairs pixel-exact scoring; and the protocol boundary between the 2019 paper's three trials with binary feedback and later ARC Prize Pass@2.

name: ARC-AGI-2
intro: ARC-AGI-2延续少量网格示例到测试输出的格式，新增多规则/多步骤组合、情境规则和上下文内符号定义任务。407名参与者在515个会话中产生13,405次测试对尝试；每道评测题均被至少2人在2次内解出。发布1,000题未校准训练集及公开、半私有、私有各120题校准评测集。
build_method: 高认知复杂度任务策划, 人类可解性筛选, 评测集难度校准
metric: Pass@2像素级精确任务准确率, 每题成本
eval_feature: 符号解释, 组合推理, 情境规则, 人类校准, 效率评测
scale: 1,000训练任务, 公开/半私有/私有评测各120题
build_method_en: Higher-cognitive-complexity task curation, human solvability filtering, calibrated evaluation splits
eval_feature_en: Symbolic interpretation, compositional reasoning, contextual rules, human calibration, efficiency evaluation
intro_en: ARC-AGI-2 preserves the few-demonstration-grid to test-output format while adding multi-rule and multi-step composition, contextual rules, and in-context symbol definitions. Its study records 13,405 test-pair attempts from 407 people in 515 sessions; every evaluation task was solved by at least two people within two attempts. The release has 1,000 uncalibrated training tasks and 120 calibrated tasks in each of the public, semi-private, and private evaluation sets.
scale_en: 1,000 training tasks plus 120 each public, semi-private, and private evaluation tasks
metric_en: Pass@2 pixel-exact task accuracy, cost per task
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.11831 Sections 4, 5, 7.1, 8.1, and 8.2 plus the official ARC-AGI-2 dataset description. The diagram preserves newly authored plus unused-reserve sources, deliberate over-generation, compositional and contextual task design, 407 participants / 515 sessions / 1,848 unique test pairs / 13,405 attempts, the at-least-two-solvers within-two-attempts gate, empirical difficulty and redundancy handling, the uncalibrated 1,000-task training set, three calibrated 120-task evaluation sets, two independent external solvers plus an additional internal reviewer, 2-5 demonstration pairs, 30×30 and ten-color bounds, the four-L4 / 12-hour / no-internet evaluation of 240 unseen tasks, two predictions, pixel-exact Pass@2, private ranking, and cost per task.

name: Arena-Hard
intro: Arena-Hard 通过BenchBuilder从Chatbot Arena众包查询中去重并过滤非英文和多轮内容，进行嵌入、UMAP与HDBSCAN主题聚类，再按特异性、复杂度等7项质量维度筛选并从250个簇各取2题形成500条困难提示，最后以成对LLM裁判和Bradley-Terry模型汇总胜率。
build_method: 众包查询清洗, 主题聚类, 七维质量评分, 困难提示采样
task_type: 开放式对话, 指令跟随
eval_feature: 真实用户困难提示, BenchBuilder, 成对LLM裁判, 风格控制
build_method_en: Crowdsourced-query cleaning, topic clustering, seven-axis quality scoring, hard-prompt sampling
eval_feature_en: Real-user hard prompts, BenchBuilder, pairwise LLM judging, style control
intro_en: Arena-Hard uses BenchBuilder to deduplicate Chatbot Arena queries, remove non-English and multi-turn content, cluster prompts with embeddings, UMAP, and HDBSCAN, score seven quality dimensions, and sample two prompts from each of 250 clusters to form 500 hard prompts. Pairwise LLM judgments are aggregated with a Bradley-Terry model.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.11939 and the official Arena-Hard-Auto repository. BenchBuilder starts from 200,000 Chatbot Arena queries; removes duplicates, multi-turn conversations, and non-English content; creates 4,000 topics with text-embedding-3-small, UMAP, and HDBSCAN; and uses GPT-4-Turbo to score seven required skills. Prompts below 6 and clusters with mean below 5 are discarded, then two prompts are sampled from each of 250 randomly selected clusters to form 500 items. Pairwise judgments swap A/B positions, yielding 1,000 judgments per model, and Bradley-Terry aggregation reports win rates and bootstrap confidence intervals with optional style controls.

name: Arena-Hard v2
intro: Arena-Hard v2 是 LMArena 从 Chatbot Arena 真实用户查询中构建的高难度开放式对话基准，包含 500 条通用高难提示和 250 条创意写作提示。官方流程缓存候选与参考模型回答，分别使用风格控制或双评判器集成进行成对比较，并以胜率及 bootstrap 置信区间发布结果。
build_method: Chatbot Arena 真实用户查询筛选, 高难与创意写作双分区, 成对 LLM 评判
metric: 成对胜率, Bootstrap 置信区间
task_type: 开放式对话, 指令跟随
eval_feature: LLM-as-a-judge, 长度与 Markdown 风格控制, 双评判器集成
scale: 750条提示（500条高难提示 + 250条创意写作提示）
build_method_en: Chatbot Arena real-user query curation, separate hard and creative-writing splits, pairwise LLM judging
eval_feature_en: LLM-as-a-judge, response-length and Markdown style control, two-judge ensemble
intro_en: Arena-Hard v2 is LMArena's difficult open-ended dialogue benchmark built from real Chatbot Arena user queries, with 500 general hard prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts. The official workflow caches candidate and reference answers, applies style-controlled or two-judge-ensemble pairwise evaluation, and reports win rates with bootstrap confidence intervals.
scale_en: 750 prompts (500 hard prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts)
metric_en: Pairwise win rate, bootstrap confidence interval
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the Arena-Hard-Auto paper arXiv:2406.11939 and the official Arena-Hard v2.0 repository workflow: fresh challenging Chatbot Arena queries; a 500-prompt hard split covering software, mathematics, and other real-world problems; a separate 250-prompt creative-writing split; cached candidate and reference-system answers; Gemini 2.5 as the official hard-split judge with GPT-4.1 as the fast stable alternative; response length and Markdown density as style-control features; independent GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.5 creative-writing judgments combined as an ensemble; candidate-better, tie, and reference-better pairwise outcomes; hard-split style-controlled aggregation; win rates with bootstrap confidence intervals; and separability plus agreement-with-human-preference quality checks.

name: Arena-Hard-Auto
intro: Arena-Hard-Auto 是一个自动化构建的基准测试，它利用 BenchBuilder 流水线从大规模众包数据（如 Chatbot Arena）中筛选出500个具有挑战性的开放式提示。该基准旨在通过LLM作为裁判进行自动化评估，以衡量和区分前沿语言模型的性能，并确保与人类偏好高度相关。
build_method: 混合, 众包, LLM生成
build_method_en: Hybrid, Crowdsourcing, LLM Generation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: Arena-Hard-Auto is an automatically constructed benchmark that uses the BenchBuilder pipeline to select 500 challenging open-ended prompts from large-scale crowdsourced data such as Chatbot Arena. This benchmark aims to measure and differentiate the performance of state-of-the-art language models through automated evaluation with LLMs as judges, ensuring high correlation with human preferences.

name: Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0
intro: Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0 从Chatbot Arena收集新鲜真实查询，形成500条困难开放式提示和250条创意写作提示；被测回答与基线回答由GPT-4.1或Gemini-2.5成对评判，并在胜率汇总时控制长度和Markdown等风格特征。
build_method: Chatbot Arena真实查询筛选, 困难与创意写作子集, 自动成对裁判
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 真实困难提示, 创意写作, GPT-4.1与Gemini-2.5裁判, 风格控制
scale: 750条提示：500条困难查询, 250条创意写作
build_method_en: Chatbot Arena real-query filtering, hard and creative-writing subsets, automatic pairwise judging
eval_feature_en: Fresh hard prompts, creative writing, GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5 judges, style control
intro_en: Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0 draws fresh real-world queries from Chatbot Arena, producing 500 difficult open-ended prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts. GPT-4.1 or Gemini-2.5 compares evaluated and baseline responses, and win-rate aggregation controls response length and Markdown style features.
scale_en: 750 prompts: 500 hard queries and 250 creative-writing queries
drawio_review_note: The construction backbone is aligned with arXiv:2406.11939, while v2.0-specific details are aligned with the official LMArena repository because no separate v2.0 paper was found. The repository specifies two distinct Chatbot Arena sets: 500 fresh hard real-world queries and 250 creative-writing queries. The official hard-prompt configuration uses Gemini-2.5 as judge, with GPT-4.1 documented as an alternative; creative writing uses independently inferred GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5 judgments as an ensemble. Results are reported by category with bootstrap intervals, and the hard leaderboard controls Markdown and response-length features.

name: ART
intro: ART（Action-based Reasoning Task）从真实 EHR 格式数据中挖掘检索、24 小时聚合与阈值/条件推理失败场景，生成并临床审核 600 个任务，用于在实时 FHIR 环境中评测医疗 AI Agent。
build_method: 真实EHR场景挖掘, 失败模式定向合成, 临床人在回路审核
metric: 精确匹配成功率（检索、24小时聚合、阈值/条件推理分项）
eval_feature: 实时FHIR交互, 无状态评测, 失败模式分项, 精确匹配
scale: 600个任务（检索、聚合、阈值/条件推理各200个），覆盖11种化验代码
build_method_en: Real-EHR scenario mining, failure-targeted synthesis, clinical human-in-the-loop audit
eval_feature_en: Live FHIR interaction, stateless evaluation, failure-mode breakdowns, exact match
intro_en: ART (Action-based Reasoning Task) mines retrieval, 24-hour aggregation, and threshold/conditional failures from real EHR-formatted data, then generates and clinically audits 600 tasks for evaluating medical AI agents in a live FHIR environment.
scale_en: 600 tasks (200 each for retrieval, aggregation, and threshold/conditional reasoning) across 11 lab codes
metric_en: Exact-match success rate by retrieval, 24-hour aggregation, and threshold/conditional category
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.08988 Sections 2-4. The workflow preserves the MedAgentBench failure analysis; 50,000 EHR observations from 695 patients; retrieval rules across 11 lab codes; 24-hour aggregation with at least three readings; seven threshold ranges and demographic rules; 200 tasks per category; authentic clinical values with synthetic phrasing only; automatic source-EHR checks; representative clinical HITL review; stateless temperature-0 FHIR R5 evaluation; and exact-match success rates for GPT-4o-mini and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

name: ArtifactsBench
intro: ArtifactsBench 针对大型语言模型生成的动态交互式视觉作品提出评测基准，弥补传统基准只关注算法正确性而忽视视觉质量和交互性的不足。该框架自动渲染生成作品并通过时间序列截图捕捉动态行为，实现多模态自动评测。
build_method: 多源候选聚合, 两阶段去重, 专家重写与难度校准, 检查表构建, MLLM裁判与人工验证
metric: Checklist-guided Score, Pair ACC, WebDev Arena Rank Alignment
modality: 文本, 图像, 代码, 多模态
eval_feature: 动态交互, 多模态, 自动化
build_method_en: Multi-source Aggregation, Two-stage Deduplication, Expert Rewriting and Difficulty Calibration, Checklist Construction, MLLM Judging and Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Interaction, Multimodal, Automated
intro_en: ArtifactsBench proposes an evaluation benchmark for dynamic interactive visual works generated by large language models, addressing the limitation of traditional benchmarks that focus solely on algorithmic correctness while neglecting visual quality and interactivity. The framework automatically renders generated works and captures dynamic behaviors through time-series screenshots, enabling multimodal automatic evaluation.
metric_en: Checklist-guided Score, Pair ACC, WebDev Arena Rank Alignment

name: ArXivMath
intro: ArXivMath 是 MathArena 按月更新的研究级数学最终答案基准。它从上一个月新发布的 arXiv 数学论文中生成候选问题，经自动过滤、人工审查和论文作者复核后发布，使用符号解析、LLM 交叉检查与人工仲裁评估模型答案。
build_method: 按月抓取 arXiv 数学论文, LLM 生成候选问题, 自动过滤, 人工审查, 论文作者复核
metric: 最终答案准确率（4次运行取平均）, 推理成本
eval_feature: 按月动态更新, 研究级数学, 污染缓解, 符号等价判定
scale: 每月约200个候选问题，经筛选后发布约30题
build_method_en: Monthly arXiv mathematics ingestion, LLM candidate generation, automated filtering, human review, and paper-author review
eval_feature_en: Monthly dynamic refresh, research-level mathematics, contamination mitigation, symbolic-equivalence grading
intro_en: ArXivMath is MathArena's monthly research-level final-answer mathematics benchmark. Candidate questions are generated from mathematics papers published on arXiv in the previous month, then pass automated filtering, human review, and paper-author review before release; answers are graded with symbolic parsing, LLM cross-checks, and human adjudication.
scale_en: About 200 candidate questions per month, filtered to about 30 released questions
metric_en: Final-answer accuracy averaged over four runs, inference cost
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.00674 Sections 2-4 and the MathArena ArXivMath methodology: monthly collection of the previous month's arXiv mathematics papers; Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview candidate generation from titles and abstracts; roughly 200 candidates per month; automated checks for self-containment, missing context, guessability, explicit AI use, and author expertise; DeepSeek-OCR-2 paper conversion to recover assumptions; manual and paper-author review; release of roughly 30 questions per month; four default-parameter runs without tools; SymPy-based final-answer parsing with model restatement for formatting errors; LLM cross-checking and human adjudication of disagreements; and accuracy, cost, and monthly-version reporting.

name: ASPERA
intro: ASPERA 通过开发者与 LLM 交互生成用户查询、参考动作执行程序（AEP）、状态初始化程序（SIP）和断言式评测程序（EP）。Asper-Bench 含 250 个经人工执行和修订的任务，用于测试模型在自定义助理库上合成可正确执行程序的能力。
build_method: 人机交互式LLM程序生成, 动态模拟, 人工执行与修订
metric: 任务成功率（无错误执行且全部EP断言通过）, 原语选择微平均F1
eval_feature: 可执行程序, 功能断言, CCK/原语选择设置, 模拟状态副作用
scale: 250个任务（71个信息查询、179个状态修改），7个数据库、69个原语
build_method_en: Interactive human-LLM program generation, dynamic simulation, human execution and correction
eval_feature_en: Executable programs, functional assertions, CCK/primitive-selection settings, simulated state effects
intro_en: ASPERA uses developer-LLM interaction to generate a user query, reference Action Execution Program (AEP), State Initialization Program (SIP), and assertion-based Evaluation Program (EP). Asper-Bench contains 250 human-executed and corrected tasks that test program synthesis over a custom assistant library.
scale_en: 250 tasks (71 information-seeking, 179 state-mutating) over 7 databases and 69 primitives
metric_en: Task success rate (error-free execution and all EP assertions pass), primitive-selection micro F1
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.15501 Sections 2-6 and the official Apple repository. The workflow preserves the 7-database/69-primitive assistant library; developer focus or human-authored queries; GPT-4o with five in-context examples per program type; query+AEP, SIP, and EP generation; developer execution/editing; conditional branch coverage and multiple acceptable outcomes; lead-author correction plus two-annotator confirmation; the 71 information-seeking and 179 state-mutating tasks; CCK and primitive-selection settings; and the paper's error-free execution plus all-assertions task-success rule.

name: AstaBench
intro: AstaBench 是一个用于评估科学研究 Agent 的可复现套件，由 11 个基准、2,404 道验证与测试题组成，覆盖文献理解、代码与执行、数据分析、端到端发现四类能力。它提供受控的 Asta 科学语料检索与有状态 Python Notebook 环境，并在统一框架下比较 22 类共 57 个 Agent 的任务表现、成本与工具配置。
build_method: 已部署 Asta 产品需求驱动, 既有与新建科学评测整合, 答案可验证性过滤, 受控工具环境
metric: 基准特定准确率/完成率, 标准差, 美元成本, 准确率-成本 Pareto 前沿
task_type: Agent任务, 代码生成, Data Analysis
eval_feature: 领域特定, 过程导向, 工具增强, 成本归一化, 工具配置分层
scale: 2,404道验证与测试题，覆盖11个基准和4类科学研究能力
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.21652 sections on AstaBench and the Asta Environment: product-informed tasks from deployed Asta agents plus existing and newly constructed scientific evaluations; exactly 2,404 validation/test questions across 11 benchmarks in literature understanding, code and execution, data analysis, and end-to-end discovery; modification or filtering of cited datasets for answerability with standard tools; the MCP Asta Scientific Corpus with date cutoffs or paper-ID constraints; a stateful Python notebook sandbox with a five-minute per-cell limit; Inspect benchmark implementations and the agent-eval suite; frozen LiteLLM dollar-cost accounting including cache discounts; tooling-based agent categories to expose confounders; nine science-optimized Asta classes plus general and external baselines; and 57 agents across 22 classes reported with task scores, uncertainty, cost, and accuracy-cost Pareto comparisons.
task_type_en: Agent Task, Code Generation, Data Analysis
build_method_en: Deployed-Asta product needs, integration of existing and new scientific evaluations, answerability filtering, controlled tool environments
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, process-oriented, tool-augmented, cost-normalized, tooling-stratified
intro_en: AstaBench is a reproducible scientific-research agent suite containing 2,404 validation and test questions across 11 benchmarks and four capability groups: literature understanding, code and execution, data analysis, and end-to-end discovery. It supplies controlled Asta scientific-corpus search and stateful Python notebook environments, then compares task performance, cost, and tool configurations for 57 agents across 22 classes.

name: AthenaBench-Mini
intro: AthenaBench-Mini 是从 8,100 题完整 AthenaBench 中抽取的 950 题网络威胁情报基准，覆盖 CTI 知识测试、攻击技术枚举、根因映射、风险缓解、漏洞严重性预测和威胁组织归因六类任务。作者以任务特定比例生成 10 个候选子集，并选择整体模型表现最接近完整基准的随机种子。
org: Rochester Institute of Technology, Athena Security Group
build_method: 权威 CTI 与实时漏洞数据整合, GPT-5 生成与双模型筛查, 人工修订, 代表性分层抽样
metric: 准确率（CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA）, 多标签 F1（RMS）, 归一化 MAD 准确率（VSP）, Combined Score
eval_feature: 六类 CTI 任务, 动态威胁数据, 多指标评分, 完整集排名保持抽样
build_method_en: Authoritative CTI and live vulnerability data integration, GPT-5 generation with two-model screening, human repair, representative stratified sampling
eval_feature_en: Six CTI tasks, dynamic threat data, multi-metric scoring, full-benchmark ranking-preserving subset selection
intro_en: AthenaBench-Mini is a 950-item cyber-threat-intelligence benchmark selected from the 8,100-item full AthenaBench. It covers CTI knowledge testing, attack-technique enumeration, root-cause mapping, risk mitigation, vulnerability-severity prediction, and threat-actor attribution; ten task-rate-specific candidate subsets are generated and the seed whose aggregate model performance most closely matches the full benchmark is retained.
scale_en: 950 items (CKT 300, ATE 100, RCM 200, RMS 100, VSP 200, TAA 50)
metric_en: Accuracy (CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA), multi-label F1 (RMS), normalized MAD accuracy (VSP), combined score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.01144 Sections 3-5 and the official AthenaBench repository: authoritative MITRE ATT&CK, CWE, CAPEC, CISA, STIX/TAXII, GDPR, NVD/CVE/CVSS, APT-report, and security-blog inputs; GPT-5 generation of five-option CKT questions for experienced CTI analysts; GPT-5 plus Gemini flagging followed by human inspection; six full-benchmark task counts totaling 8,100; task-specific Mini rates of 10% for CKT/RCM/VSP, 20% for ATE/RMS, and 50% for TAA; ten random seeds with selection by closest aggregate model performance to the complete benchmark; the exact 950-item Mini breakdown; evaluation of 12 proprietary and open-source LLMs at temperature zero where supported; task accuracy for CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA, multi-label F1 for RMS, CVSS parsing with normalized 1 - MAD / 7.7 for VSP; and a uniform-percentage combined score.

name: AudioMC
intro: Audio MultiChallenge 是面向端到端语音对话系统的自然多轮基准，覆盖推理记忆、指令保持、自洽性和语音编辑四个能力轴。它包含 47 名说话人录制的 452 段、共 15 小时对话与 1,712 条原子评分标准，并用固定上下文协议隔离最终轮回答能力。
build_method: Agentic 失败蓝图生成, 无脚本人类多轮录音, 原子二元评分标准, 三级质量审核
metric: 平均通过率（APR）, 平均评分标准得分（ARS）
eval_feature: 多轮, 长文本, 语音编辑
scale: 452段对话，47名说话人，15小时音频，1,712条评分标准
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.14865 sections on Audio MultiChallenge construction: extending text MultiChallenge with audio-native Inference Memory, Instruction Retention, Self Coherence, and Voice Editing axes; sampling axis-topic-persona seeds; running the Planner/Tester/TTS/Target-Audio-LM loop to extract human-friendly failure blueprints; collecting 3-8 turn unscripted human recordings; writing final-turn atomic binary rubrics; applying trained reviewer, independent QC, and research-team audit; releasing 452 conversations from 47 speakers with 1,712 rubrics; and evaluating with a fixed-context protocol, base64 audio histories, LLM-as-judge, APR, and ARS.

It contains 452 conversations, 15 hours of audio from 47 speakers, and 1,712 atomic rubrics, and uses a fixed-context protocol to isolate final-turn response capability.
