name: AutoCodeBench
intro: AutoCodeBench是一个大规模代码生成基准，包含3920个问题，均匀分布在20种编程语言中。它旨在评估大型语言模型在具有挑战性、多样化和实用性的多语言任务上的表现。该基准利用名为AutoCodeGen的自动化方法生成，通过LLM与多语言沙箱的交互来创建高质量的测试用例，无需人工标注。
build_method: Stack-Edu种子, LLM-沙箱逆向生成, 三阶段质量与多样性过滤
build_method_en: Stack-Edu seeds, LLM-sandbox reverse generation, three-stage quality and diversity filtering
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: AutoCodeBench is a large-scale code generation benchmark containing 3,920 problems evenly distributed across 20 programming languages. It aims to evaluate large language models on challenging, diverse, and practical multilingual tasks. The benchmark is generated using an automated method called AutoCodeGen, which creates high-quality test cases through interactions between LLMs and multilingual sandboxes, requiring no manual annotation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.09101 sections on AutoCodeGen and AutoCodeBench construction: extracting function/class/file-level Stack-Edu seeds from real GitHub educational code, refining them into self-contained DeepSeek-V3 code solutions, generating public example tests and private edge-case tests, executing solution-input pairs in a multilingual sandbox to obtain outputs, reverse-generating programming problems under six specifications, filtering with DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite ten-sample difficulty control, DeepSeek-R1 LLM-as-Critic checks, and cyclic diversity sampling, producing 3,920 problems across 20 languages, estimating quality with 6 professional annotators, and evaluating models with Pass@1 and a standardized code-block system prompt.

name: AutoCodeBench-V2
intro: AutoCodeBench-V2于2025年12月4日由腾讯官方发布：它从原始AutoCodeBench数据出发，经顶级闭源模型与沙箱反馈迭代精炼为1,000道更高质量题目。2026年2月17日修正版为998题，覆盖20种编程语言，难度分布为简单136题、中等217题、困难645题。原始论文未定义V2，因此本条目用官方V2说明与评测教程补足论文后的版本流程。
build_method: 原始AutoCodeBench, 顶级闭源模型迭代精炼, V2沙箱反馈, 官方执行验证
build_method_en: Original AutoCodeBench, iterative refinement with top proprietary models, V2 sandbox feedback, official executable verification
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: Tencent officially released AutoCodeBench-V2 on December 4, 2025. Starting from the original AutoCodeBench data, top proprietary models and sandbox feedback iteratively refined it into 1,000 higher-quality problems. The February 17, 2026 bug-fixed snapshot contains 998 problems across 20 programming languages: 136 easy, 217 medium, and 645 hard. Because the original paper predates and does not define V2, this entry uses the official V2 announcement and evaluation tutorial to cover the post-paper version workflow.
drawio_review_note: Evidence-bounded review using arXiv:2508.09101, the official AutoCodeBench homepage news, the official AutoCodeBench-V2 README/tutorial, and tencent/AutoCodeBenchmark data. The paper documents AutoCodeGen and the original 3,920-problem benchmark but predates V2. The official December 4, 2025 announcement states that V2 starts from the original data and is iteratively refined through top proprietary models and sandbox feedback into 1,000 higher-quality problems. The initial file has 136 easy, 218 medium, and 646 hard records; the February 17, 2026 bug-fixed file has 998 records split 136/217/645 across 20 languages. Direct exact-question audits found zero overlap between either V2 file and the original 3,920 questions. The official quick start replaces each output field using a required fenced-code prompt, runs hunyuansandbox/multi-language-sandbox:v2, and verifies with call_sandbox.py at concurrency 32.

name: AutomationBench
intro: AutomationBench 是 Zapier 提出的跨应用 REST API 智能体基准。它从真实自动化工作流模式出发合成并强化任务，在 47 个应用、约 500 个端点组成的确定性模拟世界中，检验智能体能否自主完成可验证的业务状态变更。基准包含 600 个公开任务和 600+ 个私有留出任务。
build_method: 真实工作流模式提炼、LLM 辅助任务合成、专家审计与确定性模拟
metric: 严格任务通过率（全有或全无）, 平均美元成本
task_type: Agent任务, 跨应用工作流, REST API工具调用
eval_feature: 跨应用, 自主API发现, 策略遵循, 确定性终态验证
scale: 600个公开任务 + 600+个私有留出任务；6个业务领域；47个应用；约500个API端点
task_type_en: Agent Task, Cross-Application Workflow, REST API Tool Use
build_method_en: Real Workflow Pattern Mining, LLM-Assisted Task Synthesis, Expert Auditing, Deterministic Simulation
eval_feature_en: Cross-Application, Autonomous API Discovery, Policy Adherence, Deterministic End-State Verification
intro_en: AutomationBench is Zapier's cross-application REST-API agent benchmark. It synthesizes and hardens tasks from real automation workflow patterns, then tests whether an agent can autonomously produce verifiable business-state changes in deterministic simulated worlds spanning 47 apps and about 500 endpoints. The benchmark contains 600 public tasks and more than 600 private held-out tasks.
scale_en: 600 public tasks + 600+ private held-out tasks; 6 business domains; 47 apps; about 500 API endpoints
metric_en: Strict all-or-nothing task pass rate, average USD cost
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.18934 and Zapier's official AutomationBench methodology: real negative-feedback workflow patterns without customer PII; six business domains; candidate-task synthesis with Opus 4.6, GPT-5.3 Codex, and Gemini 3; hardening through distractors, hidden information, near-name ambiguity, and layered policies; deterministic task contracts and repeated audits; 600 public plus 600+ private tasks; simulated worlds covering 47 apps and about 500 endpoints; BM25 top-five API-schema search plus execute calls; a 50-step autonomous limit; final-state positive and negative assertions; all-or-nothing task scoring; and pass-rate plus average-cost leaderboard reporting.

name: BABE
intro: BABE（Biology Arena BEnchmark）是一个综合性基准，旨在评估生物AI系统的实验推理能力。该基准独特地构建于同行评审的研究论文和真实世界的生物学研究，确保任务反映了实际科学探究的复杂性和跨学科性质。BABE挑战模型进行因果推理和跨尺度推理，提供了一个评估AI系统能否像科学家一样进行推理的框架，从而更真实地衡量其对生物学研究的贡献潜力。
build_method: 领域专家命题、资深专家多轮审核、LLM辅助难度筛选
metric: 平均正确率, 强相关子集正确率, 弱相关子集正确率, 多次采样增益与收敛性
eval_feature: 因果推理, 跨尺度推理
scale: 论文未披露最终题目总数；每个来源构建三题组；覆盖12个生物学子领域；45%强相关、55%弱相关
build_method_en: Domain-Expert Authoring, Multi-Round Senior-Expert Review, LLM-Assisted Difficulty Filtering
eval_feature_en: Causal Reasoning, Cross-scale Reasoning
intro_en: BABE (Biology Arena BEnchmark) is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the experimental reasoning abilities of biological AI systems. Uniquely built on peer-reviewed research papers and real-world biological studies, it ensures tasks reflect the complexity and interdisciplinary nature of actual scientific inquiry. BABE challenges models with causal and cross-scale reasoning, providing a framework to assess whether AI systems can reason like scientists, thereby more accurately measuring their potential contribution to biological research.

name: BABILong
intro: BABILong基准用于测试语言模型在极长文档中跨事实推理的能力。包含20种多样的推理任务，如事实链、简单归纳、演绎、计数及列表/集合处理。这些任务本身具有挑战性，且当所需事实分散在长文本中时难度更大。

eval_feature_en: Long Context, Contamination-free, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: BABILong extends the 20 synthetic bAbI reasoning tasks by hiding their ordered facts among naturally ordered PG19 book sentences. It provides reproducible context-length splits from 0K to 10M tokens and evaluates direct long-context models, chunk- and sentence-retrieval RAG, and curriculum-trained recurrent-memory models, including selected extrapolation experiments up to 50M tokens.

name: BackendBench
intro: BackendBench 是 Meta PyTorch 发布的开放评测套件，用于衡量模型或人类能否为 PyTorch 算子编写正确且高效的后端实现。它用 OpInfo 边界样例验证正确性，并用真实 Hugging Face 模型追踪得到的 TorchBench 张量形状评估性能。
build_method: OpInfo边界用例与真实模型张量追踪, 统一算子映射, 多测试套件执行验证
metric: Operator Correctness Pass Rate, Geometric Mean Speedup, Perf@p
task_type: 后端实现, 代码生成
eval_feature: 先正确性后性能, PyTorch eager参考实现, 真实模型形状, 全算子通过判定
scale: 271个OpInfo正确性算子, 124个性能算子; 平均13个OpInfo与110个TorchBench测试/算子
build_method_en: OpInfo edge cases and real-model tensor traces, unified operator mapping, multi-suite execution validation
eval_feature_en: Correctness before performance, PyTorch eager reference, real-model shapes, all-tests operator verdict
intro_en: BackendBench is an open Meta PyTorch evaluation suite for measuring whether models or humans can implement correct and fast PyTorch operator backends. It validates correctness with OpInfo edge cases and measures performance on TorchBench tensor shapes traced from real Hugging Face models.
scale_en: 271 OpInfo correctness operators, 124 performance operators; averages of 13 OpInfo and 110 TorchBench tests per operator
metric_en: Operator Correctness Pass Rate, Geometric Mean Speedup, Perf@p
drawio_review_note: BackendBench has no standalone benchmark paper. The diagram is aligned to the official Meta PyTorch repository, README, docs/correctness.md, and executable suite structure. It preserves the 271-operator OpInfo correctness set, 124-operator performance set, real Hugging Face model tensor traces, OpInfo edge cases, op_map alias coverage, torch.library dispatch, smoke/OpInfo/TorchBench/Facto suites, PyTorch-reference comparison with equal_nan and 1e-2 tolerances, all-tests operator verdict, synchronized do_bench timing, correctness-gated performance, geometric-mean speedup, and Perf@p reporting.

name: BBQ
intro: BBQ（Bias Benchmark for Question Answering）是技术报告中反复引用的问答偏见评测，用于检查模型在不同社会属性语境下是否产生偏见回答。
build_method: 有出处的偏见模板手写, 四条件扩展, 五人一致性验证
build_method_en: Sourced bias-template writing, four-condition expansion, five-rater agreement validation
intro_en: BBQ, the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering, is repeatedly cited in the technical reports as a QA bias benchmark for checking whether models produce biased answers across social contexts.

name: Belebele
intro: Belebele 是 Qwen3 报告中列出的多语言阅读理解 benchmark，用于比较模型跨语言理解能力。
build_method: FLORES段落, 英文MCQ迭代构建, 专家人工翻译与校对
build_method_en: FLORES passages, iterative English MCQ construction, expert human translation and proofreading
intro_en: Belebele is a multilingual reading-comprehension benchmark listed in Qwen3 reports for comparing cross-lingual understanding.

name: BenchCAD
intro: BenchCAD 是工业程序化 CAD 推理基准，包含 106 个零件族的 17,900 个执行验证 CadQuery 程序。它以四个配套任务评估多视图到代码、视觉问答、代码问答和指令式代码编辑。
build_method: 领域专家零件族生成器, 工业标准与约束采样, 沙箱执行验证, 四视图人工复核
metric: Execution Rate, Voxel IoU, Chamfer, Hausdorff, Feature F1, QA Accuracy, Normalized Edit Improvement
eval_feature: 执行验证, 工业标准零件族, 几何与参数联合评测, 盲基线控制
scale: 17,900个程序, 106个零件族; 4,800条QA记录; 748个编辑对
build_method_en: Domain-expert family generators, industrial standards and constrained sampling, sandbox execution validation, four-view human review
eval_feature_en: Execution verification, industry-standard part families, joint geometry and parameter evaluation, blind controls
intro_en: BenchCAD is an industrial programmatic-CAD reasoning benchmark with 17,900 execution-verified CadQuery programs across 106 part families. Four matched tasks evaluate multi-view-to-code generation, visual QA, code QA, and instruction-guided code editing.
scale_en: 17,900 programs, 106 part families; 4,800 QA records; 748 edit pairs
metric_en: Execution Rate, Voxel IoU, Chamfer, Hausdorff, Feature F1, QA Accuracy, Normalized Edit Improvement
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.10865 and the official BenchCAD project. The diagram preserves expert-authored deterministic CadQuery family generators, 106 families, 52 standard-anchored families covering 47 industrial standards, constrained parameter sampling, sandbox rejection for parse/import/runtime/timeout/degenerate failures, four canonical renders and expert sign-off, and the code/STEP/views/parameters/operation-list artifact bundle. It separately traces the 17,900-program core, 2,400 QA pairs expanded to 4,800 VisionQA/CodeQA records, 748 verified CodeEdit pairs, four task protocols, geometry/feature/QA/edit metrics, and blind-control interpretation.

name: BeyondAIME
intro: BeyondAIME 是 Seed1.5-Thinking 报告提出的 100 题高难数学推理测试集，用于缓解年度 AIME 仅 30 题造成的高方差。数学专家编写原创题，并对既有竞赛题做结构与场景重构；最终题目均为无固定范围的整数答案，难度达到或超过最难 AIME 题。

name: BeyondSWE
intro: BeyondSWE 将软件工程智能体评测扩展到知识范围与修改范围更广的任务，包含 246 个 GitHub 仓库中的 500 个实例：CrossRepo 200 题、DomainFix 72 题、DepMigrate 178 题、Doc2Repo 50 题。四类数据分别经过候选漏斗与任务专用专家复核，再共享智能体辅助 Docker 构建、五次稳定性检查和最终质量审计；提交结果在纯净容器中独立验证。
org: Renmin University of China, AweAI Team
build_method: 四类任务候选挖掘、任务专用专家复核、智能体辅助 Docker、五次稳定性验证
metric: Resolved Rate; Doc2Repo Pass Rate, (Almost) Correct Count
task_type: 软件工程, 跨仓库修复, 代码迁移, 仓库生成
eval_feature: 跨仓库推理、领域知识、依赖迁移、全仓库生成、纯净容器验证
scale: 500 个实例，246 个仓库（200 CrossRepo、72 DomainFix、178 DepMigrate、50 Doc2Repo）
intro_en: BeyondSWE expands software-engineering agent evaluation along broader knowledge and resolution scopes with 500 instances from 246 GitHub repositories: 200 CrossRepo, 72 DomainFix, 178 DepMigrate, and 50 Doc2Repo. Each family uses a task-specific candidate funnel and expert review before shared agent-assisted Docker construction, five-run stability inspection, and final quality auditing; submissions are independently verified in fresh containers.
build_method_en: Four-Setting Candidate Mining, Task-Specific Expert Review, Agent-Assisted Docker, Five-Run Stability Validation
metric_en: Resolved Rate; Doc2Repo Pass Rate, (Almost) Correct Count
task_type_en: Software Engineering, Cross-repository Fixing, Code Migration, Repository Generation
eval_feature_en: Cross-Repository Reasoning, Domain Knowledge, Dependency Migration, Full-Repository Generation, Fresh-Container Verification
scale_en: 500 instances, 246 repositories (200 CrossRepo, 72 DomainFix, 178 DepMigrate, 50 Doc2Repo)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.03194 Sections 3.1-3.5. The diagram corrects the legacy flow's repository-count/instance-count confusion and records 200 CrossRepo issues across 67 repositories, 72 DomainFix issues across 12 repositories, 178 DepMigrate issues across 120 repositories, and 50 Doc2Repo tasks, totaling 500 unique instances across 246 repositories. It preserves task-specific candidate funnels and expert checks, agent-assisted Docker construction, five-run P2P/F2P or reference-test stability, five senior SWE plus five senior-PhD auditing, fresh-container verification, test restoration and future-history removal, and the distinct issue-family versus Doc2Repo metrics.

name: BIG-Bench Hard
intro: BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) 是一个为推动大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力评估极限而设计的新基准。它通过引入比BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) 更具挑战性的新任务，解决了现有基准测试饱和的问题。该基准的评估结果表明，即便是最先进的模型在通用推理能力上仍有巨大的提升空间。
metric: Accuracy, Exact Match, Harmonic Average Accuracy
eval_feature: 思维链, 零样本, 少样本
build_method_en: Hybrid (Expert Construction, Adaptation of Existing Datasets)
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot, Few-shot
intro_en: BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) is a new benchmark designed to push the limits of large language models' (LLM) reasoning capabilities. By introducing tasks more challenging than those in BIG-Bench Hard (BBH), it addresses the saturation issue of existing benchmarks. Evaluation results show that even state-of-the-art models have significant room for improvement in general reasoning ability.
metric_en: Accuracy, Exact Match, Harmonic Average Accuracy

name: BigCodeBench
intro: BigCodeBench 是一个评测大型语言模型（LLMs）处理复杂实用编程任务能力的基准。它要求模型调用多种库函数，超越简单算法题。该基准包含自然语言指令变体，显示当前模型在复杂指令和精确函数使用上仍有不足，指明未来研究方向。
build_method: ODEX种子, GPT-4合成与重构, 人工筛选, 可执行沙箱验证
eval_feature: 领域特定
build_method_en: ODEX seeds, GPT-4 synthesis and refactoring, human curation, executable sandbox validation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: BigCodeBench is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' (LLMs) ability to handle complex, practical programming tasks. It requires models to invoke various library functions, going beyond simple algorithm problems. The benchmark includes natural language instruction variants, highlighting current models' limitations in handling complex instructions and precise function usage, and indicating directions for future research.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.15877 Sections 2 and 4. BigCodeBench starts from ODEX intent/code skeletons sourced from Stack Overflow, uses gpt-4-0613 with two demonstrations to synthesize tasks, replaces semantic entry points with dummy names, back-translates docstrings, and AST-validates 4,718 drafts. Thirteen annotators supervise Code Interpreter while it refactors PEP-257 docstrings and writes/runs unittest cases; invalid programs are removed to leave 1,223 task-test pairs. Human curation then proceeds through deterministic-test repair, GPT-3.5 pre-evaluation, seven-annotator cross-checking, doctest/program analysis, and sandbox workflows; 32 of 33 sampled human solutions pass. BigCodeBench-Complete contains 1,140 tasks using 139 libraries across seven domains, averaging 5.6 tests and 99% branch coverage. Rule-based prompt transformation plus five-author alignment review creates BigCodeBench-Instruct, and executable evaluation reports Pass@1.

name: BigOBench
intro: BigOBench 是一个新颖的编程基准，用于评估生成式语言模型理解和生成满足时间与空间复杂度约束代码的能力。它弥补了现有评测忽视计算复杂度理解的空白。该基准提供工具，通过性能分析推断任意Python函数的算法复杂度，包括人类或模型生成的代码。
build_method: Code Contests正确解筛选, 输入扩展, 沙箱性能剖析, 非负最小二乘拟合, 人工复杂度验证
metric: Pass@k, Best@k, All@k, Coefficient Percentile Ranking
build_method_en: Correct Code Contests Solution Filtering, Input Expansion, Sandbox Profiling, Non-negative Least-squares Fitting, Human Complexity Validation
eval_feature_en: Measured Time and Space Complexity, Constraint-aware Generation
intro_en: BigOBench is a novel programming benchmark designed to evaluate generative language models' ability to understand and generate code that meets time and space complexity constraints. It addresses the gap in existing evaluations that overlook computational complexity understanding. The benchmark provides tools to infer the algorithmic complexity of any Python function through performance analysis, applicable to both human- and model-generated code.
metric_en: Pass@k, Best@k, All@k, Coefficient Percentile Ranking

name: BioASQ

It also preserves Task 1b's 29 development and 282 test questions, four question types, gold documents/concepts/snippets/RDF triples/exact and ideal answers, Phase A output limits and retrieval metrics, Phase B use of gold Phase A evidence, exact-answer metrics, and ROUGE plus biomedical-expert assessment for ideal answers.

name: BioMysteryBench

task_type: 生物信息学任务, 科学问答
eval_feature: Bash代码执行, 包管理器安装依赖, 多步生物信息学工作流, 仅披露汇总结果
build_method_en: Internally constructed; task sources, counts, splits, and Verified inclusion rules are undisclosed
eval_feature_en: Bash execution, package-manager dependency installation, multi-step bioinformatics workflows, aggregate-only reporting
intro_en: BioPipelineBench Verified is an internal bioinformatics-workflow evaluation reported in Anthropic system cards. It covers targeted and long-read sequence analysis, metagenome assembly, and chromatin profiling, with Bash and package managers available for multi-step execution; task scale, construction, and exact Verified scoring rules are not public.
drawio_review_note: Aligned only to information disclosed in Anthropic system cards. The diagram includes the named workflow domains—targeted and long-read sequence analysis, metagenome assembly, and chromatin profiling—the isolated environment, Bash execution, package-manager installation, multi-step workflow completion, collected outputs, Verified aggregate scoring, and system-card comparison. It explicitly marks task sources, counts, splits, packaging, verification criteria, submission schema, rubrics, and partial-credit rules as undisclosed; no unsupported build details are inferred.

name: BIRD-SQL
intro: BIRD-SQL是一个大规模、跨领域的文本到SQL基准测试，包含12,751个文本-SQL对和95个数据库，总计33.4 GB，覆盖37个专业领域。该基准测试的重点是处理真实世界中的挑战，例如不干净的数据库内容、需要外部知识才能回答的自然语言问题，以及在大规模数据库中SQL查询的效率。
org: The University of Hong Kong, DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group, Tsinghua University, Shanghai AI Laborator
build_method: 95个真实数据库收集与描述, 受训众包提问, 外部知识记录, 双盲SQL标注, 专家执行复核
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格, SQL
build_method_en: 95 Real-database Collection and Description, Trained Crowdsourced Questions, External-knowledge Evidence, Double-blind SQL Annotation, Expert Execution Review
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: BIRD-SQL is a large-scale, cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark containing 12,751 text-SQL pairs and 95 databases totaling 33.4 GB across 37 professional fields. It focuses on real-world challenges such as noisy database content, natural language questions requiring external knowledge, and the efficiency of SQL queries on large-scale databases.

name: BLINK
intro: BLINK是一个针对多模态大语言模型（LLMs）的新基准，专注于其他评估中未发现的核心视觉感知能力。它将14个经典的计算机视觉任务重新格式化为3,807个多项选择题，并配有单张或多张图像和视觉提示。BLINK旨在刺激社区帮助多模态LLMs赶上人类水平的视觉感知。
org: University of Pennsylvania, University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, University of California Davis, Columbia University
build_method: 经典视觉任务改写、既有数据集复用、新数据采集、人工去歧义质检
eval_feature: 零样本
build_method_en: Classic-Vision Task Recasting, Dataset Reuse, New Data Collection, Manual Ambiguity Review
eval_feature_en: Zero-Shot, Visual Prompting, Single/Multi-Image, Human and Specialist Baselines
intro_en: BLINK is a new benchmark for multimodal large language models (LLMs) that focuses on core visual perception abilities not captured by other evaluations. It reformats 14 classic computer vision tasks into 3,807 multiple-choice questions, accompanied by single or multiple images and visual prompts. BLINK aims to encourage the community to help multimodal LLMs reach human-level visual perception.

name: Blueprint-Bench
intro: Blueprint-Bench 通过把约 20 张公寓室内照片重建为二维平面图，评估通用模型的空间智能。数据包含 50 套公寓，提交图按九项四色规则标准化，再用房间连通图、大小排序、门数量与方向的加权相似度评分。
build_method: 公寓房源照片与官方平面图, 九项四色格式规范, 确定性计算机视觉结构抽取
metric: Weighted Floor-Plan Similarity (Edge Jaccard, Degree Correlation, Density, Room/Door Counts, Door Orientation)
task_type: 多图空间重建, 平面图生成, Agent绘图
eval_feature: 模型无关输出, 确定性图结构评分, LLM/图像模型/Agent同台比较, 人类与随机基线
scale: 50套公寓, 每套约20张室内照片; 人类基线使用12套子集
task_type_en: Multi-image spatial reconstruction, floor-plan generation, agent drawing
build_method_en: Apartment-listing photos and official floor plans, nine-rule four-color format, deterministic computer-vision structure extraction
eval_feature_en: Model-agnostic output, deterministic graph scoring, shared LLM/image-model/agent comparison, human and random baselines
intro_en: Blueprint-Bench evaluates general-model spatial intelligence by reconstructing a 2D floor plan from about 20 interior apartment photographs. It contains 50 apartments; submissions follow nine four-color rules and are scored by a weighted similarity over room connectivity, size ranking, and door counts and orientations.
scale_en: 50 apartments, about 20 interior photos each; human baseline on a 12-apartment subset
metric_en: Weighted Floor-Plan Similarity (Edge Jaccard, Degree Correlation, Density, Room/Door Counts, Door Orientation)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.25229 and the official Andon Labs evaluation page. The diagram preserves collection of 50 apartment listings with about 20 interior photos each, adaptation of official floor plans, all nine black/green/red/white rendering rules, private-majority data handling with public code and sample, separate image-model, SVG-generating LLM, and Linux-agent paths, deterministic red-center detection and flood-fill segmentation, green-door and area extraction, size-ranked room graph JSON, the six similarity components, the exact 50/20/10/10/5/5 weighting, the 12-apartment human baseline, the no-image random baseline, and public leaderboard comparison.

name: BoolQ
intro: BoolQ是一个自然语言是非问答数据集。其问题是在无提示、无约束的自然场景下产生的，因此具有相当的挑战性。这些问题通常涉及复杂的非事实信息，需要模型具备强大的推理能力才能正确解答。
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Web Crawling
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot, Few-shot
intro_en: BoolQ is a natural language yes/no question answering dataset. Its questions are generated in unconstrained, natural scenarios without prompts, making it quite challenging. These questions often involve complex non-factual information, requiring models to have strong reasoning abilities to answer correctly.

name: BRIGHT-Pro
intro: BRIGHT-Pro 是面向推理密集型检索的专家标注基准。它在 BRIGHT 的 StackExchange 子集上，把 739 个查询分解为带权重的推理方面，并在 526,319 篇统一语料中标注方面级证据；评测同时覆盖静态检索和固定 175 查询的 agentic search。
org: Yale University, National University of Singapore, NYU Shanghai
build_method: 领域专家方面分解与加权, 原正例复核, 网页证据扩充, 双人独立复核
metric: alpha-nDCG@k, Weighted Aspect Recall, NDCG, Recall, Aspect Coverage, Overall Quality, AER
task_type: 检索, Agent搜索, 证据综合
eval_feature: 方面多样性感知的静态检索, 固定轮次与自适应停止的Agentic search, 引用证据综合
scale: 739个查询, 7个领域, 526,319篇统一语料; 175查询agentic子集
build_method_en: Field-expert aspect decomposition and weighting, original-positive re-audit, web evidence expansion, independent second review
eval_feature_en: Aspect-diversity-aware static retrieval, fixed-round and adaptive-stop agentic search, citation-grounded synthesis
intro_en: BRIGHT-Pro is an expert-annotated benchmark for reasoning-intensive retrieval. Built from the BRIGHT StackExchange subset, it decomposes 739 queries into weighted reasoning aspects and annotates aspect-level evidence in a unified corpus of 526,319 documents; evaluation covers static retrieval and agentic search on a fixed 175-query subset.
scale_en: 739 queries, 7 domains, 526,319-document unified corpus; 175-query agentic subset
metric_en: alpha-nDCG@k, Weighted Aspect Recall, NDCG, Recall, Aspect Coverage, Overall Quality, AER
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Start from BRIGHT StackExchange reasoning-intensive retrieval queries"] --> B["Field experts decompose each information need into compact reasoning aspects"]
    B --> C["Assign Likert importance scores and normalize them into aspect weights"]
    C --> D["Re-audit original BRIGHT positives, assign them to aspects, discard weak passages, and merge overlaps"]
    D --> E["Collect new aspect-relevant positive documents through web or AI-assisted search"]
    E --> F["Clean pages, remove boilerplate, manually trim noise, and segment multi-aspect pages into aspect-specific positives"]
    F --> G["Iteratively refine aspect schemas and run second-annotator checks for aspects, weights, and evidence credibility"]
    G --> H["Evaluate static retrieval with alpha-nDCG, weighted aspect recall, NDCG, and recall"]
    G --> I["Evaluate retrievers inside an LLM agentic search loop with citation-grounded answer judging"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从BRIGHT的StackExchange推理密集检索查询出发"] --> B["领域专家将每个信息需求分解为紧凑的推理aspect"]
    B --> C["给aspect分配Likert重要性分并归一化为权重"]
    C --> D["重新审核原BRIGHT正例，分配到aspect，丢弃弱相关段落并合并重叠内容"]
    D --> E["通过网页或AI辅助搜索收集新的aspect相关正例文档"]
    E --> F["清理页面、去除模板噪声、人工裁剪，并把多aspect页面切成aspect级正例"]
    F --> G["迭代修订aspect结构，并由第二标注员检查aspect、权重和证据可信度"]
    G --> H["用alpha-nDCG、加权aspect召回、NDCG和Recall做静态检索评估"]
    G --> I["把检索器接入LLM agentic搜索循环，并用带引用答案评判最终质量"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.04018. The diagram follows the paper's BRIGHT StackExchange starting point; seven-domain, 739-query sampling; expert aspect decomposition, rationales, Likert-to-normalized weights, original-positive re-audit, overlap merging, search expansion, FireCrawl cleaning, aspect-level segmentation, iterative schema refinement, and independent same-field second review. It also distinguishes static evaluation on the 526,319-document unified corpus from the fixed 175-query agentic subset, including fixed/adaptive rounds, top-5 search results per round, GPT-5 judging, aspect coverage, overall quality, and AER.

name: BrowseComp
intro: BrowseComp是一个用于衡量AI代理浏览网页能力的基准。它包含1266个具有挑战性的问题，需要代理在互联网上持续导航以寻找难以发现的信息。尽管问题困难，但答案简短且易于验证，使其成为一个简单易用的评测工具。
build_method_en: Manually Constructed
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn
intro_en: BrowseComp is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' web browsing capabilities. It includes 1,266 challenging questions that require agents to continuously navigate the internet to find hard-to-discover information. Despite the difficulty, the answers are brief and easy to verify, making it a straightforward and user-friendly evaluation tool.

name: BrowseComp-Plus
intro: BrowseComp-Plus 把原始 BrowseComp 的 1,266 个问答对转为 830 个证据链经人工验证的查询，并配套 100,195 篇固定去重语料、Evidence/Gold qrels 和困难负样本。它可在相同语料上解耦分析检索器、Agent 推理、引用和上下文工程。
build_method: o3证据挖掘, 14人超过400小时人工验证, GPT-4o子查询分解, Google困难负样本挖掘
metric: Answer Accuracy, Recall, Search Calls, Citation Precision/Recall, Evidence/Gold Recall@5/100/1000, NDCG@10
task_type: Agent任务, 开放式问答, 事实验证
eval_feature: 固定语料可复现评测, 检索与Agent解耦, BM25/稠密/Oracle对比, 引用落地性
scale: 830个验证查询, 100,195篇去重文档; 平均6.1篇Evidence、76.28篇困难负样本、2.9篇Gold/查询
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.06600 and the official repository. The diagram preserves the 1,266 original BrowseComp pairs, o3 clue/URL/snippet mining, filtering to 1,142 queries with initial evidence, fourteen annotators spending over 400 hours with over 80% agreement, the final 830 verified queries, separate Evidence and Gold document labels, GPT-4o decomposition into about seven sub-queries, Google Search API hard-negative mining, the fixed 100,195-document corpus and per-query averages, BM25/Qwen3-Embedding/ReasonIR/Oracle retrieval, top-5 results truncated to 512 tokens, optional full-document access, iterative cited answering, answer accuracy/recall/search calls, citation precision/recall, Evidence and Gold Recall@5/100/1000, and NDCG@10.
task_type_en: Agent Task, Open-ended QA, Fact Verification
build_method_en: o3 evidence mining, over 400 hours of verification by 14 annotators, GPT-4o sub-query decomposition, Google hard-negative mining
eval_feature_en: Reproducible fixed corpus, retriever-agent disentanglement, BM25/dense/oracle comparison, citation grounding
intro_en: BrowseComp-Plus converts 1,266 original BrowseComp question-answer pairs into 830 human-verified evidence-chain queries backed by a fixed corpus of 100,195 deduplicated documents, Evidence/Gold qrels, and hard negatives. It supports controlled, component-level analysis of retrieval, agent reasoning, citations, and context engineering.

name: C-Eval
intro: C-Eval是一个全面的中文评测套件，用于评估基础模型在中文环境下的高级知识和推理能力。它包含13948道覆盖52个学科和四个难度等级的多项选择题。C-Eval Hard是其子集，专注于需要高级推理能力的挑战性学科。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tsinghua University, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technolo
build_method: 考试题, 专家构建
eval_feature: 零样本, 少样本, 思维链
build_method_en: Exam Questions, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: C-Eval is a comprehensive Chinese evaluation suite designed to assess foundational models' advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities in Chinese contexts. It includes 13,948 multiple-choice questions across 52 subjects and four difficulty levels. C-Eval Hard is a subset focusing on challenging subjects that require advanced reasoning skills.

name: C^3-Benchmark
intro: C3-Bench 是面向 LLM Agent 多任务鲁棒性的开源基准。五角色框架生成 256 条单任务和 768 条相关多任务数据，并以复杂工具依赖、关键隐藏信息和可变决策轨迹三项挑战，诊断上下文与策略变化如何影响 Agent。
build_method: 五角色LLM生成框架, 目标轨迹与隐藏策略采样, 启发式Checker, 五位专家多轮复核
metric: Accuracy, Accomplish Progress, Optimal Path Rate, Policy Transition Frequency, Volatility Factor, Debiased Descent Direction
task_type: 多任务Agent, 工具调用, 上下文依赖, 决策轨迹鲁棒性
eval_feature: 完整有效路径枚举, 增量决策树匹配, Omit/Reference/Long控制, Challenge 2/3配对比较
scale: 256条单任务, 768条多任务; 2-4个相关任务; 336种策略切换类型; 49个Agent
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.18746v4 and the official Tencent Hunyuan repository. The diagram preserves real-user-log analysis as design evidence while stating that test data are not copied from logs; the User/Planner/AI Agent/Tool/Checker framework and fifteen subtypes; desired-trajectory and four-policy sampling; serial, parallel, and mixed multi-tool forms; HunYuan-Series user generation, HunYuan-TurboS execution generation, Omit/Reference/Long hiding; Checker heuristic review; five-expert self-check, cross-check, and senior review; 256 single-task and 768 multi-task entries with 336 policy-switch types; DFS topological enumeration and incremental decision-tree matching; correct-history isolation in Challenge 2; injected action-observation histories in Challenge 3; and Accuracy, AP, OP Rate, PTF, VF, and DDD across 49 agents.
task_type_en: Multi-task agent, tool calling, context dependency, decision-trajectory robustness
build_method_en: Five-role LLM generation framework, target-trajectory and hiding-strategy sampling, heuristic Checker, multi-stage review by five experts
eval_feature_en: Complete valid-path enumeration, incremental decision-tree matching, Omit/Reference/Long controls, paired Challenge 2/3 comparison
intro_en: C3-Bench is an open benchmark for LLM-agent robustness under multi-tasking. A five-role framework generates 256 single-task and 768 related multi-task examples, while three controlled challenges isolate complex tool dependencies, critical hidden information, and variable decision trajectories.

    I --> J(C^3-Benchmark Dataset)
    J --> K[Agent Robustness Evaluation]
    K --> L[Performance Analysis]
    L --> M(Evaluation Results)

metric_en: Accuracy, Accomplish Progress, Optimal Path Rate, Policy Transition Frequency, Volatility Factor, Debiased Descent Direction

    B["Use HunYuan-Series LLMs with few-shot examples to generate user questions across policy types"] --> C["Generate execution processes using HunYuan-TurboS with multi-role framework controlling tool dependencies"]

    E["Collect all policy type switch combinations to ensure uniform distribution across challenges"] --> F["Evaluate 49 agents on tool dependency navigation with fine-grained trajectory correctness metrics"]
    F["Evaluate 49 agents on tool dependency navigation with fine-grained trajectory correctness metrics"] --> G["Measure robustness by comparing accuracy across information hiding strategies and task numbers"]
    G["Measure robustness by comparing accuracy across information hiding strategies and task numbers"] --> H["Inject correct execution history to assess impact of variable decision trajectories on agents"]

name: CC-OCR
intro: CC-OCR基准旨在全面评估大型多模态模型在光学字符识别（OCR）方面的能力。它涵盖了多场景文本阅读、多语言文本阅读、文档解析和关键信息提取四个核心OCR任务。该基准包含39个子集，共7,058张完全标注的图像，其中41%来源于真实应用场景并首次发布。CC-OCR通过多样化的场景、任务和挑战，旨在推动LMM在OCR中心任务上的持续进步。
org: Alibaba Group, South China University of Technology

eval_feature: 四条OCR赛道、任务专属输出格式与指标、多方向和重复诊断

intro_en: The CC-OCR benchmark aims to comprehensively evaluate large multimodal models' capabilities in optical character recognition (OCR). It covers four core OCR tasks: multi-scene text reading, multilingual text reading, document parsing, and key information extraction. The benchmark includes 39 subsets with a total of 7,058 fully annotated images, 41% of which come from real-world applications and are newly released. By offering diverse scenarios, tasks, and challenges, CC-OCR seeks to drive continuous progress of LMMs in core OCR tasks.

name: CCBench
intro: CCBench是一个用于评估AI编程代理在真实世界任务中表现的基准测试，这些任务基于小型代码库（<10k LoC），且不属于大型语言模型训练数据的一部分。所有任务均来源于CodeCrafters用户的私有提交，CodeCrafters是一个工程师通过从零开始实现流行软件来参与挑战的平台。
build_method: 私有CodeCrafters提交筛选、Harbor任务封装、员工手写测试、参考解与Oracle可解性验证
eval_feature: 私有来源降低训练污染、真实小型代码库、可执行官方测试、公开任务与日志
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official CodeCrafters CCBench repository (no standalone benchmark paper is published). The diagram preserves private CodeCrafters user submissions, real-world codebases under 10k LoC, detailed staged feature instructions and test information, Harbor task packaging, official staff-written test runners battle-tested by hundreds of thousands of users over four-plus years, a reference solution and oracle solvability check for every task, the current 187-task public release, Harbor CLI agent execution, binary verifier reward, aggregate success rate, and public evaluation logs.
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, process evaluation
intro_en: CCBench is a benchmark for evaluating AI programming agents on real-world tasks based on small codebases (<10k LoC) that are not part of large language model training data. All tasks come from private submissions by CodeCrafters users, a platform where engineers participate in challenges by implementing popular software from scratch.

name: CEdit-Bench
intro: CEdit-Bench 是 LongCat-Image 技术报告提出的中英双语图像编辑基准。它整合并扩展既有编辑基准、补充新策划数据，形成覆盖15个细粒度类别的1,464对样本，并用GPT-4o评价语义一致性、感知质量和总体表现。
build_method: 既有编辑基准整合扩展、新数据策划、中英双语配对、15类细粒度任务标注
metric: 语义一致性(G_SC), 感知质量(G_PQ), 总体得分(G_O)
eval_feature: 双语图像编辑、15类细粒度任务、GPT-4o自动评测
scale: 1,464对中英双语编辑样本，15个类别
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.07584 and the official meituan-longcat/CEdit-Bench dataset card. The diagram preserves the integration and extension of existing image-editing benchmarks, newly curated data for missing task diversity, semantically paired Chinese-English instructions, all 15 reported fine-grained categories, the published key/input_image/instruction_en/instruction_cn/task_type schema, the 1,464-pair MIT-licensed release, image-plus-instruction editing inference, GPT-4o judging, and the reported G_SC semantic-consistency, G_PQ perceptual-quality, and G_O overall views. It does not confuse the LongCat-Image training pipeline with benchmark construction.
build_method_en: Integration and Extension of Existing Editing Benchmarks, New Data Curation, Chinese-English Pairing, 15-category Fine-grained Annotation
eval_feature_en: Bilingual Image Editing, 15 Fine-grained Task Categories, GPT-4o Automated Evaluation
intro_en: CEdit-Bench is a bilingual Chinese-English image-editing benchmark introduced in the LongCat-Image technical report. It integrates and extends prior editing benchmarks with newly curated data, yielding 1,464 pairs across 15 fine-grained categories and GPT-4o evaluation of semantic consistency, perceptual quality, and overall performance.
metric_en: Semantic Consistency (G_SC), Perceptual Quality (G_PQ), Overall Score (G_O)

name: CF-Div2-Stepfun
intro: CF-Div2-Stepfun 是一个评测大型语言模型竞赛编程能力的基准，选取2024年9月至2025年2月的CodeForces Division 2比赛题目以防止数据泄露。基准采用严格的离线沙箱评分，包含大量边界和压力测试，全面检验模型表现。
build_method: 新近Codeforces Div.2题目筛选, 小规模与随机大规模测试, 对抗与hack用例, 压力测试验证
build_method_en: Recent Codeforces Div.2 Selection, Small and Randomized Large Tests, Adversarial and Hacked Cases, Stress-test Validation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: CF-Div2-Stepfun is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' coding abilities, using CodeForces Division 2 problems from September 2024 to February 2025 to prevent data leakage. It employs strict offline sandbox scoring and includes extensive boundary and stress tests to comprehensively assess model performance.

name: CFBench
intro: CFBench是一个针对大型语言模型（LLMs）的综合性约束遵循基准测试。它旨在评估LLMs理解和遵循自然语言指令中复杂约束的能力，弥补了现有评估在约束全面性和真实性方面的不足。该基准包含1,000个精心策划的样本，涵盖200多个真实场景和50多个NLP任务，并提出了一个创新的约束类型系统框架和多维度评估方法。
build_method: 真实指令过滤聚类、LLM原子约束提取扩展、10大类25+子类体系、专业标注与专家质检
eval_feature: 独立检查点、主需/次需优先级、GPT-4o逐项判断、简单/困难分层
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.01122 and the official PKU-Baichuan CFBench repository and evaluation code. The diagram preserves online-log and NLP-task sourcing, filtering and clustering to about 30,000 representative instructions, LLM-assisted extraction and expansion to more than 5,000 unique atomic constraints, the 10-primary and 25-plus-subcategory taxonomy, assessment and balancing into 2,000 refined instructions, professional refinement of instructions and gold answers, independent checklist criteria with primary/secondary priority, training/cross-validation/batch validation and expert QC, the 1,000-sample release with 500 easy and 500 hard items across 200-plus scenarios, 20 domains, and 50-plus NLP tasks, 2,048-token model generation, GPT-4o checkpoint judging at temperature zero, and the executable CSR mean, ISR all-checkpoints-pass, and priority-aware PSR logic reported for easy, hard, and full sets.
build_method_en: Real-instruction Filtering and Clustering, LLM Atomic-constraint Extraction and Expansion, 10/25+ Taxonomy, Professional Annotation and Expert QC
eval_feature_en: Independent Checkpoints, Primary/Secondary Priority, GPT-4o Per-criterion Judging, Easy/Hard Stratification
intro_en: CFBench is a comprehensive constraint-following benchmark for large language models (LLMs). It aims to evaluate LLMs' ability to understand and adhere to complex constraints in natural language instructions, addressing the limitations of existing evaluations in constraint comprehensiveness and realism. The benchmark includes 1,000 carefully curated samples covering over 200 real-world scenarios and more than 50 NLP tasks, and introduces an innovative constraint type system framework along with a multidimensional evaluation approach.

name: CFEval
intro: CFEval 是 Qwen3-VL 技术报告中与 LiveCodeBench v6、OJBench 并列的代码评测。公开报告仅给出数值分数，未披露任务来源、规模、执行协议、评估器或评分公式，也未找到独立的 CFEval 论文或公开数据集。

name: CG-Bench
intro: CG-Bench是一个针对长视频理解中线索溯源问答的新型基准测试。它旨在解决现有基准主要关注短视频或依赖多项选择题的局限性，这些局限性可能导致模型在没有真正理解视频内容的情况下给出答案。CG-Bench强调模型检索相关线索的能力，包含1,219个手动策划的视频和12,129个问答对，涵盖感知、推理和幻觉三种主要问题类型。该基准还引入了线索溯源的白盒和黑盒评估方法，以全面评估模型对长视频的理解能力。
org: Nanjing University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University, Zhejiang University
build_method: 互联网长视频人工采集与七轮筛选, QAC与时间线索人工标注, GPT-4文本可答过滤, MLLM稀疏帧难度过滤

task_type: 长视频多选问答, 时间线索定位, 可信度评测, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 完整视频/线索片段对照, 白盒时间定位, 黑盒CRR, 线索辅助GPT-4o开放问答
scale: 1,219个长视频, 12,129个QAC三元组, 14,362个线索区间
build_method_en: Manual Internet Long-video Collection and Seven-round Review, QAC and Temporal-clue Annotation, GPT-4 Text-only Filtering, MLLM Sparse-frame Difficulty Filtering
eval_feature_en: Full-video/Clue-clip Contrast, White-box Temporal Grounding, Black-box CRR, Clue-aided GPT-4o Open-ended QA
intro_en: CG-Bench is a novel benchmark for clue tracing question answering in long video understanding. It addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks that mainly focus on short videos or rely on multiple-choice questions, which may lead models to answer without truly understanding the video content. CG-Bench emphasizes models' ability to retrieve relevant clues and includes 1,219 manually curated videos and 12,129 QA pairs, covering three main question types: perception, reasoning, and hallucination. The benchmark also introduces white-box and black-box clue tracing evaluation methods to comprehensively assess models' understanding of long videos.

name: CharacterEval

intro: ChartQA是一个大规模基准测试，旨在评估模型对图表进行视觉和逻辑推理的能力。它包含9.6K个人工编写的问题以及23.1K个从人工编写的图表摘要中生成的问题。该基准测试通过结合视觉特征和图表数据表来回答问题，以解决视觉和逻辑推理的独特挑战。

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2203.10244, Sections 3.1-3.2 and 5.1. ChartQA crawls 20,882 real-world charts from Statista, Pew Research, Our World in Data, and OECD, retaining images and, where available, underlying tables, metadata, SVG files, descriptions, and chart-element boxes. For ChartQA-H, AMT workers write two visual or compositional QA pairs per chart, a second worker answers them, exact agreements are accepted, and disagreements are manually resolved; the final 9,608 questions split into 7,398 train, 960 validation, and 1,250 test. For ChartQA-M, two SQuAD-tuned T5 models extract answers and generate answer-aware questions from Statista summaries; items whose answers are absent from the chart table are filtered, a 1,250-item sample is audited, and the test set is manually cleaned. The 23,111 machine questions split into 20,901/960/1,250. Evaluation uses exact match for non-numeric answers and a 5% relaxed tolerance for numeric answers.

name: ChartQAPro
intro: ChartQAPro 是面向真实复杂图表的图表问答基准，包含来自 99 个在线来源的 1,341 张图表和 1,948 道经人工复核的问题，覆盖推理、对话、选择、假设、事实核验和不可回答场景。
org: York University, Mila, QCRI, NTU, Salesforce Research
build_method: 多来源真实图表收集, 九人标注, 多VLM辅助扩展, 双人独立复核与协商修订
metric: Enhanced Relaxed Accuracy（精确匹配、5%数值容差、ANLS）
eval_feature: 真实图表多样性, 图表-段落联合理解, 多题型, 不可回答问题
build_method_en: Multi-source Real-chart Collection, Nine-annotator QA Creation, Multi-VLM-assisted Expansion, Independent Dual-annotator Review and Consensus Revision
eval_feature_en: Real-world Chart Diversity, Chart-text Reasoning, Multiple QA Types, Unanswerable Questions
intro_en: ChartQAPro evaluates question answering over complex real-world charts. It contains 1,341 charts from 99 online sources and 1,948 human-reviewed questions spanning reasoning, conversational, multiple-choice, hypothetical, fact-checking, and unanswerable settings.
metric_en: Enhanced Relaxed Accuracy (Exact Match, 5% Numeric Tolerance, ANLS)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ChartQAPro (Findings of ACL 2025), Section 3.1 and Figure 3. The final ACL version collects charts by web crawling and Google search from 99 online sources, manually filters for visual and topical diversity, preserves metadata such as URLs and alt text, and retains 1,341 charts. Nine team members create five QA families; five focus on reasoning while four cover the remaining categories. Annotators write seed pairs, use GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude to generate five new pairs per seed and additional interactive candidates, then remove simple questions and revise ambiguous or incorrect items. A second annotator independently answers each item; disagreements are collaboratively resolved, with sub-1-percent differences accepted for subjective estimates. The final 1,948 questions include unanswerable and chart-text cases. Evaluation uses exact match for multiple-choice, fact-checking, and year answers; 5-percent relative tolerance for other numeric answers; and ANLS for text, aggregated as enhanced relaxed accuracy. The 99-source count follows the final ACL paper rather than the earlier arXiv abstract's 157-source claim.

name: CharXiv
intro: 图表理解在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）应用于分析科学论文或财务报告等实际任务中扮演着关键角色。现有数据集常侧重于过度简化和同质化的图表，导致对模型进展的评估过于乐观。CharXiv是一个全面的评估套件，包含2,323个来自arXiv论文的自然、具有挑战性和多样化的图表。它包括描述性问题和推理问题，所有图表和问题均由人类专家精心挑选、整理和验证。
org: Princeton Language and Intelligence (PLI), Princeton University, University of Wisconsin, Madison, T
build_method: arXiv科学图表筛选, 研究生人工标注, 专家核验
metric: GPT-4o裁判准确率（人工参考答案）
task_type: 开放式描述问答, 图表推理问答
eval_feature: 描述与推理双任务, 每图3道可回答描述题+1道不可回答题+1道推理题, 人类基线
build_method_en: arXiv Scientific-chart Filtering, Graduate-student Annotation, Expert Verification
eval_feature_en: Descriptive and Reasoning Tracks, Three Answerable plus One Unanswerable Descriptive Question per Chart, One Reasoning Question per Chart, Human Baseline
intro_en: Chart understanding plays a crucial role in applying multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to real-world tasks such as analyzing scientific papers or financial reports. Existing datasets often focus on overly simplified and homogeneous charts, leading to overly optimistic assessments of model progress. CharXiv is a comprehensive evaluation suite containing 2,323 natural, challenging, and diverse charts sourced from arXiv papers. It includes both descriptive and reasoning questions, with all charts and questions carefully selected, curated, and validated by human experts.
metric_en: GPT-4o-judged Accuracy with Human Reference Answers

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.18521 and the NeurIPS 2024 paper, dataset-construction and evaluation sections. The authors download arXiv preprints from eight academic subjects from January 2020 through September 2023, extract and re-render figures, then apply SigLIP chart prefiltering, graduate-student selection for visual diversity, pairwise-similarity deduplication, and removal of blurry or unclearly labeled charts. The 2,323 retained charts split into 1,000 validation and 1,323 test charts. Each chart receives four descriptive questions selected from 19 templates across information extraction, enumeration, pattern recognition, counting, and compositionality; three are answerable and one is intentionally unanswerable, totaling 9,292. Each chart also receives one manually written, definite-answer reasoning question, totaling 2,323. Human experts verify charts, questions, and answers. Zero-shot responses are graded by GPT-4o against human references; a 400-item audit reports 98.5-percent agreement with human grading. Human baselines under the same instructions are 80.5 percent for reasoning and 92.1 percent for descriptive questions.

name: Chatbot Arena
intro: Chatbot Arena 是实时众包的匿名模型对战平台：用户向两个隐藏身份的模型提交同一段多轮对话并投票，系统经过内容与异常行为过滤后，用成对偏好统计生成公开排行榜。
build_method: 实时匿名双模型对战, 众包成对偏好投票, 内容与异常用户过滤, 自适应采样
metric: Bradley–Terry score, win rate, confidence interval
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 实时开放问题, 多轮对话, 人工偏好, 匿名模型对, 专家一致性验证
scale: 论文快照超过240,000张选票, 600个主题簇
build_method_en: Live Anonymous Pairwise Battles, Crowdsourced Preference Votes, Content and Anomalous-user Filtering, Adaptive Pair Sampling
eval_feature_en: Live Open-ended Prompts, Multi-turn Dialogue, Human Preference, Anonymous Model Pairs, Expert-agreement Validation
intro_en: Chatbot Arena is a live crowdsourced platform for anonymous model battles. Users send the same multi-turn conversation to two identity-hidden models and vote; filtered pairwise preferences are then converted into a public ranking.
scale_en: More than 240,000 votes in the paper snapshot, 600 topic clusters
metric_en: Bradley–Terry Score, Win Rate, Confidence Interval
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.04132, Sections 3-7. Users accept terms that permit public data release, submit live prompts to an anonymous model pair, may continue multi-turn dialogue until they can decide, and vote for model A, model B, tie, or both are bad. Each record contains both conversations and the vote. Pair sampling is non-uniform and increasingly favors similarly performing models to improve sample efficiency. The pipeline filters prompts containing model or company identity terms, flags unsafe requests, and detects anomalous users with repetitive, meaningless, or strategic behavior. The paper snapshot contains more than 240,000 votes. Validation clusters prompts into 600 diverse long-tail topics and blindly re-labels 160 battles with graduate-student experts, observing 72-to-83-percent crowd-expert agreement. Ranking estimates the pairwise win matrix, fits reweighted Bradley–Terry coefficients using inverse pair-sampling probabilities, uses sandwich covariance and confidence intervals, and publishes the resulting approximate rank and win rates.

name: ChemBench
intro: ChemBench 是自动化化学知识与推理评测框架，包含 2,788 道人工或半自动整理的问题，并通过主题、技能和难度标签、模型适配提示、稳健答案解析及化学专家基线比较模型能力。
org: LAMA Lab and international chemistry collaborators
build_method: 人工与半自动问题整理, 双科学家复核, 自动结构检查, 化学语义标注
task_type: 科学问答, 化学推理
eval_feature: 知识、推理、计算与直觉, 主题和难度分层, 工具增强系统, 化学专家基线
scale: 2,788道题（2,544道选择题, 244道开放题）, Mini子集236题
build_method_en: Manual and Semi-programmatic Question Curation, Two-scientist Review, Automated Schema Checks, Chemical-semantic Annotation
eval_feature_en: Knowledge, Reasoning, Calculation, and Intuition; Topic and Difficulty Stratification; Tool-augmented Systems; Chemist Baseline
intro_en: ChemBench is an automated framework for evaluating chemical knowledge and reasoning. Its 2,788 manually or semi-programmatically curated questions are labeled by topic, skill, and difficulty and evaluated through model-aware prompting, robust parsing, and comparison with chemistry experts.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Nature Chemistry 17 (2025), Methods: Curation workflow and Model evaluation workflow, and arXiv:2404.01475. ChemBench combines 1,039 manually curated questions from novel authoring, university exams, exercises, and question banks with 1,749 semi-programmatically generated questions from curated chemical data, yielding 2,788 items: 2,544 multiple-choice and 244 open-ended. Contributions enter through GitHub pull requests in a BIG-bench-style schema with chemical semantic annotations and a BIG-bench canary string. Before merge, each item is reviewed by at least two scientists beyond the original curator and passes automated schema checks, then receives topic, skill, and difficulty labels. ChemBench-Mini selects 236 diverse questions, retains advanced items, and balances topic-skill combinations. Evaluation accepts any text-returning model or tool-augmented system, applies model-specific templates and chemical notation normalization, runs greedy decoding at temperature zero, and parses answer tags, choices, scientific numbers, and word-numbers with regex before an LLM fallback. A web survey of 19 chemistry experts on Mini provides the human baseline; results compare strict correctness and verbalized confidence and are published by topic and skill.

name: CheXBench
intro: CheXBench是用于评估胸部X光图像理解的综合基准，涵盖图像感知、图像-文本推理和文本生成等八种不同任务类型，旨在推动胸部X光AI模型的开发和临床应用。
org: Stanford Center for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and Imaging
build_method: 35类胸片任务定义, 32个公开数据集工程化, 官方划分隔离, 八任务评测集整合
metric: Accuracy, mIoU/mAP, CheXbert-F1, BERTScore, RadGraph-F1, ROUGE-L
task_type: 多选题, 问答, 文本生成
eval_feature: 胸部X光图像理解, 图像-文本推理, 文本生成，八种任务类型
scale: 三条评测轴, 八类任务；训练背景含32个公开数据集与850万条CheXinstruct三元组
build_method_en: 35-task CXR Taxonomy, Engineering of 32 Public Datasets, Official-split Isolation, Eight-task Evaluation Integration
eval_feature_en: chest X-ray image understanding, image-text reasoning, text generation, eight task types
intro_en: CheXBench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating chest X-ray image understanding, covering eight different task types including image perception, image-text reasoning, and text generation. It aims to advance the development and clinical application of chest X-ray AI models.
scale_en: Three evaluation axes and eight task types; training context includes 32 public datasets and 8.5M CheXinstruct triplets
metric_en: Accuracy, mIoU/mAP, CheXbert-F1, BERTScore, RadGraph-F1, ROUGE-L
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A(Medical Image Databases) --> B[Image Acquisition]
    B --> C{Data Access Approval}
    C -- Approved --> D[Image Preprocessing]
    C -- Rejected --> M[Discard Data]

    F --> G[Manual Annotation]
    G --> H{Annotation Consistency Check}

flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect 32 publicly available chest X-ray datasets"] --> B["Perform extensive data engineering to curate CheXinstruct training dataset"]
    B["Perform extensive data engineering to curate CheXinstruct training dataset"] --> C["Construct evaluation benchmark covering eight distinct CXR interpretation task types"]
    C["Construct evaluation benchmark covering eight distinct CXR interpretation task types"] --> D["Train CheXagent vision-language foundation model on CheXinstruct dataset"]
    D["Train CheXagent vision-language foundation model on CheXinstruct dataset"] --> E["Systematically evaluate CheXagent performance across all eight task types"]
    E["Systematically evaluate CheXagent performance across all eight task types"] --> F["Assess real-world utility by having CheXagent draft radiology reports"]
    F["Assess real-world utility by having CheXagent draft radiology reports"] --> G["Conduct clinical assessment with eight radiologists measuring time and quality"]
