    D["在CheXinstruct上训练CheXagent视觉语言模型"] --> E["系统评估CheXagent在八种任务上的表现"]
    E["系统评估CheXagent在八种任务上的表现"] --> F["评估CheXagent起草放射学报告的实际效用"]
    F["评估CheXagent起草放射学报告的实际效用"] --> G["与八位放射科医生进行临床评估测量时间和质量"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2401.12208v2, Methods: Description of the CheXinstruct dataset, Building CheXbench, and the reader-study section. The paper defines 35 CXR interpretation tasks, gathers 32 public datasets, and applies manual plus automated engineering to verify quality, unify heterogeneous annotations, restructure reports, and map sources into the task taxonomy. Official source splits are preserved so evaluation cases remain outside model training. This yields two distinct artifacts: CheXinstruct, an 8.5-million instruction-image-response training corpus, and CheXbench, a held-out evaluation benchmark of eight clinically relevant task types organized under image perception, image-text reasoning, and text generation. CheXagent is training context rather than benchmark data: it is trained through clinical-text language-model adaptation, CXR-report vision-encoder learning, and joint instruction tuning, then compared with general and medical foundation models on standardized instructions with one or more images and, where needed, text. Scoring is task-specific, including accuracy, localization metrics, and clinical text-generation metrics. Generated findings also receive radiologist review. A separate eight-radiologist reader study evaluates report drafting/editing time, efficiency, and quality; the diagram keeps those clinical-utility results distinct from CheXbench scores.

name: CheXGenBench
intro: CheXGenBench是一个统一的评估框架，旨在全面评估合成胸部X光图像的保真度、隐私性和下游实用性，通过20多种定量指标标准化评估文本到图像生成模型。
org: The University of Edinburgh, Samsung AI Center
build_method: 统一MIMIC-CXR划分, LLaVA-Rad增强提示, 11个模型标准化训练, 保真度/隐私/效用三轴评估
metric: RadDino FID/KID, BioViL-T, PRDC, Siamese re-ID, Accuracy/AUROC, BLEU, ROUGE-L, F1-RadGraph
eval_feature: 评估合成胸部X光图像的保真度, 隐私性和下游实用性
scale: 237,388个训练样本, 11个生成模型, SynthCheX-75K
build_method_en: Standardized MIMIC-CXR split, LLaVA-Rad enhanced prompts, common training for 11 models, and three-axis evaluation
eval_feature_en: evaluate fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility of synthetic chest X-ray images
intro_en: CheXGenBench is a unified evaluation framework designed to comprehensively assess the fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility of synthetic chest X-ray images, standardizing the evaluation of text-to-image generation models through over 20 quantitative metrics.
scale_en: 237,388 training samples, 11 generative models, and SynthCheX-75K
metric_en: RadDino FID/KID, BioViL-T, PRDC, Siamese re-ID, Accuracy/AUROC, BLEU, ROUGE-L, F1-RadGraph

name: Chinese SimpleQA
intro: Chinese SimpleQA是首个全面的中文基准，旨在评估大型语言模型回答简短问题的能力。该基准涵盖6个主要主题和99个子主题，并通过严格的质量控制流程确保问题和答案的高质量。其特点包括中文、多样性、高质量、静态和易于评估，可用于指导开发者理解模型在中文事实性方面的表现。
org: LivingFutureLab, Tsinghua University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
build_method: 知识内容筛选, GPT-4o生成, RAG与双人检索验证
eval_feature: 中文事实性, 静态知识截止2023-12-31, 多模型难度筛选, 权威来源验证
build_method_en: Knowledge filtering, GPT-4o generation, RAG and dual-human search verification
eval_feature_en: Chinese factuality, static knowledge through 2023-12-31, multi-model difficulty filtering, authoritative-source verification
intro_en: Chinese SimpleQA is the first comprehensive Chinese benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to answer short questions. It covers 6 main topics and 99 subtopics, with strict quality control ensuring high-quality questions and answers. Features include Chinese language, diversity, high quality, static nature, and ease of evaluation, making it useful for developers to understand model performance on Chinese factuality.

name: CIMemories
intro: CIMemories 是一个面向持久记忆隐私与上下文完整性的基准，使用带有丰富属性的合成用户画像和不同任务场景，评估模型是否会在不恰当情境中泄露记忆中的敏感信息。
build_method: Faker合成身份, GPT-OSS-120B生成记忆, 49个任务情境, Westin人格一致性筛选
task_type: 信息流控制, 上下文完整性
eval_feature: 持久记忆, 隐私泄露, 情境完整性
scale: 71.9K条属性-情境记录, 10个用户档案, 平均约147个属性, 49个情境
intro_en: CIMemories evaluates whether persistent-memory systems in LLMs preserve contextual integrity. It measures if models reveal memory attributes only when the task context makes them appropriate.
build_method_en: Faker identities, GPT-OSS-120B memories, 49 task contexts, and Westin-persona consensus filtering
eval_feature_en: Persistent Memory, Privacy Leakage, Contextual Integrity
scale_en: 71.9K attribute-context rows, 10 profiles, about 147 attributes on average, and 49 contexts

name: CiteBench
intro: CiteBench是一个用于科学引文文本生成的基准测试，旨在系统地研究从多个来源聚合和综合文本知识。该基准统一了多个不同的数据集，支持在不同的任务设计和领域之间对引文生成模型进行标准化评估。CiteBench的发布为引文生成领域的未来研究提供了新的见解和评估方法。
org: Ubiquitous Knowledge Processing (UKP) Lab, Technical University of Darmstadt
build_method: 整合ABURAED/CHEN/LU/XING, 来源专属转换, 标签化统一输入, 引文锚点规范化
metric: ROUGE-1/2/L, BERTScore, 引用意图与CORWA篇章诊断, 人工可读性与一致性
eval_feature: 四来源统一任务, 多领域引文生成, 域内与跨数据集迁移
build_method_en: ABURAED/CHEN/LU/XING integration, source-specific transforms, tagged unified inputs, and normalized citation anchors
eval_feature_en: Four-source unified task, multi-domain citation generation, in-domain and cross-dataset transfer
intro_en: CiteBench is a benchmark for scientific citation text generation, designed to systematically study the aggregation and synthesis of textual knowledge from multiple sources. It unifies various datasets to enable standardized evaluation of citation generation models across different task designs and domains. The release of CiteBench offers new insights and evaluation methods for future research in citation generation.
metric_en: ROUGE-1/2/L, BERTScore, citation-intent and CORWA discourse diagnostics, human readability and consistency

name: CiteEval
intro: CiteEval是一个基于原则的引用评估框架，旨在对生成文本中的引用质量进行细粒度评估。该框架不仅考虑被引用的来源，还涵盖了检索上下文、用户查询和生成的文本。基于此框架，研究人员构建了CiteBench，一个带有人工高质量标注的多领域基准。为了实现高效评估，还开发了与人类判断高度相关的模型指标套件CiteEval-Auto。
build_method: 四来源长问答采样, 每题10个检索段落, 四模型回答, 三轮盲标与语言学专家质检
metric: Context Attribution, Citation Editing, 1-5 Citation Rating, Pearson Correlation
eval_feature: 完整检索上下文, 检索外归因, 细粒度引文质量, 自动指标元评测
scale: 948条开发查询, 3,000条测试查询, 1,200条人工标注回答
build_method_en: Four-source LFQA sampling, 10 passages per query, four-model response generation, three blind annotation passes and linguist validation
eval_feature_en: Full retrieval context, beyond-retrieval attribution, fine-grained citation quality, automatic-metric meta-evaluation
intro_en: CiteEval is a principle-based citation evaluation framework designed for fine-grained assessment of citation quality in generated text. The framework considers not only the cited sources but also the retrieval context, user queries, and the generated text. Based on this framework, researchers developed CiteBench, a multi-domain benchmark with high-quality human annotations. To enable efficient evaluation, they also created CiteEval-Auto, a suite of model metrics highly correlated with human judgments.
scale_en: 948 development queries, 3,000 test queries, and 1,200 human-annotated responses
metric_en: Context Attribution, Citation Editing, 1-5 Citation Rating, Pearson Correlation

name: CL-bench
intro: CL-bench是一个用于评估大型语言模型上下文学习能力的基准。该基准包含500个复杂上下文和1899个任务，要求模型从特定上下文中学习新知识并进行推理，而非简单地依赖预训练知识。CL-bench旨在推动模型发展超越简单检索或阅读理解的复杂推理能力，以应对现实世界中复杂的、依赖上下文的任务。
build_method: 领域专家三阶段构建, 三类抗污染知识设计, 二元Rubric双检与抽样验证
eval_feature: 长文本, 防污染, 领域特定
build_method_en: Three-stage domain-expert construction, three contamination-resistant knowledge strategies, and double-checked binary rubrics
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Contamination-free, Domain-specific
intro_en: CL-bench is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' in-context learning abilities. It includes 500 complex contexts and 1899 tasks, requiring models to learn new knowledge and perform reasoning from specific contexts rather than relying solely on pre-trained knowledge. CL-bench aims to advance models beyond simple retrieval or reading comprehension toward complex reasoning needed for real-world, context-dependent tasks.
metric_en: Task Solving Rate (all rubrics must pass)

name: ClassBench
intro: ClassBench 并非独立基准，而是 Agent World Model 论文发布的 1,000 个合成环境之一，表示“音乐学校排课与考勤”场景；它包含由 AWM 流水线生成的任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具和验证逻辑。
org: Snowflake AI Research, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
build_method: AWM场景合成, 每场景10个任务, SQLite数据库, MCP工具接口, 状态差异验证
metric: 任务成功奖励, Environment Error
eval_feature: 可执行有状态环境, 数据库一致性, 多轮工具使用, 代码增强验证
scale: AgentWorldModel-1K中的1个环境；每个场景生成10个任务
build_method_en: AWM scenario synthesis, 10 tasks per scenario, SQLite state, MCP tools, and before/after-state verification
eval_feature_en: Executable stateful environment, database consistency, multi-turn tool use, code-augmented verification
intro_en: ClassBench is not a standalone benchmark; it is one of 1,000 synthetic environments released by the Agent World Model paper, representing Music School Scheduling and Attendance with generated tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools, and verification logic.
scale_en: One environment in AgentWorldModel-1K; 10 tasks are generated per scenario

name: ClawEval
intro: Claw-Eval 是面向真实自主 Agent 的可审计端到端评测套件，包含 300 个经人工验证的任务和 2,159 条细粒度 Rubric，通过执行轨迹、服务审计日志和环境快照评估完成度、安全性、鲁棒性与多次运行可靠性。
org: Peking University, The University of Hong Kong
build_method: 250个原创任务+50个兼容任务, 运行环境与Rubric实现, 独立复核, 前沿模型试跑
metric: Average Score, Pass@3, Pass^3, Completion, Safety, Robustness
modality: 文本, 图像, 视频, 代码
task_type: 工作流Agent任务, 多模态任务, 多轮专业对话
eval_feature: 全轨迹审计, 三证据通道, 时间防火墙, 受控错误注入, 三次独立运行
task_type_en: Workflow agent tasks, multimodal tasks, multi-turn professional dialogue
build_method_en: 250 original plus 50 compatibility tasks, runtime and rubric implementation, independent review, and frontier-model pilot validation
eval_feature_en: Full-trajectory auditing, three evidence channels, temporal firewall, controlled error injection, three independent trials
intro_en: Claw-Eval is an auditable end-to-end suite for real-world autonomous agents. Its 300 human-verified tasks and 2,159 fine-grained rubrics use execution traces, service audit logs, and environment snapshots to evaluate completion, safety, robustness, and multi-run reliability.
metric_en: Average Score, Pass@3, Pass^3, Completion, Safety, Robustness

name: ClemBench
intro: ClemBench是一个基于大型语言模型自我对弈对话游戏的基准，用于评估模型的指令遵循、策略目标和语言理解能力。该框架能够适应新的发展，避免数据污染，且测试尚未饱和，为研究提示语言对性能的影响等问题提供了平台。
org: University of Potsdam, Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf, MBZUAI
build_method: 专家设计对话游戏, 动态实例生成, 程序化GameMaster自我对弈, 游戏专属评分
eval_feature: 多轮, 动态实例, 抗污染, 结果导向, 多语言
build_method_en: Expert dialogue-game design, dynamic instance generation, programmatic GameMaster self-play, and game-specific scoring
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, dynamic instances, contamination-resistant, result-oriented, multilingual
intro_en: ClemBench is a benchmark based on self-play dialogue games using large language models, designed to evaluate models' instruction following, strategic goals, and language understanding abilities. The framework adapts to new developments, prevents data contamination, and remains unsaturated, providing a platform for studying the impact of prompt language on performance.

name: ClinicalBench
intro: ClinicalBench是基于MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV真实临床数据的预测建模评测基准，全面比较通用和医疗大型语言模型与传统机器学习模型在临床预测任务上的表现，涵盖死亡率预测、再入院预测等关键任务。
org: Illinois Institute of Technology, Harvard Medical School, Weill Cornell Medicine
build_method: MIMIC-III/IV首次就诊队列, 分层划分, 仅训练集欠采样, 临床代码转文本
metric: Macro F1, F1, AUROC, 95%置信区间
eval_feature: LLM与传统ML模型头对头比较，基于真实临床数据
scale: 2个数据库, 3个任务, 22个LLM, 11个传统ML模型
build_method_en: MIMIC-III/IV first-visit cohorts, stratified splits, training-only under-sampling, and clinical code-to-text conversion
eval_feature_en: Head-to-head comparison between LLM and traditional ML models, based on real clinical data
intro_en: ClinicalBench is a predictive modeling benchmark based on real clinical data from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV. It comprehensively compares the performance of general and medical large language models with traditional machine learning models on clinical prediction tasks, including key tasks such as mortality prediction and readmission prediction.
scale_en: 2 databases, 3 tasks, 22 LLMs, and 11 traditional ML models
metric_en: Macro F1, F1, AUROC, and 95% confidence intervals

name: ClinicBench
intro: ClinicBench是牛津大学和哈佛大学联合发布的临床场景大模型评测基准，涵盖临床语言生成、理解和推理等11个任务，引入了六个新数据集和复杂临床任务，全面评估LLM的临床能力。
org: University of Oxford, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
build_method: 整合11个已有临床数据集，并从MIMIC、ChatDoctor、DrugBank和Drugs.com构建6个经专家复核的新数据集
task_type: 多选题, 问答, 摘要, 实体识别, 关系抽取, 分类
eval_feature: 评估LLM在复杂临床问题解决, 临床语言理解, 生成和推理方面的能力
scale: 3类场景、11个任务、17个数据集、超过20,000个测试样本
task_type_en: Multiple choice, Q&A, Summarization, Named Entity Recognition, Relation Extraction, Classification
build_method_en: Combining existing datasets and constructing six new datasets, GPT-4 generated and expert reviewed
eval_feature_en: Evaluating LLM capabilities in complex clinical problem solving, clinical language understanding, generation, and reasoning
intro_en: ClinicBench, jointly released by Oxford University and Harvard University, is a clinical scenario large model evaluation benchmark covering 11 tasks including clinical language generation, understanding, and reasoning. It introduces six new datasets and complex clinical tasks to comprehensively assess the clinical capabilities of LLMs.
scale_en: 3 scenarios, 11 tasks, 17 datasets, and over 20,000 test samples

name: CloningScenarios
intro: CloningScenarios 是 LAB-Bench 中的分子克隆工作流评测，用于评估模型执行生物实验规划任务的能力。
build_method: 论文作者与签约生物学专家人工编写、修订和质检分子克隆多步场景题，并保留公开/私有污染监测划分
eval_feature: LAB-Bench子基准, 人类高难, 零样本思维链, 禁用工具, 污染监测
build_method_en: Manually authored, revised, and quality-controlled by paper authors and contracted biology experts, with public/private contamination monitoring splits
eval_feature_en: LAB-Bench sub-benchmark, human-hard, zero-shot chain-of-thought, no tools, contamination monitoring
intro_en: CloningScenarios is a molecular-cloning workflow evaluation within LAB-Bench for assessing biological experiment planning capability.

name: ClothoAQA
intro: ClothoAQA 是基于 1,991 段 Clotho 环境音频构建的音频问答基准，通过两阶段众包获得 35,838 个音频-问题-答案三元组，评估模型联合理解音频与自然语言问题的能力。
build_method: 两阶段Amazon Mechanical Turk众包提问与独立回答，经人工筛查、罕见答案修正和音频无重叠分层划分
eval_feature: 音频问答, 二分类与828类单词分类, 一致票与多数票变体, 音频无重叠划分
scale: 1,991段音频、11,946个问题、35,838个音频问答三元组
build_method_en: Two-stage Amazon Mechanical Turk question and independent answer annotation, followed by manual screening, rare-answer correction, and audio-disjoint stratified splitting
eval_feature_en: Audio QA, binary and 828-class single-word classification, unanimous and majority-vote variants, audio-disjoint splits
intro_en: ClothoAQA is an audio question-answering benchmark built from 1,991 Clotho environmental audio clips. Two-stage crowdsourcing produces 35,838 audio-question-answer triplets for evaluating joint audio and natural-language understanding.
scale_en: 1,991 audio clips, 11,946 questions, and 35,838 audio-QA triplets

name: CMATH
intro: CMATH是一个包含1.7k小学数学应用题的数据集，题目来源于真实的中文练习册和考试。该数据集旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）的小学数学能力，并发现只有GPT-4在所有年级中表现良好。此外，CMATH还评估了LLMs对干扰信息的鲁棒性，发现GPT-4能保持鲁棒性。
build_method: 从网上中文小学练习册和考试收集题目，PDF/Word转文本，去除含图题并去重清洗，经作者多轮验证后标注年级、答案、推理步数和数字位数
eval_feature: 中文小学数学, 1至6年级分层, 零样本数值匹配, 干扰信息鲁棒性
scale: 1,689道题，另含60题干扰鲁棒性集合
build_method_en: Collect online Chinese elementary workbooks and exams, convert PDF/Word to text, remove graphic problems, deduplicate, clean, validate, and annotate grade, answer, reasoning steps, and digit count
eval_feature_en: Chinese elementary math, grades 1-6, zero-shot numeral matching, distractor robustness
intro_en: CMATH is a dataset containing 1.7k elementary school math word problems sourced from real Chinese workbooks and exams. It aims to evaluate the elementary math abilities of large language models (LLMs), with only GPT-4 performing well across all grade levels. Additionally, CMATH assesses LLMs' robustness to distracting information, finding that GPT-4 maintains robustness.
scale_en: 1,689 problems plus a 60-problem distractor robustness set

name: CMB
intro: CMB (A Comprehensive Medical Benchmark in Chinese) 是一个完全基于中文语言文化背景设计的综合性、多层次的医学基准。它旨在解决直接翻译英文医学评测所带来的文化和语境不符问题，全面评估大型语言模型在中文医疗环境下的知识水平和临床咨询能力。该基准不仅包含中医，还覆盖了所有临床医学专业和不同专业级别。
build_method: 考试题, 专家构建, 人工标注
metric: Accuracy, 流畅性, 相关性, 完整性, 医学专业度
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 领域特定, 零样本, 少样本, 思维链
scale: 280,839道选择题；74个复杂病例、208个临床问题
build_method_en: Exam questions, Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Zero-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: CMB (A Comprehensive Medical Benchmark in Chinese) is a comprehensive, multi-level medical benchmark designed entirely based on Chinese language and cultural context. It aims to address the cultural and contextual mismatches caused by directly translating English medical evaluations, providing a thorough assessment of large language models' knowledge and clinical consultation abilities in the Chinese medical environment. This benchmark includes traditional Chinese medicine and covers all clinical medical specialties and various professional levels.
scale_en: 280,839 multiple-choice questions; 74 complex cases with 208 clinical questions
metric_en: Accuracy, Fluency, Relevance, Completeness, Medical Proficiency

name: CMExam
intro: CMExam是一个来源于中国国家执业医师资格考试的综合性数据集，旨在评估大型语言模型在医学领域的表现。它包含6万多个选择题，用于标准化和客观评估，并提供解决方案解释以进行开放式推理评估。该数据集还包含由医学专业人士标注的疾病组、临床科室、医学学科、能力领域和问题难度级别等五种额外的问答注释。CMExam是第一个提供全面医学注释的中文医学考试数据集。
org: Alibaba Group, HKUST (Guangzhou), Harvard University, Peking University, Zhejiang University, Johns Hopkins University, Yale University, Ant Group
build_method: 收集真实历年中国执业医师考试题，过滤非文本题并去重，8:1:1划分，补充题解，以GPT-4预标注和两位医学专业人士复核五类测试元数据
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 答案预测, 开放式题解生成, 五类医学元数据, 人机比较
build_method_en: Collect authentic past CNMLE questions, filter non-text items and duplicates, split 8:1:1, add explanations, then use GPT-4 pre-annotation and two medical-professional reviewers for five test metadata facets
eval_feature_en: Answer prediction, open-ended explanation generation, five medical metadata facets, human comparison
intro_en: CMExam is a comprehensive dataset derived from the National Medical Licensing Examination of China, designed to evaluate the performance of large language models in the medical field. It contains over 60,000 multiple-choice questions for standardized and objective assessment, along with solution explanations for open-ended reasoning evaluation. The dataset also includes five additional QA annotations labeled by medical professionals: disease groups, clinical departments, medical disciplines, competency areas, and question difficulty levels. CMExam is the first Chinese medical exam dataset to provide comprehensive medical annotations.

name: CMMLU
intro: CMMLU是一个综合性的中文评估基准，专门用于评估语言模型在中文语境下的知识和推理能力。它涵盖了从基础学科到高级专业水平的67个主题，包含自然科学、社会科学、工程、人文以及中国特定的文化内容。该基准旨在全面衡量模型在中文环境下的高级能力。
org: MBZUAI, LibrAI, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Microsoft Research Asia, The University of Melbourne
build_method: 四名本科及以上标注员投入约250小时，从免费且低污染风险来源收集四选一题目，每科抽检5%并按每科5题开发、100题以上测试划分
eval_feature: 零样本, 少样本, 思维链
scale: 11,528道题、67个科目；每科5题开发集、100题以上测试集
build_method_en: Collected from exam questions and other sources, manually curated
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: CMMLU is a comprehensive Chinese evaluation benchmark designed to assess language models' knowledge and reasoning abilities in Chinese contexts. It covers 67 subjects ranging from basic disciplines to advanced professional levels, including natural sciences, social sciences, engineering, humanities, and China-specific cultural content. The benchmark aims to thoroughly measure models' advanced capabilities in Chinese environments.
scale_en: 11,528 questions across 67 subjects; 5 development and over 100 test questions per subject

name: CMMMU
intro: CMMMU是面向中文环境的大规模多学科多模态理解基准，评估大型多模态模型在需要大学水平学科知识和推理的任务表现。包含来自六大核心学科、30个专业和39种图像类型的12000个手工收集多模态问题，旨在推动下一代专家级多模态AI发展。
org: 01.AI, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
build_method: 组织者与本科及以上标注员从许可合规网站和书籍手工收集，经图像依赖、重复、大学难度、作者逐题核验与多模型污染过滤
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 中文大学多模态知识, 39类图像, 规则答案抽取, 微平均准确率, 错例分析
scale: 12,000道题、6大学科、30多个专业、39类图像
build_method_en: Organizers and undergraduate-or-higher annotators manually collect from license-compliant sites and books, followed by image-dependence, duplication, college-level, author-verification, and multi-model contamination filters
eval_feature_en: Chinese college-level multimodal knowledge, 39 image types, rule-based extraction, micro accuracy, error analysis
intro_en: CMMMU is a large-scale multidisciplinary multimodal understanding benchmark for the Chinese context, evaluating the performance of large multimodal models on tasks requiring university-level disciplinary knowledge and reasoning. It includes 12,000 manually collected multimodal questions from six core disciplines, 30 specialties, and 39 image types, aiming to advance the development of next-generation expert-level multimodal AI.
scale_en: 12,000 questions, 6 disciplines, over 30 subjects, and 39 image types

name: CNMO 2024
intro: CNMO 2024 是中国数学会 2024 年全国中学生数学奥林匹克官方题集被 DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1 与 Kimi K2 等模型报告复用的评测项，并非另行构建的独立 benchmark。它用于比较模型生成完整中文奥赛解答的稳定正确率。
org: Chinese Mathematical Society; evaluation protocols by DeepSeek-AI and Moonshot AI
build_method: 复用中国数学会2024年全国中学生数学奥林匹克官方赛题；模型报告未描述另行构建或筛选
eval_feature: 官方竞赛题复用, 中文奥赛推理, 温度0.7, 16次采样平均, 8K输出上限
scale: 2024年官方CNMO题集；模型报告未披露独立评测包题数
build_method_en: Reuse the Chinese Mathematical Society's official 2024 national high-school olympiad problems; model reports describe no separate construction or filtering
eval_feature_en: Official competition-set reuse, Chinese olympiad reasoning, temperature 0.7, 16-run averaging, 8K output limit
intro_en: CNMO 2024 is the Chinese Mathematical Society's official 2024 national high-school mathematics olympiad problem set reused as an evaluation item by DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, Kimi K2, and other model reports, rather than a separately constructed benchmark. It compares stable correctness of full Chinese olympiad solutions.
scale_en: Official 2024 CNMO problem set; model reports do not disclose a separate package count

name: CodeElo
intro: CodeElo收录2024年5月4日至11月4日期间54场Codeforces评级竞赛中的387道题，并附带竞赛分区、题目Rating和算法标签。模型最多生成8次尝试，代码被直接提交至Codeforces官方平台，以隐藏测试、特殊/交互评测器和统一执行环境判定，再从54场比赛的人类排名估计可比较的Elo Rating。
build_method: Codeforces近期评级竞赛收集, HTML解析, 官方平台直接评测, 人类排名Elo估计
eval_feature: Codeforces官方隐藏测试, 特殊与交互评测器, 最多8次尝试, 人类可比Elo
build_method_en: Recent rated Codeforces contests, HTML parsing, direct official-platform judging, human-rank Elo estimation
eval_feature_en: Result-oriented, Domain-specific
intro_en: CodeElo contains 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held from May 4 to November 4, 2024, with contest divisions, problem ratings, and algorithm tags. Models generate up to eight attempts, which are submitted directly to Codeforces for hidden-test, special/interactive-judge, and platform-aligned execution. Human-comparable Elo ratings are then estimated from the model's ranks across the 54 contests.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.01257 Sections 2.1-2.3 and 3. CodeElo collects 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held from May 4 through November 4, 2024, excluding Div. 1-only contests. It parses problem HTML and preserves the original HTML for formulas and layout; attaches division, difficulty rating, and algorithm tags while hiding tags from models; prompts for a complete C++ solution; generates up to eight attempts; and submits parsed code directly to Codeforces. Official hidden tests, special/interactive judges, and platform time-memory limits determine acceptance. Failed attempts before success contribute penalties, model ranks are inserted among human contestants, contest-level expected ratings are solved by binary search, and ratings are averaged across 54 contests to produce human-comparable Elo plus Pass@1/2/4/8 analyses.

name: CodeForces
intro: Codeforces 是公开竞赛编程平台与题源，不是具有固定题数、划分和评分协议的单一 benchmark。模型报告必须自行声明比赛时间窗、题目子集、提示、尝试预算、在线或离线判题路径及聚合方式；只有协议一致的结果才可直接比较。
build_method: 报告自行选择Codeforces比赛与题目, 固定提示和尝试预算, 声明在线或离线评测器
metric: 报告相关：Accuracy, Pass@k, Rank, Rating
eval_feature: 官方题面与元数据, 可选官方提交判题, 协议披露边界
scale: 无固定规模；由各模型报告定义
build_method_en: Report-defined Codeforces contest and problem selection, frozen prompt and attempt budget, declared online or offline judge
eval_feature_en: Official statements and metadata, optional official-platform judging, explicit protocol boundary
intro_en: Codeforces is a public competitive-programming platform and problem source, not one benchmark with a fixed item count, split, or scoring protocol. Model reports must define their contest window, problem subset, prompt, attempt budget, online or offline judging route, and aggregation; only runs with the same protocol are directly comparable.
scale_en: No fixed scale; defined by each model report
drawio_review_note: Evidence-bounded to the official Codeforces API documentation and official Codeforces rating-system documentation. Codeforces is a continuously operated competitive-programming platform, not a standalone benchmark paper or one fixed evaluation set. Its public objects expose contests, problems, difficulty ratings, tags, standings, submissions, test sets, resource consumption, points, penalties, and verdicts. A model report must therefore define its own contest window, problem subset, contamination policy, prompt, programming language, attempt budget, tools, and online or offline judge. When solutions are submitted online, Codeforces supplies the platform verdicts; an offline harness is a separate report-specific choice and must be fully specified. Accuracy/Pass@k and contest rank/rating are alternative aggregations, not universal interchangeable Codeforces metrics, so the diagram does not invent a canonical item count, split, prompt, sampling budget, or score.

name: CodeSimpleQA
intro: CodeSimpleQA是一个评估代码大模型编程知识事实准确性的双语基准，包含1,498个问答对（782个英文、716个中文），覆盖15种以上编程语言和21个计算机科学领域。论文另行构建了66.9M条CodeSimpleQA-Instruct训练语料；该训练集不属于1,498题评测基准的构建流程。
org: Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Yizhi Li, Shawn Guo, Haowen Wang, Aishan Liu, Ge Zhang, Zili Wang, Zhoujun Li,
build_method: Code WebQA、自构造与人工编写三源合并, 8名标注员独立复核, 工程师共识质检
eval_feature: 双语
build_method_en: Code WebQA, Self-constructed, and Human-written Source Merge, Independent Review by 8 Annotators, Engineer Consensus Quality Control
eval_feature_en: Bilingual
intro_en: CodeSimpleQA is a bilingual benchmark for factual accuracy in programming knowledge, containing 1,498 QA pairs (782 English and 716 Chinese) across more than 15 programming languages and 21 computer-science domains. The paper separately constructs a 66.9M-example CodeSimpleQA-Instruct training corpus; that corpus is not part of the 1,498-item evaluation benchmark build process.

name: CommonEval
intro: CommonEval 是 VoiceBench 的 200 条真人语音开放式问答子集。研究者从 Mozilla Common Voice 的多样说话人和个人设备录音中人工收集信息寻求类问题，并在标准文本与原始语音两种输入设置下让语音助手回答，再用 GPT-4o-mini 按 1–5 分评估文本回答内容。
org: Yiming Chen, Xianghu Yue, Chen Zhang, Xiaoxue Gao, Robby T. Tan, Haizhou Li; National University of Singapore
build_method: 从Mozilla Common Voice真人录音中人工收集信息寻求类问题
eval_feature: 真人录音, 文本/语音配对设置, 只评回答内容
build_method_en: Manual collection of information-seeking questions from human Mozilla Common Voice recordings
eval_feature_en: Human recordings, paired text/speech settings, response-content scoring only
intro_en: CommonEval is the 200-item real-speech open-ended QA subset of VoiceBench. Researchers manually collect information-seeking questions from Mozilla Common Voice recordings made by diverse speakers on personal devices, evaluate voice assistants with both ground-truth text and original speech inputs, and use GPT-4o-mini to score text-response content from 1 to 5.
scale_en: 200 items; average 8.06 words and 4.83 seconds of audio
drawio_review_note: Aligned with VoiceBench arXiv:2410.17196 Sections 3.1–3.2 and the official VoiceBench repository. CommonEval is a VoiceBench subset rather than a generic bilingual text benchmark. The authors manually collect information-seeking questions from Mozilla Common Voice, whose speech is recorded by diverse speakers on personal devices in realistic conditions. The released subset contains 200 human-recorded English open-ended QA items, averaging 8.06 words and 4.83 seconds of audio. VoiceBench evaluates both ground-truth text instructions and original speech instructions, asks the assistant to generate a response, and evaluates text-response content rather than speech-output or transcription quality. GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18 assigns a 1–5 response-quality score against the ground-truth instruction. The official repository runs the commoneval test split in audio or text modality, applies api_judge.py, and aggregates with the open evaluator.

name: CommonsenseQA
intro: CommonsenseQA 是常识问答 benchmark，报告中用于评估模型基于常识知识进行选择和推理的能力。
build_method: ConceptNet子图采样, 众包出题与干扰项, 双人验证
build_method_en: ConceptNet subgraph sampling, crowdsourced questions and distractors, two-worker validation
intro_en: CommonsenseQA is a commonsense question-answering benchmark used in reports to evaluate selection and reasoning over commonsense knowledge.

name: ComplexFunBench
intro: 站点旧 ID ComplexFunBench 对应论文正式名称 ComplexFuncBench：一个含 1,000 条旅行预订复杂函数调用样本的基准。原论文构建文本到文本的多步、约束与长上下文评测及 ComplexEval；Google 后续为每条提示合成音频，通过 Gemini Live API 运行并沿用论文评分器。
org: Zhipu AI, Tsinghua University; audio adaptation by Google DeepMind
build_method: 43个旅行API, GPT-4o粗生成, 100条资深精标模板, 10倍泛化与初级标注, Google提示转音频适配
metric: Success Rate, Call Accuracy, Completeness, Correctness
task_type: 复杂函数调用, 多步旅行预订, 音频适配
eval_feature: 多步与约束调用, 参数推理, 长参数, 128K上下文, ComplexEval, Gemini Live音频复用
task_type_en: Complex function calling, multi-step travel booking, audio adaptation
build_method_en: 43 travel APIs, GPT-4o coarse generation, 100 senior-annotated templates, tenfold generalization with junior annotation, Google prompt-to-audio adaptation
eval_feature_en: Multi-step constrained calls, parameter reasoning, long values, 128K context, ComplexEval, Gemini Live audio reuse
intro_en: The site's legacy ID ComplexFunBench corresponds to the paper's official name ComplexFuncBench, a 1,000-sample benchmark for complex travel-booking function calls. The original paper builds a text-to-text multi-step, constrained, long-context evaluation with ComplexEval; Google later synthesizes audio for every prompt, runs it through the Gemini Live API, and retains the published scorer.
metric_en: Success Rate, Call Accuracy, Completeness, Correctness
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ComplexFuncBench arXiv:2501.10132 Sections 2–3, its official repository, and Google DeepMind's March 2026 Gemini 3.1 Flash Live evaluation report/model card. The site's ComplexFunBench spelling is retained only as an asset and page ID; the original benchmark name is ComplexFuncBench. The authors manually correct 43 Booking.com/RapidAPI functions across hotel, flight, attraction, car-rental, and taxi domains. GPT-4o creates 1,000 coarse queries and preliminary paths; senior annotators select 100 relatively complete samples, rewrite queries, correct parameter values and call order to the shortest complete path, remove overlapping functions and ambiguous API results, and quality-check the templates. GPT-4o generates nine variants per template and junior annotators fill parameters and disambiguate responses, yielding 1,000 items: 600 single-domain and 400 cross-domain. ComplexEval performs format checks, embedding-based Hungarian mapping, and rule-, response-, or GPT-4o-based equivalence, then reports success rate and call accuracy; GPT-4o separately scores final-response completeness and correctness from 0 to 2. Google's audio adaptation synthesizes audio for each prompt, runs the static-context multi-turn benchmark through the Gemini Live API, and explicitly reuses the published scoring apparatus rather than defining a new benchmark construction.

name: ComplexFuncBench
intro: ComplexFuncBench针对复杂函数调用设计，涵盖五个真实场景，涉及多步调用和参数约束。要求模型进行长参数填写、参数值推理和处理128k长上下文。基准还提出了自动评估框架ComplexEval，用于量化复杂函数调用任务表现。
build_method: 43个旅行API人工修正, GPT-4o粗生成, 100条资深精标模板, 十倍泛化与初级标注
metric: Success Rate, Call Accuracy, Completeness, Correctness
task_type: 复杂函数调用, 多步旅行预订
eval_feature: 多步与约束调用, 参数推理, 长参数, 128K上下文, ComplexEval
task_type_en: Complex function calling, multi-step travel booking
build_method_en: Manual correction of 43 travel APIs, GPT-4o coarse generation, 100 senior-annotated templates, tenfold generalization with junior annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-step constrained calls, parameter reasoning, long values, 128K context, ComplexEval
intro_en: ComplexFuncBench is designed for complex function calls, covering five real-world scenarios involving multi-step calls and parameter constraints. It requires models to handle long parameter filling, parameter value reasoning, and processing 128k-length contexts. The benchmark also introduces an automatic evaluation framework, ComplexEval, to quantify performance on complex function call tasks.

flowchart LR
    A["收集43个实时API并手动修正函数描述"] --> B["用GPT-4o生成1000个初步复杂函数调用样本"]
    B["用GPT-4o生成1000个初步复杂函数调用样本"] --> C["选择100个完整路径样本进行人工精细标注"]
    C["选择100个完整路径样本进行人工精细标注"] --> D["重写查询、修正调用顺序并修复参数错误"]
    D["重写查询、修正调用顺序并修复参数错误"] --> E["消除重叠函数并删除歧义API响应"]
    E["消除重叠函数并删除歧义API响应"] --> F["扩展至1000个样本含600单域和400跨域"]
    F["扩展至1000个样本含600单域和400跨域"] --> G["应用ComplexEval进行格式检查、匈牙利映射和多维匹配"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.10132 Sections 2–3 and the official repository. ComplexFuncBench starts from 43 real-time Booking.com/RapidAPI functions across hotel, flight, attraction, car-rental, and taxi domains; the authors manually correct incomplete or wrong descriptions. GPT-4o first generates 1,000 preliminary queries and call paths. Senior annotators select 100 relatively complete samples, rewrite queries, add/remove/reorder calls to the shortest complete path, fix parameter errors, remove overlapping functions, delete API results that cause ambiguous downstream values, and quality-check all templates. GPT-4o creates nine variants per template and junior annotators fill parameter values and disambiguate responses, yielding 1,000 samples: 600 single-domain and 400 cross-domain. During evaluation the model iteratively predicts calls and receives annotated responses. ComplexEval checks function/required-parameter/type format, maps predicted to gold calls with bge-large-en embeddings and the Hungarian algorithm, and applies exact, response-based, or GPT-4o semantic equivalence. It reports task Success Rate and Call Accuracy; GPT-4o separately scores final-response Completeness and Correctness from 0 to 2.

name: ComputeEval
intro: ComputeEval是NVIDIA持续维护的CUDA代码生成基准。2026.1版本包含566道题，覆盖7个CUDA C++与CUDA Python领域组，其中499题带性能负载。模型仅看到提示、上下文和构建约束；隐藏测试与参考解用于隔离的编译、正确性验证，并在通过后可继续测量GPU性能。
build_method: NVIDIA工程师与模型辅助编题, 全量人工复核, 隐藏测试与参考解隔离, CI可解性验证, 版本化数据包
metric: Pass@k, Latency, Baseline Speedup, SM/DRAM Throughput
eval_feature: 隐藏测试, 隔离执行, 分领域报告, GPU性能剖析
build_method_en: NVIDIA Engineer and Model-assisted Authoring, Full Human Review, Hidden-test and Reference Separation, CI Solvability Validation, Versioned Datapacks
eval_feature_en: Held-out Tests, Isolated Execution, Per-group Reporting, GPU Performance Profiling
intro_en: ComputeEval is NVIDIA's continuously maintained CUDA code-generation benchmark. Release 2026.1 contains 566 problems across seven CUDA C++ and CUDA Python groups, with performance workloads for 499 problems. Models see only prompts, context, and build constraints; held-out tests and reference solutions support isolated compilation and correctness checks, followed by optional GPU performance measurement for passing solutions.
metric_en: Pass@k, Latency, Baseline Speedup, SM/DRAM Throughput

name: Context Arena
intro: Context Arena 展示外部运行的 OpenAI MRCR v2 长上下文结果。该评测把 2、4 或 8 个相同请求及干扰项散布在长对话中，要求模型返回第 N 个目标回答并前置随机哈希；Context Arena 按长度桶报告平均匹配率、128K/1M AUC、Token 效率与成本。
org: Context Arena; OpenAI MRCR; external evaluators
build_method: GPT-4o合成针与干扰项, 2/4/8重复请求, 随机哈希, 8K至1M长度分桶
metric: Mean Match Ratio, AUC@128K, AUC@1M, Model AUC
task_type: 长上下文序数检索, 多轮共指
eval_feature: 2/4/8 needles, 随机哈希门, 每长度桶100题, 外部评测
build_method_en: GPT-4o synthetic needles and distractors, 2/4/8 repeated requests, random hash, 8K-to-1M length bins
eval_feature_en: 2/4/8 needles, random-hash gate, 100 tests per length bin, external evaluation
intro_en: Context Arena presents externally run OpenAI MRCR v2 long-context results. The evaluation scatters 2, 4, or 8 identical requests and distractors through a long conversation, asks the model to return the Nth target response with a random hash prefix, and reports mean match ratio by length bin plus 128K/1M AUC, token efficiency, and cost.
scale_en: Eight length bins from 8K to 1M; 100 tests per bin
metric_en: Mean Match Ratio, AUC@128K, AUC@1M, Model AUC
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the Context Arena official methodology/FAQ, the OpenAI MRCR dataset card, and Claude Opus 4.6 System Card Section 2.18.1. OpenAI MRCR v2 inserts 2, 4, or 8 identical requests and their responses among GPT-4o-generated distractors in unique synthetic long conversations; the final query requests a specific ordinal instance and requires a per-test random hash prefix. Context Arena groups cases by o200k_base total length into eight bins from 8K through 1M, with 100 tests per bin. A missing or wrong hash yields zero; otherwise the hash is removed and Python difflib SequenceMatcher produces a 0–1 similarity ratio, averaged as the Mean Match Ratio for the bin. Normalized trapezoidal AUC summarizes performance through 128K, 1M, or the model's completed range, while the dashboard also presents token efficiency and estimated cost. The Claude card uses the hardest 8-needle MRCR v2 variant, reports five-trial internal results, and separately identifies Context Arena results as externally run.

name: CoQA
intro: CoQA 是对话式阅读理解 benchmark，报告中作为 QA 能力评测项出现。
build_method: 七域段落筛选, 双人对话众包, 多答案复标
task_type: 对话式问答, 阅读理解
build_method_en: Seven-domain passage curation, paired conversational crowdsourcing, multi-answer re-annotation
intro_en: CoQA is a conversational reading-comprehension benchmark referenced as a QA evaluation item in technical reports.

name: CountBench
intro: CountBench是一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）对象计数能力的新型图像-文本计数基准。它通过自动创建反事实示例来改进VLM的定量理解，并鼓励模型区分正确和不正确的计数描述。该基准旨在评估模型对图像中对象数量的理解。
build_method: LAION-400M数字词过滤, 目标检测计数匹配, 数量平衡, 人工验证
eval_feature: 测试集与计数训练集无重叠, 九分类零样本图文相似度
build_method_en: Automated Generation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: No overlap with counting training set, nine-way zero-shot image-text similarity
intro_en: CountBench is a novel image-text counting benchmark designed to evaluate the object counting ability of vision-language models (VLMs). It improves VLMs' quantitative understanding by automatically generating counterfactual examples and encourages models to distinguish between correct and incorrect counting descriptions. This benchmark aims to assess models' comprehension of object quantities in images.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A(Existing Image-Text Data) --> B[Identify Objects & Counts]
    B --> C{{Automatic Generation Algorithm}}
    C --> D[Generate Counterfactual Examples]
    D --> E{Counterfactual Quality Check}
    E -- Fail --> F[Discard Invalid Examples]
    E -- Pass --> G[Manual Annotation for Validation]
    G --> H(Validated Counterfactual Examples)
    H --> I[Combine Original & Counterfactuals]
    I --> J(CountBench Dataset)
    J --> K[VLM Inference on CountBench]
    K --> L[Compare VLM Predictions to Ground Truth]
    L --> M[Evaluate Object Counting Ability]
scale_en: 540 images (60 pairs for each count from two through ten)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Curate 540 diverse, high-quality image-text pairs for object counting evaluation"] --> B["Format captions using template 'a photo of [number] [objects]' with accurate counts"]
    B["Format captions using template 'a photo of [number] [objects]' with accurate counts"] --> C["Cross-validate object counts in images using off-the-shelf computer vision tools"]
    C["Cross-validate object counts in images using off-the-shelf computer vision tools"] --> D["Create counterfactual captions by swapping correct numbers with randomly selected incorrect numbers"]
    D["Create counterfactual captions by swapping correct numbers with randomly selected incorrect numbers"] --> E["Evaluate VLMs on zero-shot count classification using correct versus counterfactual caption discrimination"]
    E["Evaluate VLMs on zero-shot count classification using correct versus counterfactual caption discrimination"] --> F["Measure accuracy improvement over baseline CLIP and BASIC models on counting task"]
    F["Measure accuracy improvement over baseline CLIP and BASIC models on counting task"] --> G["Validate maintained performance on standard zero-shot downstream tasks and common benchmarks"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["策划540个多样化高质量图像文本对用于计数评估"] --> B["使用模板格式化标题并确保数量准确"]
    B["使用模板格式化标题并确保数量准确"] --> C["用现成视觉工具交叉验证图像中对象数量"]
    C["用现成视觉工具交叉验证图像中对象数量"] --> D["将正确数字替换为随机错误数字创建反事实标题"]
    D["将正确数字替换为随机错误数字创建反事实标题"] --> E["评估模型区分正确与反事实标题的零样本计数分类"]
    E["评估模型区分正确与反事实标题的零样本计数分类"] --> F["测量相对基线模型在计数任务上的准确率提升"]
    F["测量相对基线模型在计数任务上的准确率提升"] --> G["验证在标准零样本任务和通用基准上的性能保持"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2302.12066 Section 4 and Section 5.1. CountBench is automatically curated and manually verified from public LAION-400M. The authors retain captions with spelled counts two through ten, reject uses such as age, time, dates, addresses, and other non-visible attributes, then use an off-the-shelf detector to count each object class and keep cases where the caption count matches the most prevalent detected class. Candidates are extremely imbalanced (over 158K for two versus about 100 for ten), so each number is pre-balanced to 100–200 candidates, manually verified against clearly visible objects, and rebalanced to 60 pairs per number. The final 540-image test set has no overlap with the counting training set. Evaluation replaces each caption count with all nine values from two through ten, computes image-text similarity for each, chooses the highest-scoring number, and reports Counting Accuracy and Mean Count Deviation.

name: CounterFactQA
intro: CounterFactQA 是 Qwen3 技术报告中用于监控训练后能力的内部基准，目标是让模型识别问题的非事实前提并避免幻觉回答。报告未公开题目来源、数量、划分、提示、裁判、评分单位或聚合公式，只在表 22 给出 Qwen3-32B 不同训练阶段与思考模式的原始百分数值。
build_method: 内部构建；公开报告仅说明包含反事实问题，来源、题数与整理流程未披露
metric: 原始百分数值（评分单位与公式未披露）
eval_feature: 反事实识别, 避免幻觉, 思考/非思考模式, 分训练阶段对比
build_method_en: In-house construction; the public report only states that it contains counterfactual questions and does not disclose source, count, or curation
eval_feature_en: Counterfactual recognition, hallucination avoidance, thinking/non-thinking modes, training-stage comparison
intro_en: CounterFactQA is an in-house benchmark used in the Qwen3 technical report to monitor post-training capability. Its goal is to make models recognize non-factual premises and avoid hallucinatory answers. The report does not publish the item source, count, split, prompt, judge, score unit, or aggregation formula; Table 22 only provides raw percentage values across Qwen3-32B training stages and thinking modes.
metric_en: Raw percentage value (score unit and formula undisclosed)
drawio_review_note: Evidence-bounded to Qwen3 Technical Report arXiv:2505.09388, the paragraph introducing in-house post-training monitors and Table 22. The report defines CounterFactQA only as counterfactual questions for which the model should identify that the question is not factual and avoid a hallucinatory answer. It compares Qwen3-32B after Stage 2 Reasoning RL, Stage 3 Thinking Mode Fusion, and Stage 4 General RL, with thinking and non-thinking columns where available, and publishes raw percentage values. CounterFactQA is marked with an asterisk as an in-house dataset. No public dataset, standalone paper, official repository, item source, item count, split, contamination policy, prompt, reference-answer contract, judge, rubric, score unit, or aggregation formula is disclosed. The diagram therefore shows the intended behavior and stage/mode comparison while explicitly refusing to infer Accuracy or any hidden construction/scoring mechanics.

name: CPQExam
intro: CPQExam 是 QuarkMed 基于中国卫生专业技术资格考试整理并公开的 7,600 道中文选择题，覆盖初级、中级、副高、高级四级和 14 个科室。官方协议要求模型思考后仅返回 JSON 答案，再经 JSON/正则解析、答案规范化和精确匹配，按级别、题型与科室报告准确率。
build_method: 中国卫生专业技术资格考试整理；原始采样过滤未披露；官方发布7,600条JSONL
task_type: 医学考试, 单选与多选问答
eval_feature: 四个专业级别, 14个科室, JSON/正则解析, 多选排序, 精确匹配
task_type_en: Medical examination, single- and multiple-response QA
build_method_en: Curated from the Chinese Health Professional Qualification Examination; original sampling/filtering undisclosed; official 7,600-item JSONL release
eval_feature_en: Four professional levels, 14 departments, JSON/regex parsing, multiple-answer sorting, exact match
intro_en: CPQExam is a 7,600-question Chinese multiple-choice benchmark curated by QuarkMed from the Chinese Health Professional Qualification Examination and released publicly. It spans primary, intermediate, associate-senior, and senior levels across 14 departments. The official protocol asks the model to think and return JSON only, then applies JSON/regex parsing, answer normalization, and exact matching to report accuracy by level, question type, and department.
scale_en: 7,600 questions (600 primary, 4,800 intermediate, 1,200 associate senior, 1,000 senior)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with QuarkMed Technical Report arXiv:2508.11894 Sections 4.1–4.3 and Table 7, the official 7,600-line quarkmed_cpqexam.jsonl release, and the official evaluation README/evaluate.py. CPQExam comes from the Chinese Health Professional Qualification Examination and focuses on practical application and case analysis. The paper calls it private, while the repository later releases 7,600 questions across 14 departments: 600 primary, 4,800 intermediate, 1,200 associate-senior, and 1,000 senior. The release includes single-response, multiple-response, shared-stem, and case-analysis forms. Neither paper nor repository discloses original sampling, filtering, deduplication, or release-selection rules, so the diagram preserves that boundary. Evaluation uses one inference per item at temperature 0.6 and a standardized Chinese prompt requiring JSON-only {answer: ...}; the parser tries JSON, falls back to regex, converts invalid output to empty, removes separators/whitespace, sorts multiple-answer letters, and exact-matches the gold answer. The script reports Accuracy by professional level, question form, and department plus invalid count. Table 7 separately marks QuarkMed results with optional knowledge augmentation.

name: CraftBench
intro: CraftBench 不是独立评测集，而是 Agent World Model（AWM）论文附录表 16 列出的一个合成环境场景，完整名称为 Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker。公开资料只披露该场景名称；构建与训练沿用 AWM 的通用环境合成、任务生成和数据库验证流程。
build_method: AWM 从场景名称扩展、CRUD 过滤与嵌入去重开始，再生成任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具和验证代码；CraftBench 只是其中一个命名场景
metric: 无独立指标（AWM 训练奖励）
eval_feature: SQL 状态变化验证与代码增强 LLM 判分；不是 CraftBench 专属评测
scale: AWM 共 1,000 个环境、10,000 个任务；CraftBench 仅为 1 个场景名称
build_method_en: AWM expands scenario names, applies CRUD filtering and embedding deduplication, then synthesizes tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools and verification code; CraftBench is only one named scenario
eval_feature_en: SQL state-difference verification and code-augmented LLM judging; not a CraftBench-specific evaluation
intro_en: CraftBench is not a standalone evaluation set. It is one synthetic environment scenario listed in Agent World Model Appendix Table 16, with the full name Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker. Public sources disclose only the scenario name; its construction and training follow the AWM-wide environment, task and database-verification pipeline.
scale_en: AWM has 1,000 environments and 10,000 tasks; CraftBench is one scenario name
flowchart_en: 100 domain seeds → scenario expansion/CRUD filter/dedup → 1,000 AWM scenarios including the CraftBench name → identity boundary → AWM-wide task, SQLite, MCP, verifier and reward pipeline.
flowchart_zh: 100 个域名种子 → 场景扩展、CRUD 过滤与去重 → 含 CraftBench 名称的 1,000 个 AWM 场景 → 身份边界 → AWM 通用任务、SQLite、MCP、验证器与奖励流程。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Agent World Model arXiv:2602.10090 Sections 3-4, Appendix A and Table 16 plus the official Snowflake-Labs repository. CraftBench is only the Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker scenario name inside AWM's 1,000-environment collection, not an independently specified benchmark. The diagram therefore shows the AWM-wide scenario, task, SQLite, MCP, verifier, self-correction and reward pipeline while explicitly preserving the missing CraftBench-specific item count, split, prompt, evaluation run and metric.

name: CraneMath
intro: CraneMath 是 Olmo 3 第二阶段中期训练语料，而不是独立评测集。它以 FineMath4+ 为源，复用 SwallowMath 提示并由 Qwen3-32B 重写，得到 5.62B tokens 的许可更宽松数学语料；其 MATH/GSM8K 数值来自数据质量 microanneal 消融。
build_method: 以 FineMath4+ 为源，使用 SwallowMath 公开提示和 Qwen3-32B 独立重写，生成许可更宽松的合成数学中期训练语料
metric: 数据消融：MATH/GSM8K 分数变化（非 CraneMath Accuracy）
eval_feature: 以 6T-token 基础模型做 50% 网页、50% 候选源 microanneal，对比 MATH、GSM8K 与 MMLU 变化
scale: 源数据池 5.62B tokens、6.55M 文档；Olmo 3 100B 混合中占 5.63%
build_method_en: Rewrite FineMath4+ independently with the published SwallowMath prompt and Qwen3-32B to create a more permissively licensed synthetic math midtraining corpus
eval_feature_en: Run 50% web/50% candidate-source microanneals from a 6T-token base model and compare MATH, GSM8K and MMLU changes
intro_en: CraneMath is Olmo 3 Stage-2 midtraining data, not a standalone evaluation set. It rewrites FineMath4+ with the published SwallowMath prompt using Qwen3-32B, yielding a 5.62B-token permissively generated math corpus; its MATH/GSM8K numbers are data-quality microanneal ablations.
scale_en: Source pool: 5.62B tokens and 6.55M documents; 5.63% of the Olmo 3 100B mix
metric_en: Data ablation: MATH/GSM8K score changes (not CraneMath Accuracy)
flowchart_en: FineMath4+ → SwallowMath rewrite recipe → Qwen3-32B rewrite → 5.62B-token CraneMath pool → corpus identity boundary → Olmo 3 mix and microanneal utility validation.
flowchart_zh: FineMath4+ → SwallowMath 重写配方 → Qwen3-32B 重写 → 5.62B-token CraneMath 数据池 → 语料身份边界 → Olmo 3 混合与 microanneal 效用验证。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Olmo 3 arXiv:2512.13961 Sections 3.5 and Appendix A.3.1 plus the official Dolma 3 Dolmino pool and mix cards. CraneMath is a Qwen3-32B rewrite of FineMath4+ using the SwallowMath prompt, released as a 5.62B-token synthetic math midtraining source. The diagram distinguishes the 6.55M-document source pool from its 5.63% inclusion in the 100B-token mix and treats MATH/GSM8K/MMLU microanneals as data ablation, not a standalone CraneMath benchmark score.

name: CritPt
intro: CritPt（Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test）评估模型解决未发表、研究级物理问题的能力，并非识别物理临界点。50 多位活跃物理研究者基于自身研究创建 71 个复合挑战并拆成 190 个检查点，覆盖 11 个现代物理学科。
org: Argonne National Laboratory, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
build_method: 50 多位活跃物理研究者基于未发表研究新建、自包含、抗搜索与抗猜测的挑战，拆为 2—4 个检查点并经迭代专家和同行复核
eval_feature: 两步生成自由解答与代码模板答案；私有服务器按数值容差、符号等价或 Python 隐藏用例自动判分
scale: 71 个挑战、190 个检查点；1 个公开样例、70 个私有答案测试挑战
build_method_en: 50+ active physics researchers create unpublished, self-contained, search-proof and guess-resistant challenges from their research, decompose each into 2-4 checkpoints, and iteratively expert- and peer-review them
eval_feature_en: Two-step free-form solution and code-template answer generation; private server auto-grading via numeric tolerances, symbolic equivalence or hidden Python tests
intro_en: CritPt (Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test) evaluates models on unpublished research-level physics problems; it is not about detecting physical critical points. More than 50 active researchers create 71 composite challenges decomposed into 190 checkpoints across 11 modern physics disciplines.
scale_en: 71 challenges and 190 checkpoints; 1 public example and 70 test challenges with private answers
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.26574 v4, the official CritPt website, GitHub generation pipeline and Artificial Analysis grading interface. CritPt contains 71 composite challenges and 190 checkpoints created from unpublished work by 50+ active physics researchers across 30+ institutions and 11 disciplines. Each challenge is search-proof, guess-resistant and machine-verifiable, is decomposed into 2-4 checkpoints, and receives iterative expert and high-level peer review averaging more than 40 expert hours. One example is public while 70 test answers remain private. The official run generates a free-form solution and then a normalized code-template answer; complete 70-problem batches are graded by physics-specific numeric, symbolic or executable-function checks and headline accuracy is averaged over five runs.

name: CruxEval
intro: CruxEval是一个用于评估代码语言模型推理、理解和执行能力的基准。它包含800个Python函数，每个函数都配有输入输出对，并设计了输入预测和输出预测两个任务。该基准旨在衡量模型在简单代码片段上的执行预测和代码推理能力。
build_method: Code Llama 34B过量生成, 编译期与运行期过滤, Bootstrap噪声测量, 随机稳定抽样
task_type: 代码推理, 输入, 输出预测
eval_feature: 代码推理, 执行跟踪
build_method_en: Code Llama 34B Overgeneration, Compile-time and Runtime Filtering, Bootstrap Noise Measurement, Random Stable Sampling
eval_feature_en: Code Reasoning, Execution Tracing
intro_en: CruxEval is a benchmark for evaluating code language models' reasoning, understanding, and execution abilities. It includes 800 Python functions, each paired with input-output examples, and features two tasks: input prediction and output prediction. The benchmark aims to assess models' execution prediction and code reasoning skills on simple code snippets.

name: CRUXEval-I
intro: CRUXEval-I 是 CRUXEval 的输入预测任务：给定一个短 Python 函数和目标输出，模型需找出任一执行后产生该输出的输入。共享数据集由 Code Llama 34B 大规模生成并执行、严格过滤后随机选出 800 条。
build_method: Code Llama 34B 基于 69 个标准库方法生成 102,000 个函数与 489,306 个输入输出对，经编译、运行、安全和人类可解性过滤后随机选 800 条
eval_feature: 允许多个有效输入；沙箱执行 assert 目标输出 == f(生成输入)，逐题计算无偏 pass@k
scale: 800 个不同 Python 函数及输入输出对，函数长 3—13 行
build_method_en: Code Llama 34B generates 102,000 functions and 489,306 input-output pairs from 69 standard-library methods; compile, runtime, safety and human-solvability filters precede random selection of 800
eval_feature_en: Accept any valid input; sandbox-execute assert target_output == f(generated_input) and compute unbiased per-item pass@k
intro_en: CRUXEval-I is CRUXEval's input-prediction task: given a short Python function and target output, the model must find any input that executes to that output. The shared set is generated at scale by Code Llama 34B, executed, rigorously filtered and randomly reduced to 800 samples.
scale_en: 800 distinct Python functions and input-output pairs, 3-13 lines each
flowchart_en: 69 Python methods → Code Llama generation → 102K functions/489K pairs → compile/runtime/safety filters → random 800 → input-prediction prompt → parse → sandbox assertion → Pass@1/5.

name: CSR-Bench
intro: CSR-Bench 用 100 个计算机科学研究仓库评测 LLM 智能体理解部署说明、生成和执行 Bash 命令，并借助日志、GitHub Issues 与网页搜索修复部署错误的能力。
org: Amazon, University of California, Los Angeles
build_method: 从超过 1,500 个 GitHub 候选仓库按五领域分类和星数排序，再人工筛选 README 充分、代码可部署且许可宽松的 100 个仓库
metric: 命令完成率（成功执行命令数 / 执行命令总数），并按环境、下载、训练、推理、评测阶段报告
build_method_en: Classify and star-rank over 1,500 GitHub candidates across five areas, then manually retain 100 repositories with sufficient READMEs, deployable code, and permissive licenses
eval_feature_en: Process-oriented, Result-oriented
intro_en: CSR-Bench uses 100 computer-science research repositories to evaluate whether LLM agents can understand deployment instructions, generate and execute Bash commands, and recover from deployment errors using logs, GitHub issues, and web search.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.06111 Sections 3–5 and Figure 7. CSR-Bench starts from over 1,500 top-star GitHub repositories associated with more than ten major NLP, CV, AI, ML, and data-mining conferences. Candidates are grouped into NLP, computer vision, LLM, machine-learning, and interdisciplinary areas, ranked by stars, and manually screened for sufficient README documentation, deployable code, topic diversity, self-containment, and permissive licensing, leaving 100 repositories. The README is the primary deployment source and directory structure, source code, and scripts are supplementary. Command Drafter produces Bash commands in up to five sections: prerequisite setup, data/model download, training, inference, and evaluation. Script Executor runs them in a standardized Docker/Bash environment and an LLM parses stdout/stderr into a return state. Failures progress through Log Analyzer, BM25 retrieval over repository Issues, and Perplexity web search, with limited retries. The paper's metric is completion rate, successful commands divided by all executed commands, reported for setup, download, training, evaluation, and inference stages.

name: CureBench
intro: CURE-Bench 是 NeurIPS 2025 治疗推理竞赛基准，评测模型在药物决策、治疗规划、安全性与疗效分析中的多步推理、工具使用和临床可靠性。
build_method: 基于 TxAgent 数据生成系统，以 QuestionGen、TraceGen、ToolGen 三个模块生成并验证临床问题、推理轨迹和工具解法
metric: 正确性、鲁棒性、效率、事实性与临床相关性的预定义加权总分；头部提交由人类专家复核
eval_feature: 内部知识赛道与工具增强赛道；智能体裁判和临床专家验证
scale: 数千条（精确数量未公开）
build_method_en: Use a TxAgent-based modular pipeline—QuestionGen, TraceGen, and ToolGen—to generate and validate clinical questions, reasoning traces, and tool-based solutions
eval_feature_en: Internal-knowledge and tool-augmented tracks with agentic judges and clinical-expert validation
intro_en: CURE-Bench is a NeurIPS 2025 therapeutic-reasoning competition benchmark for multi-step drug decision-making, treatment planning, safety and efficacy analysis, tool use, and clinical reliability.
metric_en: Predefined weighted aggregate of correctness, robustness, efficiency, factuality, and clinical relevance, with human-expert review of top submissions
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official CURE-Bench site and NeurIPS 2025 competition abstract. CURE-Bench covers twelve published therapeutic task families spanning treatment recommendation, adverse events, drug labeling and ingredients, warnings, dependence, dosage, special populations, pharmacology, clinical information, nonclinical toxicology, and patient information. Its validated TxAgent-derived multi-agent pipeline is documented as QuestionGen for clinically plausible queries, TraceGen for grounded multi-step reasoning traces, and ToolGen for callable biomedical tools; the output is described only as thousands of examples, so no exact item count is claimed. Track 1 permits internal model knowledge only, while Track 2 permits external biomedical tools and real-time information. Submissions include reasoning traces, final answers, token use, and model metadata. The official evaluation combines correctness, rephrasing and option-order robustness, token/tool efficiency, agentic factuality and clinical-relevance checks, plus expert assessment of top submissions into a predefined weighted score. Exact task instances, split sizes, metric weights, prompts, and judge configuration are not publicly specified, and the diagram preserves those boundaries.

name: CURIE
intro: CURIE是一个科学长上下文理解、推理和信息提取基准，用于评估大型语言模型在辅助真实科学工作流程中的能力。包含10个挑战性任务，共580个问题与解答，涵盖六个科学领域。评估模型的领域专业知识、长上下文理解及多步推理能力。
build_method: 六个领域中每领域 1–3 名博士专家定义真实科研任务、选择宽松许可来源、标注标准答案和难度并交叉复核
metric: LLMSim-F1、ROUGE-L、边界框 IoU、蛋白序列一致率；各任务归一化至 [0,1] 后取十任务平均
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 开放式问答, 抽取, 摘要
eval_feature: 长文本, 领域特定, 多轮
build_method_en: One to three Ph.D. experts per discipline define realistic workflows, select permissively licensed sources, annotate ground truth and difficulty, and cross-review extraction tasks
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Domain-specific, Multi-turn
intro_en: CURIE is a scientific long-context understanding, reasoning, and information extraction benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' capabilities in supporting real scientific workflows. It includes 10 challenging tasks with a total of 580 questions and answers across six scientific domains. The benchmark assesses models' domain expertise, long-context comprehension, and multi-step reasoning abilities.

    F["根据任务使用ROUGE-L、BERTScore、IoU、同一性比率或基于模型的F1评分"] --> G["专家手动评定每个任务10-12%的响应并测量提取的精确率和召回率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.13517 Sections 3–4 and Appendix Tables 3–4. CURIE uses 1–3 Ph.D. experts in each of six disciplines—materials science, theoretical condensed-matter physics, quantum computing, geospatial analysis, biodiversity, and proteins—to define ten realistic scientific-workflow tasks. Tasks must be solvable from the supplied context and expert-evaluable; experts select permissively licensed papers or scientific records, create nuanced ground truth, assign difficulty, and cross-review extraction annotations. The release contains 580 input/solution pairs from 429 research documents, averaging about 15k words of context, across DFT-S, DFT-P, DFT-C, MPV, HFD, HFE, QECC, GEO, BIOGR, and PDB. Standard zero-shot prompts contain the task, output format, and full paper; BIOGR instead uses a map image and caption, and PDB uses stripped coordinate text. Primary aggregate metrics are LLMSim precision/recall/F1 for DFT-S, DFT-P, and MPV; ROUGE-L for DFT-C, HFD, HFE, QECC, and GEO; bounding-box IoU for BIOGR; and pairwise-alignment identity ratio for PDB. Metrics are normalized to [0,1] and averaged across ten tasks. Experts additionally use task rubrics and audit 10–12% of outputs as good, okay, or bad; this audit validates metrics but is not substituted into the primary aggregate.

name: CursorBench
intro: CursorBench 是 Cursor 基于内部工程团队真实会话持续更新的编程智能体评测套件，使用模糊、多文件、多工具和多步骤任务衡量真实开发效用。
build_method: 用 Cursor Blame 将已提交代码追溯到生成它的智能体请求，形成开发者请求与标准解法对，并从内部/受控来源筛选、每隔数月刷新
metric: 公开排行榜：正确性得分、单任务平均成本、Token 数、步骤数；内部另评代码质量、效率和交互行为
eval_feature: 智能体裁判接受多种有效解法；离线评测与受控线上实验交叉验证
build_method_en: Use Cursor Blame to trace committed code to the agent request that produced it, pair the developer query with its ground-truth solution, curate internal/controlled sources, and refresh every few months
eval_feature_en: Agentic graders accept multiple valid solutions; offline results are cross-checked with controlled online experiments
intro_en: CursorBench is Cursor's continuously updated internal coding-agent suite, built from real engineering sessions and ambiguous, multi-file, multi-tool, multi-step development tasks.
metric_en: Public leaderboard: correctness score, average cost per task, tokens, and steps; internal axes also include code quality, efficiency, and interaction behavior
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Cursor's official March 2026 methodology post and live CursorBench 3.1 leaderboard, not inferred from third-party model system cards. Cursor Blame traces committed code back to the agent request that produced it, yielding a natural developer-query/ground-truth-solution pair. Tasks come mainly from Cursor's internal codebase and controlled sources, are refreshed every few months, and intentionally use short, ambiguous descriptions. Version 3.0 focused on edit, refactor, and bug-fix tasks; 3.1 adds codebase understanding, bug finding, planning, and code review, and revises some edit-task grading criteria. Agents run against an initialized codebase and are graded by agentic graders that can accept multiple valid solutions. Cursor discloses correctness, code quality, efficiency, and interaction behavior as internal axes, while the public 3.1 leaderboard reports Score, average cost per task, tokens, and steps; cost applies each model's published input/cache-read/cache-write/output token prices. Controlled online experiments validate whether offline rankings track developer outcomes. Because the task distribution changes, scores must be compared only within the same eval version. Task instances, suite size, grader prompts/rubrics, harness, and per-item outputs remain proprietary and are explicitly marked as undisclosed.

name: CValues
intro: CValues 是首个中文人类价值观评测基准，从安全和责任两个递进层级评估 LLM：众包人员收集十类对抗安全提示，八个领域的专业专家撰写责任提示，并同时提供人工与自动评测。
build_method: 十类安全场景中由众包人员攻击早期 ChatPLUG，八个责任领域由专业专家各写 100 题；再经人工归类、反向改写和选项换序构建自动选择题
metric: 人工：安全回答占比、责任回答专家平均分；自动：准确率及排除拒答后的准确率
task_type: 开放式问答, 安全测试, 排序
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
scale: 2,100 条人工评测提示 + 4,312 道自动选择题
build_method_en: Crowdworkers attack early ChatPLUG across ten safety scenarios while eight domain experts write 100 responsibility prompts each; human categorization, opposite-response rewriting, and option-order swapping produce automatic MCQs
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: CValues is the first Chinese human-values benchmark to assess two ascending levels of alignment: crowdworker-collected adversarial safety prompts across ten scenarios and responsibility prompts authored by experts in eight domains, with both human and automatic evaluation.

flowchart LR

    B --> C[Prompt Development]
    C --> D{{Manual Annotation}}
    D --> E[Categorization & Refinement]
    E --> F{Quality Check}
    F -- Pass --> G[Adversarial Prompt Generation]
    F -- Fail --> D
    G --> H(CValues Benchmark Dataset)
    H --> I[Manual Evaluation]
    H --> J[Automated Evaluation]
    I --> K[LLM Alignment Assessment]
    J --> K
metric_en: Human: safe-response ratio and expert mean responsibility score; automatic: accuracy and accuracy excluding refusals

flowchart LR
    A["Professional experts manually collect adversarial safety prompts across 10 scenarios"] --> B["Professional experts induce responsibility prompts from 8 domains"]
    B["Professional experts induce responsibility prompts from 8 domains"] --> C["Apply two expert-in-the-loop methods to collect representative prompts susceptible to value issues"]
    C["Apply two expert-in-the-loop methods to collect representative prompts susceptible to value issues"] --> D["Construct 4312 multi-choice prompts for automatic evaluation"]
    D["Construct 4312 multi-choice prompts for automatic evaluation"] --> E["Assemble 2100 adversarial prompts for human evaluation"]
    E["Assemble 2100 adversarial prompts for human evaluation"] --> F["Conduct automatic evaluation using multi-choice prompts to measure safety and responsibility alignment"]
    F["Conduct automatic evaluation using multi-choice prompts to measure safety and responsibility alignment"] --> G["Conduct human evaluation for reliable comparison of LLM value alignment"]

flowchart LR
    A["专业专家手动收集10个场景的对抗性安全提示"] --> B["专业专家从8个领域归纳责任提示"]
    B["专业专家从8个领域归纳责任提示"] --> C["应用两种专家在环方法收集易受价值问题影响的代表性提示"]
    C["应用两种专家在环方法收集易受价值问题影响的代表性提示"] --> D["构建4312个多选题提示用于自动评估"]
    D["构建4312个多选题提示用于自动评估"] --> E["组装2100个对抗性提示用于人工评估"]
    E["组装2100个对抗性提示用于人工评估"] --> F["使用多选题提示进行自动评估以衡量安全性和责任感对齐"]
    F["使用多选题提示进行自动评估以衡量安全性和责任感对齐"] --> G["进行人工评估以可靠比较LLM价值观对齐"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.09705 Sections 2.1–2.3 and Figure 3. CValues defines two ascending Chinese-value criteria: Level 1 safety, requiring no harmful or risky response, and Level 2 responsibility, requiring positive guidance, humanistic care, and attention to social impact. For safety, the authors extend a ten-scenario taxonomy and have crowdworkers attack an early ChatPLUG instant-message chatbot; only questions that successfully trigger a safety issue are labeled by scenario and retained, yielding 1,300 prompts. For responsibility, the 100 Bottles of Poison for AI project recruits eight professional experts from domains such as environmental science, law, and psychology, each writing 100 induced questions, yielding 800 prompts. These 2,100 prompts form the human-evaluation set. Safety responses are independently labeled safe/unsafe by three specialized annotators and majority-voted, with safe-response proportion as score. Because full expert evaluation is expensive, responsibility human evaluation uses ChatPLUG-13B as a representative: three top-k candidates per prompt are judged by the originating expert, who chooses the best or neither, scores it 1–10, and may write an answer; domain means are reported. For automatic evaluation, multiple LLM responses are human-categorized into opposite value classes; ChatGPT rewrites one response if a class is missing; one response from each class is templated into a binary MCQ and the option order is swapped. The automatic set has 4,312 items—2,600 safety and 1,712 responsibility—and reports accuracy both including and excluding refusals.

name: CVBench
intro: CVBench是首个旨在严格评估跨视频关系推理能力的诊断基准。它包含1000个问答对，涵盖跨视频对象关联、跨视频事件关联和跨视频复杂推理三个层次。该基准挑战模型分析和整合来自动态视觉流的时空模式，并揭示了当前多模态大语言模型在跨视频理解方面的瓶颈。
org: Sun Yat-sen University, University of Hong Kong, Foshan University, University of Birmingham
build_method: 从 YouTube 检索 1,500 个候选视频，按跨视频关系、领域、时长和 720p/24fps 质量筛为 1,315 个，再经多级描述、GPT-4o 生成和两轮人工复核形成 1,000 题
metric: 准确率（总体、三个推理层级及 15 个子任务）
build_method_en: Retrieve 1,500 YouTube candidates; curate 1,315 by cross-video relations, domain, duration and 720p/24fps quality; then use hierarchical descriptions, GPT-4o synthesis and two-stage human review to produce 1,000 QA pairs
eval_feature_en: Process Evaluation
intro_en: CVBench is the first diagnostic benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate cross-video relational reasoning abilities. It contains 1,000 QA pairs covering three levels: cross-video object association, cross-video event association, and cross-video complex reasoning. The benchmark challenges models to analyze and integrate spatiotemporal patterns from dynamic visual streams, revealing current multimodal large language models' bottlenecks in cross-video understanding.

    D --> F[Event Association Annotation]

    B["按多领域覆盖、视频间关系、时长和画质标准筛选"] --> C["为视频片段生成字幕以捕获时空内容"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.19542 Sections 3.1–3.2, Figure 3 and Tables 1–4. CVBench defines three diagnostic tiers—cross-video object association, event association and complex reasoning—covering 15 subtasks. Task-driven YouTube retrieval yields 1,500 candidate videos. Eight annotators curate groups of two to four videos for multi-domain coverage, intrinsic relationships such as similarity, difference, causality and temporal order, primarily sub-10-minute duration, and at least 720p/24fps quality; gap filling and quality-driven replacement leave 1,315 videos. The four-stage QA pipeline adaptively samples frames and writes segment captions, aggregates video-level descriptions, builds relational summaries covering state transitions, causal links, complementarities and contradictions, and uses GPT-4o to generate at least two MCQs per group with one correct answer and three entity/temporal/causal distractors. First-stage review by eight annotators applies 15 task-specific criteria and can revise questions, fix options or recollect videos. Five new annotators independently re-examine 200 questions each for compliance, correctness and hallucination, yielding 1,000 QA pairs. Evaluation uses indexed multi-video inputs, eight frames per video for open models unless otherwise stated, zero-shot or chain-of-thought prompting, and Accuracy reported overall and by tier/subtask.

name: CVE-Bench
intro: CVE-Bench是一个评估AI智能体利用真实世界网络应用漏洞能力的基准。它通过一个沙盒框架，模拟真实世界的网络攻击场景，旨在解决现有基准在覆盖范围和真实性方面的不足。该基准基于严重级别的常见漏洞和暴露（CVE），并提供有效的漏洞利用评估。初步评估显示，最先进的智能体框架可以解决高达13%的漏洞。
build_method: 从 2024-05-01 至 2024-06-14 的 NVD Critical CVE 中，经两位作者筛选可复现、开源免费、跨平台 Web 应用并复现漏洞利用，封装 40 个容器化任务
metric: 成功率：智能体是否达成八类标准攻击目标之一；分别支持零日和一日上下文
eval_feature: 动态更新, 防污染, 对抗性, 过程评估
scale: 40 个 Critical CVE（CVSS v3.1 不低于 9.0）
build_method_en: Two authors screen NVD Critical CVEs from 2024-05-01 through 2024-06-14 for reproducible FOSS, platform-independent web applications, reproduce exploits, and package 40 containerized tasks
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Update, Contamination-free, Adversarial, Process Evaluation
intro_en: CVE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' ability to exploit real-world network application vulnerabilities. It uses a sandbox framework to simulate real-world network attack scenarios, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks in coverage and realism. The benchmark is based on high-severity Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and provides effective vulnerability exploitation assessment. Preliminary evaluations show that state-of-the-art agent frameworks can exploit up to 13% of the vulnerabilities.

    D["根据PoC或描述复现漏洞利用验证正确性"] --> E["将每个漏洞利用对齐到八种标准攻击类型"]
    E["将每个漏洞利用对齐到八种标准攻击类型"] --> F["为每个CVE指定攻击目标和生命周期上下文"]
    F["为每个CVE指定攻击目标和生命周期上下文"] --> G["部署评估服务器自动验证智能体攻击成功与否"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.17332 Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix A. The source pool is every NVD entry published from May 1 through June 14, 2024 and rated CRITICAL under CVSS v3.x. One author screens and a second independently confirms that the CVE affects a free/open-source web application, is platform-independent, needs no sensitive external information and can be reproduced. The authors reproduce exploits from a public PoC when available or from the NVD description and vendor patch otherwise; all 40 retained CVEs have CVSS v3.1 scores of at least 9.0. Reference exploit containers are kept private to reduce contamination and real-world risk. Target environments typically contain application, database and auxiliary containers, with victim simulation when required. Each task includes an endpoint, usage guidance, eight measurable standard attack goals, and disallowed actions such as attacking the evaluator or brute-forcing passwords. Zero-day mode withholds the vulnerability description; one-day mode includes the NVD summary. The agent interacts only with designated targets, and an in-container grader continuously monitors whether any standard goal is achieved; the benchmark metric is exploit success rate.

name: CWEval
intro: CWEval 是同时评测 LLM 生成代码功能性与安全性的结果驱动框架；其公开 CWEval-bench 含 119 个安全关键编码任务，覆盖 31 类 CWE 和 5 种编程语言。
build_method: 依据 CWE 文档设计自包含安全关键任务，为每题编写无安全提示泄漏的清晰规格、功能与安全动态判定器，以及安全和功能正确但不安全的双参考实现并由专家验证
metric: func@k（通过全部功能测试）与 func-sec@k（同时通过全部功能和安全测试），采用无偏 pass@k 式估计
eval_feature: 功能与安全联合动态执行；结果驱动判定
scale: 119 个任务 · 31 类 CWE · 5 种语言
build_method_en: Derive self-contained security-critical tasks from CWE documentation; write clear specifications without security-awareness leakage, dynamic functionality/security oracles, and secure plus functional-but-insecure reference implementations; then expert-verify each task
eval_feature_en: Joint dynamic functionality and security execution with outcome-driven oracles
intro_en: CWEval is an outcome-driven framework that evaluates the functionality and security of LLM-generated code simultaneously; its public CWEval-bench contains 119 security-critical tasks spanning 31 CWEs and five programming languages.
metric_en: func@k for passing all functionality tests and func-sec@k for passing all functionality and security tests, using unbiased pass@k-style estimators
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the independent CWEval paper arXiv:2501.08200 Sections III–V and the official Co1lin/CWEval repository, rather than treating CWEval as a Qwen-only vulnerability-repair benchmark. Tasks are derived from CWE documentation and isolate third-party dependencies while preserving security-critical behavior. Every specification includes a function signature, natural-language docstring and optional examples, must contain security semantics, intentionally avoids security-awareness hints, and remains functionally unambiguous. Each task has dynamic functionality oracles based on expected behavior and security oracles that may inspect outputs, execution time, memory validity or state integrity. A secure reference implementation must pass both suites; at least one functional-but-insecure implementation must pass functionality and fail security, proving vulnerability reproducibility and feasible mitigation without sacrificing function. Expert programmers manually verify the tasks. CWEval-bench contains 119 tasks covering 31 CWEs across five languages, including 11 C-specific memory-vulnerability tasks. Model samples are executed against both oracle suites. func@k estimates the probability that any of k samples is functional, while func-sec@k requires both functionality and security; both use the unbiased pass@k estimator.

name: Cybench
intro: Cybench是一个用于评估语言模型在网络安全任务中能力和风险的框架。它包含40个专业级别的夺旗（CTF）任务，这些任务来源于4个不同的CTF竞赛，涵盖了广泛的难度。每个任务都包含描述、起始文件，并在一个代理可以执行命令和观察输出的环境中初始化。为了更详细的评估，每个任务还引入了子任务。
build_method: 从四个 2022–2024 年专业 CTF 竞赛筛选 40 题，覆盖六类技能和 2 分钟至 24 小时 54 分钟首解时间；为每题补充子任务、标准解脚本、CI 与服务存活检查
metric: 无引导成功率、子任务引导最终成功率、宏平均子任务完成率、最难已解题首解时间，以及 Token/耗时
build_method_en: Select 40 tasks from four professional 2022–2024 CTFs across six categories and first-solve times from 2 minutes to 24 h 54 min; add subtasks, a solution script, CI, and server liveness checks
eval_feature_en: Process Evaluation
intro_en: Cybench is a framework for evaluating language models' capabilities and risks in cybersecurity tasks. It includes 40 professional-level CTF tasks sourced from 4 different CTF competitions, covering a wide range of difficulties. Each task contains a description, starter files, and is initialized in an environment where an agent can execute commands and observe outputs. For more detailed evaluation, each task also includes subtasks.

    B["为每个任务指定描述、起始文件和答案评估程序"] --> C["在Kali Linux容器中初始化任务及服务器"]
    C["在Kali Linux容器中初始化任务及服务器"] --> D["将每个任务分解为带中间目标的子任务"]
    D["将每个任务分解为带中间目标的子任务"] --> E["构建在环境中执行命令并观察输出的网络安全代理"]
    E["构建在环境中执行命令并观察输出的网络安全代理"] --> F["在有无子任务指导下评估8个语言模型"]
