flowchart LR
    A["选择62本大学和研究生教材，覆盖11个学科的43个子领域"] --> B["通过截图手动提取知识语句，用马赛克遮盖无关内容"]
    B["通过截图手动提取知识语句，用马赛克遮盖无关内容"] --> C["使用doubao-1.5-vision-pro从图像中提取语句并生成标题"]
    C["使用doubao-1.5-vision-pro从图像中提取语句并生成标题"] --> D["验证正确语句的独立性、完整性、语义清晰度和信息简洁性"]
    D["验证正确语句的独立性、完整性、语义清晰度和信息简洁性"] --> E["使用DeepSeek-R1将正确语句转换为保持专业语气的似是而非的错误语句"]
    E["使用DeepSeek-R1将正确语句转换为保持专业语气的似是而非的错误语句"] --> F["在测试时随机抽样并组合8-10条语句形成评估问题"]
    F["在测试时随机抽样并组合8-10条语句形成评估问题"] --> G["在动态组合的问题上评估50多个LLM的多语句综合理解能力"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.24867 Sections 3.1–4.2, Tables 1–2, and Appendix C. The diagram preserves the paper's two differently scoped hierarchy counts: Section 3.1.1 reports 62 selected textbooks spanning 43 source subfields across 11 disciplines, while Table 1 reports the final statement collection covering 44 fields and 62 subfields. It records manual screenshot capture and mosaic masking; doubao-1.5-vision-pro-32k extraction of standalone statements and titles; independence, completeness, clarity, and conciseness filters; removal of image-bearing, reference/formula, and ambiguous items; three-annotator review of 21,525 correct statements; DeepSeek-R1 generation with six error patterns and short-item filtering to 21,494 incorrect statements; the 43,019-statement pool; dynamic 8–10-statement, 4–8-option questions with 2–4 statements per option; discipline-proportional standard generation of 5,038 questions split into 3,286 English and 1,752 Chinese; and tiered regex/content fallback answer parsing where misses count as incorrect before accuracy reporting.

name: Eq-bench
intro: EQ-Bench 是面向纯文本大语言模型的情绪理解基准。它要求模型阅读由 GPT-4 生成的冲突或紧张对话，为角色的四种候选情绪分别给出 0–10 强度，经过自我批评后再修订评分，并以与作者参考情绪分布的距离计算总分。
build_method: GPT-4对话生成, 作者制定问题与参考情绪强度, 精确零样本提示, 自动解析与距离计分
task_type: 情绪理解与人际动态推理
eval_feature: 四情绪强度评分, 批评与修订, 相对强度归一化, 解析失败门槛
build_method_en: GPT-4 dialogue generation, author-defined questions/references, exact zero-shot prompting, automatic parsing and distance scoring
eval_feature_en: Four-emotion intensity ratings, critique and revision, relative-intensity normalization, parseability threshold
intro_en: EQ-Bench is a text-only emotional-understanding benchmark for large language models. Models read GPT-4-generated conflict or tension dialogues, rate four candidate emotions from 0 to 10, critique and revise their ratings, and receive a score based on distance from author-defined reference emotion distributions.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Sample location, author style, and conflict/tension scenario seeds"] --> B["Use GPT-4 to generate emotionally nuanced dialogue scenes"]
    B --> C["Authors choose four diverse emotions and 0–10 reference ratings"]
    C --> D["Build 60 English emotional-understanding questions"]
    D --> E["Prompt zero-shot first-pass scores, critique, and revised scores"]
    E --> F["Parse at temperature 0.01; add 0.15 on failure for up to five retries"]
    F --> G["Normalize four ratings to sum 10 and score 10 minus absolute differences"]
    G --> H["Average first/revised runs separately, take the better run; fewer than 50 parseable answers fails"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["随机采样地点、作者风格与冲突/紧张情境种子"] --> B["用GPT-4生成具有细腻情绪张力的对话"]
    B --> C["作者选择四种差异化情绪并设定0–10参考强度"]
    C --> D["构建60道英文情绪理解问题"]
    D --> E["零样本输出首轮评分、逐步批评与修订评分"]
    E --> F["温度0.01解析；失败则每次加0.15，最多重试五次"]
    F --> G["将四情绪归一化为总和10，并以10减绝对差之和计分"]
    G --> H["分别平均首轮/修订轮并取更高整轮；可解析题少于50即失败"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the original December 2023 EQ-Bench paper arXiv:2312.06281 Sections 2.6 and 3.1–3.10, not the later Qwen3-VL report that merely cites the benchmark. The diagram records random location/author-style/scenario seeds; GPT-4 generation constrained to conflict or tension; author-selected questions, four diverse emotions, and reference ratings; 60 English items; exact zero-shot first-pass/critique/revised response structure; temperature 0.01 with +0.15 parse-failure increments until parseable or attempts exceed five; normalization of each four-emotion vector to sum 10; per-question score 10 minus the sum of absolute differences; random baseline 0 and perfect alignment 100; separate first-pass and revised-run averages with the better entire run selected rather than per-question cherry-picking; and failure below 50 parseable answers out of 60.

name: ERQA
intro: ERQA（Embodied Reasoning Question Answering）是 Google DeepMind 随 Gemini Robotics 发布的开放具身推理基准。它包含 400 道图文交错的四选一 VQA，覆盖空间、轨迹、动作、状态估计、指向、多视角和任务推理；其中 28% 使用多张图像。
build_method: 具身能力分类, 团队策展图文交错选择题, 问题类型标注, TFRecord公开发布
eval_feature: 八类具身推理, 28%多图题, 直接与思维链提示, 分类别准确率
scale: 400个问题（84空间、72动作、66轨迹、55状态、38任务、37多视角、34指向、14其他）
build_method_en: Embodied-capability taxonomy, team-curated interleaved VQA, question-type labels, public TFRecord release
eval_feature_en: Eight embodied-reasoning categories, 28% multi-image, direct/CoT prompting, category accuracy
intro_en: ERQA (Embodied Reasoning Question Answering) is an open embodied-reasoning benchmark released by Google DeepMind with Gemini Robotics. It contains 400 interleaved image-text four-choice VQA items spanning spatial, trajectory, action, state-estimation, pointing, multi-view, and task reasoning; 28% use multiple images.
scale_en: 400 questions (84 spatial, 72 action, 66 trajectory, 55 state, 38 task, 37 multi-view, 34 pointing, 14 other)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define physical-world embodied reasoning capabilities beyond atomic perception"] --> B["Curate interleaved one-or-more-image, text, four-choice VQA items"]
    B --> C["Assign eight question types across 400 questions; preserve 28% multi-image items"]
    C --> D["Release TFRecord fields: question, images, answer, question type, visual indices"]
    D --> E["Run zero-shot direct or exact optional CoT prompting"]
    E --> F["Parse final A/B/C/D option and compare with ground truth"]
    F --> G["Report overall and per-category accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["定义超越原子感知的物理世界具身推理能力"] --> B["策展一张或多张图像与文本交错的四选一VQA"]
    B --> C["为400题标注八类问题，并保留28%多图题"]
    C --> D["以TFRecord发布问题、图像、答案、类型与视觉索引字段"]
    D --> E["进行零样本直接提示或论文原始可选思维链提示"]
    E --> F["解析最终A/B/C/D选项并与标准答案比对"]
    F --> G["报告总体与分类别准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Gemini Robotics report arXiv:2503.20020 Section 2.1, Figures 3–5, Tables 1–2, and the official embodiedreasoning/ERQA release. The diagram records the physical-world capability scope; interleaved one-or-more-image four-choice VQA format; all 400 questions; category counts from Figure 4 (84 spatial, 72 action, 66 trajectory, 55 state estimation, 38 task, 37 multi-view, 34 pointing, and 14 other); the 28% multi-image share; cross-frame registration, affordance, and 3D-relation demands; TFRecord fields question, image/encoded, answer, question_type, and visual_indices under CC BY 4.0; zero-shot direct and the report's optional CoT instruction; final-option parsing; and overall/category accuracy. The report and repository do not disclose an image-acquisition or question-authoring protocol, so the diagram explicitly avoids inventing one.

name: EvalPlus
intro: EvalPlus是一个代码合成评估框架，旨在严格评估大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的代码的功能正确性。它通过LLM和基于变异的策略自动生成大量新的测试用例来增强现有评估数据集。EvalPlus能够发现LLM合成代码中大量未被检测到的错误，并揭示了测试不足可能导致的错误排名。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Nanjing University
build_method_en: Automated Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free
intro_en: EvalPlus is a code synthesis evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess the functional correctness of code generated by large language models (LLMs). It enhances existing evaluation datasets by automatically generating numerous new test cases through LLMs and mutation-based strategies. EvalPlus can detect many previously undetected errors in LLM-synthesized code and reveals error rankings that may result from insufficient testing.

name: EVMbench
intro: EVMbench评估AI智能体检测、修补和利用高危智能合约漏洞的能力。论文从公开审计报告和Tempo安全场景出发，经自动筛选与OtterSec专家质检得到40次审计中的120个漏洞；检测覆盖全部120个漏洞，修补覆盖22个仓库的45个漏洞，利用覆盖16个仓库的24个漏洞。
build_method: 公开审计报告筛选, OtterSec专家质检, 隔离任务环境, 三模式隐藏验证
metric: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate
task_type: 智能合约漏洞检测, 修补, 利用
eval_feature: 检测用GPT-5报告匹配, 修补用隐藏利用测试, 利用用交易重放与Rust状态评分器
scale: 120个漏洞/40次审计；修补45个/22仓库；利用24个/16仓库
build_method_en: Public Audit-report Screening, OtterSec Expert QC, Isolated Task Environments, Three-mode Hidden Verification
eval_feature_en: GPT-5 Report Matching for Detect, Hidden Exploit Tests for Patch, Transaction Replay and Rust State Grader for Exploit
intro_en: EVMbench evaluates agents on detecting, patching, and exploiting high-severity smart-contract vulnerabilities. The paper filters public audit findings and Tempo security scenarios, then uses OtterSec expert QC to obtain 120 vulnerabilities from 40 audits; Detect covers all 120, Patch covers 45 vulnerabilities in 22 repositories, and Exploit covers 24 in 16 repositories.
scale_en: 120 vulnerabilities / 40 audits; Patch 45 / 22 repositories; Exploit 24 / 16 repositories
metric_en: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate

name: ExploitBench
intro: ExploitBench是一个面向网络安全智能体的能力阶梯基准。首个v8-bench版本在启用V8 heap sandbox的隔离容器中评测41个生产级已知漏洞，用16项单调能力标志刻画从代码覆盖、触发漏洞、构造利用原语到任意代码执行的进展。
build_method: 生产级V8 N-day漏洞整理, 逐漏洞隔离镜像, 统一MCP接口, 确定性重播种评分器
metric: 16-capability Bitmap, Tier Success Rate, Arbitrary Code Execution Rate
modality: 文本, 代码, 交互式工具轨迹
task_type: 漏洞覆盖, 触发, 利用原语构造, 任意代码执行
eval_feature: V8 heap sandbox, 隔离容器, 差分真值二进制, 重播种挑战响应, 300轮智能体交互
scale: 41个V8漏洞, 16项能力, 5层阶梯, 9个模型, 每设置3个种子
task_type_en: Vulnerability Coverage, Triggering, Exploit Primitives, Arbitrary Code Execution
build_method_en: Production V8 N-day Curation, Per-bug Isolated Images, Uniform MCP Interface, Deterministic Reseeded Graders
eval_feature_en: V8 Heap Sandbox, Isolated Containers, Differential Ground-truth Binaries, Reseeded Challenge-response, 300-turn Agent Runs
intro_en: ExploitBench is a capability-ladder benchmark for cybersecurity agents. Its first v8-bench release evaluates 41 known production V8 vulnerabilities in isolated containers with the V8 heap sandbox enabled, using 16 monotonic capability flags to track progress from code coverage and bug triggering through exploit primitives to arbitrary code execution.
scale_en: 41 V8 bugs, 16 capabilities, 5 tiers, 9 models, 3 seeds per setting
metric_en: 16-capability Bitmap, Tier Success Rate, Arbitrary Code Execution Rate

name: FACTS Grounding
intro: FACTS Grounding评估模型能否仅依据给定长文档生成满足请求且完全有据可依的长篇回答。基准包含860条公开Open样本和859条私有Blind样本，文档平均约2.5k tokens、最长32k tokens，并用三种评判模型分别校准资格与事实性。
org: Google DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud, Kaggle
build_method: 第三方人工构题, 全量人工核验, 平衡随机划分, 两套金标集校准多评委提示
task_type: 长上下文问答, 摘要, 文档改写, 事实立足性验证
eval_feature: 860条公开集+859条私有盲测, 最长32k上下文, 三评委资格共识, 三评委事实性聚合
scale: Open 860条 + Blind 859条；平均2.5k、最长32k tokens
task_type_en: Long-context QA, Summarization, Document Rewriting, Grounded Factuality Verification
build_method_en: Third-party Human Task Authoring, Full Manual Verification, Balanced Random Splits, Multi-judge Prompt Calibration on Two Golden Sets
eval_feature_en: 860 Open + 859 Blind Examples, Up to 32k Context, Unanimous Three-judge Eligibility, Three-judge Factuality Aggregation
intro_en: FACTS Grounding evaluates whether models can produce long-form responses that fulfill a request using only a supplied long document and remain fully grounded in it. It contains 860 public Open and 859 private Blind examples, with contexts averaging about 2.5k and reaching 32k tokens, and separately calibrates eligibility and factuality prompts for three judge models.
scale_en: 860 Open + 859 Blind examples; mean 2.5k, maximum 32k tokens

name: FEA-Bench
intro: FEA-Bench评估大模型在代码仓库中增量实现新功能的能力。论文从Top PyPI的8,000个包出发，经许可证、PR数量与快速pytest验证确定119个来源仓，再通过新组件比例、GPT-4o意图和金标准补丁后测试全过等门禁，得到83个仓库的1,401个任务；Lite子集含48个仓库的200题。
build_method: Top PyPI仓库筛选, PR测试变更抓取, 新组件规则过滤, GPT-4o意图分类, 补丁前后pytest验证
metric: Resolved Ratio, Patch Apply Rate, Retrieval Precision/Recall
task_type: 代码生成, 代码编辑, 代码补全
task_type_en: Code Generation, Code Editing, Code Completion
build_method_en: Top PyPI Repository Screening, Test-changing PR Collection, New-component Rule Filtering, GPT-4o Intent Classification, Before/after-patch pytest Validation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Long Context
intro_en: FEA-Bench evaluates repository-level incremental feature implementation. The paper starts from 8,000 Top PyPI packages, identifies 119 source repositories through license, pull-request-count, and fast pytest validation, then applies new-component-ratio, GPT-4o intent, and post-gold-patch all-tests-pass gates to obtain 1,401 tasks from 83 repositories; the Lite subset contains 200 tasks from 48 repositories.
metric_en: Resolved Ratio, Patch Apply Rate, Retrieval Precision/Recall

name: FigureQA
intro: FigureQA是一个合成科学图表视觉推理数据集。它先在约束下采样数值数据，再用改造后的Bokeh渲染五类图表并抽取元素边界框，随后从15个模板生成Yes/No问题并平衡答案；训练集含10万图和130万问题，验证集与测试集各含2万图和超过25万问题。
org: Microsoft Research Montréal, Université de Montréal/MILA, Tilburg University
build_method: 受约束数值采样, 改造Bokeh合成渲染, 15类模板问答生成, Yes/No平衡, 交替配色划分
modality: 图像, 文本, 数值源数据, 边界框
task_type: 合成图表视觉问答, 关系推理
eval_feature: 5类图表, 15类二元模板, 100种X11颜色, 未见颜色-图表组合
scale: 训练10万图/130万问题；验证与测试各2万图/超过25万问题
modality_en: Image, Text, Numerical Source Data, Bounding Boxes
task_type_en: Synthetic Chart Visual QA, Relational Reasoning
build_method_en: Constrained Numerical Sampling, Modified-Bokeh Synthetic Rendering, 15-template QA Generation, Yes/No Balancing, Alternated-color Splits
eval_feature_en: 5 Plot Types, 15 Binary Templates, 100 X11 Colors, Unseen Color-plot Combinations
intro_en: FigureQA is a synthetic scientific-chart visual-reasoning dataset. It samples constrained numerical data, renders five plot types with a modified Bokeh stack while extracting element boxes, then generates balanced Yes/No questions from 15 templates. The training set has 100k images and 1.3M questions; validation and test each have 20k images and more than 250k questions.
scale_en: Train 100k images / 1.3M questions; validation and test 20k images / >250k questions each

name: Finance Agent Benchmark
intro: Finance Agent Benchmark评估智能体完成真实金融研究任务的能力。7位业界专家共同定义9类任务并编写537道需要多份公开文档或SEC申报文件的问题，每题含标准答案、来源和分步解法；问题经异人复核、作者终审和细粒度评分准则复核后，由具备四类检索工具的智能体作答。
build_method: 7位金融专家构建9类任务, 537题多文档标注, 异人交叉复核, GPT-4o生成并人工复核评分准则
metric: Class-balanced Accuracy, Naive Accuracy, Time and Cost per Query
modality: 文本, 网页, SEC申报文件, 工具轨迹
task_type: 金融信息检索, 数值推理, 趋势与市场分析, 金融建模
eval_feature: Google/EDGAR检索, HTML解析与键值存储检索, 细粒度合取评分准则, 矛盾检测
scale: 537题/9类；公开验证50、私有验证150、私有测试337
modality_en: Text, Web Pages, SEC Filings, Tool Trajectories
task_type_en: Financial Retrieval, Numerical Reasoning, Trend and Market Analysis, Financial Modeling
build_method_en: Nine-category Taxonomy by Seven Finance Experts, 537 Multi-document Items, Independent Peer Review, GPT-4o Rubric Generation plus Manual Review
eval_feature_en: Google/EDGAR Search, HTML Parsing and Key-value Retrieval, Fine-grained Conjunctive Rubrics, Contradiction Detection
intro_en: Finance Agent Benchmark evaluates agents on realistic financial research. Seven industry experts define nine task categories and author 537 questions requiring multiple public documents or SEC filings, each with a reference answer, sources, and step-by-step solution. Items undergo independent peer review, author final review, and manual verification of fine-grained rubrics before tool-equipped agents answer them.
scale_en: 537 questions / 9 categories; public validation 50, private validation 150, private test 337
metric_en: Class-balanced Accuracy, Naive Accuracy, Time and Cost per Query

name: FinSearchComp
intro: FinSearchComp是一个完全开源的Agent基准测试，旨在对金融搜索和推理能力进行真实、专家级别的评估。该基准包含三个任务：时间敏感数据获取、简单历史查询和复杂历史调查，以复现真实的金融分析师工作流程。通过70位专业金融专家的标注和严格的质量保证流程，确保了其难度和可靠性。它包含635个问题，涵盖全球和大中华区市场，并评估了21个模型。
build_method: 三类金融任务分源构建, 70位专家标注, 盲审交叉验证, 动态与范围真值
eval_feature: 开放域工具使用, Global/大中华区双语划分, 78.6%范围评分, 专家抽查
build_method_en: Three Task-specific Financial Pipelines, 70-expert Annotation, Blind Cross-validation, Dynamic and Range-based Gold Answers
eval_feature_en: Open-domain Tool Use, Bilingual Global/Greater-China Splits, 78.6% In-range Grading, Expert Spot Checks
intro_en: FinSearchComp is a fully open-source Agent benchmark designed for realistic, expert-level evaluation of financial search and reasoning capabilities. It includes three tasks: time-sensitive data retrieval, simple historical queries, and complex historical investigations, replicating real financial analyst workflows. With annotations from 70 professional financial experts and a rigorous quality assurance process, it ensures both difficulty and reliability. The benchmark contains 635 questions covering global and Greater China markets and evaluates 21 models.

name: FIREBENCH
intro: FIREBENCH面向企业与API场景评估六类精确指令遵循能力：输出格式、顺序回复、条目排序、过度自信、正向内容要求和负向内容要求。论文Table 1给出2,470条样本，并按类别使用程序验证、简单模糊匹配或GPT-4.1准则评判。
build_method: 六类企业能力池组装, 程序化真值构造, GPT-5内容准则生成
task_type: 指令遵循, 信息抽取, 客服, 代码代理
eval_feature: 企业场景, 格式约束, API驱动
intro_en: FIREBENCH evaluates six precise instruction-following capabilities for enterprise and API settings: output format, ordered responses, item ranking, overconfidence, positive content requirements, and negative content requirements. Paper Table 1 contains 2,470 samples graded by programmatic checks, simple fuzzy matching, or GPT-4.1 rubrics depending on category.
build_method_en: Six Enterprise Capability Pools, Programmatic Ground-truth Construction, GPT-5 Content-rubric Generation
task_type_en: Instruction Following, Information Extraction, Customer Support, Coding Agents
eval_feature_en: Enterprise Scenarios, Format Constraints, API-driven Evaluation

name: FLAMES
intro: FLAMES是一个针对大语言模型价值观对齐的中文评测基准，由上海人工智能实验室和复旦大学共同开发。它包含一套精心设计的对抗性提示，旨在揭示模型在安全性、公平性等方面的深层价值观对齐缺陷。该基准不仅涵盖了通用的无害原则，还融入了和谐等具有中国文化特色的价值观维度。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University
build_method: 五维价值框架, 众包对抗提示, 两轮攻击过滤, 双人标注与专家仲裁, 专用评分器训练
task_type: 安全测试, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
scale: 2,251条提示；公开评测1,000条；约22.9K条已标回答
build_method_en: Five-dimensional Value Framework, Crowdsourced Adversarial Prompts, Two-stage Attack Filtering, Dual Annotation plus Expert Adjudication, Specified-scorer Training
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: FLAMES is a Chinese evaluation benchmark for value alignment in large language models, jointly developed by Shanghai AI Laboratory and Fudan University. It includes a set of carefully designed adversarial prompts aimed at revealing deep value alignment flaws in areas such as safety and fairness. The benchmark covers general harmlessness principles and incorporates culturally specific values like harmony.
scale_en: 2,251 prompts; 1,000 public evaluation prompts; ~22.9K annotated responses

name: FOFO
intro: 本文提出了FOFO，一个开创性的基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）遵循复杂、特定领域格式的能力，这是它们作为AI代理应用的一个关键但未被充分研究的能力。FOFO通过AI与人类协作的方法，开发了多样的真实世界格式和指令，填补了现有基准在评估格式遵循能力方面的空白。
org: Salesforce Research, University of Illinois at Chicago, Pennsylvania State University
build_method: 专家领域种子与GPT-4扩展, 专用格式生成与人工复核, FORMAT-INSTRU生成与逐条核验
task_type: 格式化文本生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 缺少任一格式要求即失败, GPT-4二元判断与解释, 100题人工一致性复核
build_method_en: Expert Domain Seeds plus GPT-4 Expansion, Domain-format Generation and Human Review, FORMAT-INSTRU Generation and Per-item Verification
eval_feature_en: Any Missing Format Requirement Fails, GPT-4 Binary Verdict plus Explanation, 100-item Human Agreement Check
intro_en: This paper introduces FOFO, a pioneering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) ability to follow complex, domain-specific formats—a critical yet underexplored capability for their use as AI agents. FOFO employs AI-human collaboration to develop diverse real-world formats and instructions, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks for assessing format adherence.

name: FRAMES
intro: FRAMES（Factuality, Retrieval, And reasoning MEasurement Set）是一个高质量数据集，旨在测试大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成最终答案时的事实性、检索能力和推理能力。该基准测试提供了一个统一的框架，用于评估LLMs在端到端检索增强生成（RAG）场景中的性能。FRAMES包含具有挑战性的多跳问题，需要整合来自多个来源的信息。
build_method: 放弃高幻觉合成试验, 人工多Wikipedia构题, 三个月后重标, 时间消歧与二元答案过滤
eval_feature: 每题2–15篇Wikipedia, 五类推理标签, BM25单步/多步与oracle, Gemini 1.5 Pro自动评分
build_method_en: Rejected High-hallucination Synthetic Pilot, Human Multi-Wikipedia Authoring, Three-month Reannotation, Temporal Disambiguation and Binary-answer Filtering
eval_feature_en: 2–15 Wikipedia Articles per Item, Five Reasoning Labels, BM25 Single/Multi-step and Oracle, Gemini 1.5 Pro Autorating
intro_en: FRAMES (Factuality, Retrieval, And reasoning MEasurement Set) is a high-quality dataset designed to test large language models (LLMs) on factuality, retrieval ability, and reasoning when generating final answers. This benchmark provides a unified framework to evaluate LLMs' performance in end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) scenarios. FRAMES includes challenging multi-hop questions that require integrating information from multiple sources.

name: FronTalk
intro: FronTalk是一个多轮、多模态前端代码生成基准。论文从C4抽样10,000个网页，经GPT-4o摘要、BERTopic聚类与人工选择得到100个网站，再生成并人工精炼10轮功能/设计意图及测试。最终100个对话含1,000轮和3,676个测试用例，文本与视觉模拟器表达等价意图，并通过网页智能体评估指令遵循、遗忘和可用性。
build_method: C4网页抽样与BERTopic聚类, 人工选择100站, GPT-4o生成十轮意图与测试, 人工删除/编辑问题用例, 双用户模拟器
modality: 文本, 图像, 代码
task_type: 前端代码生成, 多轮软件工程
eval_feature: 多模态反馈, 智能体评估, 遗忘分析
intro_en: FronTalk is a multi-turn, multimodal front-end code-generation benchmark. The paper samples 10,000 C4 webpages, uses GPT-4o summaries, BERTopic clustering, and manual selection to obtain 100 sites, then generates and manually refines ten turns of functional/design intents and tests. The final 100 dialogues contain 1,000 turns and 3,676 test cases; textual and visual simulators express equivalent intents, and web agents assess instruction following, forgetting, and usability.
build_method_en: C4 Web Sampling and BERTopic Clustering, Manual 100-site Selection, GPT-4o Ten-turn Intent/Test Generation, Manual Removal/Editing, Dual User Simulators
task_type_en: Front-end Code Generation, Multi-turn Software Engineering
eval_feature_en: Multimodal Feedback, Agent-based Evaluation, Forgetting Analysis

name: FrontierCode
intro: FrontierCode 是 Cognition 于 2026 年发布的生产级软件工程基准，检验代码智能体提交的 PR 是否真正可合并。150 个真实开源仓库任务由 20+ 位维护者构建，评分同时覆盖正确性、回归安全、构建与风格、测试、改动范围和代码质量；1.1 版以 Main 100 题和 Extended 150 题报告结果。
build_method: 开源维护者构建, 对抗式评分加固, 多阶段人工评审
metric: 通过率, 加权评分标准分
task_type: 智能体软件工程, 仓库级代码修改
eval_feature: 可合并性, 代码质量, blocker 标准, 公平联网检查
scale: 150 题, 36 个开源仓库, 1,000+ 评分标准
task_type_en: Agentic Software Engineering, Repository-level Code Modification
build_method_en: Open-source maintainer authoring, adversarial rubric hardening, multi-stage human review
eval_feature_en: Mergeability, Code Quality, Blocker Criteria, Fair Internet-use Verification
intro_en: FrontierCode is Cognition's 2026 production-quality software-engineering benchmark for whether a coding agent's pull request is truly mergeable. Its 150 real open-source tasks are built by 20+ maintainers and grade correctness, regression safety, build and style, tests, scope, and code quality; version 1.1 reports the 100-task Main and 150-task Extended sets.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Cognition's official June 2026 FrontierCode construction specification and the July 2026 FrontierCode 1.1 update. More than 20 open-source maintainers selected realistic tasks across 36 repositories and defined mergeability rubrics. Criteria combine classical, command, reverse-classical, scope, adaptive-classical, and LLM grading. Rubrics are adversarially hacked, calibrated with four solutions, reviewed by pod leads and Cognition researchers, and iterated. Version 1.1 audits 1,000+ criteria, demotes 75 overly strict blockers, and adds a fair-internet-use prompt plus a verifier that zeros violating runs. Current reporting uses Main 100 and Extended 150; Diamond is deprecated.

name: FrontierMath
intro: FrontierMath 是由 60+ 位数学家创作并盲审的数百道原创、未发表高级数学题。命题必须满足原创、可自动核验、不可猜中和计算可处理四项要求；模型可在交互式 Python 环境中实验，最终答案由精确匹配、SymPy 等价或自定义脚本自动评分。
build_method: 专家原创命题, 领域专家盲审, 原创性与污染检查, 自动验证
task_type: 高级数学推理, 实验式代码求解
eval_feature: 未发表题目, 自动验证, 低污染风险, 三维专家难度
scale: 数百道原创题；覆盖约 70% 的 MSC2020 顶级学科
intro_en: FrontierMath contains hundreds of original, unpublished advanced-mathematics problems authored and blind-reviewed by 60+ mathematicians. Problems must be original, automatically verifiable, guessproof, and computationally tractable; models may experiment in Python before exact, SymPy, or custom-script verification of the final answer.
build_method_en: Expert original problem writing, blind domain review, originality and contamination checks, automatic verification
task_type_en: Advanced Mathematical Reasoning, Experiment-enabled Code Solving
eval_feature_en: Unpublished Problems, Automated Verification, Low Contamination Risk, Three-dimensional Expert Difficulty
scale_en: Hundreds of original problems; about 70% of top-level MSC2020 subjects
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.04872 Sections 2 and 4. More than 60 mathematicians write new unpublished problems under four requirements: originality, automated verifiability, guessproofness, and computational tractability. Each package includes a statement, detailed solution, verification script, subject and technique tags, and difficulty metadata. At least one blind domain expert checks correctness, ambiguity, guessability, code, classifications, and difficulty. Secure handling, expert source checks, Quetext, and Copyscape reduce contamination. Difficulty is background 1–5 plus creativity and execution hours—not Tier 1–4. Models experiment in Python, submit a self-contained pickled object, and are graded by exact, SymPy, or custom verification.

name: FrontierScience
intro: FrontierScience 通过奥赛与研究两条互补轨道评估专家级科学推理。42 位国际奥赛奖牌得主或国家队教练创作封闭答案题，45 位博士科学家创作开放研究子问题；专家从 500+ 与 200+ 候选中筛出 100 道奥赛题和 60 道研究题开源黄金集。
build_method: 奥赛与博士专家原创命题, 多轮领域专家评审, 元评审筛选
metric: 分轨准确率；研究题以 ≥7/10 为成功
task_type: 开放式科学问答, 短答案科学推理
eval_feature: 双轨评测, 过程评分标准, 内部模型筛难, 保留集防污染
scale: 数百题；开源黄金集 100 道奥赛题 + 60 道研究题
task_type_en: Open-ended Science QA, Short-answer Scientific Reasoning
build_method_en: Original Olympiad and PhD-expert authoring, multi-round domain review, expert meta-review
eval_feature_en: Dual-track Evaluation, Process Rubrics, Internal-model Difficulty Filtering, Held-out Contamination Tracking
intro_en: FrontierScience evaluates expert scientific reasoning through complementary Olympiad and Research tracks. Forty-two international medalists or national-team coaches author closed-answer tasks and 45 PhD scientists author open research subproblems; expert meta-review filters 500+ and 200+ candidates into an open gold set of 100 Olympiad and 60 Research items.
scale_en: Hundreds of questions; open gold set of 100 Olympiad + 60 Research items
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.21165 Sections 2.1–2.4 and 3.1. The Olympiad track uses 42 medalists or national-team coaches with 108 total medals; the Research track uses 45 PhD scientists and targets authentic three-to-five-hour subproblems. Tasks are selected against internal models, independently reviewed at least once for Olympiad and twice for Research, then receive holistic or meta-review. More than 500 Olympiad and 200 Research candidates yield a 100 + 60 open gold set, with the rest held out. Olympiad answers use GPT-5 equivalence judgment over 20 trials; Research uses independent 10-point rubric items, GPT-5 high-effort judging, a 7-point success threshold, and 30 trials.

name: FullStackBench
intro: FullStack Bench 是字节跳动 Seed Foundation Code Team 提出的双语、多语言全栈代码基准。3,374 道题覆盖 16 种编程语言和 11 个主流应用领域，配有 15,168 个单元测试；SandboxFusion 抽取、合成并执行模型代码，以 Pass@1 评分。
build_method: 多源代码收集, LLM 辅助人工标注, 交叉精炼, 六模型难度投票
language: 中文, 英文；16 种编程语言
task_type: 全栈开发, 代码生成
eval_feature: 双语题面, 多语言代码, 11 个应用领域, SandboxFusion 执行
scale: 3,374 道题, 15,168 个单测, 16 种编程语言
build_method_en: Multi-source code collection, LLM-assisted human annotation, cross-refinement, six-model difficulty voting
eval_feature_en: Bilingual Prompts, Multilingual Code, 11 Application Domains, SandboxFusion Execution
intro_en: FullStack Bench is ByteDance Seed Foundation Code Team's bilingual, multilingual full-stack coding benchmark. Its 3,374 problems span 16 programming languages and 11 mainstream application domains with 15,168 unit tests; SandboxFusion extracts, synthesizes, and executes model code for Pass@1 scoring.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.00535 Sections 2–3. GitHub snippets, code documents/books, XLCoST, and expert-authored domain questions are converted into instructions, reference solutions, language-specific tests, and labels with LLM assistance and human verification. Annotators check difficulty, ambiguity, and solvability, cross-refine each other's work, and resolve disagreement by consensus or senior adjudication. Six-model voting filters items solved by all models and labels difficulty. A 500K-question Stack Overflow analysis yields 11 mainstream domains plus Others. The bilingual release contains 3,374 problems across 16 programming languages and 15,168 unit tests. SandboxFusion extracts model code, combines tests, executes it, and reports Pass@1.

name: FunctionQA
intro: FunctionQA 是 MathVista 新建的 400 题视觉代数子集，要求模型精细感知函数图并对变量、表达式、方程和函数进行代数推理。题目由 STEM 研究生人工标注，经三位评审独立核验和共识修订，再按 MathVista 的答案抽取、归一化与精确准确率协议评测。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: STEM 研究生人工标注, 三人独立复核, 共识消歧
task_type: 函数图问答, 视觉代数推理
eval_feature: 函数图精细感知, 代数推理, 确定性答案归一化
build_method_en: STEM graduate-student annotation, three independent reviews, consensus resolution
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained Function-plot Perception, Algebraic Reasoning, Deterministic Answer Normalization
intro_en: FunctionQA is MathVista's newly created 400-example visual-algebra subset. It requires fine-grained perception of function plots and algebraic reasoning over variables, expressions, equations, and functions. STEM graduate students manually annotate items, three reviewers independently verify them, and MathVista extracts, normalizes, and exactly scores model answers.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the FunctionQA portions of arXiv:2310.02255 Sections 2.2–2.4 and 3.1. FunctionQA is a MathVista-created visual algebra subset, not an Intern-S1 benchmark about software functions or tools. Its 400 items emphasize subtle perception of function plots and algebra over variables, expressions, equations, and functions. STEM graduate students manually annotate the new datasets; three reviewers independently check them, yielding 99.2% agreement across 736 new MathVista items, and the six disagreements are resolved by consensus. FunctionQA is standardized as math-targeted textbook QA with function-plot context and algebraic skill. Evaluation generates a response from image and query, uses a GPT-4 short-answer extractor, normalizes the answer, and computes deterministic exact accuracy.

name: GAIA
intro: GAIA是一个为通用AI助手设计的基准测试，旨在评估AI在现实世界问题中的表现。这些问题需要推理、多模态处理、网页浏览和工具使用等基本能力。GAIA的问题对人类来说概念简单，但对最先进的AI来说极具挑战性，旨在推动通用人工智能（AGI）的发展。
build_method: 人工标注
eval_feature: 思维链, 零样本, 多模态, 工具使用, 网页浏览
scale: 466个问题（166个开发题，300个隐藏答案测试题）
build_method_en: Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot, Multimodal, Tool Use, Web Browsing
intro_en: GAIA is a benchmark designed for general AI assistants to evaluate their performance on real-world problems. These problems require core abilities such as reasoning, multimodal processing, web browsing, and tool use. GAIA’s tasks are conceptually simple for humans but highly challenging for state-of-the-art AI, aiming to advance the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).
scale_en: 466 questions (166 development, 300 test with hidden answers)

name: Gaia2
intro: Gaia2是一个用于在真实、异步环境中评估大型语言模型代理的基准。它引入了独立于代理行为而演变的环境场景，要求代理在时间限制下操作、适应动态和嘈杂的事件、解决模糊性并与其他代理协作。每个场景都配有写操作验证器，支持细粒度的动作级评估。该基准建立在开源的ARE平台之上，旨在推动下一代实用代理系统的发展。
build_method: 人工构建与合成数据
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: Agent评估, 复杂推理, 动态适应, 多步推理
eval_feature: 异步, 动态环境, 多Agent协作, 时间限制, 噪声鲁棒性, 模糊性解决
scale: 1,120个场景（800个核心场景 + 320个增强场景）
task_type_en: Agent Evaluation, Complex Reasoning, Dynamic Adaptation, Multi-step Reasoning
build_method_en: Manually constructed and synthetic data
eval_feature_en: Asynchronous, dynamic environment, multi-agent collaboration, time constraints, noise robustness, ambiguity resolution
intro_en: Gaia2 is a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in real, asynchronous environments. It introduces environment scenarios that evolve independently of agent behavior, requiring agents to operate within time constraints, adapt to dynamic and noisy events, resolve ambiguities, and collaborate with other agents. Each scenario includes a write operation validator, enabling fine-grained, action-level evaluation. Built on the open-source ARE platform, this benchmark aims to advance the development of next-generation practical agent systems.

name: GaokaoBench
intro: GaokaoBench是一个直观的评测基准，它使用2010至2022年的中国高考题目来评估大型语言模型。该基准包含1781道客观题和1030道主观题，覆盖了理科和文科的9个科目。它采用零样本设置和人工评分相结合的方式，全面考察模型的语言理解、逻辑推理和生成能力。
build_method: 基于2010-2022年中国高考试题，通过自动化脚本和人工标注结合的方式构建
metric: Scoring Rate, Converted Total Score, Spearman Correlation, Kendall-Tau Correlation
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 填空题, 改错题
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Fill-in-the-blank, Error correction
build_method_en: Constructed based on 2010-2022 China Gaokao exam questions, combining automated scripts and manual annotation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: GaokaoBench is an intuitive evaluation benchmark that uses Chinese Gaokao exam questions from 2010 to 2022 to assess large language models. The benchmark includes 1,781 objective questions and 1,030 subjective questions, covering nine science and humanities subjects. It employs a zero-shot setting combined with human scoring to comprehensively evaluate models' language understanding, logical reasoning, and generation abilities.
metric_en: Scoring Rate, Converted Total Score, Spearman Correlation, Kendall-Tau Correlation

name: GaRAGe
intro: GaRAGe是一个大型RAG基准，包含人工整理的长篇答案及每个依据段落的注释，支持细粒度评估LLM在生成RAG答案时识别相关依据的能力。该基准涵盖2366个多样化问题，包含3.5万多条来自私有文档和网络的注释段落，反映真实RAG应用场景。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
metric: Relevance-Aware Factuality Score, F1 in attribution, true positive rate in deflections
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证
eval_feature: 混合网页/私有依据, 段落相关性标注, 拒答与引用归因
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Domain-specific
intro_en: GaRAGe is a large-scale RAG benchmark featuring manually curated long-form answers and annotated supporting paragraphs for each, enabling fine-grained evaluation of LLMs' ability to identify relevant evidence when generating RAG answers. The benchmark includes 2,366 diverse questions and over 35,000 annotated paragraphs from private documents and the web, reflecting real-world RAG application scenarios.
metric_en: Relevance-Aware Factuality Score, F1 in attribution, true positive rate in deflections

name: GDPVal
intro: GDPval是一个评估AI模型在真实世界中具有经济价值任务表现的基准测试。它涵盖了美国劳工统计局针对44个职业的大部分工作活动，这些职业来自对美国GDP贡献最大的9个行业。任务是根据平均拥有14年经验的行业专业人士的代表性工作构建的。该基准测试还提供了一个包含220个任务的黄金子集和公共自动化评分服务。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: Agent任务, 专业工作交付
eval_feature: 盲测专家对比, 多次采样, 交付物评测
scale: 1,320个任务、44个职业、9个行业（公开黄金子集220题）
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot, process evaluation
intro_en: GDPVal is a benchmark for evaluating AI models' performance on economically valuable tasks in the real world. It covers most work activities for 44 occupations from the 9 industries contributing most to the US GDP, based on data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. Tasks are constructed to represent work performed by industry professionals with an average of 14 years of experience. The benchmark also provides a gold subset of 220 tasks and a public automated scoring service.
scale_en: 1,320 tasks across 44 occupations and 9 sectors (220-task public gold subset)

name: GEdit-Bench
intro: GEdit-Bench是一个基于真实世界用户指令的图像编辑评测基准。它旨在提供一个更真实、更全面的评估框架，以衡量图像编辑模型的性能。该基准的发布旨在缩小开源模型与领先的闭源模型（如GPT-4o和Gemini）在图像编辑能力上的差距。
build_method: 真实用户数据收集, 人工筛选, 双语标注
metric: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 真实用户指令, 双语评测, VLM-as-Judge
scale: 606个双语图像编辑实例、11个类别
build_method_en: Real-user Collection, Human Filtering, Bilingual Annotation
eval_feature_en: Real-user Instructions, Bilingual Evaluation, VLM-as-Judge
intro_en: GEdit-Bench is an image editing evaluation benchmark based on real-world user instructions. It aims to provide a more realistic and comprehensive framework for assessing the performance of image editing models. The benchmark is released to narrow the gap in image editing capabilities between open-source models and leading closed-source models such as GPT-4o and Gemini.
metric_en: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall

name: GenAI-Bench
intro: GenAI-Bench 是从 GenAI-Arena 社区投票中清洗得到的多模态偏好基准，用于衡量 MLLM 裁判能否在图像生成、图像编辑和视频生成任务上复现人类四分类偏好。它与另一个含1,600条组合式提示词的同名文生视觉基准不同。
build_method: 匿名社区投票, NSFW清洗, 专家抽样复核
modality: 图像, 视频, 文本
task_type: 多模态裁判, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 四分类偏好, 精确匹配, 社区投票
build_method_en: Anonymous Community Voting, NSFW Filtering, Expert Sample Review
eval_feature_en: Four-way Preference Labels, Exact Match, Community Votes
intro_en: GenAI-Bench is a multimodal preference benchmark cleaned from GenAI-Arena community votes. It measures whether MLLM judges reproduce human four-way preferences across image generation, image editing, and video generation. It is distinct from the separate 1,600-prompt compositional text-to-visual benchmark with the same name.
scale_en: 3,723 preference pairs (1,735 image generation; 919 editing; 1,069 video)

name: GenEval
intro: GenEval 是面向文本到图像模型的对象组合评测。它用六类模板任务、MS-COCO 对象词表和自动感知模型，逐图验证对象存在、计数、颜色、位置与属性绑定是否满足提示。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, LAION
build_method: 任务模板, MS-COCO对象词表, 自动感知验证, 人工一致性检验
task_type: 文本到图像生成, 组合对齐
eval_feature: 6类组合任务, 目标检测与CLIP验证, 二元逐图判定
scale: 553个提示；每个模型每提示生成4张图
build_method_en: Task Templates, MS-COCO Object Vocabulary, Automated Perceptual Verification, Human Agreement Check
eval_feature_en: Six Compositional Tasks, Detection and CLIP Verification, Binary Per-image Correctness
intro_en: GenEval evaluates object compositionality in text-to-image models. Six templated tasks, an MS-COCO object vocabulary, and automated perceptual models verify whether each image satisfies requested objects, counts, colors, positions, and attribute bindings.
scale_en: 553 prompts; four generated images per prompt for each model

name: GenExam
intro: GenExam 是覆盖十个学科的多学科文生图考试基准。它以参考真值图、考试式提示和原子评分点衡量模型生成包含复杂学科知识图像的能力，并提供严格分与宽松分。
build_method: 多源图像收集, GPT-5筛选与提示起草, 博士标注员交叉复核
task_type: 文生图, 多学科考试评测
eval_feature: 原子评分点, 参考图GPT-5裁判, 严格与宽松计分
build_method_en: Multi-source Image Collection, GPT-5 Filtering and Prompt Drafting, Cross-validation by PhD Annotators
eval_feature_en: Atomic Scoring Points, Reference-image GPT-5 Judge, Strict and Relaxed Scoring
intro_en: GenExam is a multidisciplinary text-to-image examination benchmark spanning ten subjects. Reference images, exam-style prompts, and atomic scoring points measure whether models can generate complex images containing subject knowledge, with both strict and relaxed scores.

name: GENIUS
intro: GENIUS（Generative Fluid Intelligence Evaluation Suite）是一个用于评估统一多模态模型生成式流体智能的基准，重点考察模型在即时上下文中归纳模式、执行临时约束和适应情境知识的能力。
org: Peking University, CUHK, StepFun, PolyU, MSRA
build_method: 人工构建, 专家构建
metric: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature: 归纳推理, 约束遵循, 情境适应
scale: 510个样本、3个维度、5个任务、20个子任务
intro_en: GENIUS is a benchmark for evaluating generative fluid intelligence in unified multimodal models. It measures how models induce implicit patterns, execute ad-hoc constraints, and adapt to contextual knowledge in image generation tasks.
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Interleaved Multimodal Context Design
metric_en: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature_en: Inductive Inference, Constraint Following, Contextual Adaptation

name: GenQA
intro: GenQA 不是独立数据集或论文，而是 OLMo 3 报告与官方 OLMES 配置中 OlmoBaseEval 的九任务宏平均能力组，聚合排序选择/续写与生成式短答案问答。
build_method: 模型排名聚类, 任务格式对齐, 官方九任务套件聚合
task_type: 基础模型问答聚合, 排序选择与短答案生成
eval_feature: 九任务宏平均, 任务级few-shot协议, 准确率与答案库F1
task_type_en: Aggregated Base-model QA, Rank-choice and Short-answer Generation
build_method_en: Model-ranking Clustering, Task-format Alignment, Official Nine-task Suite Aggregation
eval_feature_en: Nine-task Macro Average, Task-specific Few-shot Protocols, Accuracy and Answer-bank F1
intro_en: GenQA is not a standalone dataset or paper. It is the nine-task macro-averaged OlmoBaseEval capability group defined in the OLMo 3 report and official OLMES configuration, aggregating rank-choice/continuation and generative short-answer QA.
scale_en: Nine tasks; BasicSkills contains six subtasks

name: Global-MMLU-Lite
intro: Global-MMLU-Lite 是 Global MMLU 的文化平衡轻量子集。流程图按论文首发版展示15种人工翻译或人工后编辑语言、每种语言各200道文化敏感题与200道文化无关题；官方数据集后来已扩展。
build_method: MMLU文化标注, 多语言翻译与人工后编辑, CS/CA平衡抽样
language: 论文v1为15种语言；当前v3为23种语言
task_type: 知识问答, 多语言评测
eval_feature: 文化敏感/无关分层, 多语言精确选项匹配, 论文版平衡抽样
build_method_en: MMLU Cultural Annotation, Multilingual Translation and Human Post-editing, Balanced CS/CA Sampling
eval_feature_en: Culturally Sensitive/Agnostic Strata, Multilingual Exact Option Match, Paper-release Balanced Sampling
intro_en: Global-MMLU-Lite is the culturally balanced lightweight subset of Global MMLU. The diagram follows the paper release: 15 fully human-translated or post-edited languages, with 200 Culturally Sensitive and 200 Culturally Agnostic questions per language; the maintained official dataset has since expanded.
language_en: 15 languages in paper v1; 23 languages in current v3
scale_en: 6,000 items in paper v1 (15×400); about 14K in current v3

name: GMAI-MMBench
intro: GMAI-MMBench是一个全面的通用医疗AI基准，旨在评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在各种医疗应用中的有效性。该基准解决了现有基准在临床相关性、评估不完整性和交互式LVLMs指导不足等方面的局限性。它由284个数据集构建，涵盖38种医学图像模态、18项临床相关任务、18个科室和4种感知粒度，采用视觉问答（VQA）形式。
build_method: 多源医疗数据整合, 标签标准化, 人工验证
eval_feature: 零样本, 可定制词汇树切片, 隐藏测试答案
build_method_en: Multi-source Medical Data Integration, Label Standardization, Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot, Custom Lexical-tree Slices, Hidden Test Answers
intro_en: GMAI-MMBench is a comprehensive general medical AI benchmark designed to evaluate the effectiveness of large vision-language models (LVLMs) across various medical applications. It addresses limitations of existing benchmarks in clinical relevance, incomplete evaluation, and insufficient guidance for interactive LVLMs. The benchmark is built from 284 datasets, covering 38 medical image modalities, 18 clinically relevant tasks, 18 departments, and 4 levels of perceptual granularity, using a visual question answering (VQA) format.
scale_en: 25,831 VQA pairs (4,550 validation; 21,281 test) from 284 datasets

name: GMMLU
intro: Global-MMLU 是对 MMLU 的 42 语言扩展，通过专业翻译、社区后编辑和机器翻译提高多语言质量，并为代表性子集标注文化、地理和方言知识需求，以区分文化敏感（CS）与文化无关（CA）评测。
build_method: 机器翻译, 专业翻译, 社区后编辑, 文化敏感性标注
task_type: 选择题, 知识问答, 多语言评测
eval_feature: 文化敏感/文化无关切片, 多语言, 翻译质量
task_type_en: Multiple-choice QA, Knowledge QA, Multilingual Evaluation
build_method_en: Machine Translation, Professional Translation, Community Post-editing, Cultural-sensitivity Annotation
eval_feature_en: Culturally Sensitive/Agnostic Slices, Multilingual, Translation Quality
intro_en: Global-MMLU extends MMLU to 42 languages, improving multilingual quality through professional translations, community post-edits, and machine translation. A representative subset is annotated for cultural, geographic, and dialect knowledge requirements to distinguish Culturally Sensitive (CS) from Culturally Agnostic (CA) evaluation.
scale_en: 589,764 samples in 42 languages; 6,000-item Lite set in 15 languages

name: GPQA
intro: GPQA包含448个由领域专家编写的生物、物理和化学多项选择题，设计为“谷歌难题”，难以被熟练非专家和先进AI系统解答。旨在促进可扩展监督研究，帮助专家从超越人类能力的AI系统中获得真实信息。
org: New York University, Google DeepMind, Cohere
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 领域特定, 防污染
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Contamination-free
intro_en: GPQA contains 448 multiple-choice questions in biology, physics, and chemistry, written by domain experts and designed as "Google-proof" problems that are difficult for skilled non-experts and advanced AI systems to solve. It aims to promote scalable supervision research and help experts obtain reliable information from AI systems that surpass human capabilities.

name: GPQA Diamond
intro: GPQA Diamond是GPQA (Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A) 基准的一个精选子集，包含198个由领域专家验证的最高质量问题。这些问题涵盖物理、化学和生物学等研究生级别的科学领域，被广泛用于评估大型语言模型的高级科学推理能力。
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 领域特定, 防污染
build_method_en: Manually constructed
eval_feature_en: Multi-step reasoning
intro_en: GPQA Diamond is a curated subset of the GPQA (Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A) benchmark, containing 198 highest-quality questions verified by domain experts. These questions cover graduate-level scientific fields such as physics, chemistry, and biology, and are widely used to evaluate the advanced scientific reasoning abilities of large language models.

name: GraphWalks
intro: GraphWalks 是 OpenAI 发布的长上下文图推理数据集，没有配套的构建论文。模型读取哈希节点有向边表，完成精确深度 BFS 或父节点集合查询，并按官方最后一行答案格式返回节点集合。
build_method: 有向图题面与BFS/Parents标签生成；官方未公开图采样算法
task_type: 图推理, 长上下文集合预测
eval_feature: 精确深度BFS, 父节点查询, 集合F1, 最后一行答案解析
build_method_en: Directed Graph Prompt and BFS/Parents Label Generation; Graph Sampling Algorithm Not Documented
eval_feature_en: Exact-depth BFS, Parent Query, Set F1, Last-line Answer Parser
intro_en: GraphWalks is an OpenAI long-context graph-reasoning dataset without a companion construction paper. Models read a directed edge list with hashed node names, execute exact-depth BFS or parent-set queries, and return a node set in the official last-line answer format.

name: GSM8K
intro: GSM8K是一个包含8500个高质量、语言多样的小学数学应用题的数据集，旨在诊断和评估大型语言模型在多步数学推理方面的能力。尽管这些问题在概念上相对简单，但即便是最大规模的Transformer模型也难以在该基准上取得高分。
eval_feature: 思维链
build_method_en: Manually constructed
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: GSM8K is a dataset of 8,500 high-quality, linguistically diverse elementary math word problems designed to diagnose and evaluate large language models' abilities in multi-step mathematical reasoning. Although these problems are conceptually simple, even the largest Transformer models struggle to achieve high scores on this benchmark.

name: GSM8K-Platinum
intro: GSM8K-Platinum 是完整 GSM8K 测试集的低噪声修订版。研究者先用多个前沿模型定位潜在问题，再人工删除歧义或逻辑不一致的题并修正错标答案，使每个保留错误更能代表真实模型失败。
build_method: 多模型筛查, 人工核验, 错标修正
eval_feature: 可靠性评测, 低标签噪声, 零样本
build_method_en: Multi-model Screening, Human Verification, Label Correction
eval_feature_en: Reliability Evaluation, Low Label Noise, Zero-shot
intro_en: GSM8K-Platinum is a low-noise revision of the full GSM8K test set. Multiple frontier models first flag potential problems; humans then remove ambiguous or logically inconsistent questions and correct mislabeled answers so every retained error better represents a genuine model failure.
scale_en: 1,209 questions cleaned from the 1,319-item GSM8K test set

name: HaluEval
intro: HaluEval 是一个包含 35,000 个样本的幻觉识别基准：30,000 个任务特定样本均分至问答、知识对话和摘要，另有 5,000 个来自 Alpaca 查询的通用样本。任务特定分支由 ChatGPT 生成并经事实增强过滤；通用分支则以响应分歧筛选难例并由人工标注幻觉类型与跨度。
org: Renmin University of China, Université de Montréal
build_method: ChatGPT 双策略生成、事实增强筛选、人工标注
eval_feature: 对抗性难例、任务特定与通用双分支、幻觉跨度标注
build_method_en: Two-strategy ChatGPT generation, ground-truth-enhanced filtering, human annotation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial hard cases, task-specific and general branches, hallucination-span labels
intro_en: HaluEval is a 35,000-sample hallucination-recognition benchmark: 30,000 task-specific samples evenly cover question answering, knowledge-grounded dialogue, and summarization, while 5,000 general samples come from Alpaca queries. ChatGPT generates task-specific hallucinations that are ground-truth-enhanced filtered; the general branch selects response-disagreement hard cases and adds human hallucination-type and span labels.

name: HalluLens
intro: HalluLens 以幻觉来源区分外在幻觉与内在幻觉：前者与训练数据中的世界知识不一致，后者与输入上下文不一致。其动态外在套件包含 PreciseWikiQA、LongWiki、MixedEntities 和 GeneratedEntities，共 15,200 个样本；内在分支整合 HHEM、ANAH 2.0 与 FaithEval 三个既有基准。
org: FAIR at Meta, GenAI at Meta, HKUST
build_method: 动态生成外在任务、整合既有内在幻觉基准
metric: False Refusal, Hallucinated When Not Refused, Correct Answer, Precision, Recall@32, F1@32, False Acceptance
task_type: 开放式问答, 生成, 事实验证, 分类, 安全测试
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 对抗性
scale: 15,200 个动态外在样本 + 3 个整合的内在幻觉基准
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Generation, Fact Verification, Classification, Safety Testing
build_method_en: Dynamic extrinsic-task generation plus integrated intrinsic benchmarks
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, real-time, Contamination-free, Adversarial
intro_en: HalluLens classifies hallucinations by source: extrinsic hallucinations conflict with world knowledge represented in training data, while intrinsic hallucinations conflict with the input context. Its dynamic extrinsic suite contains PreciseWikiQA, LongWiki, MixedEntities, and GeneratedEntities for 15,200 samples; the intrinsic branch integrates the existing HHEM, ANAH 2.0, and FaithEval benchmarks.
scale_en: 15,200 dynamic extrinsic samples + 3 integrated intrinsic benchmarks
metric_en: False Refusal, Hallucinated When Not Refused, Correct Answer, Precision, Recall@32, F1@32, False Acceptance

name: HalluQA
intro: HalluQA 是针对中文大模型幻觉的 450 题问答基准，由 175 道误导题、69 道高难误导题和 206 道知识题组成，共覆盖 30 个领域。数据以 GLM-130B、ChatGPT 与 Puyu 的稳定错误作为对抗性筛选信号，并由作者或 NLP 专家复核问题、答案和外部依据。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建, LLM生成
task_type: 开放式问答, 幻觉评判
eval_feature: 对抗性、中文原生、GPT-4 五票判定
scale: 450（175 误导题 + 69 高难误导题 + 206 知识题；30 个领域）
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Chinese-native, five-vote GPT-4 judging
intro_en: HalluQA is a 450-question benchmark for hallucinations in Chinese LLMs, comprising 175 misleading questions, 69 misleading-hard questions, and 206 knowledge questions across 30 domains. Stable failures from GLM-130B, ChatGPT, and Puyu serve as adversarial selection signals, while authors or an NLP expert verify questions, answer sets, and external evidence.

name: HallusionBench
intro: HallusionBench是一个全面的基准测试，旨在评估图像-上下文推理能力。该基准测试通过强调对视觉数据的细致理解和解释，对先进的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）提出了重大挑战。它包含346张图像和1129个问题，全部由人类专家精心制作。通过新颖的视觉问题结构和对照组设计，HallusionBench能够对模型的响应趋势、逻辑一致性和各种故障模式进行定量分析，并深入理解语言幻觉和视觉错觉等问题。
org: University of Maryland, University of California, Beijing Institute of Technology, Tencent AI Lab, C
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
metric: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc
modality: 图像, 文本, 多模态
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Adversarial, process evaluation
intro_en: HallusionBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate image-context reasoning abilities. By emphasizing detailed understanding and interpretation of visual data, it poses significant challenges to advanced large vision-language models (LVLMs). It includes 346 images and 1,129 questions, all carefully crafted by human experts. Through novel visual question structures and control group designs, HallusionBench enables quantitative analysis of model response patterns, logical consistency, and various failure modes, providing deep insights into issues such as language hallucination and visual illusions.
metric_en: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc

name: HarmBench
intro: HarmBench 是一个标准化自动红队评测框架，包含 510 个由作者依据主流模型使用政策人工设计和反复筛选的有害行为，覆盖 4 个功能类别与 7 个语义类别。它通过固定的验证/测试划分、标准化生成设置和两类专用分类器，以攻击成功率衡量红队方法对目标模型及防御的突破效果。
org: Center for AI Safety, University of California Berkeley, Stanford University, University of Illinois
build_method: 政策提炼, 专家人工构建, 反复筛选, 分层划分
task_type: 自动红队, 安全测试
eval_feature: 对抗性, 保留测试集, 专用分类器
build_method_en: Policy Distillation, Expert Authoring, Iterative Curation, Stratified Splitting
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Held-out Test Set, Specialized Classifiers
intro_en: HarmBench is a standardized automated red-teaming framework with 510 harmful behaviors manually designed and repeatedly curated by the authors from major model-use policies. The behaviors cover four functional and seven semantic categories. A fixed validation/test split, standardized generation settings, and two specialized classifier paths measure attack success against target models and defenses.

name: HEAD-QA
intro: HEAD-QA是基于西班牙医疗系统专业资格考试的多项选择问答基准，涵盖医学、护理学、心理学、化学、药学和生物学六个领域，对人类专家也极具挑战性。
build_method: 官方考试题抽取、无效题清理、按年份切分与机器翻译人工抽检
eval_feature: 西班牙文/英文双语、按年份切分、与官方人类成绩可比
build_method_en: Official-exam extraction, invalid-item removal, chronological splitting, and human-audited machine translation
eval_feature_en: Spanish/English bilingual views, chronological splits, and comparability with official human results
intro_en: HEAD-QA is a multiple-choice question benchmark based on the Spanish healthcare system professional qualification exam, covering six fields: medicine, nursing, psychology, chemistry, pharmacy, and biology. It is highly challenging even for human experts.

    F -- Pass --> G(Validated Q&A Pairs)

    F --> G["准确率和官方分数"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.04701 and the official HEAD-QA release. HEAD-QA is created from Spanish public-health specialization examinations from 2013 onward. It covers medicine, pharmacology, psychology, nursing, biology, and chemistry; radiophysics is excluded because equations made PDF parsing difficult, and questions invalidated after the official exams are removed. Each sample stores a question ID/text, optional image path, answer IDs/text, and the correct-answer ID. The full dataset has 6,765 questions: 2,657 from 2013-2014 for training, 1,366 from 2015 for development, and 2,742 from later exams for testing. The original Spanish data is translated with Google API; two bilingual reviewers assess adequacy and one native English speaker assesses fluency on 60 random items. Evaluation selects one option and reports accuracy plus official POINTS (correct +3, wrong -1); no additional blank-answer rule is inferred.

name: HealthAdminBench
intro: HealthAdminBench 是一个医疗行政 computer-use agent 基准。135 个专家任务在 4 个确定性 GUI 环境中复现事前授权、拒付申诉和耐用医疗设备流程，并以 1,698 个可验证子任务同时衡量细粒度进展与严格的端到端任务成功。
org: Stanford University, Kinetic Systems, Stanford Health Care
build_method: 专家工作流设计, 确定性GUI仿真, 专家审计, 混合验证器
metric: 任务成功率, 子任务成功率, 95% Bootstrap置信区间
task_type: Computer-use Agent, 医疗行政工作流
eval_feature: 确定性GUI, 状态持久化, 严格端到端判定
scale: 135 个任务, 1,698 个子任务（1,177 确定性 + 521 自由文本）
build_method_en: Expert Workflow Design, Deterministic GUI Simulation, Expert Audit, Hybrid Verification
eval_feature_en: Deterministic GUI, Persistent State, Strict End-to-end Scoring
intro_en: HealthAdminBench evaluates healthcare-administration computer-use agents with 135 expert-designed tasks in four deterministic GUI environments. Prior authorization, appeals and denials, and durable medical equipment workflows are decomposed into 1,698 verifiable subtasks, supporting both granular progress measurement and strict end-to-end task success.
metric_en: Task Success Rate, Subtask Success Rate, 95% Bootstrap Confidence Intervals

name: HealthBench
intro: HealthBench 是一个由 262 名医生共同构建的开放式医疗对话基准，包含 5,000 个多轮对话和 48,562 条独特评分标准，覆盖 7 个主题与 5 个行为轴。对话来自定制模型生成、医生红队和 HealthSearchQA 改写，并经相关性过滤；逐样本 rubric 由模型裁判判定后汇总为标准化分数。
build_method: 医生策划, LLM生成, 医生红队, Rubric标注
metric: 医生编写Rubric的模型评分, 截断均值, Bootstrap标准误
task_type: 开放式医疗对话, 医疗安全
eval_feature: 多轮, 医生Rubric, 模型裁判, 行为轴切片
scale: 5,000 个对话, 48,562 条独特评分标准
build_method_en: Physician Curation, LLM Generation, Physician Red Teaming, Rubric Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Physician Rubrics, Model-based Grader, Behavioral-axis Slices
intro_en: HealthBench is an open-ended medical-dialogue benchmark built with 262 physicians. Its 5,000 multi-turn conversations carry 48,562 unique rubric criteria across seven themes and five behavioral axes. Conversations come from a tailored generation pipeline, physician red teaming, and HealthSearchQA rewrites, followed by relevance filtering; a model-based grader evaluates physician-authored rubrics and aggregates normalized scores.
metric_en: Model-graded Physician Rubric Score, Clipped Mean, Bootstrap Standard Error

name: HealthBench Hard
intro: HealthBench Hard 是从 HealthBench 5,000 个对话中按多模型低分筛出的 1,000 个困难样本。构建时先剔除所有模型均为零分的约 1.5% 样本，再按五家模型提供方的平均 HealthBench 分数选择最低 1,000 个；原始对话、医生 rubric 和正式评分公式均保持不变。
build_method: HealthBench子集筛选, 多提供方模型难度排序
metric: 医生编写Rubric的模型评分, 截断均值, Bootstrap标准误
task_type: 开放式医疗对话, 医疗安全
eval_feature: 多模型难例选择, 医生Rubric, 模型裁判
scale: 1,000 个困难对话（从 HealthBench 5,000 个对话筛选）
build_method_en: HealthBench Subset Selection, Cross-provider Model Difficulty Ranking
eval_feature_en: Multi-model Hard-case Selection, Physician Rubrics, Model-based Grader
intro_en: HealthBench Hard is a 1,000-example difficult subset selected from HealthBench's 5,000 conversations. Construction first removes the roughly 1.5% of examples on which every selection model scores zero, then takes the 1,000 lowest average HealthBench scores across five model providers. The original conversations, physician rubrics, and official scoring formula remain unchanged.
scale_en: 1,000 difficult conversations selected from 5,000 HealthBench conversations
metric_en: Model-graded Physician Rubric Score, Clipped Mean, Bootstrap Standard Error

name: HealthBench Professional
intro: HealthBench Professional 是 OpenAI 面向真实临床医生聊天任务发布的开放基准，包含从 15,079 个候选中分层筛选的 525 个任务，覆盖会诊、写作与文档、医学研究三类常见工作。190 名医生参与创作与三阶段复核，困难样本相对候选池富集约 3.5 倍，约三分之一来自医生红队测试。
build_method: 真实医生聊天采集, 三阶段医生复核, 难度分层抽样, 医生Rubric标注
metric: 长度校正的医生Rubric分数, 场景与专科切片
task_type: 开放式临床对话, 医疗专业任务
eval_feature: 真实临床工作流, 医生红队, 专科匹配人类基线, 模型Rubric裁判, 长度校正
scale: 525个任务（从15,079个候选筛选）；190名医生
task_type_en: Open-ended clinician chat, professional medical tasks
build_method_en: Real clinician chats, three-stage physician review, difficulty-stratified sampling, physician-authored rubrics
eval_feature_en: Real clinical workflows, physician red teaming, specialist-matched human baseline, model rubric grader, length adjustment
intro_en: HealthBench Professional is OpenAI's open benchmark of real clinician-chat tasks. Its 525 tasks were stratified from 15,079 candidates across care consult, writing and documentation, and medical research. A cohort of 190 physicians contributed authorship and three-stage review; difficult examples are enriched by about 3.5 times and roughly one-third are physician red-teaming cases.
scale_en: 525 tasks selected from 15,079 candidates; 190 physician contributors
metric_en: Length-adjusted physician-rubric score, use-case and specialty slices
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.27470, especially Sections 2-4 and 8, plus the official OpenAI release page and dataset schema. HealthBench Professional is a separate 2026 open benchmark that complements HealthBench; it is not a Claude system-card split. 190 physicians with experience across 50 countries and 26 specialties authored or reviewed real ChatGPT for Clinicians conversations from good-faith use and deliberate red teaming. Stage 1 creates the conversation, example-specific signed rubric, and Likert 1-7 difficulty rating; Stage 2 checks realism, difficulty, and rubric quality, with two independent physicians verifying difficult cases; Stage 3 adjudicates ambiguity and removes subjective criteria. Metadata tags drive stratified selection of 525 tasks from 15,079 candidates, enriching difficult examples about 3.5 times, with roughly one-third red teaming. Specialist-matched physicians provide unbounded-time, web-enabled responses for all tasks. GPT-5.4 at low reasoning grades each criterion independently; met signed points are normalized by maximum positive points, then an empirically estimated response-length adjustment is applied before clipped mean and slice reporting.

name: HealthBench-Hallu
intro: HealthBench-Hallu 是 Baichuan-M3 报告在 HealthBench 模型回答上运行的细粒度医疗幻觉评测。它抽取并原子化医学事实声明，以实时检索的权威证据将声明标为支持、不确定或驳斥，并用加权幻觉率区分严重事实错误与证据不足。论文未披露独立题目数。
build_method: HealthBench回答复用, GPT-5事实声明抽取, 实时权威证据检索
metric: 加权幻觉率, 驳斥率, 不确定率
task_type: 医疗回答, 事实声明级幻觉验证
eval_feature: 声明原子化, 实时检索, 权威证据, 三档标签
scale: 基于 HealthBench 模型回答运行；论文未披露独立题目数
build_method_en: HealthBench Response Reuse, GPT-5 Claim Extraction, Live Authoritative-evidence Retrieval
eval_feature_en: Claim Atomicity, Live Search, Authoritative Evidence, Three-way Labels
intro_en: HealthBench-Hallu is the fine-grained medical-hallucination evaluation run over HealthBench model responses in the Baichuan-M3 report. It extracts and atomizes medical factual claims, retrieves current authoritative evidence, labels each claim Supported, Uncertain, or Refuted, and separates severe factual errors from insufficient evidence with a weighted hallucination rate. The paper does not disclose a separate item count.
scale_en: Runs over HealthBench model responses; no independent item count is reported
metric_en: Weighted Hallucination Rate, Refuted Rate, Uncertain Rate

name: HealthSearchQA
intro: HealthSearchQA 是 Google 在 MultiMedQA 论文中引入的开放式消费者医疗问答数据集。论文版本包含 3,375 条常见健康搜索问题，由医学状况及相关症状作为种子，检索搜索引擎向输入种子词用户公开展示的常见问题；数据只提供问题，不含参考答案，采用自由文本开放域回答。
build_method: 医学状况与症状种子, 公开常见搜索问题检索与策划
metric: 12个临床医生评估轴, 普通用户意图与有用性评分, Bootstrap区间
eval_feature: 消费者健康查询, 无参考答案, 医学共识与伤害评估, 普通用户效用评估
scale: 3,375条仅含问题的消费者医疗查询
build_method_en: Medical-condition and symptom seeds, retrieval and curation of publicly shown common search questions
eval_feature_en: Consumer health queries, no reference answers, medical consensus and harm review, lay-user utility evaluation
intro_en: HealthSearchQA is Google's open-ended consumer medical QA dataset introduced with MultiMedQA. The paper version contains 3,375 commonly searched health questions retrieved from publicly shown search-engine queries using medical conditions and associated symptoms as seeds. It provides questions only, with free-text open-domain responses and no reference answers.
metric_en: 12 clinician evaluation axes, lay-user intent and helpfulness ratings, bootstrap intervals
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Medical conditions and symptom seeds"] --> B["Public commonly searched questions"]
    B --> C["3,375 question-only queries"]
    C --> D["MultiMedQA consumer-health component"]
    D --> E["100 HealthSearchQA questions in a 140-question study"]
    E --> F["Clinician and lay-user ratings"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["医学状况与症状种子"] --> B["公开常见搜索问题"]
    B --> C["3,375条仅含问题的查询"]
    C --> D["MultiMedQA消费者健康组成"]
    D --> E["140题研究中的100道HealthSearchQA"]
    E --> F["临床医生与普通用户评分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2212.13138, especially Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.5. The arXiv paper consistently reports 3,375 HealthSearchQA questions in its contribution list, MultiMedQA summary table, dataset-construction paragraph, and size line. Medical conditions and associated symptoms seed retrieval of publicly available commonly searched questions generated by a search engine and shown to users entering those terms. The released benchmark is English, open-domain, free-response, and question-only; it does not include reference answers or use automatic accuracy. The human-evaluation framework was refined through clinician focus groups and triplicate ratings of 25 question-answer tuples per dataset. The paper's detailed study randomly selected 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA questions, disjoint from prompt-tuning examples. Clinician and model answer sources were blinded; one of nine clinicians rated each answer over 12 scientific-consensus, harm, comprehension, retrieval, reasoning, content, and bias axes. Five non-medical raters evaluated intent and helpfulness/actionability, while 100 bootstrap replicas produced 95% percentile intervals. The diagram explicitly keeps this 140-question sampled study separate from construction of all 3,375 queries.

name: HellaSwag
intro: HellaSwag是一个常识推理挑战数据集。人类在该数据集上的准确率超过95%，但先进的语言模型得分却很低。该数据集通过对抗性过滤（Adversarial Filtering）方法构建，旨在生成对机器而言极具挑战性、但对人类来说却很简单的句子补全问题。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
build_method: LLM生成, 对抗性过滤
eval_feature: 对抗性, 常识推理
build_method_en: LLM Generation, Adversarial Filtering
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, commonsense reasoning
intro_en: HellaSwag is a commonsense reasoning challenge dataset. Humans achieve over 95% accuracy on it, while advanced language models score much lower. The dataset is constructed using Adversarial Filtering to create sentence completion tasks that are very challenging for machines but easy for humans.

name: HELMET
intro: HELMET是一个全面的基准测试，旨在有效且彻底地评估长上下文语言模型（LCLMs）。它涵盖了七个多样化的、以应用为中心的类别，解决了现有基准测试中存在的覆盖范围有限、上下文长度不足和评估指标不可靠等问题。HELMET通过增加可控的上下文长度（高达128K tokens）、基于模型的评估和少样本提示，提供了更可靠和一致的LCLM排名。研究发现，合成任务不能可靠预测下游性能，且HELMET中不同类别之间趋势各异、相关性低。
build_method: 公开长上下文任务策划、可控长度构造与任务适配评测
metric: SubEM, Citation metrics, NDCG@10, Accuracy, ROUGE F1, GPT-4o model-based scores
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题, 摘要, 信息检索, 文本生成
eval_feature: 七类应用导向任务、128K+可控上下文、稳健少样本提示与参考式模型评测
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Multiple Choice, Summarization, information retrieval, text generation
build_method_en: Public-task curation, controllable-length construction, and task-appropriate evaluation
eval_feature_en: Seven application-centric categories, controllable 128K+ contexts, robust few-shot prompts, and reference-based model evaluation
intro_en: HELMET is a comprehensive benchmark designed to effectively and thoroughly evaluate long-context language models (LCLMs). It covers seven diverse, application-focused categories, addressing limitations in existing benchmarks such as limited coverage, insufficient context length, and unreliable evaluation metrics. HELMET offers more reliable and consistent LCLM rankings by incorporating controllable context lengths (up to 128K tokens), model-based evaluation, and few-shot prompting. Studies show that synthetic tasks do not reliably predict downstream performance, and trends vary with low correlation across different categories within HELMET.
metric_en: SubEM, citation metrics, NDCG@10, accuracy, ROUGE F1, GPT-4o model-based scores
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["diverse long-context desiderata"] --> B["RAG/Cite/Re-rank/ICL/LongQA/Summ/Recall"]
    B --> C["selected public datasets"]
    C --> D["control input length to 128K+"]
    D --> E["two-shot and robust prompts"]
    E --> F["reference-based or model-based metrics"]
    F --> G["59-LCLM holistic evaluation"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["多样长上下文目标"] --> B["RAG/引用/重排/ICL/长QA/摘要/召回"]
    B --> C["精选公开数据集"]
    C --> D["控制到128K以上长度"]
    D --> E["双样例稳健提示"]
    E --> F["参考或模型评估指标"]
    F --> G["59个LCLM整体评测"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.02694 and the official princeton-nlp/HELMET repository. HELMET targets four weaknesses in long-context evaluation: limited application coverage, inadequate length, unreliable metrics, and incompatibility with base models. It curates seven categories and 21 dataset/task configurations: RAG, citation generation, passage re-ranking, many-shot ICL, long-document QA, summarization, and synthetic recall. Evidence tasks vary retrieved or ranked passages and gold positions; ICL varies balanced shots; long documents are truncated from the end; synthetic tasks control generated length and placement, supporting 128K tokens and beyond. Most tasks use two-shot prompts, with variable-shot ICL and original RULER settings. Direct metrics include SubEM, citation metrics, NDCG@10, accuracy, and ROUGE F1. GPT-4o grades NarrativeQA with fluency times normalized correctness and summaries with atomic-claim precision/recall F1 times fluency. The paper compares 59 LCLMs and explicitly argues for a multi-category profile rather than a synthetic proxy.

name: HiPhO
intro: HiPhO 使用 2024-2025 年 7 项物理奥赛的 13 套官方试卷评估 (M)LLM。论文基准包含 360 道题、519 个小题，覆盖 5 个物理领域、4 种模态和 6 种答案类型；每个题解对均经专家人工核验，7 套考试提供官方步骤评分细则，最终按考试总分映射官方金银铜牌线。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
build_method: 官方试卷OCR, 题解索引匹配, 全量专家核验, 评分细则结构化, 多维标注
metric: 考试总分, 答案级与步骤级得分, 金银铜牌等级
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 官方评分细则, 部分分, 多解取最高分, 多模态, 人机奖牌对比
scale: 13套试卷, 360道题, 519个小题；7套含评分细则
build_method_en: Official-exam OCR, question-answer index matching, complete expert verification, marking-scheme structuring, multidimensional annotation
eval_feature_en: Official marking schemes, partial credit, best-of-multiple solutions, multimodal input, human medal comparison
intro_en: HiPhO evaluates (M)LLMs on 13 official papers from seven 2024-2025 physics Olympiads. The paper benchmark contains 360 problems and 519 subquestions across five physics fields, four modality types, and six answer types. Experts manually verify every QA pair; seven exams include official step-level marking schemes, and total exam scores map to official gold, silver, and bronze thresholds.
scale_en: 13 exam papers, 360 problems, 519 subquestions; 7 papers include marking schemes
metric_en: Exam score, answer- and step-level score, Gold/Silver/Bronze level
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Official 2024-2025 exam PDFs"] --> B["OCR and LaTeX-preserving extraction"]
    B --> C["QA matching and complete expert verification"]
    C --> D["Marking schemes and problem refinement"]
    D --> E["360 problems and 519 subquestions"]
    E --> F["Answer- and step-level grading"]
    F --> G["Exam scores and medal thresholds"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["2024-2025官方试卷PDF"] --> B["OCR与LaTeX保留抽取"]
    B --> C["题解匹配与全量专家核验"]
    C --> D["评分细则与题目精炼"]
    D --> E["360道题与519个小题"]
    E --> F["答案级与步骤级评分"]
    F --> G["考试总分与奖牌线"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.07894, especially Sections 3.1-3.3 and Appendices A.1-A.2, plus the official SciYu/HiPhO release. The paper snapshot selects 13 exam papers from seven influential 2024-2025 physics Olympiads based on influence and availability of human scores. Official PDFs are converted to markdown by OCR while preserving LaTeX, questions and answers are matched by indices, and experts manually verify every QA pair, correcting OCR errors, mismatches, and answer inconsistencies. Seven exams provide official marking schemes; criteria are converted into model-readable step rubrics, and four exams support multiple official solutions. Post-processing completes context, structures interdependent subquestions, and specifies required units. The final paper benchmark has 360 problems, 519 subquestions, 308 English and 52 Chinese problems, five physics fields, four modality types, six answer types, and three difficulty levels. Answer grading uses a rule-based math verifier followed by a strong-model review for failed equivalent matches. For exams with marking schemes, a strong model awards step-level partial credit and takes the highest score across valid official solution paths; exams without schemes use answer-level grading. Problem scores sum to exam scores and map to official medal thresholds.

name: HireBench
intro: HireBench 并非独立基准，而是 Agent World Model 论文与 AgentWorldModel-1K 发布数据中的 1,000 个合成环境之一，对应“Coding Graduate Pipeline”招聘场景。AWM 为该场景生成 10 个任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具、样例数据和逐任务验证器。
org: Snowflake AI Research, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
build_method: AWM场景合成, 每场景10个任务, SQLite数据库, MCP工具接口, 状态差异验证
metric: 四类任务结果, 完成奖励, Environment Error
eval_feature: 可执行有状态环境, 数据库一致性, 多轮工具使用, 代码增强LLM裁判
scale: AgentWorldModel-1K中的1个环境；10个招聘任务
build_method_en: AWM scenario synthesis, 10 tasks per scenario, SQLite state, MCP tools, and before/after-state verification
eval_feature_en: Executable stateful environment, database consistency, multi-turn tool use, code-augmented LLM judge
intro_en: HireBench is not a standalone benchmark. It is one of 1,000 synthetic environments in the Agent World Model paper and AgentWorldModel-1K release, representing the Coding Graduate Pipeline recruiting scenario. AWM generates ten tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools, sample data, and task-specific verifiers for this scenario.
scale_en: One environment in AgentWorldModel-1K; 10 recruiting tasks
metric_en: Four-class task outcome, completion reward, Environment Error
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10090v3, especially Figure 2, Sections 3.1-3.3, execution-based self-correction, and Appendix Table 15, plus the official Snowflake/AgentWorldModel-1K scenario and task files. HireBench is not defined as a standalone benchmark: the paper lists ‘HireBench Coding Graduate Pipeline’ as a generated scenario, and the released gen_scenario.jsonl maps it to ats_applicant_tracking_system_4. Its ten released tasks cover job requisitions, coding assessments, candidate profiles, submissions, interviews, offers, bulk pipeline updates, and recruiting analytics. The common AWM pipeline expands 100 domain-name seeds into stateful CRUD scenarios, classifies and embedding-deduplicates them, generates ten API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario, synthesizes SQLite schema and sample state, emits a minimal typed FastAPI/MCP tool interface, and creates task-specific before/after-state verifiers. Components run in isolation and feed errors back for up to five repair iterations. Agent evaluation combines structured database signals with the trajectory in a code-augmented LLM judge and returns Completed, Partially Completed, Agent Error, or Environment Error.

name: HLE
intro: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) 是一个前沿的多模态基准，旨在评估高级AI系统在人类知识前沿的表现。该基准包含2500个由全球主题专家创建的选择题和简答题，覆盖数学、人文学科和自然科学等多个领域。HLE的设计目标是成为同类中最后一个封闭式学术基准，其问题无法通过简单的网络搜索快速解答，从而对当前最先进的LLM构成重大挑战。
org: Center for AI Safety and collaborating institutions
task_type_en: Multiple choice and short answer questions
build_method_en: Constructed by experts from various global fields
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Zero-shot, few-shot, Domain-specific
intro_en: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is a cutting-edge multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate advanced AI systems' performance at the forefront of human knowledge. It includes 2,500 multiple-choice and short-answer questions created by global subject experts, covering fields such as mathematics, humanities, and natural sciences. HLE aims to be the last closed-book academic benchmark of its kind, with questions that cannot be quickly answered through simple web searches, posing a significant challenge to state-of-the-art LLMs.

name: HLE-Full
intro: HLE-Full 是网站和模型报告中对完整 Humanity’s Last Exam 评测的标签，并非另行构建的数据集；它使用 HLE 当前公开的 2,500 道多模态专家题。
org: Center for AI Safety, Scale AI
build_method: 全球学科专家投稿、多模型难度筛选与两阶段专家评审
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 多项选择, 精确短答案
eval_feature: 完整多模态、无工具、闭卷与置信度校准
build_method_en: Global subject-expert submissions, multi-model difficulty filtering, and two-stage expert review
eval_feature_en: Full multimodal, no-tool, closed-book evaluation with confidence calibration
intro_en: HLE-Full is a website and model-report label for the complete Humanity’s Last Exam evaluation, not a separately constructed dataset; it uses the current 2,500-item multimodal expert release of HLE.
scale_en: 2,500 public questions (plus a private held-out set)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["global subject experts"] --> B["strict closed-ended submissions"]
    B --> C["frontier-LLM difficulty filtering"]
    C --> D["two rounds of expert review"]
    D --> E["2,500 public questions plus private holdout"]
    E --> F["full multimodal no-tool evaluation"]
    F --> G["O3-mini correctness judge"]
    G --> H["accuracy and RMS calibration error"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["全球学科专家"] --> B["严格封闭式投稿"]
    B --> C["前沿LLM难度筛选"]
    C --> D["两轮专家评审"]
    D --> E["2500道公开题及私有保留集"]
    E --> F["完整多模态无工具评测"]
    F --> G["O3-mini正确性裁判"]
    G --> H["准确率和RMS校准误差"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the current revision of arXiv:2501.14249 and the official cais/hle release. HLE-Full is a reporting label for complete HLE, not a separately constructed benchmark. Nearly 1,000 experts from 500+ institutions in 50 countries submit closed-ended questions across more than 100 subjects. Each submission includes the question, answer specification, detailed rationale, subject, and contributor affiliation and must be precise, unambiguous, solvable, non-searchable, and original or a nontrivial synthesis. Several frontier LLMs precheck difficulty; more than 70,000 attempts yield about 13,000 model-stumping candidates. Graduate-degree reviewers give each item 1-3 first-round reviews before organizer/expert approval. The current paper and dataset release contain 2,500 public questions plus a private held-out set; 24% are multiple choice, the remainder exact match, and around 14% require images. Full multimodal no-tool evaluation requests reasoning, a final answer, and confidence; O3-mini accepts equivalent answer formats. Metrics are accuracy and RMS calibration error.

name: HLE-Verified
intro: HLE-Verified 是 Humanity’s Last Exam 的系统验证与结构化修订版本，通过组件级核验、双轨专家修复和最终裁决，将 2,500 题划分为 668 个金集、1,143 个修订集和 689 个有记录的不确定集。
build_method: 专家审查, 模型交叉检查和独立专家修复
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: Verified
build_method_en: Expert review, model cross-checking, and independent expert correction
eval_feature_en: Verified
intro_en: HLE-Verified is a systematic verification and structured revision of Humanity’s Last Exam. Component-wise validation, dual independent expert repair, and final adjudication partition all 2,500 items into 668 Gold, 1,143 Revision, and 689 documented Uncertain items.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["2,500 original HLE items"] --> B["problem/answer/rationale components"]
    B --> C["expert review plus pass@8 evidence"]
    C --> D["668 unchanged Gold items"]
    C --> E["repairable items"]
    E --> F["dual expert repairs and final adjudication"]
    F --> G["1,143 Revision items"]
    F --> H["689 documented Uncertain items"]
    D --> I["three disjoint release subsets"]
    G --> I
    H --> I
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["2500个原始HLE条目"] --> B["题目/答案/解析组件"]
    B --> C["专家审查与pass@8证据"]
    C --> D["668个未修改金集"]
    C --> E["可修复条目"]
    E --> F["双轨专家修复与最终裁决"]
    F --> G["1143个修订条目"]
    F --> H["689个有记录的不确定条目"]
    D --> I["三个互斥发布子集"]
    G --> I
    H --> I
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the current v3 of arXiv:2602.13964. HLE-Verified starts from all 2,500 original HLE items and decomposes each into problem (including image), final answer, and rationale. Stage I combines independent domain-expert binary judgments, multi-frontier-model pass@8 replication with answer normalization/equivalence, and conservative internal adjudication without content edits. Valid problems and answers with no high-risk ambiguity form 668 unchanged Gold items; these bypass Stage II. Flawed but repairable items enter Stage II under an objective-preservation constraint. Two independent expert teams propose Problem Fix, Solution Fix, and Answer Fix edits with change notes; model proposals are auxiliary only; internal experts select or synthesize minimal canonical repairs. The release has three disjoint subsets: 668 Gold, 1,143 revised-and-certified, and 689 Uncertain items with source and required-expertise tags, plus traces and a 19-category defect taxonomy. Evaluation compares raw and verified full/edited subsets with accuracy and calibration error, using text-only items unless specified. The current v3 counts supersede earlier abstract counts of 641 and 1,170.

name: HLEtext
intro: HLEtext 是 Step 3.5 Flash 报告使用的 Humanity’s Last Exam 纯文本子集，并非独立数据集；它筛除需要图像理解的 HLE 题目后按官方判分协议评测。
org: StepFun; HLE by Center for AI Safety and Scale AI
build_method: 按HLE专家构建流程生成全集后筛除需要图像理解的题目
task_type: 多项选择, 精确短答案
eval_feature: HLE纯文本子集、pass@1、gpt-oss-120b裁判
scale: 未公布精确行数（HLE中约14%题目需图像）
build_method_en: Construct full HLE through the expert pipeline, then remove questions requiring image comprehension
eval_feature_en: HLE text-only subset, pass@1, and gpt-oss-120b judging
