build_method_en: Hybrid, Automated Generation, Web Crawling, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, Real-time, Contamination-free, Zero-shot
intro_en: LiveBench is a benchmark designed for large language models to resist test set contamination and reviewer bias. It includes frequently updated questions from the latest information sources, supports automatic scoring, and covers a range of challenging tasks such as mathematics, programming, reasoning, language understanding, instruction following, and data analysis.

name: LiveCodeBench
intro: LiveCodeBench是一个针对大型语言模型代码相关任务的基准，通过持续收集LeetCode、AtCoder和CodeForces等竞赛平台的新题目，避免训练数据污染。评测范围广泛，涵盖代码生成、自我修复、代码执行和测试输出预测等能力。

build_method_en: Web Crawling, Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, Real-time, Contamination-free, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: LiveCodeBench is a benchmark for code-related tasks in large language models. It continuously collects new problems from competitive platforms like LeetCode, AtCoder, and CodeForces to avoid training data contamination. The evaluation covers a wide range of abilities, including code generation, self-repair, code execution, and test output prediction.

name: LiveCodeBench Pro
intro: LiveCodeBench Pro 是实时、持续更新的竞赛编程基准；论文快照包含截至 2025-04-25 的 584 道 Codeforces、ICPC 系列与 IOI 系列题目。题目在解答、题解和讨论公开前采集，并由奥赛奖牌得主标注算法技能和认知重点。
org: New York University, Princeton University, University of California San Diego, University of Washing
build_method: 实时竞赛采集, 主办方多层测试, Elo 难度分层, 专家三盲标注
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 领域特定
build_method_en: Real-Time Contest Capture, Host Multi-Layer Testing, Elo Difficulty Tiers, Triple-Blind Expert Annotation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, Real-time, Contamination-free, Domain-specific
intro_en: LiveCodeBench Pro is a live, continuously updated competitive-programming benchmark; the paper snapshot contains 584 Codeforces, ICPC-series, and IOI-series problems collected before April 25, 2025. Problems are captured before solutions, editorials, or discussions appear, then Olympiad medalists annotate algorithmic skills and cognitive focus.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.11928. The paper snapshot contains 584 problems collected before April 25, 2025 from Codeforces, ICPC series, and IOI series, explicitly excluding LeetCode. Each problem is captured before accepted solutions, editorials, or discussions appear, must pass the contest host's coordinator-plus-expert-tester gate, and uses the full immutable post-contest test set. Difficulty is Easy <=2000, Medium (2000,3000], or Hard >3000. Olympiad medalists assign algorithm tags plus knowledge-, logic-, and observation-heavy labels through triple-blind consensus. Evaluation reports Pass@1/Pass@k and Bayesian MAP Elo, with line-by-line comparison of 125 o3-mini failures and 125 similarly rated human failures.

name: LiveCodeBench v6

task_type: 竞赛编程, 代码生成

intro_en: LiveCodeBench v6 is release_v6 of the continuously updated competitive-programming benchmark, containing 1,055 LeetCode, AtCoder, and CodeForces problems released from May 2023 through April 2025. The official code-generation runner defaults to the pruned code_generation_lite tests, samples n=10 candidate programs per problem at temperature 0.2, executes them with a modified APPS checker, and reports Pass@1 and Pass@5.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.07974 Sections 2–4 and Appendix A plus the official LiveCodeBench/LiveCodeBench release_v6 runner. The benchmark continuously collects public contest problems from LeetCode weekly and biweekly contests, AtCoder beginner contests, and selected CodeForces Division 3 and 4 contests; records statements, dates, difficulty labels, solutions, tests, and starter code when available; and uses platform tests or generated test coverage as required. release_v6 fixes 1,055 problems dated May 2023 through April 2025. The official code-generation path defaults to pruned code_generation_lite tests and exposes --not_fast for the original full tests. Current runner defaults are n=10, temperature=0.2, top_p=0.95, and 2,000 max tokens; model-style parsing feeds a modified APPS checker, and Pass@1 plus Pass@5 can be reported or sliced by date.

    B --> C["将Base视为报告评测标签而非独立发布版本"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned jointly with the LiveCodeBench paper arXiv:2403.07974 and DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report arXiv:2412.19437 Section 4.4. LiveCodeBench supplies dated competitive-programming problems from LeetCode, AtCoder, and CodeForces, platform-specific test curation, functional or standard-input formats, and unseen functional tests. DeepSeek-V3 then names a distinct evaluation row LiveCodeBench-Base (0801–1101); this is a report label rather than an official standalone LCB release. The report uses its internal generation-based framework, fixes the same date slice across DeepSeek-V2-Base, Qwen2.5-72B Base, LLaMA-3.1-405B Base, and DeepSeek-V3-Base, applies a three-shot setting, and reports Pass@1. The diagram intentionally does not substitute LiveCodeBench's original one-shot base-model protocol or the separate chat-model CoT setup for this DeepSeek report configuration.

name: LiveDRBench
intro: LiveDRBench是一个评估深度研究（Deep Research）系统的基准，它不只关注最终报告，更强调搜索过程的广度和推理强度。该基准包含100个科学及公共领域的挑战性任务，并采用关键论点的中间表示来进行客观的性能衡量。
build_method: 问题反转, 分类特定标准论点, 人工核验, 全网检索评测
task_type: Agent任务, 事实验证, 生成
build_method_en: Problem inversion, category-specific gold claims, manual verification, full-web evaluation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, Real-time, Process-oriented, Domain-specific
intro_en: LiveDRBench is a benchmark for evaluating Deep Research systems, focusing not only on the final report but also on the breadth of the search process and the strength of reasoning. It includes 100 challenging tasks from scientific and public domains and uses intermediate representations of key arguments for objective performance measurement.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.04183v1, Sections 3–5. LiveDRBench defines deep research by high search fan-out and nontrivial reasoning, explicitly evaluating claim generation rather than long-form report writing. Refreshable tasks are created by inverting document or long-context reasoning problems: answer properties become clues for finding a matching entity or event, then additional properties make the answer unique. The benchmark contains 100 tasks across eight SciFacts, NovelDS, PriorArt, Entities, and Flights categories spanning scientific and world-event domains; typical tasks target about 20 information units through at least 10 searches. Category-specific source documents or scraping build initial gold claims, and manual review adds valid agent answers missing from the initial lists. Full-web outputs are normalized to JSON claims and subclaims, matched with the published GPT-4o agreement prompt, and scored with modified precision, recall, and F1 that propagate subclaim quality to parent claims. The paper also analyzes source counts, branching, and backtracking in system traces.

name: LiveMathBench
intro: LiveMathBench是一个由多项竞赛和考试题目组成的双语数学基准，旨在减少数据污染并评估大型语言模型的推理能力。该基准持续更新，并提出G-Pass@k指标，用于衡量模型在复杂推理任务中的性能潜力和稳定性。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Monash University
build_method: 考试题, 网络爬取, LLM生成, 混合
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 双语
build_method_en: Exam Questions, Web Crawling, LLM Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, Real-time, Contamination-free, Bilingual
intro_en: LiveMathBench is a bilingual math benchmark composed of multiple competition and exam questions, designed to reduce data contamination and evaluate the reasoning ability of large language models. The benchmark is continuously updated and introduces the G-Pass@k metric to measure model performance potential and stability on complex reasoning tasks.

name: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark
intro: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark 使用 400 个固定创意简报评估故事创作。当前官方流程对同一简报的完整故事进行双顺序、多评判模型成对比较，校正位置偏差后拟合 Thurstone 全局比较分数，并通过双重 bootstrap 给出置信区间。
build_method: 固定专家创意简报, 多模型成对评判
metric: Thurstone comparison score, win probability, 95% CI
task_type: 创意故事生成, 成对偏好评测
eval_feature: 双顺序评判, 位置偏差校正, 双重 bootstrap
build_method_en: Fixed expert creative briefs, multi-model pairwise judging
eval_feature_en: Dual-order judging, position-bias correction, two-way bootstrap
intro_en: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark evaluates story generation with 400 fixed creative briefs. Its current official workflow compares completed stories for the same brief in both visible orders with multiple judge models, corrects position bias, fits global Thurstone comparison scores, and estimates uncertainty with a two-way bootstrap.
metric_en: Thurstone comparison score, win probability, 95% CI
drawio_review_note: No associated paper was found. Aligned with official lechmazur/writing repository snapshot 0286ecf. The current leaderboard uses 400 fixed briefs with ten required narrative elements and 600–800-word tagged stories, retains completed stories without score imputation, compares matched stories in both visible orders with multiple evaluators, parses signed margins, corrects side-position bias, averages opposite-order judgments, fits global Thurstone comparison scores, and bootstraps both stories and evaluators. The repository's archived absolute 0–10, 18-dimension workflow is not presented as the current method.

name: LMArena
intro: LMArena 源自 Chatbot Arena，是匿名双模型对战的人类偏好评测平台。论文快照包含 243,329 场对战、50 个模型和 90,051 名用户；在数据质量控制与专家复标后，使用重加权 Bradley–Terry 模型估计排行榜及置信区间。
build_method: 匿名在线众包成对比较
metric: Bradley–Terry score, win rate, confidence interval
task_type: 开放式多轮对话, 人类偏好评测
eval_feature: 匿名盲测, 主动配对采样, 专家复标
scale: 论文快照 243,329 场对战 / 50 个模型 / 90,051 名用户
task_type_en: Open-ended multi-turn dialogue, human preference evaluation
build_method_en: Anonymous online crowdsourced pairwise comparison
eval_feature_en: Anonymous blind voting, active pair sampling, expert relabeling
intro_en: LMArena originates from Chatbot Arena, an anonymous two-model battle platform for human-preference evaluation. The paper snapshot contains 243,329 battles, 50 models, and 90,051 users; after data-quality controls and blind expert relabeling, a reweighted Bradley–Terry model estimates leaderboard scores and confidence intervals.
metric_en: Bradley–Terry score, win rate, confidence interval
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.04132, especially Sections 2–4 and the January 21, 2024 paper snapshot, plus official FastChat repository snapshot 587d5cf. The diagram preserves anonymous random-side model sampling, free-form multi-turn user prompts, four vote labels, post-vote identity reveal, identity-keyword and unsafe-content filtering, anomalous-user detection, 243,329 battles from 90,051 users over 50 models and 149 languages, blind expert relabeling of 160 battles with 72–83% crowd–expert agreement, non-uniform pair-sampling correction, reweighted Bradley–Terry maximum likelihood, robust sandwich confidence intervals, and uncertainty-aware approximate ranks. It deliberately does not label the paper's current method as Elo.

name: LogicGame
intro: LogicGame是一个旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）基于规则的推理能力的基准。它通过提供多样化的游戏场景，要求模型理解并应用预定义的规则来解决问题，从而将其逻辑推理能力与先验知识分离开来。该基准不仅评估最终结果，也关注中间步骤，并涵盖了从简单到复杂的不同难度级别。
build_method: 现实场景调研与众包, 执行/规划双域原创题, 双语翻译, 自动过程校验
task_type: Agent任务, 规划, 生成
build_method_en: Research and crowdsourcing, original Execution/Planning games, bilingual translation, automatic process checking
eval_feature_en: Process-oriented, Domain-specific
intro_en: LogicGame is a benchmark designed to evaluate the rule-based reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs). It presents diverse game scenarios that require models to understand and apply predefined rules to solve problems, thereby separating their logical reasoning from prior knowledge. The benchmark assesses not only the final outcomes but also intermediate steps, covering a range of difficulty levels from simple to complex.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.15778v4, Sections 3–4 and Appendix C. LogicGame uses research and crowdsourcing to design original game-like rule problems that are unavailable online, then separates deterministic Execution tasks from strategic multi-step Planning tasks; planning items receive intermediate checkpoints or state variables where needed. References contain final answers and step-by-step processes, and responses must be JSON with answer and, when required, process lists. Four levels from 0 to 3 increase rule complexity and reasoning steps; each question has two fully worked exemplars, and meticulous translation produces aligned Chinese and English versions. The release contains 304 problems. Evaluation uses temperature 0 and a 2,048-token maximum, reports binary Answer Accuracy, character-level Process Accuracy, and their logical-AND Answer Process Accuracy, and separately analyzes JSError, IFError, and NIJ-Acc.

name: LogicVista
intro: LogicVista是一个评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉情境下综合逻辑推理能力的基准测试。它通过5项逻辑推理任务和9种不同能力，使用448道多项选择题来评估MLLM的通用逻辑认知能力。每道题目都附有正确答案和人工编写的推理过程，支持开放式和多项选择评估。
build_method: 许可/注册/付费封闭来源, 五人三个月人工标注, LLM答案抽取

task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答

eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: LogicVista is a benchmark for evaluating the comprehensive logical reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in visual contexts. It assesses the general logical cognition of MLLMs through 5 logical reasoning tasks and 9 different capabilities, using 448 multiple-choice questions. Each question includes the correct answer and a human-written reasoning process, supporting both open-ended and multiple-choice evaluations.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.04973v1, Section 3 and evaluation protocol. LogicVista uses proprietary visual reasoning sources protected by licenses, registration, payment, and creator permission to reduce data leakage. Five annotators worked for three months to extract images, choices, correct answers, and supporting rationales, then stored the annotations in JSON. Its 448 multiple-choice samples are tagged with five reasoning skills—inductive, deductive, numerical, spatial, and mechanical—and nine capabilities—diagrams, OCR, patterns, graphs, tables, 3D shapes, puzzles, sequences, and physics. Eight representative MLLMs are evaluated with choice-style or open-ended outputs. For open responses, an extraction LLM receives the question, options, model answer, and reasoning, returns a choice letter, and repeats with validation feedback when invalid. The same binary correctness result is aggregated into overall, reasoning-skill, and capability-level accuracy.

name: LongBench
intro: LongBench 是首个中英双语、多任务长上下文理解基准，含 21 个数据集、4,750 条测试样本，覆盖单文档问答、多文档问答、摘要、少样本学习、合成任务和代码补全六类场景，其中 14 个英文任务、5 个中文任务、2 个代码任务。所有数据统一为 input/context/answers 等字段，按任务使用 F1、ROUGE-L、准确率或编辑相似度自动评分，并提供按长度均匀采样的 LongBench-E。
build_method: 复用与改造既有任务, 专家长文问答, 合成检索计数, 统一字段
language: 英文, 中文, 代码
task_type: 长文档问答, 摘要, 少样本学习, 合成任务, 代码补全
eval_feature: 六类任务, 任务专用指标, 首尾截断, 长度分档
task_type_en: Long-document QA, summarization, few-shot learning, synthetic tasks, code completion
build_method_en: Reuse and adapt existing tasks, expert long-document QA, synthetic retrieval and counting, unified schema
eval_feature_en: Six task categories, task-specific metrics, middle truncation preserving both ends, length bins
intro_en: LongBench is the first bilingual, multitask benchmark for long-context understanding. It contains 21 datasets and 4,750 test examples across single-document QA, multi-document QA, summarization, few-shot learning, synthetic tasks, and code completion, with 14 English tasks, five Chinese tasks, and two code tasks. Every record follows a unified input/context/answers schema, automatic evaluation uses task-specific F1, ROUGE-L, accuracy, or edit similarity, and LongBench-E provides a more uniform length distribution.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Combine adapted public tasks, expert long-document QA, synthetic tasks, and code completion"] --> B["Standardize input, context, answers, length, dataset, language, classes, and ID"]
    B --> C["Release 21 datasets and 4,750 examples across six categories"]
    C --> D["Optionally sample 13 datasets into three LongBench-E length bins"]
    D --> E["Run task-specific zero-shot prompts and preserve both ends when truncating"]
    E --> F["Apply F1, ROUGE-L, accuracy, or edit similarity and report averages"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["组合改造后的公开任务、专家长文问答、合成任务与代码补全"] --> B["统一input、context、answers、length、dataset、language、classes与ID"]
    B --> C["发布六类21个数据集共4,750条样本"]
    C --> D["可选将13个数据集采样为LongBench-E三档长度"]
    D --> E["运行任务专用零样本提示并在截断时保留首尾"]
    E --> F["应用F1、ROUGE-L、准确率或编辑相似度并报告平均分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2308.14508, ACL 2024 Long Paper 172, and the official THUDM/LongBench task construction, prompt, prediction, and metric files. LongBench draws from existing validation or test splits; directly converts several QA and summarization datasets with ZeroSCROLLS-style templates; builds multi-document QA from answer evidence plus distractors; has PhD and master's students author MultiFieldQA pairs; constructs few-shot inputs from training demonstrations plus validation queries; creates Wikipedia/C4 retrieval and counting tasks using GPT-3.5-Turbo summaries; and samples LCC plus RepoBench-P XF-F Oracle-Filled code completion. The unified release has input, context, answers, length, dataset, language, all_classes, and _id fields and totals 21 datasets / 4,750 examples: 14 English, five Chinese, and two code tasks. LongBench-E samples 13 eligible datasets into 0–4k, 4–8k, and 8k+ bins up to 100 each. Official inference uses task-specific zero-shot templates and, when necessary, removes the middle while preserving the first and last halves; evaluation selects QA F1, ROUGE-L, classification or retrieval accuracy, or code edit similarity.

name: LongBench v2
intro: LongBench v2是一个旨在评估大型语言模型在处理长上下文问题时进行深度理解和推理能力的基准。它包含503个具有挑战性的多项选择题，上下文长度从8千到200万词不等，覆盖了单文档问答、多文档问答、长上下文学习等六个任务类别。该基准通过自动化和人工审核流程确保了高质量和高难度，人类专家的准确率也仅为53.7%。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
task_type: 选择题, 问答, 分类, 摘要, 代码生成
eval_feature: 长文本, 多轮, 领域特定
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, QA, Classification, Summarization, Code Generation
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: LongBench v2 is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' deep understanding and reasoning abilities when handling long-context problems. It includes 503 challenging multiple-choice questions with context lengths ranging from 8,000 to 2 million words, covering six task categories such as single-document QA, multi-document QA, and long-context learning. The benchmark ensures high quality and difficulty through automated and manual review processes, with human experts achieving an accuracy of only 53.7%.

name: LongDocURL
intro: LongDocURL是一个综合性的多模态长文档基准测试，旨在评估大型视觉语言模型在长文档理解、数值推理和跨元素定位方面的能力。现有基准测试在处理页数和布局元素定位分析方面存在局限。该基准测试定义了长文档理解、数值推理和跨元素定位三个主要任务类别，并包含20个子任务。它通过半自动化构建流程收集了2,325个高质量问答对，覆盖超过33,000页文档，显著优于现有基准。
org: Tsinghua University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI), Institute of Automation Chin
build_method: 混合
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 过程评估
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Process Evaluation
intro_en: LongDocURL is a comprehensive multimodal long document benchmark designed to evaluate large vision-language models' abilities in long document understanding, numerical reasoning, and cross-element localization. Existing benchmarks have limitations in handling page counts and layout element localization analysis. This benchmark defines three main task categories: long document understanding, numerical reasoning, and cross-element localization, comprising 20 sub-tasks. It collects 2,325 high-quality QA pairs through a semi-automated construction process, covering over 33,000 pages, significantly surpassing existing benchmarks.
scale_en: 2325 QA pairs, over 33000 pages of documents

name: LongText-Bench
intro: LongText-Bench 是 X-Omni 提出的中英双语图像长文本渲染基准。它以标牌、物体标签、印刷品、网页、幻灯片、海报、字幕和对话八类场景构建 160 个双语提示概念，官方数据分别提供 160 条英文和 160 条中文记录。每个提示生成 4 张图，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 识别文字后按英文词或中文字符做无序多重集合匹配，并以文字准确率评分。
build_method: GPT-4o按八类生成长短提示, 中英配对, 逐条人工复核与长度平衡
task_type: 图像生成, 长文本渲染, OCR评测
eval_feature: 每提示四图, Qwen2.5-VL-7B OCR, 无序词/字符匹配
task_type_en: Image generation, long-text rendering, OCR evaluation
build_method_en: GPT-4o short/long prompt generation across eight scenarios, paired English and Chinese records, per-prompt human review and length balancing
eval_feature_en: Four images per prompt, Qwen2.5-VL-7B OCR, unordered word/character matching
intro_en: LongText-Bench is the bilingual image long-text rendering benchmark introduced by X-Omni. It defines 160 bilingual prompt concepts across signs, labeled objects, printed materials, web pages, slides, posters, captions, and dialogues; the official data provide 160 English and 160 Chinese records. Four images are generated per prompt, Qwen2.5-VL-7B recognizes their text, and Text Accuracy is computed with unordered multiset matching over English words or Chinese characters.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define eight text-rich scenarios"] --> B["Use GPT-4o to create 20 English prompts per scenario: ten short and ten long"]
    B --> C["Add corresponding Chinese records and manually review every prompt"]
    C --> D["Release 160 bilingual prompt concepts as 160 EN plus 160 ZH records"]
    D --> E["Generate four images per language-specific prompt and OCR with Qwen2.5-VL-7B"]
    E --> F["Normalize and multiset-match English words or Chinese characters to report Text Accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["定义八类富文本场景"] --> B["用GPT-4o为每类生成20个英文提示：短长各10个"]
    B --> C["添加对应中文记录并逐条人工审核"]
    C --> D["以160条英文加160条中文记录发布160个双语提示概念"]
    D --> E["每个语言提示生成4张图并用Qwen2.5-VL-7B做OCR"]
    E --> F["归一化后按英文词或中文字符无序匹配并报告文字准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with X-Omni arXiv:2507.22058 Appendix C.2, the official X-Omni-Team/X-Omni evaluator, and the X-Omni/LongText-Bench dataset card and JSONL release. The benchmark defines eight text-rich scenarios—signboards, objects with labels, printed materials, web pages, slides, posters, captions, and dialogues—and uses GPT-4o to create 20 English prompts per scenario, ten short and ten long. Every prompt is manually reviewed and rendered-text lengths are adjusted for balance: English short 10–30 and long 30–50 words; Chinese short 20–40 and long typically over 60 characters. The release pairs 160 English records with 160 Chinese records sharing prompt IDs, so it represents 160 bilingual prompt concepts / 320 language records. Evaluation samples four images per language-specific prompt, OCRs them with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct up to 1,024 new tokens, removes punctuation, lowercases and whitespace-normalizes English or retains Chinese/alphanumeric characters, and computes a micro-averaged matched-ground-truth ratio using unordered word multisets for English and character multisets for Chinese. This deliberately avoids edit distance because OCR output does not preserve relative text-segment order.

name: LongVideoBench
intro: LongVideoBench是一个以长达一小时的视频-语言交错输入为特色的问答基准。它包含3763个不同长度的网络视频及其字幕，旨在全面评估大型多模态模型（LMM）的长期多模态理解能力。该基准测试引入了一种新的视频问答任务，称为“引用推理”，要求模型根据问题中引用的视频上下文来推理相关的视频细节。LongVideoBench包含6678个人工标注的多项选择题，涵盖17个细分领域，为长视频理解提供了一个全面的评估框架。
build_method: 720P网络视频收集, 字幕生成与质量过滤, 三角色人工标注, 交错视频-字幕输入
metric: 总体准确率, 时长组准确率, 问题类别准确率
build_method_en: 720P web-video collection, subtitle and quality filtering, three-role human annotation, interleaved video-subtitle inputs
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: LongVideoBench is a QA benchmark featuring video-language inputs up to one hour long. It includes 3,763 web videos of varying lengths with subtitles, designed to comprehensively evaluate the long-term multimodal understanding ability of large multimodal models (LMMs). The benchmark introduces a new video QA task called "reference reasoning," which requires models to infer relevant video details based on referenced video context in the questions. LongVideoBench contains 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice questions across 17 subdomains, providing a comprehensive evaluation framework for long video understanding.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect 720P+ web videos from 119 channels across 10 content categories and four duration groups"] --> B["Filter for English subtitles and transcribe missing subtitles with Whisper-V3-Large"]
    B --> C["Sample topics uniformly and score visual quality with Q-Align"]
    C --> D["Manually filter candidates to retain 3,763 final videos"]
    D --> E["Design referring queries that pinpoint relevant video moments as referred context"]
    E --> F["Annotate perception and relation questions across 17 fine-grained categories"]
    F --> G["Collect 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice question-answer pairs"]
    G --> H["Evaluate long-video multimodal models with accuracy across duration and question categories"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从119个频道收集720P以上网页视频，覆盖10类内容和4个时长组"] --> B["筛选英文字幕视频，并用Whisper-V3-Large转录缺失字幕"]
    B --> C["按主题均匀采样并用Q-Align评估视觉质量"]
    C --> D["人工过滤候选视频，保留3763个最终视频"]
    D --> E["设计引用查询，定位相关视频片段作为引用上下文"]
    E --> F["按感知和关系两级标注17个细分类别问题"]
    F --> G["收集6678个人工标注的多选问答对"]
    G --> H["按时长组和问题类别用准确率评估长视频多模态模型"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.15754, Sections 2–4. LongVideoBench defines four non-contiguous duration groups—(8s,15s], (15s,60s], (180s,600s], and (900s,3600s]—and ten content categories. It downloads 720P-or-better videos from 119 channels (99 landscape and 20 portrait); on source platforms that provide transcripts it removes videos with missing or non-English subtitles, while on platforms without provided transcripts it generates subtitles with Whisper-V3-Large. It then samples topics uniformly, filters low visual quality with Q-Align, and manually curates 3,763 videos. Trained annotators watch each full video and author L1 Perception or L2 Relation referring-reasoning MCQs in 17 categories, with highlighted referring queries, referred-frame indices, and 3–4 distractors. A primary annotator, examiner, and reviser check every item; about 20% are revised. The 6,678 questions split into 1,337 validation questions over 752 videos and 5,341 test questions over 3,011 videos. Evaluation interleaves subtitle chunks between frames around subtitle mid-timestamps and reports zero-shot accuracy overall, by duration, and by question category.

name: LoraxBench
intro: LoraxBench 是面向印尼语及 19 种印度尼西亚本地语言的综合基准，覆盖阅读理解、开放问答、自然语言推理、翻译、因果推理和文化问答六项任务。三种本地语言同时区分正式与日常语域，共形成 23 个语言/语域子集；数据由专业母语者翻译、第二位母语者复核，并经过长度与数字一致性自动检查。
build_method: 印尼语源任务改造, 专业母语者翻译, 第二母语者复核, 自动一致性检查
language: 印尼语及19种本地语言（23个语言/语域子集）
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 自然语言推理, 翻译, 分类
eval_feature: 多语言, 语域对比, 本土文化
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Natural Language Inference, Translation, Classification
build_method_en: Indonesian-source task adaptation, professional native-speaker translation, second-speaker review, automated consistency checks
eval_feature_en: Multilingual, register-sensitive, local-cultural
intro_en: LoraxBench is a comprehensive benchmark for Indonesian and 19 regional Indonesian languages across reading comprehension, open-domain QA, natural language inference, translation, causal reasoning, and cultural QA. Formal and casual variants for three local languages yield 23 language/register subsets. Professional native speakers translate the data, second native speakers review it, and automated length and numeric-consistency checks flag corrections.
language_en: Indonesian and 19 local languages (23 language/register subsets)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Adapt six Indonesian-source tasks"] --> B["Clean source-specific items and define 23 language/register subsets"]
    B --> C["Translate with professional native speakers and review with a second speaker"]
    C --> D["Run length and numeric checks, then correct flagged translations"]
    D --> E["Release 87,011 rows, including 2,300 TyDi-QA training rows"]
    E --> F["Evaluate with task-specific accuracy and ChrF++"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["改造六类印尼语源任务"] --> B["按来源清洗并定义23个语言/语域子集"]
    B --> C["由专业母语者翻译并由第二位母语者复核"]
    C --> D["运行长度与数字检查并修正标记项"]
    D --> E["发布87,011行，其中含2,300条TyDi-QA训练数据"]
    E --> F["使用任务专属准确率与ChrF++评测"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.12459 and the official google/LoraxBench release. The diagram preserves the six source tasks, 20-language and 23-subset design, task-specific cleanup, professional native-speaker translation, second-speaker review, automated length/numeric checks, prompt variants, and task-specific metrics. It also records the source count discrepancy instead of silently collapsing it: paper Table 3 sums to 84,711 test items, the paper prose states 84,895, and the official release has 87,011 rows because it additionally includes 2,300 TyDi-QA training examples.

name: LPFQA
intro: LPFQA 从 50 多个专业论坛的 2,000 多个近期讨论串中构建长尾专业问答。论文版经截图保真、VLM 抽取、LLM 过滤、209 人专家项目组验证和 6–8 个前沿模型难度校准，形成 430 题，覆盖 7 个一级与 21 个二级领域。
build_method: 专业论坛整理, VLM/LLM 过滤, 专家验证
language: 英文, 中文翻译字段
task_type: 专业多项选择问答, 专业简答
eval_feature: 真实长尾论坛, 专家验证, 模型难度校准
scale: 论文版 430 题 / 7 个一级领域 / 21 个二级领域
task_type_en: Professional multiple-choice QA, professional short answer
build_method_en: Professional-forum curation, VLM/LLM filtering, expert verification
eval_feature_en: Real long-tail forums, expert verification, model-based difficulty calibration
intro_en: LPFQA builds long-tail professional QA from more than 2,000 recent discussions across over 50 professional forums. Screenshot preservation, VLM extraction, LLM filtering, verification by a 209-member project expert panel, and calibration with 6–8 frontier models yield the paper's 430 tasks across seven primary and 21 secondary domains.
scale_en: Paper release: 430 tasks / 7 primary domains / 21 secondary domains
drawio_review_note: Aligned primarily with arXiv:2511.06346v2. The paper describes expert cross-review of more than 50 professional forums, more than 2,000 post-January-2025 threads gathered over seven months, screenshot preservation, VLM structuring, LLM answer-quality filtering, conversion into one-correct 4–6-distractor MCQs or short answers, about 1,000 candidates, expert verification, 6–8-model difficulty calibration, and a 430-task release of 249 MCQs and 181 short answers across 7 primary and 21 secondary domains. The paper states that judging receives the question, expert answer, and model output, so the diagram follows that paper contract. The later official Hugging Face snapshot 8bf9f2e expands to 502 records and its stored judge prompt may omit the original question; that implementation difference is documented rather than back-projected into the paper pipeline.

name: LVBench
intro: LVBench 是面向长且内容丰富视频的多模态理解基准。它从 500 个 YouTube 候选中按五项规则筛得 103 个视频、共 117 小时，完整观看后围绕六项能力编写问题，并通过 GLM-4 与 GPT-4 纯文本作答过滤，形成 1,549 道四选一问题。
build_method: 长视频筛选, 全片人工标注, 模型泄漏过滤
eval_feature: 30 分钟以上视频, 最小证据时间段, 六项能力
build_method_en: Long-video screening, full-video human annotation, model-based leakage filtering
eval_feature_en: Videos at least 30 minutes long, minimal evidence timestamps, six capabilities
intro_en: LVBench is a multimodal-understanding benchmark for long, content-rich videos. Five screening rules reduce 500 YouTube candidates to 103 videos totaling 117 hours; annotators watch each video in full, write questions over six capabilities, and filter text-only leakage with GLM-4 and GPT-4 to produce 1,549 four-choice questions.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2406.08035v3 and official LVBench repository snapshot 518df47. The diagram preserves the paper's definition of long and content-rich video, the 500-candidate pool across six categories, all five filters—clear protagonist, structural coherence, at least one significant event per five minutes, stable 720p visual quality, and visual-modality dependence—and the retained 103 videos totaling 117 hours with 4,101-second average duration. Annotators first watch full videos and mark events, entities, temporal relations, and causal relations; then write about 24 questions per hour across six capabilities and four balanced choices, annotate minimal clue timestamps, and reduce excess temporal-grounding items. Samples for which text-only GLM-4 and GPT-4 both produce the same correct answer are removed, leaving 1,549 questions. Evaluation reports exact choice accuracy overall and by capability and video category, with full-video input for native models and fixed-frame sampling such as 32 or 96 frames otherwise.

name: Mantis-Eval
intro: Mantis-Eval 是 Mantis 论文发布的留出多图理解测试集，由标注者使用 Google 搜索获取图像并人工编写必须联合理解多张图像的问题。它包含 217 条英文样本，平均每条 2.5 张图、最多 5 张图，同时覆盖多选题和简答题。
build_method: Google图像检索, 人工多图问题编写与整理
metric: 多选准确率, 简答准确率, 总体准确率
task_type: 多图像理解, 视觉问答
eval_feature: 跨图推理, 共指理解
scale: 217条测试样本；平均2.5张图，最多5张图
build_method_en: Google image search, manual multi-image question authoring and curation
eval_feature_en: Cross-image reasoning, coreference understanding
intro_en: Mantis-Eval is the held-out multi-image understanding test set introduced by the Mantis paper. Annotators acquire images through Google Search and manually author questions that require joint understanding of multiple images. Its 217 English examples contain 2.5 images on average and at most five, with both multiple-choice and short-answer formats.
scale_en: 217 test examples; 2.5 images on average, maximum 5
metric_en: Multiple-choice accuracy, short-answer accuracy, overall accuracy
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Acquire multi-image groups through Google Search"] --> B["Manually author reasoning and coreference questions"]
    B --> C["Release 217 held-out multiple-choice and short-answer examples"]
    C --> D["Use native image sequences or horizontally merged inputs"]
    D --> E["Apply type-specific parsing and report accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["通过Google搜索获取多图组合"] --> B["人工编写推理与共指问题"]
    B --> C["发布217条留出的多选与简答样本"]
    C --> D["按模型使用原生图像序列或水平拼接输入"]
    D --> E["按题型解析并报告准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2405.01483 and the official TIGER-AI-Lab/Mantis evaluator. The paper describes a manually curated held-out set of 217 examples whose images are acquired through Google Search and whose questions require understanding content across images. The diagram retains the reported 2.5-image average and five-image maximum without inventing an undocumented quality-control protocol. The evaluation path follows the official code: native multi-image inputs or horizontal merging for single-image baselines, option-letter or option-text parsing for multiple choice, final-answer phrase parsing for short answers, case-insensitive comparison, and separate plus overall accuracy.

name: MARS-Bench
intro: MARS-Bench 是首个面向火星科学任务的标准化评测基准，覆盖轨道和地表影像上的分类、分割与目标检测任务，用于系统评估基础模型在火星地质与遥感场景中的表现。
org: Arizona State University, Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology
eval_feature: 领域特定
build_method_en: Web Crawling
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used in real-world conversational applications, but their robustness in handling long and complex dialogue sessions—including frequent shifts in intent and complex cross-turn dependencies—has been criticized. MARS-Bench is a multi-turn competitive real-world scenario dialogue benchmark designed to address this gap. It is constructed through detailed textual annotations per session and aims to evaluate three key aspects of multi-turn dialogue: ultra-long turns, interactive multi-turns, and cross-turn tasks.

name: MatBench
intro: MatBench 是标准化材料属性预测基准，汇集 10 个 DFT 或实验数据源并定义 13 项任务，其中 10 项回归、3 项分类；每项任务使用固定五折嵌套交叉验证。本站同时记录 Intern-S1/OpenCompass 的生成式 LLM 适配器：它只选择其中四项任务，并使用不同的裁判与综合分口径。
org: Citrine Informatics, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
build_method: 多源材料属性数据清洗, 固定嵌套五折交叉验证
modality: 材料成分, 晶体结构, 数值属性
task_type: 材料属性预测, 回归, 分类
eval_feature: 固定嵌套交叉验证, 四任务LLM适配器
modality_en: Material composition, crystal structure, numerical properties
build_method_en: Multi-source materials-property cleaning, fixed nested five-fold cross-validation
eval_feature_en: Fixed nested cross-validation, four-task LLM adapter
intro_en: MatBench is a standardized materials-property prediction benchmark built from ten DFT-derived or experimental sources and organized into 13 tasks: ten regression and three classification tasks. Every task uses fixed five-fold nested cross-validation. This page also documents the Intern-S1/OpenCompass generative LLM adapter, which selects only four tasks and uses a distinct judging and aggregate-score protocol.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Clean ten DFT and experimental sources into 13 property-prediction tasks"] --> B["Use fixed nested five-fold cross-validation"]
    B --> C["Report MAE for regression and ROC-AUC for classification"]
    A --> D["Intern-S1/OpenCompass selects four tasks for generative LLM evaluation"]
    D --> E["Extract numeric answers or judge classifications, then normalize the four-task aggregate"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["清洗10个DFT与实验数据源并形成13项属性预测任务"] --> B["使用固定嵌套五折交叉验证"]
    B --> C["回归报告MAE，分类报告ROC-AUC"]
    A --> D["Intern-S1/OpenCompass选择四项任务进行生成式LLM评测"]
    D --> E["抽取数值或裁判分类，再归一化四任务综合分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the original MatBench paper arXiv:2005.00707, official materialsproject/matbench metadata, and the Intern-S1 OpenCompass adapter. The original protocol cleans ten materials sources into 13 tasks, fixes seed 18012019 and five stratified outer folds where applicable, tunes only inside training folds, and reports MAE for ten regression tasks or ROC-AUC for three classification tasks. The separate adapter branch selects matbench_steels, matbench_expt_gap, matbench_expt_is_metal, and matbench_glass; an LLM extracts numeric predictions or judges classification correctness, numeric tasks use MAE, classification tasks use accuracy, and the two MAEs are converted with the OpenCompass score transforms before aggregation.

name: MATH
intro: MATH数据集包含12500道具有完整步骤解答的竞赛数学题，旨在衡量机器学习模型的数学问题解决能力。完整解答可用于训练模型生成答案推导和解释，促进数学推理相关研究和准确率提升。
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Competition Questions
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: The MATH dataset contains 12,500 competition-level math problems with full step-by-step solutions, designed to evaluate the mathematical problem-solving ability of machine learning models. The complete solutions can be used to train models to generate answer derivations and explanations, promoting research in mathematical reasoning and improving accuracy.

name: Math-VR
intro: Math-VR 是大规模中英双语数学视觉推理语料与 benchmark。作者从约 90 万道含图解题中，经 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 筛图、GPT-4.1 转写和质检，得到 89,075 道独立问题、178,150 条双语样本；其中 2,500 道留出题展开为 5,000 条双语 benchmark 样本，并以答案正确性 AC 与过程部分得分 PS 评测。
build_method: 公开题目收集, VLM图像筛选, GPT辅助标准化与质检, 专家人工复核
metric: AC（答案正确性）, PS（过程部分得分）
task_type: 开放式数学问答, 视觉推理
eval_feature: 视觉推理, 双语评测, 过程评分
build_method_en: Public-problem collection, VLM image filtering, GPT-assisted standardization and quality checks, expert manual review
eval_feature_en: Visual reasoning, bilingual evaluation, process scoring
intro_en: Math-VR is a large-scale bilingual Chinese–English corpus and benchmark for mathematical visual reasoning. Starting from about 900K problems with illustrated solutions, Qwen2.5-VL-72B filters images and GPT-4.1 transcribes, standardizes, and verifies records, yielding 89,075 unique questions and 178,150 bilingual samples. The 2,500 held-out questions expand to 5,000 bilingual benchmark items scored with Answer Correctness (AC) and Process Score (PS).
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect about 900K illustrated secondary-school problems"] --> B["Filter mathematical figures with Qwen2.5-VL-72B"]
    B --> C["Use GPT-4.1 to transcribe, standardize, verify, and translate"]
    C --> D["Build 89,075 unique questions and 178,150 bilingual samples"]
    D --> E["Manually review a 3,000-question candidate pool into 2,500 held-out questions"]
    E --> F["Create verified scoring points and report AC plus PS"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集约90万道含图解的中学数学题"] --> B["用Qwen2.5-VL-72B筛选数学图形"]
    B --> C["用GPT-4.1转写、标准化、验证与翻译"]
    C --> D["形成89,075道独立问题和178,150条双语样本"]
    D --> E["人工复核3,000道候选题并形成2,500道留出题"]
    E --> F["构造经验证的评分点并报告AC与PS"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.11718 and the official HKU-MMLab/Math-VR-CodePlot-CoT release. The diagram covers the benchmark construction rather than confusing it with the separate CodePlot-CoT model method: roughly 900K source problems, Qwen2.5-VL-72B figure filtering, GPT-4.1 transcription, Markdown standardization, quality checking and bilingual translation, 89,075 unique questions split into 86,575 train and 2,500 test questions, and 178,150 bilingual samples. The benchmark path excludes proofs and most multiple choice, manually reviews a random 3,000-question pool with 15 senior STEM students, releases 2,500 unique / 5,000 bilingual test items, builds human-verified scoring points and difficulty weights, and reports AC and PS with human-correlation validation.

name: MATH500
intro: MATH500 是《Let’s Verify Step by Step》从原始 MATH 测试集留出的 500 道竞赛数学题。为构造过程监督训练数据，原测试集中的 4,500 题被加入训练池，余下 500 题均匀随机保留为固定测试集；官方 PRM800K 判分器先归一化答案，再以字符串或 SymPy 符号等价性计算准确率。
build_method: 从MATH测试集均匀随机留出, 固定500题评测集
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 答案归一化, 符号等价性
build_method_en: Uniform random holdout from the MATH test split, fixed 500-problem evaluation set
eval_feature_en: Answer normalization, symbolic equivalence
intro_en: MATH500 is the 500-problem competition-mathematics holdout introduced by Let's Verify Step by Step. To build process-supervision training data, 4,500 problems from the original MATH test set were added to the training pool and the remaining 500 were held out uniformly at random as a fixed test set. The official PRM800K grader normalizes answers and then uses string or SymPy symbolic equivalence to compute accuracy.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Start from MATH: 7,500 train and 5,000 test problems"] --> B["Move 4,500 original test problems into process-supervision training"]
    B --> C["Uniformly sample and reserve the remaining 500 problems"]
    C --> D["Generate a model solution and extract its final answer"]
    D --> E["Apply Hendrycks and PRM800K normalization"]
    E --> F["Accept normalized-string or SymPy equivalence and report accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从MATH的7,500题训练集和5,000题测试集出发"] --> B["将原测试集4,500题加入过程监督训练"]
    B --> C["均匀随机保留余下500题"]
    C --> D["生成模型解答并抽取最终答案"]
    D --> E["应用Hendrycks与PRM800K归一化"]
    E --> F["接受字符串或SymPy等价并报告准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the parent MATH paper arXiv:2103.03874, the MATH500 selection described in arXiv:2305.20050, and the official openai/prm800k grader. MATH supplies 12,500 competition problems, seven subjects, five difficulty levels, and step-by-step solutions. For process-supervision work, 4,500 of the original 5,000 MATH test problems were added to training and a uniformly random 500-problem remainder was held out; its subject and difficulty distributions were checked against the parent test set. Evaluation extracts the candidate final answer, applies Hendrycks-style plus PRM800K normalization, accepts identical normalized strings or a SymPy-simplified zero difference, and reports mean accuracy. The diagram intentionally removes the unsupported old Asymptote-preservation and exact-string-only claims.

name: MathBench
intro: MathBench是一个用于严格评估大型语言模型数学能力的综合性基准。它覆盖了从基础算术到大学数学的五个难度级别，包含中英文双语问题，旨在全面考察模型的理论知识和实际应用能力。该基准不仅包含应用题，还设有理论题，以检验模型对基本概念的掌握程度。其独特的循环评估（Circular Evaluation）方法能更真实地反映模型的数学推理水平。
build_method: 专家构建, 考试题
task_type: 数学问题, 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 思维链, 领域特定, Bilingual Gradient Evaluation, Circular Evaluation (CE) Method
task_type_en: Math problems, Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Exam questions
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Domain-specific, Bilingual Gradient Evaluation, Circular Evaluation (CE) Method
intro_en: MathBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the mathematical abilities of large language models. It covers five difficulty levels ranging from basic arithmetic to university-level mathematics and includes bilingual problems in both Chinese and English. The benchmark aims to thoroughly assess models' theoretical knowledge and practical application skills. It features not only applied problems but also theoretical questions to test models' grasp of fundamental concepts. Its unique Circular Evaluation method provides a more authentic reflection of models' mathematical reasoning capabilities.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2405.12209 Sections 2-3 and Appendix A. The diagram preserves the Stage/Subject Area/Topic taxonomy across five learning stages, theory questions from definitions and corollaries, application questions from exams, competitions, and licensed datasets, four-choice normalization with confusable distractors, bilingual graduate-student annotation, GPT-4 four-rotation screening and manual review of CE-0/1/2 items, the 3,709-question MathBench-T 2,209 plus MathBench-A 1,500 release, Chat-model CoT CircularEval, Base-model few-shot PPL evaluation, the all-four-rotations correctness rule, and fine-grained reporting.

name: MathCanvas-Bench
intro: MathCanvas是一个旨在为大型多模态模型（LMMs）提供内在视觉思维链（VCoT）能力的综合框架，以解决其在几何等数学领域中对视觉辅助的依赖。该框架通过两个阶段训练模型：首先是视觉操作阶段，利用15.2M对语料库进行图表生成和编辑的预训练；其次是战略性视觉辅助推理阶段，通过219K示例数据集进行微调，教授模型何时以及如何利用视觉辅助。为严格评估，引入了MathCanvas-Bench，一个包含3K问题的挑战性基准，要求模型生成交错的视觉-文本解决方案。
build_method: 混合
eval_feature: 思维链, 过程评估
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Process evaluation
intro_en: MathCanvas is a comprehensive framework designed to equip large multimodal models (LMMs) with intrinsic visual chain-of-thought (VCoT) capabilities, addressing their reliance on visual aids in mathematical domains like geometry. The framework trains models in two stages: first, a visual operation stage with pretraining on a 15.2M corpus for chart generation and editing; second, a strategic visual-aided reasoning stage fine-tuned on a 219K example dataset to teach models when and how to use visual assistance. To rigorously evaluate performance, MathCanvas-Bench is introduced, a challenging benchmark with 3K problems requiring models to generate interleaved visual-text solutions.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.14958 Sections 3.1-3.2 and the evaluation section. The diagram focuses on benchmark construction: 632K textbook/exam/web multimodal problems, GPT-5 relevance and LaTeX filtering to 367K, GPT-5 quality filtering to 303K, text-image deduplication to 222K, SwinIR and 512-square image normalization, GPT-4.1 labeling into eight major categories, removal of all MCQs, proportion-to-the-0.7 weighted sampling of 3K open problems, 5-gram Jaccard greater-than-0.4 leakage removal from training, the approximately 219K training complement, interleaved visual-text solutions, GPT-4.1 subanswer extraction, Complete Accuracy, and exponentially increasing Weighted Scoring.

name: MathOlympiad-Bench
intro: MathOlympiad-Bench 是 Goedel-Prover-V2 引入的人工核验 Lean 形式化奥林匹克数学基准。它包含来自 Compfiles 与 IMOSLLean4 的 360 道题，每题均配对一个形式定理和对应非形式化陈述并通过编译检查；证明模型以 Lean 接受结果计算 Pass@N，还可利用编译器反馈进行最多两轮自我修正。
build_method: 人工形式化, Lean 编译验证
eval_feature: 形式化证明, Lean 验证器, 验证器引导自我修正
build_method_en: Human formalization, Lean compilation validation
eval_feature_en: Formal theorem proving, Lean verifier, verifier-guided self-correction
intro_en: MathOlympiad-Bench is the human-verified Lean-formalized olympiad benchmark introduced by Goedel-Prover-V2. It contains 360 problems from Compfiles and IMOSLLean4, each pairing one formal theorem with its informal statement and passing compilation checks; proof models are scored by Lean acceptance and Pass@N, with up to two compiler-feedback self-correction rounds.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.03613 Section 4.2 and the official Goedel-LM/MathOlympiadBench dataset card. The diagram preserves the Compfiles and IMOSLLean4 sources; the exact 158 IMO, 131 IMO Shortlist, 68 national-olympiad, and three-puzzle composition; human repair of incomplete, multi-file, multi-theorem, and Mathlib-incompatible records; exactly one Lean theorem paired with one informal statement; compilation with sorry; MiniF2F overlap checks; 360 human-verified items; Lean 4.9.0-rc1; 30,000-token whole-proof generation; up to two verifier-feedback repair rounds under a 40,000-token total budget; compiler acceptance; and Pass@N reporting.

name: MATHQA
intro: MathQA 是一个将 AQuA-RAT 中 37,259 道英文多项选择数学文字题与可执行运算程序对齐的数据集。论文定义了包含 58 种领域感知运算的表示语言，通过动态众包平台和多人验证获得可解释的逐步求解程序。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
build_method: 众包标注, 人工验证
task_type: 数学文字题, 程序生成
eval_feature: 可解释推理, 可执行程序
build_method_en: Crowdsourced Annotation, Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Interpretable Reasoning, Executable Programs
intro_en: MathQA aligns 37,259 English multiple-choice math word problems from AQuA-RAT with executable operation programs. The paper defines a representation language of 58 domain-aware operations and obtains interpretable step-by-step solutions through a dynamic crowdsourcing platform and multi-person validation.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select solvable numeric AQuA-RAT questions and preserve five options"] --> B["Define 58 operations and categorize problems to prune the operation space"]
    B --> C["Crowd-author executable operation programs on a dynamic platform"]
    C --> D["Require use of a problem value and a final value close to the correct option"]
    D --> E["Control worker quality and accept alignment with at least two of three votes"]
    E --> F["Expand annotations to near-duplicate templates and assemble 37,259 items"]
    F --> G["Randomly split 80/12/8 into train, development, and test sets"]
    G --> H["Decode and execute programs, match values to options, and report answer accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择可解的数值型 AQuA-RAT 题并保留五个选项"] --> B["定义 58 种运算并按领域分类以缩小运算空间"]
    B --> C["在动态平台上众包编写可执行运算程序"]
    C --> D["要求使用题中数值且最终值接近正确选项"]
    D --> E["控制标注员质量并以三人至少两票通过对齐验证"]
    E --> F["扩展到近重复模板并汇总 37,259 个样本"]
    F --> G["按 80/12/8 随机拆分训练、开发和测试集"]
    G --> H["解码执行程序、匹配选项并报告答案准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with MathQA (NAACL 2019), Sections 3, 4, 6.1, 6.2, and 7.1. The paper enhances solvable AQuA-RAT multiple-choice problems with programs over 58 domain-aware operations; categorizes problems to prune operations; uses a dynamic crowd platform with execution feedback, submission constraints, worker quality tests, and at least two-of-three alignment validation; expands annotations to similar templates; reports the exact table total of 37,259 items and an 80/12/8 random split; and evaluates by executing predicted programs, matching their values to options, and measuring answer accuracy.

name: MathVision
intro: MATH-Vision (MATH-V) 是一个精心策划的数据集，旨在评估大型多模态模型（LMMs）在视觉背景下的数学推理能力。它包含3,040个高质量的数学问题，这些问题来源于真实的数学竞赛，涵盖16个不同的数学学科和5个难度级别。该数据集揭示了当前LMMs与人类在MATH-V上的显著性能差距，并提供了详细的分类以指导未来的研究和开发。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 竞赛题改编, 人工标注
task_type: 图像问答, 数学问题解决
eval_feature: 多模态, 过程评估, 细致分类
build_method_en: Exam Adaptation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multimodal, Process evaluation, Fine-grained classification
intro_en: MATH-Vision (MATH-V) is a carefully curated dataset designed to evaluate the mathematical reasoning abilities of large multimodal models (LMMs) in visual contexts. It contains 3,040 high-quality math problems sourced from real math competitions, covering 16 different mathematical subjects and 5 difficulty levels. The dataset highlights the significant performance gap between current LMMs and humans on MATH-V and provides detailed categorizations to guide future research and development.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.14804 Section 3 and the official mathllm/MATH-V evaluation code. The diagram preserves selection of 19 visual math competitions spanning 12 grades, copyright and answer-retrievability controls, Mathpix extraction of roughly 9K problems, ten senior science annotators, Stage-1 text-image and content filtering to 3,352, lexical-overlap plus Levenshtein candidate deduplication and manual review to 3,040, independent subject annotation aided by GPT-4V and Gemini Pro into 16 subjects, five difficulty levels, the corrected 1,532 multiple-choice plus 1,508 free-form composition, the 304-item testmini, boxed-answer prompting, official answer normalization with choice-letter or option-text and mathematical equivalence support, and overall/subject/level accuracy.

name: MathVista
intro: MathVista 是一个系统评测视觉情境数学推理的多模态基准，包含来自 28 个既有数据集和 IQTest、FunctionQA、PaperQA 三个新数据集的 6,141 道题，覆盖五类任务与七类数学推理能力。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: 多源数据汇集、人工标注、格式标准化
language: 英文, 中文, 波斯语
task_type: 视觉问答, 数学推理
eval_feature: 五类任务, 七类推理, 三阶段答案抽取与规范化
build_method_en: Multi-source aggregation, human annotation, format standardization
eval_feature_en: Five tasks, seven reasoning types, three-stage answer extraction and normalization
intro_en: MathVista is a multimodal benchmark for systematically evaluating mathematical reasoning in visual contexts. Its 6,141 problems come from 28 existing datasets plus three new sets—IQTest, FunctionQA, and PaperQA—and cover five tasks and seven mathematical reasoning skills.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.02255 and the official lupantech/MathVista repository. The diagram preserves the 28 existing sources split into nine math-targeted QA and 19 general VQA datasets, the three new IQTest/FunctionQA/PaperQA sources, 6,141 total items, five tasks, seven reasoning skills, record-level metadata and answer contracts, the disjoint 1,000-item testmini plus 5,141-item hidden-label test split, type-aware response generation, GPT-4 answer extraction validated above 99.5% on 200 examples, official choice/integer/float/list normalization, deterministic correctness, and fine-grained accuracy reporting.

name: MaXIFE
intro: MaXIFE是一个综合性评估基准，旨在评估大型语言模型在23种不同语言中的指令遵循能力。它包含1667个可验证的指令任务，并结合了基于规则和基于模型的评估方法，以平衡效率和准确性。该基准旨在推动自然语言处理领域多语言指令遵循评估的研究和发展。
build_method: 混合
eval_feature: 多语言, 跨语言, 可验证
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Multilingual, Cross-lingual, Verifiable
intro_en: MaXIFE is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark designed to assess large language models' instruction-following ability across 23 different languages. It includes 1,667 verifiable instruction tasks and combines rule-based and model-based evaluation methods to balance efficiency and accuracy. This benchmark aims to advance research and development in multilingual instruction-following evaluation within natural language processing.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.01776 Sections 3-4. The diagram preserves real-user questionnaires, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5 Sonnet expansion to 795 basic questions, 47 verifiable instruction types in 11 categories with 18 templated types, distinct LLM-plus-native question translation and professional-human instruction translation, full linguistic QC, 23 languages and 18,285 language instances, resource-level labeling, temperature-zero multilingual and cross-lingual evaluation, 32 rule-checked subtypes, 15 model-judged instructions, per-instruction 0-1 scores, and Loose versus Strict aggregation over 1,667 checks.

name: MCP-Atlas
intro: MCP-Atlas 是一个面向生产级 MCP 工具使用的大规模基准，包含 36 个真实服务器、220 个工具和 1,000 个专家编写任务。任务不泄露服务器、工具或参数，并加入语义相近干扰项；最终答案按基于工具输出的原子声明覆盖率评分。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工与自动质检
metric: 声明覆盖率, 通过率
eval_feature: 多轮, 结果导向, 动态, 实时
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human and Automated QA
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Result-oriented, Dynamic, Real-time
intro_en: MCP-Atlas is a large-scale benchmark for production MCP tool use with 36 real servers, 220 tools, and 1,000 expert-authored tasks. Prompts reveal no server, tool, or parameter names and include semantically plausible distractors; final answers are scored by coverage of atomic claims grounded in tool outputs.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Benchmark Construction
        A[Task Design & Goal Setting] --> B(1000 Tasks, 3-6 Tool Calls, Multi-Server, Conditional Logic)
        B --> C[Environment Setup: 36 Real MCP Servers, 220 Tools]
    end

    subgraph Task Schema Definition
        C --> D[1. Tool Set Configuration: 10-25 Tools/Task, 3-7 Target, 5-10 Distractors]
        D --> E[2. Prompt Creation: Natural Language, Multi-Hop Reasoning, No Explicit Tool Names]
        E --> F[3. Reference Trajectory: Minimal Tool Call Sequence, Diagnostic Use Only]
        F --> G[4. Claims List: Atomic, Verifiable Claims from Tool Outputs]
    end

    subgraph Quality Assurance
        G --> H[Human Review Layer 1: Domain Expert Review (Correctness, Solvability)]
        H --> I[Human Review Layer 2: Prompt Naturalness Validation (No Tool Name Leakage)]
        I --> J[Automated LLM Verification: Claims List Completeness, Trajectory Consistency]
        J --> K[Quality Control Samples: Random Manual Review for Systematic Issues]
    end

    subgraph Evaluation Methodology
        K --> L[Claim Verification: Agent Answer vs. Claims List (Fulfilled, Partially, Not)]
        L --> M[Coverage Scoring: Average Claim Scores (1, 0.5, 0)]
        M --> N{Pass/Fail Determination: Coverage Score >= 0.75 Threshold}
    end

    N -- Pass --> O[Benchmark Dataset Release (500-Task Public Subset)]
    N -- Fail --> P[Diagnostic Analysis & Iteration]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select and containerize 36 production servers exposing 220 tools"] --> B["Experts author 1,000 prompts without server, tool, or parameter names"]
    B --> C["Expose 6-37 tools with only 2-8 relevant and plausible distractors"]
    C --> D["Execute reference trajectories and write atomic claim rubrics"]
    D --> E["Apply five QA layers and randomly split 500 public / 500 private"]
    E --> F["Run agents under matched prompts, tool sets, budgets, and final-answer rules"]
    F --> G["Three judges score claims as 1, 0.5, or 0 and average coverage"]
    G --> H["Pass at coverage at least 0.75 and diagnose failures with 11 categories"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择并容器化 36 个生产级服务器及其 220 个工具"] --> B["专家编写 1,000 个不泄露服务器、工具或参数名的任务"]
    B --> C["每题暴露 6-37 个工具，其中仅 2-8 个相关并加入可信干扰项"]
    C --> D["执行参考轨迹并编写原子声明评分标准"]
    D --> E["执行五层质检并随机拆分 500 题公开集和 500 题私有集"]
    E --> F["在相同提示、工具集、预算和最终答案规则下运行智能体"]
    F --> G["三个评判器按 1、0.5、0 评分声明并计算平均覆盖率"]
    G --> H["覆盖率至少 0.75 即通过并用 11 类体系诊断失败"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.00933v3, Sections 3.1-3.4 and Appendices B, D, and J. The paper builds 1,000 expert-authored tasks over 36 production MCP servers and 220 tools; containerizes and version-pins servers; hides server, tool, and parameter names; exposes 6-37 tools with only 2-8 relevant and semantically plausible distractors; uses reference trajectories only for solvability, tool-dependence checks, and diagnostics; writes atomic claim lists; applies five QA layers; randomly splits 500 public and 500 private tasks; and passes a task only when three-judge final-answer claim coverage reaches 0.75.

name: MCP-Bench
intro: MCP-Bench是一个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的评测基准，旨在评估大型语言模型在真实多步任务中的工具使用能力。它连接了28个MCP服务器和250个工具，涵盖金融、旅行、科学计算等领域，测试模型在工具检索、多步规划和跨域协作方面的表现。
build_method: LLM 自动合成, 人工检查
metric: 规则执行指标, LLM 评判分数, 总分
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 多轮, 领域特定
scale: 104 个任务, 28 个服务器, 250 个工具
build_method_en: LLM Synthesis, Human Inspection
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, Real-time, Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: MCP-Bench is an evaluation benchmark based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), designed to assess large language models' ability to use tools in real multi-step tasks. It connects 28 MCP servers and 250 tools across domains such as finance, travel, and scientific computing, testing models on tool retrieval, multi-step planning, and cross-domain collaboration.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[MCP-Bench Introduction] --> B[Goal: Evaluate LLMs on Complex Tool Use]
    B --> C[Built on Model Context Protocol (MCP)]
    C --> D[Connects to 28 Live MCP Servers]
    D --> E[Servers Span 250 Tools]
    E --> F[Tools Across Diverse Domains (Finance, Travel, Scientific Computing, Academic Search)]
    F --> G[Task Design: Multi-step, Cross-tool Coordination]
    G --> H[Task Design: Fuzzy Instructions, No Explicit Tool Names]
    H --> I[Task Design: Multi-hop Execution Trajectories]
    I --> J[Task Design: Ground Responses in Intermediate Outputs]
    J --> K[Task Design: Orchestrate Cross-domain Workflows]
    K --> L[Evaluation Framework]
    L --> M(Tool-level Schema Understanding & Usage)
    L --> N(Trajectory-level Planning)
    L --> O(Task Completion)
    O --> P[Experiments on 20 Advanced LLMs]
    P --> Q{Persistent Challenges Revealed}
metric_en: Rule-based Execution Metrics, LLM Judge Scores, Overall Score
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect 28 live servers with 250 tools across 11 domains"] --> B["Discover tool I/O dependency chains and synthesize 104 tasks with o4-mini"]
    B --> C["Filter for solvability at least 9/10 and utility at least 5/10, then inspect manually"]
    C --> D["Fuzz instructions while preserving required numbers and add 10 distractor servers per task"]
    D --> E["Run agents for up to 20 rounds of planning, execution, observation compression, and state update"]
    E --> F["Check tool-name validity, schema compliance, runtime success, and dependency order"]
    F --> G["Use o4-mini rubrics for completion, tool use, and planning on a 1-10 scale"]
    G --> H["Shuffle rubrics five times, normalize, average, and report all metrics"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集覆盖 11 个领域的 28 个在线服务器与 250 个工具"] --> B["发现工具输入输出依赖链并用 o4-mini 合成 104 个任务"]
    B --> C["按可解性至少 9/10 和实用性至少 5/10 过滤后再人工检查"]
    C --> D["模糊化指令但保留必要数值并为每题加入 10 个干扰服务器"]
    D --> E["让智能体最多执行 20 轮规划、调用、观察压缩和状态更新"]
    E --> F["检查工具名、Schema、运行成功和依赖顺序"]
    F --> G["用 o4-mini 按 1-10 分评判完成度、工具使用和规划"]
    G --> H["五次打乱评分维度后归一化取平均并汇报全部指标"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.20453, Sections 4.1, 4.2, 5.1, and 5.2. The paper collects 28 live MCP servers with 250 tools across 11 domains; discovers inherent and scenario-based dependency chains; uses o4-mini to synthesize 56 single-server, 30 two-server, and 18 three-server tasks; filters at solvability 9/10 and utility 5/10 before human inspection; fuzzes instructions while retaining required numbers; attaches 10 distractor servers and 100-plus extra tools per task; executes up to 20 rounds; combines rule checks with o4-mini rubric scores; and shuffles each rubric five times before normalization and averaging.

name: MCP-Universe
intro: MCP-Universe 通过真实 MCP 服务器和执行式评估器测试智能体的工具使用能力。它包含位置导航、代码仓库管理、金融分析、3D 设计、浏览器自动化和网页搜索六个领域，共 11 个服务器、133 个工具和 231 个任务。
build_method: 人工任务设计, 人工与自动验证
metric: 成功率, 平均评估器得分
eval_feature: 长文本, 零样本, 过程评估, 工具调用
scale: 231 个任务, 11 个服务器, 133 个工具
build_method_en: Manual Task Design, Execution-based Verification
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Zero-shot, Process evaluation, Tool invocation
intro_en: MCP-Universe tests agent tool use through real MCP servers and execution-based evaluators. It contains 231 tasks over 11 servers and 133 tools in six domains: location navigation, repository management, financial analysis, 3D design, browser automation, and web search.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[Problem Identification: Simplistic Benchmarks] --> B[Solution: Introduce MCP-Universe]
    B --> C[Benchmark Design: Realistic & Hard Tasks]
    C --> D(6 Core Domains)
    D --> D1(Location Navigation)
    D --> D2(Repository Management)
    D --> D3(Financial Analysis)
    D --> D4(3D Design)
    D --> D5(Browser Automation)
    D --> D6(Web Searching)
    D --> E[Evaluation Implementation: Execution-based Evaluators]
    E --> E1[Format Evaluators: Agent Compliance]
    E --> E2[Static Evaluators: Time-Invariant Content]
    E --> E3[Dynamic Evaluators: Real-Time Ground Truth]
    E --> F[Evaluation Process: LLM Interaction with MCP Servers]
    F --> G{Evaluation Results: SOTA Model Limitations}
    G --> H[Challenges: Long-Context & Unknown-Tools]
    H --> I[Open-Source Framework Release: UI Support]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Integrate 11 real servers and 133 tools across six application domains"] --> B["Manually design 4-5 task types per domain and reject tasks that are too easy"]
    B --> C["Author 231 tasks and cross-check feasibility, ambiguity, and correctness"]
    C --> D["Create and cross-check 4 format, 32 static, and 48 dynamic evaluators"]
    D --> E["Automatically configure the LLM-agent pair, servers, resources, and evaluators"]
    E --> F["Run ReAct agents through MCP and capture interaction logs"]
    F --> G["Apply format, invariant-content, and real-time-ground-truth checks"]
    G --> H["Report binary task success rate and average evaluator score"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["在六个领域集成 11 个真实服务器和 133 个工具"] --> B["每个领域人工设计 4-5 类任务并淘汰过于简单的候选题"]
    B --> C["编写 231 个任务并交叉核验可行性、歧义性和正确性"]
    C --> D["编写并核验 4 个格式、32 个静态和 48 个动态评估器"]
    D --> E["自动配置 LLM-智能体组合、服务器、资源和评估器"]
    E --> F["让 ReAct 智能体通过 MCP 执行并记录交互日志"]
    F --> G["执行格式、不变内容和实时动态真值检查"]
    G --> H["汇报二元任务成功率和平均评估器得分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.14704, Sections 3.1-3.4 and 4.1. The paper integrates 11 real MCP servers with 133 tools across six domains; manually creates four or five scenario types per domain; rejects tasks solvable without MCP or consistently solvable with MCP within five retries; cross-checks all 231 tasks; creates and cross-checks 84 execution evaluators (4 format, 32 static, 48 dynamic); automatically configures each LLM-agent, server, resource, endpoint, and evaluator combination; records MCP interactions; and reports binary task success rate plus average evaluator score.

name: MCPMark
intro: MCPMark是一个旨在评估大语言模型（LLMs）与外部系统交互能力的基准测试。它由127个高质量任务组成，这些任务由领域专家和AI智能体共同创建，每个任务都包含一个初始状态和自动验证脚本。MCPMark通过模拟真实世界的工作流程，要求LLMs进行更丰富和多样化的环境交互，涉及广泛的创建、读取、更新和删除（CRUD）操作，以全面评估LLMs作为通用智能体的能力。
org: NUS TRAIL, EvalSys, LobeHub, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Fudan University
build_method: 人机协作构建, 专家与社区验证
eval_feature: 多轮, 状态跟踪, 程序化验证
build_method_en: Human-AI Co-design, Expert and Community Validation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, State Tracking, Programmatic Verification
intro_en: MCPMark is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLMs) ability to interact with external systems. It consists of 127 high-quality tasks co-created by domain experts and AI agents, each featuring an initial state and an automated verification script. By simulating real-world workflows, MCPMark requires LLMs to perform richer and more diverse environment interactions, covering a wide range of create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) operations, to comprehensively assess LLMs' capabilities as general-purpose agents.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[需求分析] --> B[任务设计: Experts与AI协作]
    B --> C[任务数量: 127个高质量任务]
    C --> D[初始状态策展]
    D --> E[编程Validation脚本开发]
    E --> F{任务类型: CRUD操作}
    F -- Create --> G[环境交互: 创建]
    F -- Read --> H[环境交互: 读取]
    F -- Update --> I[环境交互: 更新]
    F -- Delete --> J[环境交互: 删除]
    G --> K[任务Validation]
    H --> K
    I --> K
    J --> K
    K --> L[Evaluation框架: 最小代理框架]
    L --> M[代理框架: 工具调用循环]
    M --> N[LLMEvaluation: 尖端模型]
    N --> O[性能指标: pass@1, pass^4]
    O --> P[行为指标: 执行回合, 工具调用]
    P --> Q[结果分析]
    Q --> R[基准发布]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select five MCP services and curate 38 realistic initial states"] --> B["Experts and a task-creation agent explore each environment"]
    B --> C["Evolve instructions to increase search, processing, and interaction difficulty"]
    C --> D["Draft verifiers, solve tasks with an execution agent, and test success and failure states"]
    D --> E["Iterate into 127 instruction-state-verifier tasks with broad CRUD coverage"]
    E --> F["Apply expert cross-review, a month-long community check, and extra review of unsolved tasks"]
    F --> G["Execute in tracked sandboxes, run programmatic verifiers, and reset after every attempt"]
    G --> H["Use four runs to report pass@1, pass@4, and pass^4 reliability"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择五个 MCP 服务并策展 38 个真实初始状态"] --> B["专家与任务创建智能体共同探索每个环境"]
    B --> C["演化指令以增加检索、处理和交互难度"]
    C --> D["起草验证器、借助执行智能体解题并测试成功与失败状态"]
    D --> E["迭代形成 127 个指令-状态-验证器任务并覆盖多样 CRUD 操作"]
    E --> F["执行专家交叉复审、一个月社区检查和未解任务额外核验"]
    F --> G["在状态跟踪沙盒执行、运行程序验证器并在每次尝试后重置"]
    G --> H["用四次独立运行汇报 Pass@1、Pass@4 和 Pass^4"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.24002, Sections 2.1-2.3, 3.1, and Appendix A. The paper curates 38 initial states for Filesystem, Notion, Playwright, GitHub, and PostgreSQL; pairs experts with task-creation and task-execution agents in exploration, evolvement, verification, and iteration stages; tests verifier success and failure behavior; assembles 127 CRUD-diverse instruction-state-verifier tasks; applies expert cross-review, a month-long community check, and additional review of tasks solved by no model; runs a state-tracked sandbox lifecycle with programmatic verification and reset; and reports pass@1, pass@4, and pass^4 from four independent runs.

name: Med-HALT
intro: Med-HALT是专门用于评估大型语言模型在医疗领域幻觉问题的基准数据集，提供来自不同国家医疗检查的多样化数据，包含多种创新测试模式，涵盖推理和记忆幻觉两大类别。
build_method: 多国医学考试汇集、测试变换、PubMed文献配对
task_type: 医疗问答, 幻觉评测, 信息检索
eval_feature: 3类推理幻觉测试, 4类记忆幻觉测试
scale: 每项推理测试18,866个样本；每项记忆测试4,916个样本
task_type_en: Medical QA, hallucination evaluation, information retrieval
build_method_en: Multinational medical-exam aggregation, test transformations, PubMed article pairing
eval_feature_en: Three reasoning hallucination tests and four memory hallucination tests
intro_en: Med-HALT is a benchmark dataset specifically designed to evaluate hallucination issues of large language models in the medical field. It provides diverse data from medical examinations across different countries and includes various innovative testing modes, covering both reasoning and memory hallucination categories.
scale_en: 18,866 samples per reasoning test; 4,916 samples per memory test
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.15343, the CoNLL 2023 paper, and the official Med-HALT project page. The diagram preserves 9,515 Indian MedMCQA items, 4,068 Spanish HeadQA items, 2,801 US MedQA items, and 2,482 Taiwan MedQA items for 18,866 samples per reasoning test; 4,916 PubMed records per memory test; False Confidence, None of the Above, and hybrid human/GPT-3.5 Fake Question tests; Abstract-to-Link, PMID-to-Title, Title-to-Link, and Link-to-Title memory tests; the evaluated Text-Davinci/GPT-3.5/Llama-2/MPT/Falcon families; structured-output exception handling; binary correctness; and Accuracy plus Pointwise Score aggregation.

name: MedAgentBench
intro: MedAgentBench是一个广泛的评估套件，旨在评测大型语言模型在医疗记录环境中的智能体能力。它包含300个由医生编写的临床任务和100名患者的真实数据，在一个符合FHIR标准的交互式环境中进行，以推动模型在复杂医疗任务中的规划和工具利用能力。
build_method: 医生任务策展、去标识EHR抽取、FHIR环境构建
task_type: 医疗Agent, 工具调用, EHR交互
eval_feature: FHIR交互环境, 查询与动作任务, 规则评分
task_type_en: Medical agent, tool use, EHR interaction
build_method_en: Physician task curation, deidentified EHR extraction, FHIR environment construction
eval_feature_en: FHIR environment, query and action tasks, rule-based grading
intro_en: MedAgentBench is a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to assess large language models' agent capabilities in medical record environments. It includes 300 clinician-written clinical tasks and real data from 100 patients, conducted within an interactive environment compliant with FHIR standards, aiming to advance models' planning and tool-use abilities in complex medical tasks.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.14654 and the official stanfordmlgroup/MedAgentBench code. The diagram preserves two internal-medicine physicians, 300 tasks across ten specific and seven broad categories, inpatient and outpatient scope, a 100-patient STARR cohort anchored on morning sodium labs, five years of labs/vitals/procedures/diagnoses/medications, synthetic MRNs and Faker demographics, the exact 785,207 FHIR-resource count, HAPI FHIR JPA with persistent H2 and Docker packaging, nine official GET/POST functions plus FINISH, 150 query and 150 action tasks, manual reference solutions for query grading, rule-based POST-payload checks for actions, and Overall/Query/Action Success Rate.

name: MedAgentsBench
intro: MedAgentsBench 对应论文最新版 MedicalAgentsBench，是一个从八个医学问答数据集按模型难度、人工推理深度、临床有效性和污染风险筛选出的复杂医疗推理基准，最终包含 862 道困难选择题。
org: Yale University, ETH Zurich, Stanford University
build_method: 难度感知筛选、医学专家审核、MELD污染筛查
task_type: 医疗推理, 多项选择问答, Agent方法比较
eval_feature: 低于50%正确率门槛, 五级推理深度, 成本Pareto分析
scale: 862道困难题，8个源数据集，9个评测子集
task_type_en: Medical reasoning, multiple-choice QA, agent-method comparison
build_method_en: Difficulty-aware filtering, medical-expert review, MELD contamination screening
eval_feature_en: Below-50% accuracy gate, five-level reasoning depth, cost Pareto analysis
intro_en: MedAgentsBench corresponds to the current MedicalAgentsBench paper: a complex medical reasoning benchmark filtered from eight medical QA datasets using model difficulty, human reasoning-depth and clinical-validity review, and contamination screening. The final set contains 862 hard multiple-choice questions.
scale_en: 862 hard questions, 8 source datasets, 9 evaluation subsets
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.07459v3, which renames the paper benchmark MedicalAgentsBench and supersedes the stale medagents-benchmark README snapshot. The diagram preserves eight source datasets and nine evaluation subsets, diverse-model difficulty probing, the below-50% correctness gate, the exact balanced 100x7 plus 89 MedBullets plus 73 MMLU distribution totaling 862, four clinical-year medical-student annotators, a five-level reasoning-depth rubric, removal of 21 invalid questions, MELD question-half continuation screening without answer options, average length 147.4 tokens, ten base models, nine externalized reasoning methods, choice accuracy, full-cycle inference time, token/hosting cost, and accuracy-cost Pareto analysis.

name: MedAlign
intro: MedAlign是由临床医生生成的电子病历指令遵循评测数据集，包含983条临床指令和303条人工参考回复，旨在评估大型语言模型在真实医疗场景中的指令遵循和EHR处理能力。
build_method: 临床医生指令收集、BM25病历匹配、专家参考回复
metric: 临床正确率, 胜率, 平均排名, Kendall Tau
task_type: 指令遵循, 文本生成
eval_feature: 三阶段策展, 盲法临床评审, 自动NLG指标相关性
scale: 983条指令, 303条人工参考回复, 276份电子病历
build_method_en: Clinician instruction collection, BM25 EHR matching, expert reference responses
eval_feature_en: Three-stage curation, blinded clinician review, automated NLG-metric correlation
intro_en: MedAlign is an electronic health record instruction-following evaluation dataset generated by clinicians, containing 983 clinical instructions and 303 human reference responses. It aims to assess large language models' instruction-following and EHR processing capabilities in real medical scenarios.
metric_en: Clinician correctness, win rate, mean rank, Kendall Tau
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2308.14089 Sections 3–6. The diagram preserves OMOP-CDM longitudinal EHRs converted to one XML document each; 15 clinicians across seven specialties; 1,314 raw instructions and ROUGE-L-above-0.7 deduplication to 983, including 407 generally applicable; BM25Okapi top-five retrieval over a 77,200-patient subsample; manual binary relevance yielding 303 instructions with a relevant top-five EHR (74% versus 38% random); same-specialty non-author response assignment, feasibility and sufficiency checks, latest-timestamp anchoring, 303 references grounded in 276 distinct EHRs; six LLMs, recent-context truncation and 30k-chunk multi-step refinement; blinded review by nine clinicians; binary correctness and quality ranking; automated NLG metrics; and Kendall-Tau correlation.

name: MedBench
intro: MedBench是面向中文医疗大模型的综合、标准化评测体系，整合8个公开数据集并自建12个数据集，共包含300,901道题目，覆盖43个临床专业和医学语言理解、生成、知识问答、复杂推理、安全伦理五个维度。其云端平台物理隔离题目与标准答案，并通过选项循环打乱和随机提示匹配减少捷径学习。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Ruijin Hospital
build_method: 公开数据整合, 专家构建, 医生核验, 动态评测
eval_feature: 五维综合评测, 43个临床专业, 选项循环打乱, 随机提示匹配
build_method_en: Public-data integration, expert construction, physician verification, dynamic evaluation
eval_feature_en: Five-dimensional evaluation, 43 clinical specialties, circular choice shuffling, random prompt matching
intro_en: MedBench is a comprehensive, standardized evaluation system for Chinese medical LLMs. It combines eight public datasets with twelve newly constructed datasets, totaling 300,901 questions across 43 clinical specialties and five dimensions: medical language understanding, generation, knowledge QA, complex reasoning, and safety and ethics. Its cloud platform physically separates questions from gold answers and uses circular choice shuffling plus random prompt matching to reduce shortcut learning.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.10990 and the official MedBench platform. The diagrams preserve the five MLU, MLG, MKQA, CMR, and HSE dimensions; eight public plus twelve self-constructed datasets; five-stage curation; the SCARE 2023 rewrite and three-senior-doctor approval route for DDx-basic, DDx-advanced, and MedTreat; two-physician verification; 300,901 Chinese questions across 20 datasets and 43 specialties; the balanced 8,913-record cloud evaluation sample and quarterly refresh; physical question/gold separation; exhaustive circular choice shuffling; random selection from three prompts; Accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE-L, and Micro-F1 scoring; five-dimension aggregation; and blinded validation by three senior physicians.

name: MedBullets
intro: MedBullets是论文与JAMA Clinical Challenge同时提出但独立统计的医学问答数据集，包含308道2022年4月至2023年12月公开的Medbullets Step 2/3模拟临床题。每题含病例描述、五个选项、正确答案和解释所有选项的专家解析；论文另构造四选项版本，并分别评测答案准确率与解释质量。
build_method: 专家构建, 考试题
metric: Accuracy, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, BLEURT, BARTScore, CTC, G-Eval
eval_feature: 答案与解释联合评测, 三种提示策略, 自动与人工解释评估
build_method_en: Expert Curation, exam questions
eval_feature_en: Joint answer and explanation evaluation, three prompting strategies, automatic and human rationale assessment
intro_en: MedBullets is a medical QA dataset introduced alongside, but counted separately from, JAMA Clinical Challenge. It contains 308 publicly available Medbullets Step 2/3 simulated clinical questions from April 2022 through December 2023. Each item includes a case description, five choices, the correct answer, and an expert explanation covering all options; the paper also creates a four-choice variant and evaluates both answer accuracy and explanation quality.
metric_en: Accuracy, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, BLEURT, BARTScore, CTC, G-Eval
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.18060 and the official ChallengeClinicalQA repository. The diagrams keep Medbullets as a 308-item English Step 2/3 dataset collected from publicly linked posts dated April 2022 through December 2023, exclude image-dependent cases, retain the case, five choices, answer, and option-level expert rationale, create Medbullets-5 and a four-choice variant by removing one incorrect option, and explicitly keep the 1,524-item 13-domain JAMA Clinical Challenge as a separate companion track. They preserve the seven evaluated LLMs, direct X-to-Y, two-stage X-to-R-to-Y, and gold-conditioned explanation prompting, zero-, two-, and five-shot settings with leave-one-out examples, answer Accuracy, the ROUGE-L/BERTScore/BLEURT/BARTScore/CTC/G-Eval explanation suite, and the 30-item, two-model, three-rating-per-output human study of completeness, correctness, and relevance.

name: MedCalc-Bench
intro: MedCalc-Bench是面向大型语言模型医学计算能力的基准，包含55个MDCalc任务的1,047条人工复核样本，其中19个为规则型计算器、36个为公式型计算器。每条样本含患者病历、计算问题、相关属性、标准答案和逐步解释，用于同时检验医学知识、属性抽取和算术计算。
build_method: 混合, LLM生成, 专家构建
task_type: 开放式问答, 数学问题, 抽取
eval_feature: 领域特定, 思维链
build_method_en: Hybrid, LLM Generation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Chain-of-Thought
