intro_en: MedCalc-Bench evaluates LLM medical-calculation ability with 1,047 manually reviewed instances from 55 MDCalc tasks: 19 rule-based and 36 equation-based calculators. Each item contains a patient note, a calculation question, relevant attributes, a gold answer, and a step-by-step explanation, jointly testing medical knowledge, attribute extraction, and arithmetic.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.12036 and the official ncbi-nlp/MedCalc-Bench repository. The diagrams preserve selection of 55 MDCalc tasks split into 19 rule-based and 36 equation-based calculators and seven subtypes; the more-than-180,000-note Open-Patients pool; GPT-3.5-Turbo eligibility detection; GPT-4 attribute extraction; medical-professional verification covering 34 calculators; completion of the remaining 21 calculators with 20 notes each through templates for ten equation tasks and clinician-written notes for eleven rule tasks; calculator templates for step-by-step gold solutions; the exact 1,047-instance test set; eight-model evaluation under zero-shot direct, zero-shot CoT, and same-calculator one-shot CoT; exact matching for rule and date tasks, 5% tolerance for laboratory, physical, and dosage calculations; seven-subtype Accuracy; and knowledge, extraction, computation, and other error analysis.

name: MedExQA
intro: MedExQA是覆盖五个代表不足医学专业的英文多选问答基准，共965道题，每题配两份写作风格不同且经过人工核验的解释。数据来自公开模拟测试和考试，经过重复项、BERT语义近重复及法律法规题筛除，并划分为25条开发集和940条测试集，用于联合评估答案分类与解释生成。
build_method: 公开考试汇集, 去重过滤, 双解释构建, 人工核验
eval_feature: 五个低代表专业, 每题双解释, 答案错误时解释得分归零
build_method_en: Public-exam aggregation, deduplication and filtering, dual-explanation construction, human validation
eval_feature_en: Five underrepresented specialties, two explanations per item, zero explanation score for wrong answers
intro_en: MedExQA is an English multiple-choice QA benchmark spanning five underrepresented medical specialties. Its 965 questions each have two human-validated explanations in distinct writing styles. Public mock tests and exams are deduplicated, filtered for BERT semantic similarity and law or regulation content, then split into 25 development and 940 test items for joint answer-classification and explanation-generation evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.06331, the BioNLP 2024 paper, and the official knowlab/MedExQA repository rather than a downstream QuarkMed reference. The diagrams preserve five underrepresented specialties and exact counts of 148 biomedical engineering, 377 clinical laboratory science, 111 clinical psychology, 194 occupational therapy, and 135 speech-language pathology questions; public mock-test and exam collection; exact and BERT-cosine near-duplicate removal; manual-keyword filtering of law and regulation items; answer-option shuffling; two distinct human-validated explanations per item; the exact 965-item release with a five-per-specialty 25-item development set and 940-item test set; 18 open baselines, three GPT models, and MedPhi-2 under zero-shot temperature-zero evaluation; logits or regex/fuzzy answer parsing; BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and SciBERT BERTScore with explanation score zeroed for wrong answers; and three-MSc-annotator 0/0.5/1 human validation on the development set.

name: MedHallu
intro: MedHallu是首个专门用于检测大型语言模型医疗幻觉的综合基准，包含10000个高质量问答对，评估模型在医疗领域生成看似合理但事实不准确输出的倾向。
build_method_en: Generated by controlled pipeline system
eval_feature_en: The first benchmark focusing on medical hallucination detection, 10K high-quality QA pairs
intro_en: MedHallu is the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to detect medical hallucinations in large language models. It contains 10,000 high-quality QA pairs to evaluate models' tendencies to generate plausible but factually incorrect outputs in the medical domain.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.14302 Sections 3-4, Figure 2, and Algorithm 1. The diagrams preserve the exact 1,000 pqa_labeled plus 9,000 randomly selected pqa_artificial source mix; question, knowledge, and ground-truth inputs; four medical hallucination types; Qwen2.5-14B generation with temperature 0.3-0.7, top-p 0.95, 512-token cap, and answer length within 10 percent of gold; GPT-4o mini, Gemma2-9B, and Qwen2.5-7B discriminative filtering; difficulty assignment by fooled-model count; bidirectional DeBERTa-large-MNLI checking at confidence 0.75; TextGrad refinement with at most five generation attempts; semantic-similarity fallback labeled easy; the final 10,000-pair, three-tier release; and zero-shot versus knowledge-aware binary detection reported with F1 and precision.

name: MedHELM
intro: MedHELM提出了可扩展的医学任务评估框架，基于29名临床专家验证的分类体系，覆盖5大类、22个子类和121项任务。其35个基准由17个现有基准、5个重构基准和13个全新基准组成，其中13个全新基准里有12个基于EHR；框架以自动指标或三模型LLM评审团评分，并联合分析胜率与成本。
build_method: 临床专家分类体系, 现有基准映射, 数据重构, EHR任务构建
metric: LLM-as-Judge, Win Rate, Accuracy, Exact Match
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 分类, 生成, 对话
eval_feature: 多轮, 领域特定
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Classification, Generation, Dialogue
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation, LLM Generation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: MedHELM is a scalable medical-task evaluation framework built on a taxonomy validated by 29 clinicians and covering five categories, 22 subcategories, and 121 tasks. Its 35 benchmarks comprise 17 existing, five reformulated, and 13 new benchmarks, 12 of the 13 new benchmarks using EHR data. It scores tasks with automated metrics or a three-model LLM jury and jointly analyzes normalized win rate and cost.
metric_en: LLM-as-Judge, Win Rate, Accuracy, Exact Match
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.23802 and the official Stanford CRFM MedHELM platform. The diagrams preserve the initial five-category, 21-subcategory, 98-task taxonomy; review by 29 clinicians across 14 specialties and four institutions; 96.7% mapping agreement, 4.21/5 comprehensiveness, and 107 comments; the final five-category, 22-subcategory, 121-task taxonomy; 17 existing, five reformulated, and 13 new benchmarks, 12 of the new benchmarks using EHR data; the exact 35-benchmark suite with 13 open-ended and 22 closed-ended tasks and 14 public, seven gated, and 14 private access levels; context, prompt, metric, and optional-gold contracts; uniform evaluation of nine frontier models; exact-match or Micro-F1 closed scoring; the GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and Llama 3.3 70B jury's nine 1-to-5 ratings; 20-clinician validation on 31 ACI-Bench plus 25 MEDIQA outputs with jury ICC 0.47; and pairwise normalized win rate, 35-benchmark macro-average, and 2025-05-12 cost pricing.

name: MEDIQA-QA
intro: MEDIQA-QA是ACL BioNLP Workshop发布的医疗问答推理基准，旨在推动自然语言推理和问题蕴涵识别在医疗问答领域的应用，要求参与者对提供的答案进行正确性判断和重新排序。
org: U.S. National Library of Medicine, IBM Research
build_method: 消费者健康问题收集, CHiQA检索, 医学专家评分与重排
metric: 准确率、平均倒数排名、精确率、Spearman秩相关系数
task_type: 答案验证, 答案排序
eval_feature: 医疗问答推理，自然语言推理和问题蕴涵识别
build_method_en: Consumer-health question collection, CHiQA retrieval, medical-expert rating and reranking
eval_feature_en: Medical QA reasoning, natural language inference and question entailment recognition
intro_en: MEDIQA-QA is a medical question answering reasoning benchmark released by the ACL BioNLP Workshop. It aims to advance the application of natural language inference and question entailment recognition in the medical QA domain, requiring participants to assess the correctness of provided answers and reorder them accordingly.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A(Medical Knowledge Bases) --> B[Expert Data Selection]
    B --> C[Question Formulation]
    C --> D[Answer Generation]
    D --> E[Clinical Reasoning Contextualization]
    E --> F{{Expert Review}}
    F --> G{Quality Check}
    G -- Approved --> H(MEDIQA-QA Dataset)
    G -- Rejected --> I[Refinement]
    I --> C
    H --> J[Model Evaluation]
    J --> K[Clinical Reasoning Capability]
metric_en: Accuracy, Mean Reciprocal Rank, Precision, Spearman's rank correlation
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Form 208 training questions from TREC LiveQA and Alexa"] --> B["Use CHiQA to retrieve 1,701 training answers"]
    B --> C["Create 25 validation and 150 test questions with 1,341 CHiQA answers"]
    C --> D["Have medical experts assign four-level relevance scores and ranks 1 to 11"]
    D --> E["Release 383 questions and 3,042 candidate answers with gold scores and ranks"]
    E --> F["Optionally add RQE over MedQuAD and NLI evidence"]
    F --> G["Predict relevance, filter incorrect answers, and rerank candidates"]
    G --> H["Report Accuracy, MRR, Precision, and Spearman rank correlation"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从TREC LiveQA与Alexa形成208个训练问题"] --> B["用CHiQA检索1,701个训练候选答案"]
    B --> C["创建25题验证集与150题测试集及1,341个CHiQA答案"]
    C --> D["由医学专家给出四级相关性分数与第1至11名排序"]
    D --> E["发布383个问题和3,042个带标准分数及排序的候选答案"]
    E --> F["可选加入MedQuAD问题蕴涵与自然语言推理证据"]
    F --> G["预测相关性、过滤错误答案并重排候选答案"]
    G --> H["报告准确率、平均倒数排名、精确率与Spearman秩相关"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MEDIQA 2019 shared-task paper (ACL Anthology W19-5039), Sections 2.3, 3.3, 4.1, and 5.3. The diagrams preserve the two 104-question training sources and their 839/862 CHiQA answers, the 25-question/234-answer validation set, the 150-question/1,107-answer test set, medical-expert relevance scores 4 to 1 and ranks 1 to 11, optional RQE/NLI evidence, and all four official metrics: Accuracy, MRR, Precision, and Spearman's rho. Both 1625 by 501 desktop exports were visually reviewed without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

name: MedMCQA
intro: MedMCQA是一个大规模多项选择题问答数据集，针对真实医学入学考试题目设计。包含来自AIIMS和NEET PG考试的19.4万道高质量题目，涵盖2400个医疗主题和21个医学科目。该数据集测试模型在广泛医学领域的推理能力。
build_method: 医学考试题收集, 纯文本质量清洗, 按考试防泄漏划分
build_method_en: Medical-exam collection, text-only quality cleaning, exam-based leakage-safe splitting
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: MedMCQA is a large-scale multiple-choice question answering dataset designed for real medical entrance exam questions. It contains 194,000 high-quality questions from AIIMS and NEET PG exams, covering 2,400 medical topics and 21 medical subjects. This dataset evaluates models' reasoning abilities across a wide range of medical fields.

name: MedMT-Bench
intro: MedMT-Bench是一个针对长医疗对话的挑战性基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型在医疗场景中的长上下文记忆、理解、抗干扰性、自我纠正、安全防御、指令澄清以及多指令响应能力。该基准测试涵盖了诊断前、诊断中和诊断后阶段，数据通过场景合成并由专家进行精炼，共包含400个测试用例，平均22轮对话。它采用LLM作为评估协议，通过实例级评估标准和原子测试点来评估LLM在医疗对话场景中的长期记忆、安全性和指令遵循方面的表现。
build_method: 混合
metric: Accuracy, Human-LLM agreement, Consistency Rate, Overall Accuracy
task_type: 长多轮指令遵循, 医疗对话理解, 安全评估
eval_feature: 长上下文记忆, 安全防御, 指令澄清, 多指令响应, 合成数据生成, 专家精炼, 原子测试点
task_type_en: Long multi-turn instruction following, medical dialogue understanding, safety assessment
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Long context memory, safety defense, instruction clarification, multi-instruction response, synthetic data generation, expert refinement, atomic test points
intro_en: MedMT-Bench is a challenging benchmark for long medical dialogues, designed to evaluate large language models' long-context memory, comprehension, robustness, self-correction, safety defense, instruction clarification, and multi-instruction response capabilities in medical scenarios. The benchmark covers pre-diagnosis, diagnosis, and post-diagnosis stages, with data synthesized from scenarios and refined by experts, comprising 400 test cases with an average of 22 dialogue turns each. It uses LLMs as the evaluation protocol, assessing their long-term memory, safety, and instruction adherence in medical dialogue contexts through instance-level evaluation criteria and atomic test points.
metric_en: Accuracy, Human-LLM agreement, Consistency Rate, Overall Accuracy
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.23519 Sections 3-5, Figures 4-5, and the linked ICLR 2026 OpenReview submission. The diagrams preserve the pre-, in-, and post-diagnosis stages; five difficult instruction-following dimensions; open text and image sources mapped to 24 departments and nine sub-scenarios; system, user, responder, generator, and verifier agents; synchronous atomic-test-point generation; scene-by-scene portrait transfer; editing by about 20 full-time medical MSc or PhD staff; correction of coherence, categorization, medical, and scoring defects; two-layer cross-review with third-reviewer adjudication; retention of questions missed by multiple models; 400 cases averaging 22 and reaching 52 turns; evaluation of 17 models; Gemini-2.5-Pro judging at temperature zero with binary atomic criteria; accuracy breakdowns; and 91.94 percent human-LLM agreement.

name: MedNLI
intro: MedNLI是一个面向临床领域的自然语言推理（NLI）数据集。该数据集由医生基于患者的真实病历进行标注，旨在推动模型在知识密集且数据有限的专业领域（如医疗）中的应用。研究者通过利用开放域数据的迁移学习和医学术语等领域知识，有效提升了模型的性能。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: 自然语言推理, 分类
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: MedNLI is a clinical domain natural language inference (NLI) dataset. It is annotated by doctors based on real patient records, aiming to advance model applications in knowledge-intensive and data-scarce specialized fields like medicine. Researchers have effectively improved model performance by leveraging transfer learning from open-domain data and incorporating domain knowledge such as medical terminology.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1808.06752 Sections 2-4. The diagrams preserve MIMIC-III v1.3 as the de-identified source with 38,597 patients and 2,078,705 notes; rule-based Past Medical History extraction; biomedical LingPipe sentence splitting and random premise sampling; premise-only clinician prompting; one definitely true, might-be-true, and definitely false hypothesis per premise; the two-radiologist, 100-premise-each pilot; removal of 16 invalid premises; cross-labeling of 552 pairs with Cohen kappa 0.78; two additional clinicians and four clinicians total; 4,683 premises annotated over six weeks; 14,049 unique pairs; premise-disjoint splits of 11,232 train, 1,395 development, and 1,422 test pairs; feature, BOW, InferSent, and ESIM baselines; open-domain transfer and clinical knowledge methods; and held-out three-way classification accuracy.

name: MedQA
intro: MedQA是首个自由格式多项选择开放领域医学问答数据集，来源于专业医学执业考试。它涵盖英语、简体中文和繁体中文三种语言，旨在对现有的开放领域问答系统构成挑战，并推动自然语言处理领域更强大模型的发展。
build_method: 医学执业考试题采集, 去重与选项规范化, 教材OCR语料
language: 英文、简体中文、繁体中文
task_type: 多项选择, 开放域问答
build_method_en: Medical-board exam collection, deduplication and option normalization, textbook OCR corpus
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: MedQA is the first free-format multiple-choice open-domain medical question answering dataset, derived from professional medical licensing exams. It covers English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese, aiming to challenge existing open-domain QA systems and promote the development of more powerful models in natural language processing.
scale_en: 61,097 questions: 12,723 English, 34,251 simplified Chinese, 14,123 traditional Chinese

name: MedS-Bench
intro: MedS-Bench是一个用于评估大型语言模型在临床环境中表现的综合性基准。它涵盖了11个高级临床任务，如临床报告摘要、治疗建议和诊断等，旨在解决现有基准主要关注选择题的局限性。评测结果显示，即便是最先进的模型在处理这些复杂任务时也面临挑战。
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 分类, 生成, 抽取, 摘要, 事实验证
eval_feature: 领域特定
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Classification, Generation, Extraction, Summarization, Fact Verification
build_method_en: Integrated 39 existing datasets
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: MedS-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating large language models in clinical settings. It covers 11 advanced clinical tasks, such as clinical report summarization, treatment recommendations, and diagnosis, addressing the limitation of existing benchmarks that mainly focus on multiple-choice questions. Evaluation results show that even state-of-the-art models face challenges in handling these complex tasks.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.12547 Sections 2 and 4 plus Supplementary A.1-A.2 and the maintained official MedS-Bench platform. The diagrams distinguish the paper release—28 source datasets, 11 categories, 52 tasks, and about 0.3 million samples—from the platform's current post-paper expansion to 39 datasets. They preserve instruction-prompted QA reformatting, hand-written task definitions, manual classification into eight model-recall and three context-retrieval categories, existing train-test splits or a random 9:1 split, exclusion of test items from demonstrations, all-item MCQA evaluation and cost-aware sampling around 1,500 where specified, six-model paper evaluation, three-shot prompting except zero-shot MCQA, task-specific Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, BLEU, and ROUGE scoring, and dynamic leaderboard submissions and refresh.

name: MedSafetyBench
intro: MedSafetyBench是首个基于美国医学会医学伦理原则来评估大型语言模型医疗安全性的基准。它包含1800个有害医疗请求和相应的安全回应，旨在系统性地研究和提升大模型在医疗应用中的安全性。通过该基准的评估和微调，可以有效降低大模型在医疗领域应用的潜在风险。
build_method: LLM生成, 混合
task_type: 安全测试, 分类, 生成
eval_feature: 领域特定, 对抗性
build_method_en: LLM Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Adversarial
intro_en: MedSafetyBench is the first benchmark for evaluating the medical safety of large language models based on the American Medical Association's medical ethics principles. It includes 1,800 harmful medical prompts and corresponding safe responses, aiming to systematically study and improve the safety of large models in medical applications. Evaluation and fine-tuning using this benchmark can effectively reduce potential risks of large models in the medical field.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.03744 Sections 3.1-4.2 and Appendices A-C. The diagrams preserve the nine AMA ethics principles; separate GPT-4 and GCG-jailbroken Llama-2-7b-chat request generation; manual duplicate and relevance filtering; the exact 900-plus-900 source balance; GPT-4 safe-response writing followed by manual verification; nine-principle stratified 900/900 Eval and Improve splits with 450 examples from each source per split; validation by 25 doctors on 25 random requests each; MedSafety-Eval and 330-item GenSafety-Eval prompting without safe responses; GPT-3.5 harmfulness judging from 1 to 5 under the AMA policy; three safety-alignment training sets; and medical-capability checks on MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MMLU-Medical.

name: MedSP1000
intro: MedSP1000 是由标准化病人教学案例转化而来的交互式临床 Agent 评测基准，包含 1,638 个标准化病人案例和 24,602 条轨迹级同行评审 rubric。每轮评测中，临床 Agent 与病人 Agent 和环境控制器闭环交互，并按原始材料中的专家标准进行过程级评分。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
build_method: 标准化病人案例改造, 专家rubric, 交互式仿真
task_type: 医疗Agent任务, 临床对话, 过程级评估
eval_feature: 动态临床决策, 信息收集, 治疗规划, 纵向管理
task_type_en: Medical agent task, Clinical dialogue, Process-level evaluation
build_method_en: Standardized patient case adaptation, Expert Rubrics, Interactive Simulation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic clinical decision-making, Information gathering, Treatment planning, Longitudinal management
intro_en: MedSP1000 is an SP-derived interactive benchmark for clinical-agent evaluation, containing 1,638 standardized patient cases and 24,602 trajectory-level peer-reviewed rubrics. In each run, a clinical agent interacts in a closed loop with a patient agent and an environment controller, and is scored throughout the encounter against expert criteria from the original materials.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2606.05112 Sections 2.1 and 4.1-4.3, Figures 1 and 8, and the official MAGIC-AI4Med repository. The diagrams preserve the two-keyword MedEdPORTAL search yielding 1,073 articles and 22,244 attachments; 931 directly text-extractable articles plus manual review of 142 with 86 retained and 56 removed; 1,017 articles and 7,147 unified Markdown files via MarkItDown, MinerU2, and OCR; Codex simulatability assessment retaining 613 articles; splitting into 1,638 cases across 17 specialties; copy-and-delete construction of scenario, patient, environment, and evaluator packets; iterative leakage and consistency audit; verbatim parsing of 24,602 frozen rubric items into six ACGME competencies; 12-clinician validation of 100 cases and 100 runs with two raters each; the speak-actions-eos interface; patient and environment-controller closed-loop interaction with unsupported results never fabricated; binary trajectory grading; and equal-case macro rubric completion with specialty and competency breakdowns.

name: MedXpertQA
intro: MedXpertQA是一个用于评估专家级医学知识和高级推理能力的基准。包含4460个问题，涵盖17个专业和11个身体系统，分为文本子集和多模态子集。多模态部分采用包含多样图像和丰富临床数据（如病历和检查结果）的专家级考试题目。
build_method: 专家构建, 考试题
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
build_method_en: Expert Curation, exam questions
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Multi-turn
intro_en: MedXpertQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate expert-level medical knowledge and advanced reasoning abilities. It contains 4,460 questions covering 17 specialties and 11 body systems, divided into text and multimodal subsets. The multimodal subset features expert-level exam questions with diverse images and rich clinical data, such as medical records and test results.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.18362 Sections 3.1-4.3 and Appendices C, E, H, and I. The diagrams preserve collection of 37,543 authoritative licensing, specialty-board, radiology, and NEJM questions; human-response, explanation, and prior-difficulty annotations; adaptive Brier calibration and 14 votes from eight AI experts; the 10,146 and 4,737 difficulty-filter counts; edit-distance and MedCPT-IQR semantic filtering to 4,713 and 4,683; GPT-4o and Claude question rewriting; low-response distractor removal and 10-versus-5 option expansion; licensed-physician correction and deletion to 4,460; 2,455 Text and 2,005 MM items with five development examples each; 17 specialties and 11 body systems; the paper's internally different 2,839-image main-overview and 2,852-image Table-2 test-set reports; reasoning labels with a 10-percent human review; and zero-shot CoT, greedy-decoding, 18-model, human-baseline accuracy evaluation.

name: MemoryAgentBench
intro: MemoryAgentBench 是一个面向记忆型 LLM Agent 的多轮交互基准，围绕准确检索、测试时学习、长程理解和选择性遗忘四类核心记忆能力评估代理在增量信息环境中的表现。
build_method: 改造已有长文本数据集并纳入新构造数据集, 重组为多轮格式
eval_feature: 长文本, 多轮, 测试时学习
intro_en: MemoryAgentBench is a multi-turn benchmark for memory-enabled LLM agents. It evaluates agents in incremental information environments across accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting.
build_method_en: Transforms existing long-context datasets and incorporates newly constructed datasets into a multi-turn format
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multi-turn, Test-time Learning
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2507.05257v4 Sections 3.1-4.1 and Appendices B, D, and F. The diagrams preserve the four competencies; reconstruction of document QA, LongMemEval, five classification datasets, Redial, InfiniteBench summarization, and DetectiveQA; automatic EventQA construction from five books with character NER, 101 events per book, six-way questions, and 500 total queries; MQUAKE-derived FactConsolidation with later contradictory facts, 6K-to-262K contexts, and 100 single-hop plus 100 multi-hop queries; the exact 2,071-question, 130-sequence release; chunks-questions-answers standardization; inject-once-query-multiple dialogue wrapping; task-aware 512 and 4,096 chunk sizes; long-context, RAG, and agentic-memory systems; sequential memory updates; and task-specific Accuracy, substring exact match, Recall@5, GPT-4o judging, F1, cost, and latency reporting.

name: MIA-Bench
intro: MIA-Bench是一个新的基准，旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）严格遵循复杂指令的能力。该基准包含400个图像-提示对，每个都旨在挑战模型在生成满足特定请求模式的准确响应时对分层指令的遵循。评估结果显示了最先进的MLLM在性能上存在显著差异，突出了指令遵循方面的改进空间。
build_method: 人工分层提示编写, GPT-4V内容标注, GPT-4o逐组件评测
metric: 指令遵循总分与八类分项分数（0至100）
build_method_en: Manual layered-prompt authoring, GPT-4V content labeling, GPT-4o component-wise evaluation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Contamination-free
intro_en: MIA-Bench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to strictly follow complex instructions. It contains 400 image-prompt pairs, each intended to challenge models in generating accurate responses that meet specific request patterns while adhering to hierarchical instructions. Evaluation results reveal significant performance gaps among state-of-the-art MLLMs, highlighting room for improvement in instruction following.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.01509, Sections 2, 2.1, and 2.2. The diagrams preserve all four image sources, GPT-4V content labeling, manual layered-prompt authoring, the correctness/no-leakage/image-dependence gates, all eight sub-instruction types, five collection-time complexity levels, per-component weights from 1 to 10 summing to 10, the exact 400-pair release, and GPT-4o component-wise scoring aggregated to category and total scores. Both 1625 by 501 desktop exports were visually reviewed without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

name: MicroVQA
intro: MicroVQA 是面向生物显微研究的多模态推理基准，包含 1,042 道由生物学专家创建并全量复核的多项选择题，覆盖专家图像理解、假设生成和实验方案设计三类科学研究任务。
org: Stanford University; Tsinghua University; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; Princeton University; KTH Royal Institute of Technology; Chan Zuckerberg Biohub Network
build_method: 专家构建, 两阶段MCQ生成, 多智能体优化
task_type: 视觉问答, 科学问答
eval_feature: 研究级推理, 显微图像, 语言捷径控制
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Two-stage MCQ Generation, Multi-agent Refinement
eval_feature_en: Research-level Reasoning, Microscopy Images, Language-shortcut Control
intro_en: MicroVQA is a multimodal reasoning benchmark for biological microscopy research. It contains 1,042 multiple-choice questions created and fully reviewed by biology experts across expert image understanding, hypothesis generation, and experiment proposal.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.13399 Sections 3-5 and Appendices E-F. The diagrams preserve task definition through nine microscopy-research interviews; recruitment of 12 biology experts; licensed image sourcing from contributor experiments, databases, and papers since 2024; creation of 1,061 raw samples at 30-40 minutes each; quality feedback after the first 10 and 40 samples; 50 physician-scientist-authored NBME-aligned gold MCQs; DSPy prompt optimization using content, format, and clue metrics; Stage-one exam conversion; RefineBot evaluator-reflector, rewriter, and semantic checker; seed reruns requiring both GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 to fail twice; full original-creator review of the 1,042 released MCQs; and MMMU-Pro CoT accuracy evaluation with task and no-image analyses.

name: MILU
intro: MILU 是 Claude 系统卡中使用的印度语言多任务理解评测，用于衡量模型在多种 Indic 语言上的知识与理解能力。
org: AI4Bharat, IIT Madras, IBM Research India
build_method: 考试题收集, 清洗, 翻译补齐, 人工检查
eval_feature: Indic语言, 多学科知识, 印度文化知识
build_method_en: Exam-question collection, cleaning, translation gap filling, manual checks
eval_feature_en: Indic languages, multi-subject knowledge, India-centric cultural knowledge
intro_en: MILU is a Multi-task Indic Language Understanding benchmark used in Claude system cards to measure knowledge and understanding across Indic languages.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Scrape more than 150K questions from over 40 national, state, and regional exam types"] --> B["Remove reading-comprehension, image-based, over-four-option, wrong-language, and duplicate items"]

    G --> H["Report accuracy by language, subject, domain, and resource level"]

    B --> C["用IndicTrans2译成英文并由GPT-4o-mini恢复缺失主题标签"]
    C --> D["聚类标签并人工合并为41个学科与八大领域"]
    D --> E["对少于100题的学科-语言组合用GPT-4o翻译同科英文题补齐"]
    E --> F["逐语言人工审计并发布79,617道测试题与8,933道验证题"]
    F --> G["在零样本、一样本与五样本多选设置下评估模型"]
    G --> H["按语言、学科、领域与资源等级报告准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.02538 / NAACL 2025, Sections 3.1-3.3 and 5. Both 1625 by 501 desktop exports were visually reviewed without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

name: MiniF2F
intro: MiniF2F 是跨形式系统的奥赛级数学证明基准，v1 含 488 条人工形式化陈述，按来源、题型和难度分层划分为各 244 条验证与测试样本，并可在 Metamath、Lean 及部分 Isabelle 与 HOL Light 版本间比较。
org: École Polytechnique; OpenAI; University of Pittsburgh
build_method: 人工形式化, 跨系统移植, 分层划分
eval_feature: 跨系统, 机器可验证, 奥赛级数学
build_method_en: Manual Formalization, Cross-system Porting, Stratified Split
eval_feature_en: Cross-system, Machine-verifiable, Olympiad Mathematics
intro_en: MiniF2F is a cross-system benchmark for formal Olympiad-level mathematics. Version 1 contains 488 manually formalized statements, stratified into 244 validation and 244 test items and aligned across Metamath, Lean, and partially Isabelle and HOL Light.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2109.00110 Sections 3-4 and Appendix A. The diagrams preserve the cross-system formal-to-formal goal; AMC, AIME, IMO, MATH, high-school, and undergraduate sources; focus on portable algebra, number theory, and inequalities; explicit treatment of multiple-choice, word, and witness problems; average 15-minute manual formalization and roughly half-as-long review; alignment to Metamath and Lean with partial Isabelle and HOL Light versions; the 488-statement v1 release; equal 244/244 stratified validation and test splits; frozen-version rules and prover-compatible licensing; Metamath GPT-f, Lean tidy, GPT-f, and PACT baselines; repeated proof search; target-system proof checking; and unbiased low-variance Pass@N reporting.

name: MiniF2F-Test
intro: MiniF2F-Test 是 MiniF2F v1 中冻结并留作最终评测的 244 条形式化数学陈述，按题型与可用难度从 488 条跨系统陈述中分层随机划分，并以机器检查的 Pass@N 衡量证明搜索成功率。
org: École Polytechnique, OpenAI, University of Pittsburgh
build_method: 跨系统人工形式化, 人工复核, 分层随机划分, 冻结测试集
task_type: 形式化证明, 数学推理
eval_feature: 留出测试集, 跨形式系统, 机器验证证明, 重复证明搜索

eval_feature_en: Held-out Test Set, Cross-system Formalization, Machine-checked Proofs, Repeated Proof Search
intro_en: MiniF2F-Test is MiniF2F version 1's frozen 244-statement final-evaluation split, stratified by problem type and available difficulty from 488 cross-system formal statements and scored with machine-checked Pass@N proof-search success.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2109.00110 Sections 3–4 and Appendix A plus the maintained MiniF2F repository. MiniF2F-Test is the frozen 244-statement held-out half of version 1 rather than a separately collected benchmark. The diagram preserves source collection, portability screening, task-form adaptations, average formalization and review effort, cross-system alignment, exact stratified split and test provenance counts, version freezing, validation-only development, repeated proof search, machine checking, and Pass@N reporting.

name: Minimal-LinuxBench
intro: Minimal-LinuxBench 是 Anthropic 从 Redwood Research 私下共享的 LinuxBench 改编的内部 AI 控制评测：从 1,948 个主任务/副任务对中随机抽取 200 对，检验智能体能否完成副任务且逃过全轨迹监控。

name: MixEval
intro: MixEval 提出了一种通过策略性地混合现有基准来建立高效、黄金标准的大型语言模型（LLM）评估的新范式。它通过将从网络中挖掘的真实世界用户查询与现有基准中的相似查询进行匹配，弥合了真实用户查询的全面性与基于标准答案的基准的高效性之间的差距。基于此，MixEval构建了更具挑战性的MixEval-Hard，为模型改进提供了更大空间。
org: National University of Singapore, Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, Carnegie
build_method: Common Crawl查询检测, 与真值基准逐样本匹配, 动态更新
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 动态, 实时
build_method_en: Common Crawl query detection, sample-level matching to ground-truth benchmarks, dynamic updates
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, real-time
intro_en: MixEval proposes a new paradigm for establishing efficient, gold-standard evaluations of large language models (LLMs) by strategically mixing existing benchmarks. It bridges the gap between the comprehensiveness of real-world user queries mined from the web and the efficiency of benchmark queries with standard answers by matching similar queries from existing benchmarks. Based on this, MixEval creates the more challenging MixEval-Hard, offering greater room for model improvement.

name: MixEval-Hard
intro: MixEval-Hard是MixEval的升级版，设计更具挑战性，旨在为模型改进提供更大空间。该基准通过混合多种现成评测，桥接真实用户查询与标准答案基准的差距。
build_method: MixEval难度加权, 拒绝采样, 查询分布约束
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 多轮, 动态, 实时
build_method_en: MixEval difficulty weighting, rejection sampling, query-distribution constraint
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, dynamic, real-time
intro_en: MixEval-Hard is an upgraded version of MixEval, designed to be more challenging and provide greater room for model improvement. This benchmark bridges the gap between real user queries and standard answer benchmarks by combining multiple existing evaluations.

name: MLE-Bench
intro: MLE-Bench是一个用于评估AI智能体在机器学习工程方面表现的基准。它收集了75个Kaggle机器学习工程竞赛，旨在测试AI智能体在模型训练、数据准备和实验运行等方面的真实世界技能。该基准通过开源智能体脚手架评估了前沿语言模型，并建立了人类基线。
org: OpenAI, University of California Berkeley, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Stanford Universit
build_method: 75个来自Kaggle的机器学习工程相关竞赛
task_type: Agent任务, 机器学习工程
eval_feature: Kaggle公开可用排行榜
build_method_en: 75 ML engineering-related competitions from Kaggle
eval_feature_en: Kaggle's publicly available leaderboards
intro_en: MLE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' performance in machine learning engineering. It compiles 75 Kaggle machine learning engineering competitions to test agents' real-world skills in model training, data preparation, and experiment execution. The benchmark assesses state-of-the-art language models using an open-source agent framework and establishes a human baseline.

name: MLGym
intro: MLGym是首个面向机器学习任务的Gym环境，支持大型语言模型代理的评估与开发。它包含13个多样化且开放式的AI研究任务，涵盖计算机视觉、自然语言处理和强化学习等领域，旨在促进对AI研究型Agent的开发与评估。

intro_en: MLGym is the first Gym environment designed for machine learning tasks, supporting the evaluation and development of large language model agents. It includes 13 diverse and open-ended AI research tasks spanning computer vision, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning, aiming to advance the development and assessment of AI research agents.

name: MLVU
intro: MLVU是一个多任务长视频理解基准，旨在全面深入评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在长视频理解（LVU）任务中的性能。它通过显著扩展视频长度、包含多样化的视频类型（如电影、监控录像、自我中心视频、卡通、游戏视频等）以及开发多样化的评估任务来解决现有基准的局限性。对23个最新MLLMs的实证研究表明，现有技术在处理长视频时仍有显著提升空间，且在大多数评估任务中表现不佳。MLVU有望通过对MLLMs的全面深入分析，推动长视频理解领域的研究进展。
org: BAAI, BUPT, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Zhejiang University, Peking University
build_method: 人工标注, 公共数据改编, GPT-4辅助标注, 视频合成
metric: 选择题准确率与M-Avg、GPT-4生成式评分与G-Avg
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
build_method_en: Human annotation, public-dataset adaptation, GPT-4 assistance, video synthesis
eval_feature_en: Process evaluation
intro_en: MLVU is a multi-task long video understanding benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on long video understanding (LVU) tasks. It addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks by significantly extending video length, including diverse video types (such as movies, surveillance footage, egocentric videos, cartoons, game videos, etc.), and developing a variety of evaluation tasks. An empirical study of 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows that current techniques still have substantial room for improvement in handling long videos and perform poorly on most evaluation tasks. MLVU aims to advance research in long video understanding through comprehensive and in-depth analysis of MLLMs.

name: MM-BrowseComp
intro: MM-BrowseComp是一个全面的多模态深度研究基准，旨在评估智能体通过浏览和推理多模态网页内容来解决复杂问题的能力。该基准包含224个具有挑战性的多跳问题，每个问题的解决方案都特意设计为需要理解图像或视频模态中的内容。评估结果显示，即使是OpenAI o3等最强模型也未能超过30%的准确率，凸显了当前模型在多模态理解和推理方面的不足。该基准还提供了经过验证的清单，用于细粒度分析多模态依赖性和推理路径。
org: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tsinghua University, University of California, B

modality: 文本, 图像, 视频, 多模态

intro_en: MM-BrowseComp is a comprehensive multimodal deep research benchmark designed to evaluate agents' ability to solve complex problems by browsing and reasoning over multimodal web content. The benchmark includes 224 challenging multi-hop questions, each requiring understanding of content in image or video modalities. Evaluation results show that even top models like OpenAI o3 fail to exceed 30% accuracy, highlighting current limitations in multimodal understanding and reasoning. The benchmark also provides a validated checklist for fine-grained analysis of multimodal dependencies and reasoning paths.

name: MM-IFEval
intro: MM-IFEval 是 MM-IFEngine 论文提出的多模态指令遵循评测基准，用于评估多模态模型是否能同时遵循输出组合约束与图像相关感知约束。它由 MM-IFEngine 生成的图像-指令对和人工标注构建，包含 400 道挑战题，其中 300 道为组合级开放题、100 道为感知级问题，并结合规则验证与 judge 模型评分。

build_method_en: MM-IFEngine Generation, Human Annotation, Conflict Review

intro_en: MM-IFEval is a multimodal instruction-following benchmark introduced by the MM-IFEngine paper. It evaluates whether MLLMs can follow both compose-level output constraints and perception-level constraints tied to images. It is built from MM-IFEngine-generated image-instruction pairs with human annotations, contains 400 challenging questions, and combines rule-based checks with a judge model.
metric_en: Compose-level Accuracy, Perception-level Accuracy, Average Accuracy
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Gather diverse image sources and define 16 tasks"] --> B["Filter few-shot and option-bearing source questions"]
    B --> C["Build six constraint groups and 32 subcategories"]
    C --> D["Use an LLM to integrate constraints and filter contradictions"]
    D --> E["Human-annotate compose-level and perception-level problems"]
    E --> F["Run an extra LLM conflict check"]
    F --> G["Assemble 300 compose-level and 100 perception-level questions"]
    G --> H["Apply rules to 10 verifiable constraint subcategories"]
    H --> I["Use direct and comparative LLM judgment for remaining constraints"]
    I --> J["Report compose, perception, and average accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["汇集多样图像来源并定义16类任务"] --> B["过滤含少样本示例或选项的来源问题"]
    B --> C["建立六类约束与32个子类别"]
    C --> D["用LLM整合约束并过滤矛盾组合"]
    D --> E["人工标注组合级与感知级问题"]
    E --> F["用额外LLM复核约束冲突"]
    F --> G["汇总300道组合级和100道感知级问题"]
    G --> H["对10个可验证约束子类执行规则验证"]
    H --> I["对其余约束执行LLM直接与对比判断"]
    I --> J["报告组合级、感知级和平均准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.07957 Sections 3.2-4.2 and Appendices A-B and E. The diagram preserves diverse image sources, 16 task descriptions, source-question filtering, six constraint groups with 32 subcategories, LLM compatibility checks, human compose/perception annotation, post-annotation conflict mitigation, the exact 300 plus 100 split, rule functions for 10 verifiable subcategories, direct LLM judgment, comparative LLM judgment, and C-level, P-level, and average accuracy.

name: MM-MTBench
intro: MM-MT-Bench是一个多轮LLM-as-a-judge评估基准，类似于文本MT-Bench，用于测试多模态指令调优模型。现有基准测试（如MMMU、MathVista、ChartQA等）侧重于封闭式问题和简短回答，无法评估模型在多轮对话中遵循用户指令和零样本回答开放式问题的能力。MM-MT-Bench旨在克服这一限制。
build_method: 人工策展, 二次复核, LLM评判
task_type: 开放式问答, 多轮对话
build_method_en: Manual Curation, Secondary Verification, LLM-as-a-Judge
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn Dialogue, Zero-shot
intro_en: MM-MT-Bench is a multi-turn LLM-as-a-judge evaluation benchmark, similar to the text-based MT-Bench, designed to test multimodal instruction-tuned models. Existing benchmarks (such as MMMU, MathVista, ChartQA, etc.) focus on closed-ended questions and short answers, and cannot assess a model's ability to follow user instructions and provide zero-shot answers to open-ended questions in multi-turn dialogues. MM-MT-Bench aims to overcome this limitation.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[策展五类图像与实用场景] --> B[人工编写并二次复核问题和答案]
    B --> C[构建69个单轮、18个两轮、4个三轮和1个四轮对话]
    C --> D[确保每题必须依赖图像]
    D --> E[各轮使用标准历史答案独立作答]
    E --> F[GPT-4o按正确性与完整性给出1至10分]
    F --> G[汇总平均分并验证与视觉竞技场ELO的0.91相关性]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select extraction, summarization, and image-reasoning use cases"] --> B["Curate charts, tables, PDF pages, diagrams, and miscellaneous images"]
    B --> C["Manually write prompts and reference answers"]
    C --> D["Have a second labeler group verify answers"]
    D --> E["Build 92 one-to-four-turn conversations"]
    E --> F["Require the image for every prompt"]
    F --> G["Answer each turn using gold past answers as history"]
    G --> H["Have GPT-4o independently judge every turn"]
    H --> I["Rate correctness and completeness from 1 to 10"]
    I --> J["Average ratings and compare with Vision Arena ELO"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择抽取、摘要与图像推理场景"] --> B["策展图表、表格、PDF页面、图示与其他图像"]
    B --> C["人工编写问题与参考答案"]
    C --> D["由第二组标注员复核答案"]
    D --> E["构建92个一至四轮对话"]
    E --> F["确保每个问题必须依赖图像"]
    F --> G["每轮使用标准历史答案独立作答"]
    G --> H["让GPT-4o独立评判每一轮"]
    H --> I["按正确性与完整性给出一至十分"]
    I --> J["汇总平均分并对照视觉竞技场ELO"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.07073 Section 3 and the official Mistral MM-MT-Bench dataset. The diagram preserves all five image categories and counts, manual image-prompt-answer curation, second-labeler verification, the exact 69 single-turn plus 18 two-turn plus four three-turn plus one four-turn distribution, mandatory image dependence, independent turn inference with gold prior-turn history, full-history GPT-4o judging, 1-to-10 correctness and completeness ratings, mean score reporting, and the paper's 0.91 Vision Arena ELO correlation.

name: MMAU
intro: MMAU 是一个大规模多任务音频理解与推理 benchmark，用于评估音频语言模型在语音、环境声和音乐上的高级感知、信息抽取和复杂推理能力。它包含 10,000 道基于精心筛选音频并经专家标注与复核的多选题，覆盖 27 类任务。
build_method: 七步专家策展, 人工标注, GPT-4选项增强
task_type: 音频理解, 音频推理
eval_feature: 音频推理, 信息抽取, 27项技能, 领域知识
build_method_en: Seven-step Expert Curation, Human Annotation, GPT-4 Option Augmentation
eval_feature_en: Audio reasoning, Information extraction, 27 skills, Domain knowledge
intro_en: MMAU is a massive multi-task audio understanding and reasoning benchmark for evaluating audio-language models on advanced perception, information extraction, and complex reasoning over speech, environmental sounds, and music. It contains 10,000 expert-annotated and reviewed multiple-choice questions grounded in carefully selected audio across 27 tasks.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select 13 speech, sound, and music corpora"] --> B["Curate 90 candidate tasks down to 27"]
    B --> C["Select plausible audio and expert-author QA pairs"]
    C --> D["Use a separate expert team to filter ambiguous or low-quality items"]
    D --> E["Use GPT-4 to add context-aware distractor options"]
    E --> F["Expert-review answers, options, task tags, and skill tags"]
    F --> G["Reduce 11,000 annotated pairs to 10,000 final MCQs"]
    G --> H["Balance three domains and 27 tasks"]
    H --> I["Split 1,000 test-mini and 9,000 main test questions"]
    I --> J["Report multiple-choice accuracy by domain and overall"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择13个语音、声音和音乐语料库"] --> B["将90个候选任务策展为27个任务"]
    B --> C["选择合适音频并由专家编写问答"]
    C --> D["由独立专家团队过滤歧义或低质量样本"]
    D --> E["用GPT-4增加基于上下文的干扰选项"]
    E --> F["由专家复核答案、选项、任务和技能标签"]
    F --> G["将11,000个标注对缩减为10,000道最终多选题"]
    G --> H["平衡三个领域与27类任务"]
    H --> I["拆分1,000题小测试集和9,000题主测试集"]
    I --> J["按领域与整体报告多选准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.19168 Section 3.2 and Appendix C. The diagram preserves the paper's seven named stages, 13 source corpora, preference for real audio, 90-to-27 task curation, expert QA annotation, independent expert filtering, GPT-4 context-aware option augmentation, final task and skill tagging, the exact 11,000 minus 800 minus 200 equals 10,000 accounting, balancing across speech, sound, music, and 27 tasks, the 1,000 plus 9,000 split, and multiple-choice accuracy reporting.

name: MMBench
intro: MMBench是一个旨在全面评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）多模态能力的双语基准测试。它通过精心策划的质量控制方案，提供了大量多样化的评估问题。MMBench引入了CircularEval策略，并利用大型语言模型将自由形式的预测转换为预定义选项，以确保评估结果的准确性。该基准测试包含中英文多项选择题，支持对VLMs性能进行公平比较。
org: OpenCompass Community, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The University of Hong Kong, SenseTime, Shanghai Jiao
eval_feature: 双语, 防污染, 过程评估
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, Contamination-free, Process Evaluation
intro_en: MMBench is a bilingual benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the multimodal capabilities of visual language models (VLMs). It offers a large and diverse set of evaluation questions through a carefully curated quality control scheme. MMBench introduces the CircularEval strategy and uses large language models to convert free-form predictions into predefined options, ensuring the accuracy of evaluation results. The benchmark includes multiple-choice questions in both Chinese and English, supporting fair comparisons of VLM performance.

name: MMBench-CN
intro: MMBench-CN 是 MMBench 的中文子集/分项，报告中用于观察多模态模型中文视觉问答表现。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 三级能力体系, 志愿者多源收集, 双路质量过滤, GPT-4翻译与人工核验
eval_feature: 中文视觉问答, CircularEval, 选项抽取
scale: 3,217道题, 20个细粒度能力, 开发/测试=4:6
build_method_en: Three-level ability taxonomy, volunteer multi-source collection, dual quality filtering, GPT-4 translation and human verification
eval_feature_en: Chinese Visual QA, CircularEval, Choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-CN is the Chinese subset or breakdown of MMBench used in reports to inspect multimodal Chinese visual-QA performance.

name: MMBench-EN
intro: MMBench-EN 是 MMBench 的英文子集/分项，报告中用于观察多模态模型英文视觉问答表现。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 三级能力体系, 志愿者多源收集, 文本可答与错题双路质量过滤
eval_feature: 英文视觉问答, CircularEval, 选项抽取
scale: 3,217道题, 20个细粒度能力, 开发/测试=4:6
build_method_en: Three-level ability taxonomy, volunteer multi-source collection, text-only and wrong-item quality filtering
eval_feature_en: English Visual QA, CircularEval, Choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-EN is the English subset or breakdown of MMBench used in reports to inspect multimodal English visual-QA performance.

name: MMBench-V1.1
intro: MMBench-V1.1 是 Qwen3-VL、Qwen2.5-Omni 等报告使用的 MMBench 版本，用于通用视觉问答能力评测。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 三级能力体系, 志愿者多源收集, 双路质量过滤, CircularEval
eval_feature: CircularEval, 选项抽取, 视觉问答
scale: 3,217道题, 20个细粒度能力, 开发/测试=4:6
build_method_en: Three-level ability taxonomy, volunteer multi-source collection, dual quality filtering, CircularEval
eval_feature_en: CircularEval, Choice extraction, Visual QA
intro_en: MMBench-V1.1 is a MMBench version used by reports such as Qwen3-VL and Qwen2.5-Omni for general visual question-answering evaluation.

name: MMBench-Video
intro: MMBench-Video是一个用于严格评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）视频理解能力的定量基准。该基准包含来自YouTube的长视频和自由形式的问题，更贴近实际应用场景，旨在严谨评估模型的视频理解水平。所有问题均由人工根据精心构建的能力分类法进行标注。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, SenseTime Research, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI
build_method: 人工标注, 交叉验证, GPT-4V时序过滤
eval_feature: 长视频理解, 时序推理, GPT-4评审
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Cross-validation, GPT-4V Temporal Filtering
eval_feature_en: Long video understanding, Temporal reasoning, GPT-4 judging
intro_en: MMBench-Video is a quantitative benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the video understanding capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). It includes long videos from YouTube and open-ended questions, reflecting real-world scenarios, and aims to provide a thorough assessment of models' video comprehension. All questions are manually annotated based on a carefully constructed taxonomy of abilities.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[收集16类YouTube长视频] --> B[建立三级26项叶子能力体系]
    B --> C[人工编写自由问答并交叉验证]
    C --> D[四次GPT-4V随机单帧实验]
    D --> E[用GPT-4移除平均分至少2.5的246题]
    E --> F[汇总609个视频与1,998个问答对]
    F --> G[多帧推理并用GPT-4给出0至3分]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect YouTube videos in 16 categories"] --> B["Keep videos at least 30 seconds and QA clips up to six minutes"]
    B --> C["Define a three-level taxonomy with 26 leaf abilities"]
    C --> D["Human-author multiple free-form QA pairs per video"]
    D --> E["Apply five authoring guidelines and cross-validation"]
    E --> F["Run four GPT-4V random-single-frame trials per question"]
    F --> G["Use GPT-4 to remove 246 questions scoring at least 2.5"]
    G --> H["Assemble 609 videos and 1,998 QA pairs"]
    H --> I["Generate model answers from chronological frames and optional subtitles"]
    I --> J["Use GPT-4 semantic judging and report 0-to-3 scores"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集覆盖16类主题的YouTube视频"] --> B["保留至少30秒视频且问答片段不超过六分钟"]
    B --> C["定义含26项叶子能力的三级分类"]
    C --> D["人工为每个视频编写多个自由问答对"]
    D --> E["执行五项编写准则与交叉验证"]
    E --> F["每题运行四次GPT-4V随机单帧实验"]
    F --> G["用GPT-4移除平均分至少2.5的246题"]
    G --> H["汇总609个视频与1,998个问答对"]
    H --> I["根据时序多帧与可选字幕生成模型回答"]
    I --> J["用GPT-4按语义评判并报告零至三分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.14515 Section 3.1 and Appendices C-D. The diagram preserves 16 YouTube categories, the 30-second minimum and six-minute QA clip bound, the three-level perception/reasoning taxonomy with 26 leaf capabilities, human multi-question authoring and five guidelines, cross-validation, four-seed GPT-4V random-single-frame probing, GPT-4 filtering at mean score 2.5 with 246 questions removed, the final 609 videos and 1,998 QA pairs, chronological multi-frame inference, and GPT-4 semantic grading from 0 to 3.

name: MME
intro: MME是一个针对多模态大型语言模型的综合性评估基准。它旨在衡量模型在14个子任务上的感知和认知能力，包括存在、计数、位置、颜色、海报、名人、场景、地标、艺术品、OCR、常识推理、数值计算、文本翻译和代码推理。为避免数据泄漏，所有指令-答案对均由人工设计。
org: Nanjing University, Tencent Youtu Lab, Xiamen University, Chinese Academy of Sciences
eval_feature: 无
build_method_en: Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: None
intro_en: MME is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models. It aims to assess models' perceptual and cognitive abilities across 14 subtasks, including existence, counting, location, color, posters, celebrities, scenes, landmarks, artworks, OCR, commonsense reasoning, numerical calculation, text translation, and code reasoning. To prevent data leakage, all instruction-answer pairs are manually designed.

name: MMLongBench
intro: MMLongBench是首个涵盖多种长上下文视觉-语言任务的基准，旨在有效且全面地评估长上下文视觉-语言模型（LCVLMs）。它包含13,331个示例，涵盖五种不同类别的下游任务，如视觉RAG和多样本ICL。该基准通过提供广泛的任务覆盖、多样的图像类型和严格的长度控制，为诊断和推进下一代LCVLMs提供了基础。
org: Zhaowei Wang, Wenhao Yu, Xiyu Ren, Jipeng Zhang, Yu Zhao, Rohit Saxena, Liang Cheng, Ginny Wong, Sim
build_method: 16个现有数据集改造, 跨模态长度控制, 混合构建
task_type: 视觉RAG, NIAH, 多样本ICL, PDF摘要, 长文档问答
eval_feature: 长上下文, 多模态, 跨模态
scale: 13,331个示例，16个数据集，五类任务，五档长度
build_method_en: Adaptation of 16 Existing Datasets, Cross-modal Length Control, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multimodal, Cross-modal
intro_en: MMLongBench is the first benchmark covering various long-context vision-language tasks, designed to effectively and comprehensively evaluate long-context vision-language models (LCVLMs). It includes 13,331 examples across five different downstream task categories, such as visual RAG and multi-sample ICL. By offering broad task coverage, diverse image types, and strict length control, this benchmark provides a foundation for diagnosing and advancing the next generation of LCVLMs.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[选择16个现有数据集] --> B[组织视觉RAG、NIAH、多样本ICL、PDF摘要和长文档问答]
    B --> C[按任务插入证据、干扰项、上下文示例或截断页面]
    C --> D[以视觉块像素重排加文本词元统一计数]
    D --> E[生成8K、16K、32K、64K和128K五档输入]
    E --> F[汇总13331个样本并评测46个LCVLM]
    F --> G[按任务报告准确率、子串精确匹配或流畅度F1]
scale_en: 13,331 examples, 16 datasets, five task categories, five input lengths
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select 16 existing vision-language datasets"] --> B["Organize Visual RAG, NIAH, Many-shot ICL, PDF summarization, and DocVQA"]
    B --> C["Insert evidence, distractors, exemplars, or page truncation by task"]
    C --> D["Count vision patches after pixel unshuffle together with text tokens"]
    D --> E["Create 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, and 128K versions"]
    E --> F["Assemble 13,331 examples and evaluate 46 LCVLMs"]
    F --> G["Report Accuracy, Substring Exact Match, or Fluency-F1 by task"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择16个现有视觉语言数据集"] --> B["组织视觉RAG、NIAH、多样本ICL、PDF摘要和长文档问答"]
    B --> C["按任务插入证据、干扰项、上下文示例或截断页面"]
    C --> D["将像素重排后的视觉块与文本词元统一计数"]
    D --> E["生成8K、16K、32K、64K和128K版本"]
    E --> F["汇总13331个样本并评测46个LCVLM"]
    F --> G["按任务报告准确率、子串精确匹配或流畅度F1"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.10610 Sections 3-4 and Appendices B-C plus the EdinburghNLP/MMLongBench repository. The diagram preserves 13,331 examples drawn from 16 existing datasets without new crowdsourcing; the five Visual RAG, NIAH, Many-shot ICL, PDF summarization, and Long-document VQA categories; category-specific construction including 100-word Wikipedia passages, mixed needles, balanced exemplars with random integer labels, atomic summary claims, and answer-page preservation; unified image-patch pixel-unshuffle plus text token counting; exact 8K/16K/32K/64K/128K inputs; evaluation of 46 models on 4,050 examples at each of five lengths for 20,250 instances; and task-appropriate Accuracy, Substring Exact Match, and GPT-4o Fluency-F1 reporting.

name: MMLongBench-Doc
intro: MMLongBench-Doc 是一个长上下文多模态文档理解基准。论文由十名专家在 135 份长篇 PDF 上复核已有题并编写新题，经三轮半自动质检形成 1,082 道题，覆盖单页、跨页和不可回答问题以及文本、表格、图表和图像证据。
org: Nanyang Technological University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Fudan University, Sun Yat-sen University
build_method: 长篇PDF, 十名专家标注, 三轮半自动质检
modality: 文档, 文本, 图像, 图表, 表格
eval_feature: 长上下文, 跨页推理, 幻觉检测
build_method_en: Long PDFs, Ten-expert Annotation, Three-round Semi-automatic QC
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Cross-page Reasoning, Hallucination Detection
intro_en: MMLongBench-Doc is a long-context multimodal document-understanding benchmark. Ten experts review source questions and author new ones over 135 lengthy PDFs, then apply three rounds of semi-automatic quality control to produce 1,082 single-page, cross-page, and unanswerable questions grounded in text, tables, charts, and images.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect 76 existing and 59 new PDFs across seven types"] --> B["Train ten expert annotators and run 54 batches"]
    B --> C["Review 425 source questions and author new evidence-grounded items"]
    C --> D["Include single-page, cross-page, unanswerable, and multimodal questions"]
    D --> E["Run no-document relevance, with-document reflection, and expert cross-check QC"]
    E --> F["Assemble 1,082 questions: 184 source and 898 new"]
    F --> G["Generate free-form answers and use GPT-4o to extract short answers"]
    G --> H["Report rule-based generalized Accuracy and generalized F1"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集七种类型的76份已有与59份新PDF"] --> B["培训十名专家并执行54批标注"]
    B --> C["复核425道来源题并编写有证据的新题"]
    C --> D["纳入单页、跨页、不可回答和多模态问题"]
    D --> E["依次执行无文档必要性、带文档反思和专家交叉检查"]
    E --> F["汇总1082题：184道来源题与898道新题"]
    F --> G["生成自由文本回答并由GPT-4o抽取简短答案"]
    G --> H["报告规则计算的广义准确率和广义F1"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.01523 Sections 3-4 and the official MMLongBench-Doc project. The diagram corrects the old 130-document/1,062-question summary to the paper's 135 documents and 1,082 questions; preserves the 76 existing plus 59 new documents, seven types, 47.5-page and 21,214-token averages, ten doctor/PhD annotators, 54 batches and 60-90 minutes per document, 425 existing-question review, new-question rates and evidence metadata, all three QC rounds with 94 removals/13.8% revisions/17.5% cross-check inconsistency and kappa 0.42, final 184 source plus 898 new questions and 494/365/223 type counts, GPT-4o short-answer extraction, rule-based generalized Accuracy and generalized F1, and LVLM versus OCR+LLM comparison.

name: MMLU
intro: MMLU是一个多任务准确率测试，涵盖57个任务，包括基础数学、美国历史、计算机科学和法律等。高准确率要求模型具备广泛的世界知识和问题解决能力。
org: UC Berkeley, Columbia University, UChicago, UIUC
build_method: 考试题, 专家构建
eval_feature: 少样本
build_method_en: Exam Questions, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Few-shot
intro_en: MMLU is a multi-task accuracy test covering 57 tasks, including basic math, U.S. history, computer science, and law. High accuracy requires models to have broad world knowledge and problem-solving skills.

name: MMLU-CF
intro: MMLU-CF 是一个无污染且更具挑战性的多项选择题基准。论文从超过 2,000 亿份公共网页文档抽取并逐级清洗、难度抽样、多模型质检和语义去重，再执行三项去污染变换，最终形成各 10,000 题的公开验证集与封闭测试集。
build_method: 网页规则抽取, LLM筛选, 去污染变换
eval_feature: 三项去污染规则, 闭源测试集, 零样本, 五样本
scale: 20,000题：10,000题公开验证集与10,000题封闭测试集
build_method_en: Rule-based Web Extraction, LLM Filtering, Contamination-free Transformations
eval_feature_en: Three decontamination rules, Closed test set, Zero-shot, Five-shot
intro_en: MMLU-CF is a clean and more challenging multiple-choice benchmark. The paper extracts questions from more than 200 billion public web documents, then applies staged cleaning, difficulty sampling, multi-model quality checking, semantic deduplication, and three contamination-free transformations before producing matched 10,000-question public-validation and closed-test splits.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[超过2000亿份网页抽取270万题] --> B[规则清洗去重至166万题]
    B --> C[GPT-4o评难度并平衡抽样五万题]
    C --> D[GPT-4o、Gemini、Claude质检并语义去重]
    D --> E[改写题干、打乱选项、随机替换任一选项]
    E --> F[划分各一万题的公开验证集和封闭测试集]
    F --> G[零样本与五样本准确率评测]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Extract 2.7M MCQs from over 200B public web documents"] --> B["Rule-clean and deduplicate to 1.66M questions"]
    B --> C["Use GPT-4o difficulty ratings to sample a balanced 50K pool"]
    C --> D["Run GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude quality checks plus semantic deduplication"]
    D --> E["Rephrase stems, shuffle choices, and randomly replace any one choice"]
    E --> F["Create matched 10K public-validation and 10K closed-test splits"]
    F --> G["Report zero-shot and five-shot exact accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从超过2000亿份公共网页文档抽取270万道多选题"] --> B["规则清洗并去重至166万题"]
    B --> C["用GPT-4o难度评分平衡抽样五万题"]
    C --> D["由GPT-4o、Gemini和Claude质检并语义去重"]
    D --> E["依次改写题干、打乱选项并随机替换任一选项"]
    E --> F["构造各一万题且分布匹配的公开验证集与封闭测试集"]
    F --> G["报告零样本与五样本精确准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.15194 Sections 2-3 and the official microsoft/MMLU-CF repository. The diagram preserves the more-than-200-billion-document and 3,000-domain crawl, 2.7M-to-1.66M rule cleaning, GPT-4o 0-9 difficulty scoring, balanced 50K sampling around difficulty six, GPT-4o/Gemini/Claude quality and harmlessness checking with mean score above four, semantic deduplication, all three contamination-free transformations and their special-choice handling, matched 10K public-validation and 10K closed-test splits, and zero-shot/five-shot accuracy evaluation.

name: MMLU-Pro
intro: MMLU-Pro是MMLU的增强版，旨在通过整合更具挑战性的、以推理为中心的问题，并将选项从四个扩展到十个，来扩展以知识驱动为主的MMLU基准。该基准包含了超过12,000个来自学术考试和教科书的严谨策划的问题，涵盖14个不同领域。实验结果表明，MMLU-Pro不仅提升了挑战性，还表现出在不同提示下的更高稳定性。
eval_feature: 思维链
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: MMLU-Pro is an enhanced version of MMLU, designed to expand the knowledge-driven MMLU benchmark by incorporating more challenging, reasoning-focused questions and increasing the number of options from four to ten. The benchmark includes over 12,000 rigorously curated questions from academic exams and textbooks, covering 14 different domains. Experimental results show that MMLU-Pro not only increases difficulty but also demonstrates greater stability across different prompts.

name: MMLU-ProX
intro: MMLU-ProX 是基于 MMLU-Pro 构建的高级多语言 LLM 评测基准。它将同一批推理型问题扩展到 29 种语言，每种语言包含 11,829 道并行题，并提供 658 题轻量版；构建流程使用强 LLM 翻译并由专家审校概念准确性、术语一致性和文化相关性。
org: University of Tokyo, RIKEN, University of Geneva, Singapore University of Technology and Design, University of Tokyo Matsuo Lab
build_method: 四阶段LLM翻译, 外部模型检查, 专家核验
task_type: 选择题, 多语言知识推理
eval_feature: 29种并行语言, 零样本, 五样本CoT, 专家翻译评分
scale: 29种语言；每语言11,829题、轻量版658题；实际评测11,759题与588题
build_method_en: Four-stage LLM Translation, External Model Examination, Expert Verification
eval_feature_en: 29 parallel languages, Zero-shot, Five-shot CoT, Expert translation ratings
intro_en: MMLU-ProX is an advanced multilingual LLM evaluation benchmark built on MMLU-Pro. It extends the same reasoning-focused questions to 29 languages, with 11,829 parallel questions per language and a 658-question lite version; translations are produced with strong LLMs and expert-reviewed for conceptual accuracy, terminology consistency, and cultural relevance.
scale_en: 29 languages; 11,829 full and 658 lite questions per language; 11,759 and 588 actual evaluation items
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Clean MMLU-Pro's 57-subject ten-choice English source"] --> B["Use Claude 3.7 Sonnet for initial translation and self-reflection"]
    B --> C["Improve translations and preserve terms, formulas, code, and formatting"]
    C --> D["Use o3 on four African languages and GPT-4.1 on the other 25"]
    D --> E["Expert-check 20 items across 14 disciplines in 15 languages"]
    E --> F["Require accuracy, fluency, and completeness means above four"]
    F --> G["Release 11,829 full and 658 lite parallel questions in 29 languages"]
    G --> H["Hold out 70 prompt items and report zero-shot/five-shot CoT accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["清洗MMLU-Pro覆盖57学科的十选一英文源题"] --> B["用Claude 3.7 Sonnet完成初译与自我反思"]
    B --> C["改进翻译并保持术语、公式、代码与格式"]
    C --> D["由o3检查四种非洲语言、GPT-4.1检查其余25种"]
    D --> E["专家核验15种语言中覆盖14领域的每领域20题"]
    E --> F["要求准确性、流畅性与完整性类别均分高于四分"]
    F --> G["发布29语言并行的11829题完整版与658题轻量版"]
    G --> H["预留70道提示题并报告零样本和五样本思维链准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the accepted EMNLP 2025 MMLU-ProX paper, the official project page, and repository. The diagram preserves English-source duplicate and consistency cleaning, Claude 3.7 Sonnet's four translation stages, o3 examination for Swahili/Zulu/Yoruba/Wolof and GPT-4.1 for the other 25 languages, expert verification of 20 items per 14 disciplines in 15 languages by two native translators, 1-5 accuracy/fluency/completeness ratings and retranslating when both experts rate any dimension below three, 29-language parallel totals of 11,829 full and 658 lite questions, the 70 prompt-item holdout, and actual zero-shot/five-shot CoT evaluation counts of 11,759 and 588.

name: MMLU-Redux
intro: MMLU-Redux是MMLU的一个经过修正的子集，旨在解决原始数据集中存在的标注错误问题。该数据集包含了对MMLU全部57个学科的5700个问题的手动重新标注，研究发现原始数据集中约有6.49%的题目存在错误。通过提供更准确的基准，MMLU-Redux有助于更可靠地评估和比较大型语言模型的能力。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
eval_feature: 57学科分层抽样, 层级错误标注, 可信来源核验, 专家一致性复核
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Stratified coverage of 57 subjects, hierarchical error taxonomy, source verification, expert agreement audit
intro_en: MMLU-Redux is a revised subset of MMLU designed to address annotation errors in the original dataset. It contains 5,700 manually re-annotated questions covering all 57 subjects of MMLU. Studies found that about 6.49% of the original questions contained errors. By providing a more accurate benchmark, MMLU-Redux helps to more reliably evaluate and compare the capabilities of large language models.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.04127v3 / NAACL 2025 and the official MMLU-Redux repository. Fourteen human experts re-annotate a stratified sample of 100 questions from each of all 57 MMLU subjects, totaling 5,700 items. The hierarchical protocol first checks question and option clarity, then verifies whether zero, one, or multiple answers are correct and whether the MMLU label matches. Annotators search exact question-option matches and trusted sources, recording error type, source, reason, and a suggested correction while retaining the original label. Three-annotator Cohen's-kappa audits on five error-prone subjects exceed 0.6; stratified analysis estimates a 6.49% full-MMLU error rate and corrected evaluation can change model rankings.

name: MMLU-Redux 2.0
intro: MMLU-Redux 2.0 是对 MMLU 测试集的专家错误审计：从全部 57 个学科各抽取 100 题，共人工重新标注 5,700 题的错误类型、来源和建议答案。论文估计原始 MMLU 错误率约为 6.49%，并比较全量题目与仅正确题目的模型分数和排名。
org: University of Edinburgh, Sapienza University of Rome, Polytechnic University of Bari, University Col
build_method: 分层错误体系, 14名专家重标注, 来源核验
metric: 精确匹配准确率（全量与仅正确题目）
eval_feature: 错误审计, 正确题目过滤, 模型排名影响
build_method_en: Hierarchical Error Taxonomy, 14-expert Re-annotation, Source Verification
eval_feature_en: Error audit, Correct-only filtering, Model-ranking effects
intro_en: MMLU-Redux 2.0 is an expert error audit of the MMLU test set. It samples 100 questions from each of all 57 subjects and manually re-annotates 5,700 rows with error types, sources, and suggested answers. The paper estimates a 6.49% error rate in full MMLU and compares model scores and rankings on all versus correct-only items.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[从57个MMLU学科各抽100题] --> B[定义五类错误以及正常和待专家类型]
    B --> C[14名专家核查题目、选项、答案和可信来源]
    C --> D[记录错误类型、来源、建议答案与解释]
    D --> E[三人复标五个学科并检查一致性]
    E --> F[发布5700题完整元数据并估计6.49%错误率]
    F --> G[对比全量与仅正确题目的精确匹配分数和排名]
metric_en: Exact-match Accuracy on all versus correct-only items
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Sample 100 test questions from each of 57 MMLU subjects"] --> B["Define five error types plus OK and Expert"]
    B --> C["Have 14 experts inspect questions, choices, answers, and trusted sources"]
    C --> D["Record error type, source, suggested answer, and explanation"]
    D --> E["Triple-annotate five subjects and check agreement"]
    E --> F["Release 5,700 annotated rows and estimate a 6.49% MMLU error rate"]
    F --> G["Compare original exact match on all versus correct-only items"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从57个MMLU学科各抽取100道测试题"] --> B["定义五类错误以及正常和待专家类型"]
    B --> C["由14名专家检查问题、选项、答案与可信来源"]
    C --> D["记录错误类型、来源、建议答案与解释"]
    D --> E["三人复标五个学科并检查一致性"]
    E --> F["发布5700条标注并估计MMLU错误率为6.49%"]
    F --> G["对比全量与仅正确题目的原始精确匹配结果"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.04127 Sections 3-5 and the edinburgh-dawg/mmlu-redux-2.0 dataset card. The diagram preserves 100 sampled test questions from each of 57 subjects, the 5,700 total, the paper's hierarchical error taxonomy, 14 subject experts, source tracing and trusted-source fallback, error/source/suggested-answer/explanation metadata, Expert escalation, triple annotation of five error-rich subjects with Cohen's kappa above 0.6, the 6.49% estimated full-MMLU error rate, and comparison of original exact match on all versus correct-only instances. It explicitly avoids the prior unsupported claim that the paper replaces original labels with suggested corrected answers during evaluation.

name: MMMLU
intro: MMMLU（Multilingual Massive Multitask Language Understanding）是 OpenAI 发布的多语言 MMLU 扩展，由专业人工将含 57 类学科的 MMLU 测试集翻译为 14 个 locale，并配套零样本思维链、多语言答案解析与精确准确率评测代码。
build_method: 专业人工翻译
task_type: 知识问答, 多语言评测
eval_feature: 多语言, 多学科
build_method_en: Professional Human Translation
eval_feature_en: Multilingual, Multi-subject
intro_en: MMMLU, Multilingual Massive Multitask Language Understanding, is OpenAI's multilingual MMLU extension. Professional human translators translated the 57-category MMLU test set into 14 locales, with zero-shot chain-of-thought, multilingual answer extraction, and exact-accuracy evaluation code.

name: MMMLU-non-English
intro: MMMLU-non-English 是 DeepSeek-V3 技术报告采用的 OpenAI MMMLU 非英语评测变体：保留全部 14 个专业人工翻译 locale，在统一内部框架中以五样本、基于困惑度的多选题协议计算精确匹配。
build_method: 专业人工翻译, 子集评测
task_type: 多项选择, 知识问答
eval_feature: 多语言, 非英语
build_method_en: Professional Human Translation, Subset Evaluation
eval_feature_en: Multilingual, Non-English
intro_en: MMMLU-non-English is the OpenAI MMMLU evaluation variant used in the DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report. It keeps all 14 professionally translated locales and applies a shared internal five-shot, perplexity-based multiple-choice protocol with exact match.

name: MMMU
intro: MMMU是一个评估多模态模型在需要大学水平知识和推理任务上的基准，包含来自六个学科的11500个问题和多样化图像类型。该基准设计用于测试模型的高级感知与领域知识推理能力。
org: IN.AI Research, University of Waterloo, The Ohio State University, Carnegie Mellon University, Unive
build_method: 专家构建, 考试题
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 大学级知识, 多模态推理, 领域专家能力
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Exam Questions
eval_feature_en: College-level knowledge, multimodal reasoning, expert capability
intro_en: MMMU is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal models on tasks requiring university-level knowledge and reasoning. It includes 11,500 questions from six disciplines and diverse image types. The benchmark is designed to test models' advanced perception and domain knowledge reasoning abilities.

name: MMMU-Pro
intro: MMMU-Pro是MMMU基准的强化版本，通过剔除文本模型可解答的问题、扩展候选选项，并引入仅视觉输入的设置（问题嵌入图像中），严格评估多模态模型的真实理解与推理能力。结果显示模型在MMMU-Pro上的表现显著下降，提供了更严苛的多模态AI评测工具。
build_method: 混合, 专家构建
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 对抗性, 思维链, 领域特定
build_method_en: Hybrid, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Chain-of-Thought, Domain-specific
intro_en: MMMU-Pro is an enhanced version of the MMMU benchmark that strictly evaluates multimodal models' true understanding and reasoning abilities by removing questions solvable by text-only models, expanding candidate options, and introducing a vision-only setting (with questions embedded in images). Results show a significant performance drop on MMMU-Pro, providing a more rigorous multimodal AI evaluation tool.

name: MMSIBench
intro: MMSI-Bench 是多图空间智能基准。六名 3D 视觉研究者从八个真实世界数据集、超过 12 万张候选图像中人工构建 1,000 道四选一问题，最终使用 1,990 张独立图像，并以详细推理、可信干扰项和三名独立审核者保证质量；论文评测 37 个 MLLM。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Zhejiang University, Tsinghua Universit
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
eval_feature: 多图像空间推理, 推理标注, 错误分析
scale: 1,000个问题, 1,990张最终图像, 12万余候选图像
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-image spatial reasoning, reasoning annotations, error analysis
intro_en: MMSI-Bench evaluates multi-image spatial intelligence. Six 3D-vision researchers manually built 1,000 four-choice questions from more than 120,000 candidate images across eight real-world datasets, yielding 1,990 unique final images. Detailed reasoning, plausible distractors, and three independent reviewers support quality; the paper evaluates 37 MLLMs.

name: MMStar
intro: MMStar是一个精英级的视觉不可或缺的多模态基准测试，包含1500个经过人工精心挑选的样本。它旨在评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的多模态能力，涵盖6个核心能力和18个详细维度。该基准测试通过自动化流程初步筛选样本，并进行严格的人工审查，以确保样本具有视觉依赖性、最小数据泄露，并需要高级多模态能力。此外，还开发了两种指标来衡量数据泄露和多模态训练中的实际性能增益。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Artific
build_method: 自动筛选, 人工审核
eval_feature: 视觉依赖, 防污染, 多模态增益与泄漏
build_method_en: Automated filtering, human review
eval_feature_en: Visual dependency, contamination control, multimodal gain and leakage
intro_en: MMStar is an elite, vision-essential multimodal benchmark consisting of 1,500 carefully curated samples. It aims to evaluate the multimodal capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs), covering 6 core abilities and 18 detailed dimensions. The benchmark uses an automated process for initial sample screening followed by rigorous manual review to ensure visual dependency, minimal data leakage, and the need for advanced multimodal skills. Additionally, two metrics were developed to measure data leakage and actual performance gains in multimodal training.

name: MMSU
intro: MMSU 是大规模多任务语音理解与推理基准，包含 5,000 道音频选择题与 47 项任务，覆盖感知、推理、音系、语义和副语言现象。数据由语言学专家设计、三类音频来源和十名标注员多轮质检构成，论文评测 12 个 SpeechLLM 与 10 个 OmniLLM。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 语音数据, 专家整理
task_type: 音频理解, 语音问答
eval_feature: 语音理解, 语言学现象, 感知与推理
build_method_en: Speech data, expert curation
eval_feature_en: Spoken understanding, linguistic phenomena, perception and reasoning
intro_en: MMSU is a massive multitask spoken-language understanding and reasoning benchmark with 5,000 audio MCQs across 47 tasks. Its expert-designed linguistic framework, three audio-source routes, and multi-round review by ten annotators cover perception, reasoning, phonology, semantics, and paralinguistics; the paper evaluates 12 SpeechLLMs and 10 OmniLLMs.

name: MMT-Bench
intro: MMT-Bench 是大型视觉语言模型多任务能力基准，包含 31,325 道多模态多选题、32 个元任务和 162 个子任务，覆盖 13 种输入类型与 14 类能力。论文通过 OpenCompass 的三级答案抽取评测 32 个公开 LVLM，并以任务向量构建分层任务地图。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The University of Hong Kong, The University of Adelaide, Zhejiang University
build_method: 多源数据, 规则生成, ChatGPT生成
modality: 图像, 文本, 视频, 点云
task_type: 多模态理解, 多任务评测
eval_feature: 多任务, 任务地图, 视觉识别定位推理规划
scale: 31,325个多选视觉问题, 32个元任务, 162个子任务
build_method_en: Multi-source data, rule generation, ChatGPT generation
eval_feature_en: Multitask, task map, visual recognition-localization-reasoning-planning
intro_en: MMT-Bench evaluates large vision-language models across 31,325 multimodal multiple-choice questions, 32 meta-tasks, 162 subtasks, 13 input types, and 14 capability types. The paper evaluates 32 public LVLMs with OpenCompass three-stage answer extraction and builds a hierarchical task map from task vectors.

name: MMVP
intro: MMVP通过从 ImageNet-1K 与 LAION-Aesthetics 中筛选 CLIP 表征高度相似但 DINOv2 表征差异显著的“CLIP 盲点对”，评测多模态模型的细粒度视觉落地能力。最终基准含 150 个图像对、300 道直接且无歧义的问题，覆盖方向、存在、状态、数量、位置、外观、结构、文本和视角九类视觉模式；同一图像对的两题都答对才计为正确。
org: New York University, FAIR at Meta, University of California Berkeley
build_method: 双编码器自动筛选, 人工编题
eval_feature: CLIP盲点, 九类视觉模式, 两题全对计分
build_method_en: Dual-encoder Filtering, Human Question Writing
eval_feature_en: CLIP blind pairs, nine visual patterns, both-questions-correct scoring
intro_en: MMVP evaluates fine-grained visual grounding by mining CLIP-blind pairs from ImageNet-1K and LAION-Aesthetics: pairs with highly similar CLIP representations but dissimilar DINOv2 representations. The final benchmark contains 150 image pairs and 300 direct, unambiguous questions across nine visual patterns—direction, presence, state, count, position, appearance, structure, text, and viewpoint—and a pair is correct only when both associated questions are answered correctly.

name: MMVU
intro: MMVU是一个全面的专家级、多学科视频理解基准，用于评估基础模型在视频理解方面的能力。它包含3,000个由专家标注的问题，涵盖科学、医疗健康、人文社会科学和工程四大核心学科的27个主题。MMVU旨在挑战模型应用领域特定知识并进行专家级推理，以分析专业领域的视频，超越了当前视频基准中通常评估的基本视觉感知。每个示例都由人类专家从头开始标注，并辅以专家标注的推理依据和相关领域知识，以促进深入分析。
build_method: 用户研究, 专家标注, 教材引导构建
task_type: 视频选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 视频必要性验证, 专家推理依据, GPT-4o判分
build_method_en: User Study, Expert Annotation, Textbook-guided Curation
eval_feature_en: Video-necessity validation, expert rationales, GPT-4o grading
intro_en: MMVU is a comprehensive expert-level, multidisciplinary video understanding benchmark designed to evaluate foundational models' capabilities in video comprehension. It includes 3,000 expert-annotated questions covering 27 topics across four core disciplines: science, medical health, humanities and social sciences, and engineering. MMVU aims to challenge models to apply domain-specific knowledge and perform expert-level reasoning to analyze videos in specialized fields, going beyond the basic visual perception typically assessed in current video benchmarks. Each example is annotated from scratch by human experts, accompanied by expert-provided reasoning and relevant domain knowledge to support in-depth analysis.

name: Monorepo-Bench
intro: Monorepo-Bench 是 GPT-5.3-Codex 系统卡披露的 OpenAI 内部大型仓库软件工程评测；每个样本从改动前分支开始，由智能体按人工编写的拉取请求式提示修改代码，并以隐藏单元测试是否全部通过判定成功。
build_method: 内部大型仓库, 人工编写拉取请求式提示与线索, 人工编写隐藏单元测试
metric: 成功率（全部任务专用隐藏测试通过）
task_type: 软件工程, 大型仓库任务
eval_feature: 改动前分支环境, 智能体式编码, CLI 与 Python, 全测试通过门槛
build_method_en: Internal Large Repository, Human-written PR-style Prompts and Hints, Human-written Hidden Unit Tests
eval_feature_en: Pre-change Branch Environment, Agentic Coding, CLI and Python, All-tests-pass Gate
intro_en: Monorepo-Bench is OpenAI's in-house large-repository software-engineering evaluation disclosed in the GPT-5.3-Codex system card; each sample starts from a pre-change branch, asks an agent to implement a human-written pull-request-style request, and succeeds only when all hidden unit tests pass.
metric_en: Success Rate (all task-specific hidden tests pass)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official GPT-5.3-Codex System Card Section 5.1.3.1 and Table 6. The diagram preserves the disclosed real-world software- and research-engineering scope, human-written PR-style change requests, hints, and hidden unit tests, pre-change branch checkout, agentic CLI/Python rollout, final code modification, all-task-specific-tests-pass success gate, and aggregate success-rate comparison. It explicitly marks task count and selection as undisclosed and does not invent a Pass@1 label or partial-credit scheme.

name: MORSE-500
intro: MORSE-500是一个可程序控制的视频多模态推理压力测试，含500个内嵌问题的视频实例，覆盖抽象、数学、物理、规划、空间和时间六类推理。所有视频均通过确定性Python脚本生成，脚本可按实体数量、推理深度、干扰密度、时间动态和视觉复杂度扩展难度，并可在物理任务中纳入真实场景或视频生成模型素材；自动技术验证与作者人类评审共同保证可复现质量。
org: University of Maryland, Google, Cornell University
build_method: 程序化生成, 自动与人类质检
eval_feature: 六类推理, 可扩展难度, 内嵌问题
build_method_en: Programmatic Generation, Automated and Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Six reasoning categories, scalable difficulty, embedded questions
intro_en: MORSE-500 is a programmatically controllable video reasoning stress test with 500 question-embedded instances spanning abstract, mathematical, physical, planning, spatial, and temporal reasoning. Every video is generated through deterministic Python scripts that scale entity count, reasoning depth, distractor density, temporal dynamics, and visual complexity while incorporating real-world scenarios or video-generation material for suitable physics tasks; automated technical checks and author review enforce reproducible quality.

name: MotionBench
intro: MotionBench 是细粒度视频运动理解基准，通过复杂交互、特定领域和 Unity 合成三路流程构建 5,385 个视频与 8,052 道选择题，并以六类运动任务的准确率评测模型是否真正利用动态信息。
build_method: 网络爬取, 自动生成, 人工标注, 混合
metric: Accuracy, MR, LM, CM, MO, AO, RC
eval_feature: 三路视频构建, 首帧捷径过滤, 六类运动任务, 在线测试评测
build_method_en: Web Crawling, Automated Generation, Human Annotation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Three-stream Video Construction, First-frame Shortcut Filtering, Six Motion Tasks, Online Test Evaluation
intro_en: MotionBench is a fine-grained video-motion-understanding benchmark built through intricate-interaction, specific-field, and Unity-synthetic streams into 5,385 videos and 8,052 multiple-choice QAs, with six task accuracies testing whether models use dynamic information.
metric_en: Accuracy, MR, LM, CM, MO, AO, RC
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.02955 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A–B plus the official MotionBench repository. The diagram preserves the three video sources and their filters, Unity motion/avatar/scene/viewpoint recipe, dynamic-caption effort and secondary review, six GPT-4o QAs per intricate video, the three-model first-frame shortcut gate, ten-annotator manual QA review, direct specific-field and ground-truth synthetic annotation, every stream count, six motion categories, exact 5,385-video and 8,052-QA release, 4,020/4,034 split, online test labels, answer prompt and regex parser, overall/category Accuracy, and annotation density.

name: MRCR
intro: OpenAI MRCR（多轮共指消解）通过合成长多轮写作对话，测试模型能否从同分布干扰项中按顺序找回第 i 个目标回答。数据覆盖2、4、8个针和八个4K至1M词元长度桶，每个组合100条，共2,400条；回答须先输出指定随机前缀，再以 Python SequenceMatcher 与标准文本计算相似度。
build_method: 合成长对话, GPT-4o生成回答
task_type: 开放式问答, 多轮对话
eval_feature: 2/4/8个针, 八个长度桶, 前缀门控
build_method_en: Synthetic Conversation Generation, GPT-4o Responses
eval_feature_en: 2/4/8 needles, eight length bins, prefix gate
intro_en: OpenAI MRCR (Multi-round Coreference Resolution) uses synthetic long multi-turn writing conversations to test whether a model can retrieve the i-th target response among same-distribution distractors. It covers 2, 4, and 8 needles across eight 4K-to-1M-token bins with 100 samples per combination, for 2,400 total; the response must start with a required random prefix before Python SequenceMatcher compares it with the gold text.

name: MSEarthMCQ
intro: MSEarthMCQ 是 MSEarth 地球科学多模态基准的多项选择子集。它从40万余篇论文中抽取图像、原始图注和正文证据，由 GPT-4o 生成精炼图注与候选问题，再经五模型及 70B+ 模型参与的三阶段投票和地球科学硕士专家验证，最终保留2,784道覆盖五大地球圈层的图像落地问题。
org: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 论文挖掘, 多智能体生成筛选, 专家验证
task_type: 地球科学多项选择问答
eval_feature: 论文证据, 三阶段多模型投票, 专家验证
build_method_en: Paper Mining, Multi-agent Generation and Filtering, Expert Validation
eval_feature_en: Paper evidence, three-phase model voting, expert validation
intro_en: MSEarthMCQ is the multiple-choice subset of the MSEarth multimodal Earth-science benchmark. It mines figures, original captions, and supporting text from more than 400K papers; GPT-4o generates refined captions and candidate questions, followed by three-phase voting with five-model and 70B-plus-model stages and validation by master's-level Earth-science experts.
