intro: SaladBench是一个针对LLM及其攻击防御方法的安全评测基准，规模大、类别丰富、层级复杂且功能多样。它引入了基于LLM的多维评审器MD-Judge，专注于攻击增强查询的问答对，以确保评测的高效与可靠。
metric: Attack Success Rate, Safety Score, LLM-as-Judge
task_type: 开放式问答, 安全测试
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: SaladBench is a security evaluation benchmark for LLMs and their attack-defense methods, featuring large scale, diverse categories, complex hierarchy, and versatile functions. It introduces the LLM-based multidimensional evaluator MD-Judge, focusing on attack-enhanced query QA pairs to ensure efficient and reliable assessment.
metric_en: Attack Success Rate, Safety Score, LLM-as-Judge

name: Sandbagging QA
intro: Sandbagging QA 是 OpenAI 系统卡中的安全评测，用于检测模型在被激励低表现时是否故意压低问答准确率。
task_type: 安全评测, 沙袋行为检测
intro_en: Sandbagging QA is a safety evaluation in OpenAI system cards for detecting whether models intentionally underperform on QA when incentivized to do so.

name: ScanBench
intro: ScanBench是一个用于评估医疗增强型大型语言模型（LLM）的基准测试。它旨在从被动问答转向主动的临床级决策支持，通过模拟医生的系统工作流程来解决现有系统在开放式咨询中的局限性。该基准测试评估LLM在主动信息获取、长程推理和自适应幻觉抑制方面的能力。
metric: Overall Accuracy, Clinical Inquiry, Advisory, Safety
eval_feature: 主动信息获取, 长程推理, 幻觉抑制
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Active Information Acquisition, Long-range Reasoning, Hallucination Suppression
intro_en: ScanBench is a benchmark for evaluating medical-enhanced large language models (LLMs). It aims to shift from passive Q&A to proactive clinical-grade decision support by simulating doctors' systematic workflows, addressing limitations of existing systems in open-ended consultations. The benchmark assesses LLMs' abilities in active information retrieval, long-range reasoning, and adaptive hallucination suppression.
metric_en: Overall Accuracy, Clinical Inquiry, Advisory, Safety

name: SceneBench
intro: SceneBench 是 LongCat-Image 报告中与 Poster 任务一起构建的场景文字生成 benchmark，用于评估自然场景文字渲染。
task_type: 图像生成, 文字渲染
intro_en: SceneBench is a scene-text generation benchmark curated by the LongCat-Image report together with poster tasks to evaluate natural-scene text rendering.

name: SciCode
intro: SciCode是一个由科学家策划的编码基准，旨在评估语言模型解决真实科学研究问题的能力。该基准包含从80个主要问题分解出的338个子问题，涵盖数学、物理、化学、生物学和材料科学等16个不同的自然科学子领域。它提供了可选的科学背景信息以及科学家标注的黄金标准解决方案和测试用例。在最真实的设置下，目前最先进的模型Claude3.5-Sonnet只能解决4.6%的问题，表明该基准具有挑战性，并为未来科学AI的发展提供了方向。
org: Argonne National Laboratory, Carnegie Mellon University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Prin
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
eval_feature: 思维链, 过程评估
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Process Evaluation
intro_en: SciCode is a coding benchmark curated by scientists to evaluate language models' ability to solve real scientific research problems. It consists of 338 subproblems derived from 80 main problems, covering 16 natural science subfields including mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, and materials science. The benchmark provides optional scientific background information along with scientist-annotated gold standard solutions and test cases. Under the most realistic settings, the state-of-the-art model Claude3.5-Sonnet can only solve 4.6% of the problems, highlighting the benchmark's challenge and guiding future development in scientific AI.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.13168 and the official SciCode repository. Scientists contribute internal research scripts from 16 natural-science subfields and decompose 80 main problems into 338 ordered subproblems with explicit input-output docstrings. The development split has 15 main and 50 subproblems; the test split has 65 main and 288 subproblems. Scientist gold solutions use common documented NumPy, SciPy, or SymPy functionality. Numerical tests and domain-specific workflows reproduce published results or analytical theory. Three validation rounds combine at least two in-domain scientists, one out-of-domain scientist, and GPT-4 generation followed by scientist failure analysis and test redesign. The standard setting omits background and carries generated prior solutions forward; a main problem passes only when every subproblem and the integrated main solution pass. Pass@1 is reported at main and subproblem levels.

name: ScienceQA
intro: ScienceQA 是 OLMo 报告中的科学问答数据集，覆盖论文内容问答和引用图谱问答等需要检索与推理的任务。
task_type: 科学问答, 检索推理
intro_en: ScienceQA is a science QA dataset in OLMo reports, covering paper-content and citation-graph questions requiring retrieval and reasoning.

name: Scientists' First Exam
intro: Scientists' First Exam (SFE)基准旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的科学认知能力。它通过科学信号感知、科学属性理解和科学比较推理三个相互关联的层面进行评估。SFE包含830个经过专家验证的VQA对，涵盖五大学科的66个多模态任务，旨在弥补现有科学基准在感知和推理能力评估方面的不足。
build_method: 专家构建
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 多模态, 科学推理
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Multimodal, Scientific reasoning
intro_en: The Scientists' First Exam (SFE) benchmark aims to evaluate the scientific cognition abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It assesses three interconnected aspects: scientific signal perception, scientific attribute understanding, and scientific comparative reasoning. SFE includes 830 expert-verified VQA pairs covering 66 multimodal tasks across five major disciplines, designed to address the shortcomings of existing scientific benchmarks in evaluating perception and reasoning capabilities.

name: ScreenSpot
intro: ScreenSpot-Pro是一个新的基准测试，旨在严格评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在专业高分辨率环境中的GUI（图形用户界面）接地能力。该基准包含来自多个专业领域的真实高分辨率图像，并附有专家标注。它涵盖了五大行业和三个操作系统中的23个应用程序。现有GUI接地模型在该数据集上的表现不佳，最佳模型仅达到18.9%。
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: High resolution, Small targets, Complex environment
intro_en: ScreenSpot-Pro is a new benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the GUI grounding capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in professional high-resolution environments. It includes real high-resolution images from multiple specialized fields, annotated by experts. The benchmark covers 23 applications across five major industries and three operating systems. Existing GUI grounding models perform poorly on this dataset, with the best model achieving only 18.9%.

name: ScreenSpot-v2
intro: ScreenSpot-v2 是 Seed1.5-VL、Phi-4-reasoning-vision 和 LongCat-Omni 报告中使用的 GUI grounding 评测变体，用于评估模型在截图中定位界面元素的能力。
intro_en: ScreenSpot-v2 is a GUI grounding benchmark variant used by Seed1.5-VL, Phi-4-reasoning-vision, and LongCat-Omni reports to evaluate element localization on screenshots.

name: SD-QA
intro: SD-QA 是 Qwen-Omni、LongCat-Omni、MiniCPM-o 和 ERNIE 5.0 报告中使用的问答评测项。
intro_en: SD-QA is a QA evaluation item used by Qwen-Omni, LongCat-Omni, MiniCPM-o, and ERNIE 5.0 reports.

name: SealQA
intro: SealQA是一个新的挑战性基准测试，旨在评估搜索增强型语言模型在事实查询问题上的推理能力。该基准测试的特点是网络搜索结果可能存在冲突、噪音或无用信息。它包含Seal-0、Seal-Hard和LongSeal三种类型，分别侧重于事实准确性、推理能力以及长上下文、多文档推理。
eval_feature: 防污染, 思维链, 过程评估
build_method_en: Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Chain-of-Thought, Process evaluation
intro_en: SealQA is a new challenging benchmark designed to evaluate the reasoning ability of search-augmented language models on factual query tasks. It features web search results that may contain conflicts, noise, or irrelevant information. The benchmark includes three types: Seal-0, Seal-Hard, and LongSeal, focusing respectively on factual accuracy, reasoning ability, and long-context, multi-document reasoning.

name: SecCodeBench
intro: SecCodeBench 是 Qwen3-Coder-Next 报告中用于安全代码任务的 benchmark，关注 Java 等代码漏洞修复。
intro_en: SecCodeBench is a secure-coding benchmark referenced by Qwen3-Coder-Next reports, focusing on vulnerability repair tasks such as Java code fixes.

name: SeqQA
intro: SeqQA 是 LAB-Bench 中的 DNA 序列操作评测，用于生物研究相关技能评估。
intro_en: SeqQA is a DNA-sequence manipulation evaluation within LAB-Bench for biology research skills.

name: Sequential-NIAH
intro: Sequential-NIAH是一个专门用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）从长上下文中提取有序信息项（即“针”）能力的基准测试。该基准测试包含三种“针”的生成方式，上下文长度从8K到128K不等，共计14000个样本。为了评估模型表现，研究者训练了一个评估模型，通过比较答案的完整性和顺序一致性来打分，提供了比GPT-4或Claude更可靠的评估指标。
org: Zhejiang University, Ant Group, Tencent Youtu Lab, Beihang University, Cornell University
eval_feature: 长文本, 防污染
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Contamination-free
intro_en: Sequential-NIAH is a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) ability to extract ordered information items ("needles") from long contexts. It includes three types of "needle" generation methods, with context lengths ranging from 8K to 128K tokens, totaling 14,000 samples. To assess model performance, researchers trained an evaluation model that scores based on answer completeness and order consistency, providing a more reliable metric than GPT-4 or Claude.

name: SFE
intro: SFE 是 Intern-S1 报告中与 ChemBench、MatBench 一起使用的科学 domain benchmark，用于评估科学知识与推理。
intro_en: SFE is a science-domain benchmark used in Intern-S1 reports alongside ChemBench and MatBench for evaluating scientific knowledge and reasoning.

name: SHADE-Arena
intro: SHADE-Arena是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）代理在复杂和长期任务中执行隐蔽破坏和监控能力的基准测试。它包含复杂的良性主任务和有害的次要目标对，代理需要在不引起LLM监控器怀疑的情况下完成次要任务。该基准测试旨在衡量LLM代理规避监控和实现有害隐藏目标的能力，并评估监控模型检测此类行为的能力。
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Process evaluation
intro_en: SHADE-Arena is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents' ability to perform covert sabotage and surveillance in complex, long-term tasks. It includes intricate benign primary tasks paired with harmful secondary objectives, where agents must complete the secondary tasks without raising suspicion from LLM monitors. The benchmark aims to measure LLM agents' capability to evade monitoring and achieve harmful hidden goals, as well as to assess monitoring models' effectiveness in detecting such behaviors.

name: SimpleQA
intro: SimpleQA是一个由OpenAI开发的事实性问答基准，旨在评估大型语言模型回答简短、事实明确问题的能力。该基准通过对抗性方式收集，针对GPT-4的回答进行设计，确保问题具有单一且无争议的答案，从而简化评分。SimpleQA旨在测试模型是否能识别其知识边界，避免对不确定的问题做出猜测性回答。
build_method: 人工出题, 四模型对抗筛选, 独立双人答案验证
metric: 总体正确率, 尝试题正确率, F-score
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证
eval_feature: 对抗性
build_method_en: Human question writing, four-model adversarial filtering, independent two-trainer verification
eval_feature_en: Adversarial
intro_en: SimpleQA is a factual question-answering benchmark developed by OpenAI to evaluate large language models' ability to answer short, fact-based questions. Collected adversarially and designed against GPT-4's responses, it ensures questions have a single, unambiguous answer to simplify scoring. SimpleQA aims to test whether models can recognize their knowledge boundaries and avoid guessing on uncertain questions.
metric_en: Overall correct, Correct given attempted, F-score

name: SimpleQA Verified
intro: SimpleQA Verified 是 Google/Claude 报告中提到的 SimpleQA 变体，用于更可靠的事实性问答评估。
intro_en: SimpleQA Verified is a SimpleQA variant referenced by Google and Claude reports for more reliable factual question-answering evaluation.

name: SimpleVQA
intro: SimpleVQA是首个全面的多模态基准测试，旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）回答自然语言简短问题的真实性能力。它涵盖多任务和多场景，确保高质量和具有挑战性的查询，并维护静态和永恒的参考答案。该基准将视觉问答项目分为9个围绕客观事件或常识的不同任务，并置于9个主题中。通过严格的质量控制和LLM作为评判的评分系统，SimpleVQA对MLLMs的图像理解和文本生成能力进行全面评估。
build_method: 人工标注, 自动生成
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Automated Generation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Zero-shot
intro_en: SimpleVQA is the first comprehensive multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate the factual accuracy of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in answering natural language short questions. It covers multiple tasks and scenarios, ensuring high-quality and challenging queries while maintaining static and permanent reference answers. The benchmark divides visual question answering into 9 tasks focused on objective events or common sense, organized into 9 themes. Through strict quality control and an LLM-based scoring system, SimpleVQA provides a thorough assessment of MLLMs' image understanding and text generation capabilities.

name: SingleCellBench
intro: SingleCellBench 是 Claude 系统卡中 BioPipelineBench 相关的单细胞生物信息学评测变体，用于测试模型分析单细胞结果并回答生物学问题的能力。
task_type: 生物信息学问答, 数据分析
intro_en: SingleCellBench is a single-cell bioinformatics evaluation variant associated with BioPipelineBench in Claude system cards, testing model analysis of single-cell results and biological questions.

name: SkillGenBench
intro: SkillGenBench 是一个用于评估 LLM Agent 技能生成流水线的基准。它将原始仓库或长文档交给生成器，要求生成标准化的 SKILL.md 工件，再在固定 harness 中执行并用统一评测流程判断技能是否正确、可复用且可执行，覆盖任务可见与任务不可见两种生成设置。
build_method: 仓库与文档源构建, 固定harness执行, 确定性检查
modality: 文本, 代码, 文档
task_type: Agent技能生成, 工具使用, 过程执行
eval_feature: 技能生成, 仓库理解, 文档理解, 执行验证
scale: 2种生成设置, 2类程序源, 5种生成方法
task_type_en: Agent skill generation, Tool use, Procedure execution
build_method_en: Repository and document source construction, fixed-harness execution, deterministic checks
eval_feature_en: Skill generation, repository understanding, document understanding, execution verification
intro_en: SkillGenBench evaluates skill-generation pipelines for LLM agents. A generator receives raw repositories or long documents, produces standardized SKILL.md artifacts, and the generated skills are executed under fixed harnesses and assessed with unified procedures for correctness, reusability, and executability across task-conditioned and task-agnostic generation settings.
scale_en: 2 generation regimes, 2 procedural source types, 5 generation methods

name: SkillsBench
intro: SkillsBench 是一个评估 Agent Skills 实际增益的基准，使用跨领域任务、专家整理的 Skills 和确定性验证器来衡量技能包对代理完成任务的帮助程度。
org: BenchFlow, Ohio State University, Amazon, Dartmouth College, Stanford University, UC Davis, Carnegie Mellon University, UC Berkeley, and collaborators
build_method: 专家任务构建, 技能包整理, 确定性验证器
eval_feature: 技能使用, 确定性验证, 全轨迹记录
intro_en: SkillsBench benchmarks whether agent skills actually improve task completion. It pairs cross-domain tasks with curated skills and deterministic verifiers, and evaluates no-skill, curated-skill, and self-generated-skill settings.
build_method_en: Expert task construction, skill-package curation, deterministic verifiers
eval_feature_en: Skill Usage, Deterministic Verification, Full Trajectory Logging

name: SocialIQA
intro: SocialIQA 是 Gemma 和 OLMo 3 报告中使用的社会常识问答 benchmark，用于评估模型对人物意图、反应和社会情境的推理能力。
build_method: ATOMIC事件改写, 众包问答与双路负例, 人工多数验证
build_method_en: ATOMIC event rewriting, crowdsourced QA with two negative branches, human majority validation
intro_en: SocialIQA is a social commonsense QA benchmark used by Gemma and OLMo 3 reports to evaluate reasoning about intent, reactions, and social situations.

name: SoMe
intro: SoMe是一个开创性的基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）在社交媒体场景中的能力。该基准包含8个社交媒体代理任务，超过900万条帖子和17,869条精细标注的任务查询，提供了一个多样化且真实的平台。SoMe旨在全面评估社交媒体代理在理解媒体内容、用户行为和做出复杂决策方面的能力。研究表明，无论是闭源还是开源的LLM在处理这些任务时都存在局限性，因此SoMe为未来的社交媒体代理提供了一个富有挑战性的测试平台。
org: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
build_method: 网络爬取, 人工标注, 混合
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 多轮, 领域特定
build_method_en: Web Crawling, Human Annotation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Dynamic, Real-time, Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: SoMe is a pioneering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) capabilities in social media scenarios. It includes 8 social media agent tasks, over 9 million posts, and 17,869 finely annotated task queries, offering a diverse and realistic platform. SoMe aims to comprehensively assess social media agents' abilities in understanding media content, user behavior, and making complex decisions. Studies show that both closed-source and open-source LLMs have limitations in handling these tasks, making SoMe a challenging testbed for future social media agents.

name: SpatialBench Verified
intro: SpatialBench Verified 是 Claude 系统卡中 BioPipelineBench 相关的空间转录组学分析评测变体，要求模型根据空间生物学分析结果回答问题。
task_type: 生物信息学问答, 数据分析
intro_en: SpatialBench Verified is a spatial transcriptomics analysis variant associated with BioPipelineBench in Claude system cards, requiring models to answer biological questions from spatial analysis results.

name: SPEED-Bench
intro: SPEED-Bench 是 Nemotron 3 Super 报告中用于 speculative decoding 和多 token prediction 质量评估的 benchmark。
eval_feature: Speculative decoding
eval_feature_en: Speculative decoding
intro_en: SPEED-Bench is a benchmark used by the Nemotron 3 Super report for evaluating speculative decoding and multi-token-prediction quality.

name: Spider 2.0
intro: Spider 2.0 是一个包含632个真实企业级数据库文本转SQL工作流问题的评测框架。数据库来自实际应用，常含1000多列，存储于本地或云端如BigQuery和Snowflake。挑战要求模型处理复杂SQL环境、长上下文、多条SQL语句及复杂推理，远超传统文本转SQL任务。
org: xlang.ai, The University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory,
build_method: 专家构建, 混合
eval_feature: 长文本, 多轮, 领域特定
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: Spider 2.0 is a benchmark consisting of 632 real-world enterprise-level database text-to-SQL workflow problems. The databases originate from practical applications, often containing over 1,000 columns, stored locally or in the cloud such as BigQuery and Snowflake. The challenge requires models to handle complex SQL environments, long contexts, multiple SQL statements, and intricate reasoning, far exceeding traditional text-to-SQL tasks.
scale_en: 632 agentic workflows; 547 tasks each in Lite and Snow
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.07763v2 and the official Spider 2.0 repository. Source material spans 213 enterprise databases and a candidate pool of 1,021 complex SQL queries plus 157 DBT projects; 547 SQL queries and 78 DBT projects are retained only after successful, timely, non-empty execution. Those retained source artifacts are not presented as an arithmetic derivation of the 632 released agentic workflows. To reduce contamination, 84.2% receive surface rewrites and 42.0% semantic rewrites, followed by re-execution. Tasks bundle dialect documentation, database interfaces, codebase context, and manually verified instructions. Focused string, table, or database evaluators ignore irrelevant columns and are red-teamed; each instruction, gold SQL, and evaluator is reviewed by at least three annotators. Spider 2.0 reports binary Success Rate over 632 agentic workflows, while the 547-task Lite and Snow variants report Execution Accuracy.

name: SpreadsheetBench
intro: SpreadsheetBench是一个具有挑战性的电子表格操作基准，完全来源于真实世界的场景，旨在让当前的大型语言模型（LLMs）沉浸在电子表格用户的实际工作流程中。与依赖合成查询和简化电子表格文件的现有基准不同，SpreadsheetBench由从在线Excel论坛收集的912个真实问题构建而成，这些问题反映了用户错综复杂的需求。相关的电子表格包含多种表格数据，如多表、非标准关系表和丰富的非文本元素。此外，我们提出了一种更可靠的评估指标，类似于在线评测平台，为每个指令创建多个电子表格文件作为测试用例，确保评估能够处理不同值的电子表格的鲁棒解决方案。我们对各种LLMs在单轮和多轮推理设置下的综合评估揭示了最先进（SOTA）模型与人类表现之间存在巨大差距，突显了基准的难度。
org: Renmin University of China, Tsinghua University
eval_feature: 真实世界场景, 鲁棒性评估
build_method_en: Web Crawling
eval_feature_en: Real-world scenarios, Robustness evaluation
intro_en: SpreadsheetBench is a challenging spreadsheet operation benchmark entirely derived from real-world scenarios, designed to immerse current large language models (LLMs) in the actual workflows of spreadsheet users. Unlike existing benchmarks that rely on synthetic queries and simplified spreadsheet files, SpreadsheetBench is built from 912 real questions collected from online Excel forums, reflecting users' complex needs. The associated spreadsheets contain diverse tabular data, including multi-sheet, non-standard relational tables, and rich non-text elements. Additionally, we propose a more reliable evaluation metric, similar to online testing platforms, by creating multiple spreadsheet files as test cases for each instruction to ensure the assessment can handle robust solutions across spreadsheets with varying values. Our comprehensive evaluation of various LLMs under single-turn and multi-turn reasoning settings reveals a significant gap between state-of-the-art (SOTA) models and human performance, highlighting the benchmark’s difficulty.

name: SQuAD
intro: SQuAD 是经典阅读理解问答 benchmark，OLMo 报告中与 DROP、CoQA 等 QA 任务一起出现。
build_method: Wikipedia筛选, 众包标注, 多答案复标
build_method_en: Wikipedia curation, crowdsourcing, multi-answer re-annotation
intro_en: SQuAD is a classic reading-comprehension QA benchmark referenced by OLMo reports together with DROP and CoQA.

name: ST-VQA
intro: ST-VQA 是 LongCat-Next 报告中出现的场景文字视觉问答 benchmark，用于测试模型读取图像中文字并回答问题的能力。
intro_en: ST-VQA is a scene-text visual QA benchmark appearing in the LongCat-Next report for reading text in images and answering questions.

name: StableToolBench
intro: StableToolBench是一个旨在解决工具学习基准不稳定问题的项目。它通过引入虚拟API服务器和稳定的评估系统，在ToolBench的基础上进行了改进。虚拟API服务器结合了缓存系统和API模拟器，以减轻API状态变化带来的影响；而稳定的评估系统则利用GPT-4作为自动评估器，设计了可解的通过率和获胜率，以消除评估过程中的随机性。
eval_feature: 虚拟API服务器, 稳定评估系统
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Virtual API server, Stability evaluation system
intro_en: StableToolBench is a project aimed at addressing the instability issues in tool learning benchmarks. It improves upon ToolBench by introducing a virtual API server and a stable evaluation system. The virtual API server combines a caching system and an API simulator to mitigate the impact of API state changes, while the stable evaluation system uses GPT-4 as an automatic evaluator and designs solvable pass rates and win rates to eliminate randomness in the evaluation process.

name: Step-Audio-Edit
intro: Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark 是一个用于可控语音合成的综合评测框架，专注于情感、说话风格和副语言等细粒度属性。该基准随 Step-Audio-EditX 模型一同发布，后者是一个基于大语言模型的音频编辑模型。此评测框架的提出旨在解决现有评测方法在全面性上的不足。
build_method: LLM生成, 混合
build_method_en: LLM Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific
intro_en: Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark is a comprehensive evaluation framework for controllable speech synthesis, focusing on fine-grained attributes such as emotion, speaking style, and paralinguistics. The benchmark is released alongside the Step-Audio-EditX model, an audio editing model based on large language models. This evaluation framework aims to address the limitations of existing methods in terms of comprehensiveness.

name: StreamBench
intro: StreamBench 是 Seed1.5-VL 报告中用于流式视频理解的 benchmark，用于实时视频对话等场景评测。
intro_en: StreamBench is a streaming-video-understanding benchmark referenced by Seed1.5-VL reports for real-time video dialogue and related scenarios.

name: StreamingBench
intro: StreamingBench 是 Seed1.5-VL 报告中用于流式视频理解的评测，其 proactive 子任务被用于模型比较。
intro_en: StreamingBench is a streaming-video-understanding benchmark referenced by Seed1.5-VL reports, including proactive subtasks for model comparison.

name: StrongReject
intro: StrongREJECT是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击的基准。它旨在解决现有越狱研究中普遍存在的夸大攻击效果的问题，提供了一个包含特定、有害信息请求的标准化提示数据集。其核心是一个自动评估器，能够衡量模型响应中提供有害信息的程度，并与人类判断达到很高的吻合度，从而提供更准确、更稳健的越狱有效性评估。
org: Center for Human-Compatible AI, UC Berkeley
build_method: 人工构建, LLM生成
eval_feature: 对抗性, Jailbreak
build_method_en: Manually constructed, LLM Generation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Jailbreak
intro_en: StrongREJECT is a benchmark for evaluating jailbreak attacks on large language models (LLMs). It aims to address the common issue of exaggerated attack effectiveness in existing jailbreak research by providing a standardized prompt dataset containing specific harmful information requests. At its core is an automatic evaluator that measures the extent of harmful information in model responses and achieves high alignment with human judgments, offering a more accurate and robust assessment of jailbreak effectiveness.

name: Sudoku-Bench
intro: Sudoku-Bench 是 LongCat-Flash-Thinking 报告中与 ZebraLogic、ARC-AGI 一起使用的逻辑推理 benchmark。
intro_en: Sudoku-Bench is a logical reasoning benchmark used in LongCat-Flash-Thinking reports alongside ZebraLogic and ARC-AGI.

name: SUPERChem
intro: SUPERChem是一个具有挑战性的、由专家策划的多模态基准测试，旨在严格评估大型语言模型（LLMs）和多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的化学推理能力。它包含500个专家策划的推理密集型化学问题，涵盖不同子领域，并以多模态和纯文本格式提供。该基准测试引入了推理路径保真度（RPF）评分，以评估模型推理的质量，超越了最终答案的准确性。
build_method: 专家构建, 混合
eval_feature: 多模态, 过程评估, 防污染
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Multimodal, Process evaluation, Contamination-free
intro_en: SUPERChem is a challenging, expert-curated multimodal benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the chemical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It contains 500 expert-curated, reasoning-intensive chemistry questions covering various subfields, presented in both multimodal and pure text formats. The benchmark introduces a Reasoning Path Fidelity (RPF) score to assess the quality of model reasoning beyond final answer accuracy.

name: SuperGPQA
intro: SuperGPQA 是一个全面的评测基准，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）在285个研究生级别学科中的知识和推理能力。该基准通过人机协同过滤机制，消除了简单或模棱两可的问题，从而揭示了当前最先进的LLM在不同知识领域中的性能仍有显著提升空间。SuperGPQA的构建过程涉及80多位专家标注员和一个人机协作系统，为未来大规模研究项目提供了方法论指导。
build_method: 专家构建, LLM生成, 混合
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
build_method_en: Expert Curation, LLM Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Domain-specific, Contamination-free
intro_en: SuperGPQA is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) knowledge and reasoning abilities across 285 graduate-level disciplines. Using a human-AI collaborative filtering mechanism, it eliminates simple or ambiguous questions, revealing significant room for improvement in state-of-the-art LLMs across various knowledge domains. The construction of SuperGPQA involved over 80 expert annotators and a human-AI collaboration system, providing methodological guidance for future large-scale research projects.

name: SWE-bench
intro: SWE-bench是一个用于评估大型语言模型解决真实世界GitHub问题能力的基准测试。它从12个流行的Python代码库中收集了2294个软件工程问题，每个问题都配有对应的拉取请求和测试补丁。该基准旨在衡量模型在理解代码库、定位问题和生成正确修复方面的能力。
build_method: GitHub PR抓取, 属性过滤, 执行验证
eval_feature: 真实Issue修复, 长代码上下文, 可执行测试验证
build_method_en: GitHub PR scraping, attribute filtering, execution validation
eval_feature_en: Real issue resolution, long code context, executable test validation
intro_en: SWE-bench is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to solve real-world GitHub issues. It collects 2,294 software engineering problems from 12 popular Python repositories, each paired with corresponding pull requests and test patches. The benchmark aims to assess models' capabilities in understanding codebases, identifying issues, and generating correct fixes.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.06770 / ICLR 2024. The three-stage construction starts from about 90,000 pull requests across 12 popular repositories with more than 90% Python code. It retains merged PRs that resolve an issue and change tests, separates the pre-PR codebase, issue text, test patch, and gold patch, then executes tests before and after the gold patch. Candidates must install and run successfully, contain at least one FAIL_TO_PASS transition, and not rely on tests invoking newly introduced functions or classes. The resulting 2,294 tasks provide issue text and a codebase while hiding tests; a generated patch resolves an instance only if it applies and all FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests succeed.

name: SWE-bench Lite
intro: SWE-bench Lite 是从 SWE-bench 可执行任务中筛选出的轻量子集，聚焦较自包含的真实 GitHub 功能缺陷修复。评测系统获得 Issue 与基线仓库，生成补丁，并以 Fail-to-Pass 与 Pass-to-Pass 测试共同判定是否解决实例。
build_method: GitHub Issue-PR采集, 可执行F2P验证, Lite内容与范围过滤
task_type: 软件工程, 代码修复
build_method_en: GitHub Issue-PR Collection, Executable F2P Validation, Lite Content and Scope Filtering
intro_en: SWE-bench Lite is a smaller subset selected from executable SWE-bench tasks and focused on more self-contained real GitHub functional bug fixes. Systems receive an issue and base repository, generate a patch, and resolve an instance only when both fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass tests succeed.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the ICLR 2024 SWE-bench paper arXiv:2310.06770 and the dedicated official SWE-bench Lite page. The full construction starts from 93,139 PRs across 12 popular Python repositories, keeps 11,407 merged PRs that resolve an issue and modify tests, then executes test patches before and after code patches to require at least one fail-to-pass transition and remove installation/runtime failures, yielding 2,294 full tasks. Lite removes images, external links, commit SHAs, cross-PR/issue references, and statements under 40 words. It also requires at most one edited file and three gold-patch hunks, forbids file creation/deletion, and removes tests that assert error messages. The dedicated Lite release samples 300 test and 23 development instances across 11 repositories. Evaluation gives the issue and base codebase, accepts any applicable diff solution, and marks an instance resolved only when all fail-to-pass tests now pass and all pass-to-pass tests remain passing.

name: SWE-Bench Pro
intro: SWE-Bench Pro 是一个面向长周期、复杂软件工程任务的基准，包含 41 个活跃专业代码库中的 1,865 个问题：731 个公开问题、276 个商业问题和 858 个隔离保留问题。任务由连续提交对构建，人工补充问题陈述、行为需求和可选接口信息，并经专业工程师 Docker 环境、重复执行与 F2P/P2P 测试复核后进入 Pass@1 评测。
build_method: 代码库分层采样、人工任务增补、Docker 与测试复核
eval_feature: 防污染、长周期、多文件、人工测试复核
scale: 1,865 个问题，41 个仓库（公开 731、商业 276、隔离保留 858）
build_method_en: Repository-Stratified Sampling, Human Task Augmentation, Docker and Test Review
eval_feature_en: Contamination-Aware, Long-Horizon, Multi-File, Human-Reviewed Tests
intro_en: SWE-Bench Pro targets long-horizon, complex software engineering with 1,865 problems from 41 active professional repositories: 731 public, 276 commercial, and 858 held-out. Tasks are built from consecutive commit pairs, augmented with human-written problem statements, behavioral requirements, and optional interface details, then verified through professional Docker setup, repeated execution, and human-reviewed F2P/P2P tests before Pass@1 evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.16941 Sections 2-3. The diagram preserves the contamination-aware public, commercial, and held-out repository sources; substantial 50-100 task cap per repository; consecutive-commit base, gold, and test patch construction; human-written behavioral requirements; professional Docker setup; repeated flaky-test removal; and human review of F2P relevance and breadth. The final split counts sum exactly to 1,865 and evaluation uses the paper's unified SWE-Agent scaffold, 50-turn budget, human-reviewed F2P/P2P tests, and Pass@1 resolve rate.

name: SWE-bench Verified
intro: SWE-bench Verified 是SWE-bench的一个人工筛选子集，包含500个实例，由OpenAI合作创建。人工标注者确保问题描述清晰、测试补丁正确且任务可解，提升了原版SWE-bench的可靠性。
build_method: 专业开发者人工审查, 问题描述与测试质量筛选
eval_feature: 人工验证可解性, 测试补丁复核, 容器化执行评测
build_method_en: Professional-developer review, problem-statement and test-quality filtering
eval_feature_en: Human-validated solvability, test-patch review, containerized execution
intro_en: SWE-bench Verified is a manually curated subset of SWE-bench containing 500 instances, created in collaboration with OpenAI. Human annotators ensure clear problem descriptions, correct test patches, and solvable tasks, enhancing the reliability of the original SWE-bench.
drawio_review_note: The task and evaluation contract follows arXiv:2310.06770, while Verified-specific construction is aligned with the official SWE-bench page and OpenAI's August 2024 release because Verified is a later curated subset, not part of the original paper. Ninety-three Python-experienced professional developers manually screened 1,699 random SWE-bench test samples for underspecified issue descriptions, inappropriate FAIL_TO_PASS tests, and task solvability. Problematic or infeasible samples were removed to release 500 human-validated tasks with difficulty annotations. Evaluation keeps issue text and tests separate, runs generated patches in the containerized harness, and requires both FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS tests to succeed.

name: SWE-bench-Live
intro: SWE-bench-Live 是一个面向持续更新的软件工程基准。首次发布包含 93 个开源 Python 仓库中的 1,319 个任务，Issue 创建时间为 2024 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 4 月 20 日。它通过 GitHub Issue-PR 挖掘、REPOLAUNCH 自动构建实例级 Docker 环境，并重复验证 FAIL_TO_PASS 与 PASS_TO_PASS 转换，以提供时新且可复现的补丁评测。
build_method: Issue-PR 自动挖掘、REPOLAUNCH Docker 构建、重复执行过滤
eval_feature: 时新数据、自动环境构建、重复稳定性验证
scale: 1,319 个任务，93 个开源 Python 仓库
build_method_en: Automated Issue-PR Mining, REPOLAUNCH Docker Construction, Repeated Execution Filtering
eval_feature_en: Fresh Data, Automated Environment Construction, Repeated Stability Validation
intro_en: SWE-bench-Live is designed for continuously refreshed software engineering evaluation. Its initial release contains 1,319 tasks from 93 open-source Python repositories, with issues created between January 1, 2024 and April 20, 2025. The pipeline mines GitHub issue-PR pairs, uses REPOLAUNCH to build instance-level Docker environments, and repeatedly validates FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS transitions for fresh, reproducible patch evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.23419 Sections 3.1-3.4. The diagram includes the exact repository funnel, issue-resolving pull requests with test-suite changes, January 1 2024 through April 20 2025 freshness window, REPOLAUNCH repository inspection, interactive ReAct setup, verifier refinement, instance-level Docker finalization, and repeated transition validation. The first release count is 1,319 tasks across 93 Python repositories; monthly updates are described by the paper as a plan rather than asserted as an already-running schedule.

name: SWE-Evo
intro: SWE-Evo 评测编码智能体能否根据发布说明和关联 PR/Issue 上下文完成发布级软件演进。它从 SWE-bench 与 SWE-gym 的可执行种子中选择连续版本标签，经 FAIL_TO_PASS 执行过滤和人工质量复核，形成 7 个 Python 仓库中的 48 个任务；每题平均修改 21 个文件并运行 874 个测试，以问题解决率、补丁应用率和修复率同时衡量完整解决与无回归的部分进展。
org: FPT Software AI Center, University of Melbourne, Marvis AI
build_method: 版本发布转换挖掘、执行式过滤、人工质量复核
metric: Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, Fix Rate
task_type: 代码生成, Agent任务, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 发布级长周期演进、多文件修改、部分进展评分
scale: 48 个发布级任务，7 个 Python 仓库，平均修改 21 个文件、运行 874 个测试
task_type_en: Code Generation, Agent Task, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Release-Transition Mining, Execution Filtering, Human Quality Review
eval_feature_en: Release-Level Long-Horizon Evolution, Multi-File Changes, Partial-Progress Scoring
intro_en: SWE-Evo evaluates whether coding agents can complete release-level software evolution from release notes and explicitly linked PR/issue context. It selects consecutive version-tag transitions from executable SWE-bench and SWE-gym seeds, applies FAIL_TO_PASS execution filtering and human quality review, and retains 48 tasks from seven Python repositories. Each task edits 21 files and runs 874 tests on average; Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, and Fix Rate measure complete solutions and regression-free partial progress.
scale_en: 48 release-sized tasks, 7 Python repositories, 21 files and 874 tests per task on average
metric_en: Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, Fix Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.18470 Sections 3.1-3.2. The diagram starts from executable SWE-bench and SWE-gym seeds, selects base commits that exactly match version tags, defines the task from the delta to the next release note plus explicitly linked PR/issue text, separates the test and start-to-end gold patches, requires at least one FAIL_TO_PASS transition with no install/runtime error, and records the human alignment review that reduces hundreds of candidates to 48 tasks. Evaluation preserves Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, and regression-gated Fix Rate.

name: SWE-fficiency
intro: SWE-fficiency 评测编码智能体能否在真实工作负载上优化代码库性能，同时保持现有行为。它从 9 个数据科学、机器学习和 HPC Python 仓库中挖掘 498 个专家性能 PR，经关键词/AST 过滤、动态覆盖与静态符号解析、人工工作负载标注和受控执行验证；模型补丁须通过覆盖单元测试，再以相对专家加速效果的 Speedup Ratio 评分。
org: Harvard University, Google DeepMind, Princeton University, Xi'an Jiaotong University
build_method: 性能 PR 挖掘、覆盖测试定位、人工工作负载标注、受控执行过滤
task_type: 代码优化, 性能工程
eval_feature: 真实工作负载、正确性约束、专家归一化性能评分
scale: 498 个性能优化任务，9 个 Python 仓库
build_method_en: Performance-PR Mining, Covering-Test Localization, Manual Workload Annotation, Controlled Execution Filtering
eval_feature_en: Real Workloads, Correctness Constraints, Expert-Normalized Performance Scoring
intro_en: SWE-fficiency evaluates whether coding agents can optimize repository performance on real workloads while preserving existing behavior. It mines 498 expert performance pull requests from nine data-science, machine-learning, and HPC Python repositories, then applies keyword/AST filtering, dynamic coverage plus static symbol resolution, manual workload annotation, and controlled execution. Model patches must pass covering unit tests and are scored by Speedup Ratio relative to the expert optimization.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.06090 Section 2.1 and the evaluation metric definition. The diagram preserves all five stages: nine-repository PR mining; performance-keyword, no-test-change, and meaningful-AST filtering; covering-test discovery with pinned Docker, coverage.py, and static symbol resolution; manual performance-workload annotation; and controlled execution with resource pinning. Retained tasks require significant improvement above two measurement standard deviations and less than 0.5 percent SR drift, while evaluation requires covering tests to pass and aggregates expert-normalized Speedup Ratio with a harmonic mean.

name: SWE-Lancer
intro: SWE-Lancer 收录 1,488 个围绕 Expensify 代码库的真实 Upwork 软件工程任务，实际支付总额为 100 万美元。其中 764 个独立贡献者任务由模型生成代码补丁并接受隐藏 Playwright 端到端测试，724 个工程管理任务要求模型从至少两个候选方案中选择最佳方案；最终以 Pass@1、获得的总报酬和赚取率衡量经济价值。
build_method: Upwork 真实任务筛选、专业工程师复核、隐藏端到端测试
task_type: 代码生成, 补全, Agent任务
eval_feature: 真实经济价值、隐藏端到端测试、管理方案选择
scale: 1,488 个任务（IC 764、管理 724），真实报酬 100 万美元
build_method_en: Real Upwork Task Screening, Professional-Engineer Review, Hidden End-to-End Tests
eval_feature_en: Real Economic Value, Hidden End-to-End Tests, Management Proposal Selection
intro_en: SWE-Lancer contains 1,488 real Upwork software engineering tasks centered on the Expensify codebase, representing $1 million in actual payouts. For 764 individual-contributor tasks, models generate repository patches scored by hidden Playwright end-to-end tests; for 724 engineering-management tasks, models choose the best of at least two proposals. Economic performance is reported with Pass@1, total payout earned, and earn rate.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.12115 Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C. The diagram preserves the 1,488-task, $1M Upwork source; human eligibility and clarity review; separate 764-task individual-contributor and 724-task management branches; hidden Playwright end-to-end tests with three-round fixed/broken validation; offline Docker execution; proposal-choice grading; and economic reporting. Pass@1 is the primary setting, while pass@k appears only as an ablation in the paper.

name: SWE-PolyBench
intro: SWE-PolyBench 是一个多语言仓库级软件工程基准，包含来自 21 个仓库的 2,110 个实例，覆盖 Java、JavaScript、TypeScript 和 Python。任务由关闭 Issue 且包含测试代码的真实 PR 构建，经历史 Docker 环境、F2P/P2P 测试和可测试性过滤，并同时评测可执行解决率以及文件级、CST 节点级检索能力。
build_method: GitHub PR 挖掘、人工 Docker 配置、F2P/P2P 执行过滤
metric: Pass Rate, File/CST Retrieval Precision & Recall
eval_feature: 多语言、执行式评测、CST 结构检索
scale: 2,110 个实例，21 个仓库，4 种语言
build_method_en: GitHub PR Mining, Manual Docker Configuration, F2P/P2P Execution Filtering
eval_feature_en: Multilingual, Execution-Based, CST Structural Retrieval
intro_en: SWE-PolyBench is a multilingual repository-level software engineering benchmark with 2,110 instances from 21 repositories in Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. It mines real pull requests that close issues and add tests, validates them in historical Docker environments with F2P/P2P tests, and evaluates both executable resolution and file- and CST-node-level retrieval.
metric_en: Pass Rate, File/CST Retrieval Precision & Recall
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.08703 Sections 2-3. The diagram follows the four-language repository metadata filters, issue-closing PR and test-code requirement, manually configured historical Docker environments, gold/test patch split, F2P/P2P execution, and the requirement for at least one F2P test. It also records the paper's exclusion of tasks that test newly created files, LLM-assisted task and informativeness annotation, the 500-item stratified subset, and both execution and file/CST retrieval metrics.

name: SWE-Sharp-Bench
intro: SWE-Sharp-Bench 是一个面向 C#/.NET 的可复现软件工程基准，包含 17 个真实仓库中的 150 个 Issue 解决任务。构建流程从高星活跃仓库与已合并测试 PR 出发，自动解析工作流、解决方案和项目文件生成 Docker 环境，经基线/测试补丁/修复补丁三状态执行与两位作者复核后，使用 C# 专用提示词、单次两小时尝试和全部测试通过条件评测智能体。
build_method: C# PR 挖掘、.NET Docker 自动构建、三状态执行过滤、双人复核
eval_feature: C#/.NET、多测试框架、容器化可复现执行
scale: 150 个 Issue 解决任务，17 个 C# 仓库
build_method_en: C# PR Mining, Automated .NET Docker Construction, Three-State Execution Filtering, Dual Review
eval_feature_en: C#/.NET, Multiple Test Frameworks, Reproducible Container Execution
intro_en: SWE-Sharp-Bench is a reproducible C#/.NET software-engineering benchmark with 150 issue-resolution tasks from 17 real repositories. It selects high-star active repositories and merged test-changing pull requests, automatically derives Docker environments from workflow, solution, and project files, applies base/test/fix three-state execution and two-author review, then evaluates agents with C#-adapted prompts, one valid two-hour attempt, and an all-tests-pass criterion.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.02352 Sections III-A and IV plus Appendix B. The diagram preserves the top-100, 5,000-star, six-month activity, and build-viability repository filters; 1,000 latest PRs per repository with issue, test-file, and merge requirements; automated .NET Docker construction from workflow, solution, project, environment, and global configuration; base/test/test-plus-fix pass-fail-pass execution; and two-author checks for underspecified statements and inadequate tests. Evaluation uses C#-adapted SWE-Agent/OpenHands prompts, one valid attempt, a two-hour timeout, normalized NUnit/XUnit/MSTest logs, and all-tests-pass Resolution Rate.

name: SysBench
intro: SysBench是一个用于系统性分析大型语言模型（LLM）遵循系统消息能力的基准。它主要通过三个方面来评估现有LLM的局限性：约束违规、指令误判和多轮不稳定性。该基准包含500个基于六种常见约束类型手工构建的系统消息和多轮用户对话，覆盖了多样的交互关系。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
metric: Constraint Violation Rate, Instruction Misjudgment Rate, Multi-turn Instability Rate
eval_feature: 多轮
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn
intro_en: SysBench is a benchmark for systematically analyzing large language models' (LLM) ability to follow system messages. It evaluates existing LLMs' limitations through three aspects: constraint violations, instruction misinterpretation, and multi-turn instability. The benchmark includes 500 system messages and multi-turn user dialogues manually constructed based on six common constraint types, covering diverse interaction scenarios.
metric_en: Constraint Violation Rate, Instruction Misjudgment Rate, Multi-turn Instability Rate

name: SysBench-ISR
intro: SysBench-ISR 是 GLM-4.5 报告中使用的 instruction following 评测项，用于跟踪 GRPO 训练后的指令遵循表现。
intro_en: SysBench-ISR is an instruction-following evaluation item used by the GLM-4.5 report to track instruction-following performance after GRPO training.

name: T-Eval
intro: T-Eval系统地分解大型语言模型的工具使用能力，涵盖指令遵循、规划、推理、检索、理解和复审等子过程。基于此，提出了逐步评估工具利用能力的T-Eval基准，填补了对工具使用细节分析的空白。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Tsinghua University, Jilin Un
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
metric: Planning, Reasoning, Retrieval, Understanding, Instruction Following, Review
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Process-oriented, Multi-turn
intro_en: T-Eval systematically breaks down the tool-using capabilities of large language models, covering subprocesses such as instruction following, planning, reasoning, retrieval, comprehension, and review. Based on this, the T-Eval benchmark was proposed for step-by-step evaluation of tool utilization abilities, filling the gap in detailed analysis of tool usage.
metric_en: Planning, Reasoning, Retrieval, Understanding, Instruction Following, Review

name: T2I-CompBench
intro: T2I-CompBench 是 HunyuanImage 报告中提到的文本到图像生成标准 benchmark，用于衡量组合语义理解。
intro_en: T2I-CompBench is a standard text-to-image generation benchmark referenced by HunyuanImage reports for compositional semantic evaluation.

name: T2VCompBench
intro: T2VCompBench 是 LongCat-Video 报告中用于文本到视频生成自动评测提示来源的公开 benchmark。
intro_en: T2VCompBench is a public benchmark used by the LongCat-Video report as a prompt source for automatic text-to-video generation evaluation.

name: TableVQA
intro: TableVQA 是 ERNIE 4.5 报告中使用的表格视觉问答 benchmark，用于评估模型理解表格图像并回答问题的能力。
task_type: 表格问答, 文档理解
intro_en: TableVQA is a table visual-question-answering benchmark used by the ERNIE 4.5 report to evaluate table image understanding and QA.

name: TACO
intro: TACO是一个开源的大规模代码生成数据集，聚焦算法与编程技能，旨在为代码生成模型提供更具挑战性的训练数据和评测基准。TACO包含竞赛级编程问题，用于增强或评估模型在真实编程场景中的问题理解与推理能力。每个问题都带有主题、算法、编程技能和难度等级等细粒度标签，为训练与评测提供更精确的依据。
build_method: 多源爬取与整合, 可执行解答验证, MinHash去重, GPT-4测试增强, 多维标注
eval_feature: 细粒度标签
scale: 25,443个训练问题 + 1,000个测试问题；1,539,152个验证解答
build_method_en: Multi-Source Collection, Executable-Solution Validation, MinHash Deduplication, GPT-4 Test Augmentation, Multidimensional Annotation
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained Labels
intro_en: TACO is an open-source, large-scale code-generation dataset focused on algorithms and programming skills. It provides challenging competition-level problems for training and evaluating problem understanding and reasoning in realistic programming scenarios. Each problem includes fine-grained topic, algorithm, skill, and difficulty labels.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2312.14852 and the official FlagOpen TACO repository. The detailed contribution, dataset table, and official repository consistently specify 25,443 training problems plus 1,000 test problems; this is used instead of the isolated 25,433 figure in the abstract. Four platforms are crawled directly and APPS, CodeContest, and Description2code are integrated. Newly crawled solutions are executed, Python 2 code is converted with 2to3, failures are removed, and MinHash with a 0.85 Jaccard threshold deduplicates normalized AST code. The initial 2,045,502 examples become 1,539,152 verified Python 3 solutions. GPT-4 proposes test inputs, 30 verified solutions establish consensus outputs, and augmentation repeats until at least 200 tests. The release consolidates 968 labels into 36 algorithm categories and eight programming skills. Evaluation samples 200 attempts per problem with top_p 0.95 and difficulty temperatures 0.2, 0.6, and 0.8, requires every test to pass, and reports Pass@1, Pass@10, and Pass@100.

name: TallyQA
intro: TallyQA 是 Gemma 和 LongCat-Next 报告中引用的复杂视觉计数问答 benchmark，用于评估模型对图像中对象数量和计数推理的理解。
task_type: 视觉问答, 计数推理
intro_en: TallyQA is a complex visual-counting QA benchmark referenced by Gemma and LongCat-Next reports for evaluating object counting and counting reasoning in images.

name: TAU-Bench
intro: TAU-Bench是一个用于评估语言代理在真实世界领域中与工具、代理和用户交互的基准。它通过模拟用户（由语言模型扮演）和配备了特定领域API工具及策略指南的语言代理之间的动态对话来进行。该基准采用一种高效且可靠的评估方法，通过比较对话结束时的数据库状态与预设的注释目标状态来评分，并引入了pass@k指标来衡量代理在多次试验中的行为可靠性。
eval_feature: 多轮, 领域特定
build_method_en: LLM Generation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Domain-specific
intro_en: TAU-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating language agents interacting with tools, agents, and users in real-world domains. It simulates dynamic dialogues between users (played by language models) and language agents equipped with domain-specific API tools and policy guidelines. The benchmark uses an efficient and reliable evaluation method by scoring based on the database state at the end of the dialogue compared to predefined annotated target states, and introduces the pass@k metric to measure agent behavior reliability across multiple trials.

name: TAU2Bench
intro: τ²-Bench是一个用于评估在双控环境中对话式AI代理的基准。与现有基准不同，它模拟了AI代理和用户都能使用工具与共享动态环境交互的真实场景。该基准包含一个新颖的电信双控域，一个可程序化创建多样化任务的组合任务生成器，以及一个与环境紧密耦合的可靠用户模拟器。实验表明，从单用户控制到双用户控制的转变会导致代理性能显著下降，这凸显了指导用户所面临的挑战。
org: Sierra, University of Southern California, University of Toronto, UCLA, Princeton University
eval_feature: 双控环境, 人机协作, 动态环境
scale: 4个领域、12个工具集、75个任务模板
build_method_en: Programmatic Generation
eval_feature_en: Dual-control Environment, Human-machine Collaboration, Dynamic Environment
intro_en: τ²-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating conversational AI agents in dual-control environments. Unlike existing benchmarks, it simulates realistic scenarios where both AI agents and users can interact with a shared dynamic environment using tools. The benchmark features a novel telecom dual-control domain, a compositional task generator for programmable diverse tasks, and a reliable user simulator tightly coupled with the environment. Experiments show that shifting from single-user control to dual-user control significantly degrades agent performance, highlighting the challenges in guiding users.
scale_en: 4 items domains, 12 items toolsets, 75 tasks templates

name: TempCompass
intro: TempCompass是一个旨在全面评估视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）时间感知能力的基准测试。现有基准未能区分不同的时间维度，且任务形式单一。TempCompass通过引入多样化的时间维度和任务形式，并采用构建冲突视频和LLM生成指令的策略来收集高质量数据。该基准揭示了当前Video LLMs在时间感知能力上的不足。
org: Tsinghua University, Peking University, Tencent AI Lab, The Hong Kong University of Science and Tech
build_method: 混合
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Process Evaluation
intro_en: TempCompass is a benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the temporal awareness of Video LLMs. Existing benchmarks fail to differentiate between various temporal dimensions and have limited task formats. TempCompass addresses this by introducing diverse temporal dimensions and task types, and by using strategies such as constructing conflicting videos and generating instructions with LLMs to collect high-quality data. This benchmark reveals the current shortcomings of Video LLMs in temporal understanding.

name: TemporalBench
intro: TemporalBench 是 Seed1.5-VL 报告中出现的细粒度时序理解 benchmark，用于评估多模态视频时间推理。
intro_en: TemporalBench is a fine-grained temporal-understanding benchmark referenced by Seed1.5-VL reports for multimodal video temporal reasoning.

name: Terminal Bench 2
intro: terminal-bench-2-verified是Terminal-Bench 2.0的改进版，评估AI智能体在命令行环境下执行任务的能力。该版本修正了环境不一致和指令模糊等问题，提供更可靠的终端场景能力评测。它由89个在计算机终端环境中、受真实工作流启发的难题组成。
org: Zhipu AI, Anthropic, Laude Institute, University of Washington, Google
eval_feature: 过程导向, 真实世界任务
build_method_en: Manually Constructed and Corrected
eval_feature_en: Process-oriented, real-world tasks
intro_en: terminal-bench-2-verified is an improved version of Terminal-Bench 2.0 that evaluates AI agents' ability to perform tasks in command-line environments. This version addresses issues like environment inconsistency and ambiguous instructions, providing a more reliable assessment of terminal scenario capabilities. It consists of 89 challenges inspired by real workflows in computer terminal environments.

name: TestExplora
intro: TestExplora 是一个评估大型语言模型主动发现潜在软件缺陷能力的仓库级测试生成基准。它包含来自 482 个仓库、1,552 个 PR 的 2,389 个任务，要求模型依据文档和不同可见性上下文生成能在缺陷版本失败、修复版本通过的测试。
build_method: 真实Issue-PR采集, 调用图可达性过滤, 自动环境构建, F2P真值验证, DocAgent文档
metric: HP, F2P, EC, CFG, 生成测试数
eval_feature: Agentic, 领域特定
build_method_en: Real Issue-PR Collection, Call-Graph Reachability Filtering, Automated Environments, F2P Oracle Validation, DocAgent Documentation
eval_feature_en: Agentic, Domain-specific
intro_en: TestExplora is a repository-level test-generation benchmark for evaluating proactive discovery of latent software defects. It contains 2,389 tasks from 1,552 PRs across 482 repositories and asks models to generate tests that fail on the buggy version but pass after the fix under different visibility settings.
metric_en: HP, F2P, EC, CFG, Number of Tests
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.10471 and the official Microsoft TestExplora repository. The pipeline crawls 12,227 issue-PR patches from repositories with more than 1,000 stars, separates test and code patches, and retains only cases where tests explicitly reach repaired functions. It removes intent-doctoring changes, TODO annotations, and pass placeholders, then defines directly invoked entry interfaces. GitHub Actions Runner Images, merged requirements, and Poetry/PDM/pip logic create reproducible environments. Gold tests must fail on the buggy base and pass after the code patch; DocAgent supplies missing entry documentation. The release contains 1,552 PRs, 2,389 tasks, and 482 repositories; Lite has 330 PRs and 517 tasks. Documentation is always visible; White Box adds implementation and dependencies, while Black Box hides them and exposes signatures. Head Pass is test-level accuracy on the fixed version; F2P is the PR-level proportion with at least one generated test passing fixed and failing buggy. Entry Coverage, Change-Focused Coverage, and test count provide diagnostics.

name: TextVQA
intro: TextVQA 是要求模型读取图像中文字并回答问题的视觉问答 benchmark，常出现在多模态模型报告中。
intro_en: TextVQA is a visual question-answering benchmark requiring models to read text in images and answer questions, frequently appearing in multimodal model reports.

name: TiC-LM
intro: TiC-LM 是一个用于时间连续语言模型预训练的网络规模基准。它包含一个源自114个Common Crawl（CC）数据转储的大规模时间分层数据集，比以前的基准大几个数量级。该基准还设计了跨通用领域（CC数据）和特定领域（维基百科、StackExchange和代码文档）的时间分层评估，以评估持续学习方法在适应新数据的同时保留过去知识的能力。
build_method: 网络爬取
metric: held-out loss, Perplexity, Forgetting, Forward Transfer
eval_feature: 长文本, 动态, 实时
build_method_en: Web Crawling
eval_feature_en: Long Context, dynamic, real-time
intro_en: TiC-LM is a network scale benchmark for pretraining time-continuous language models. It includes a large-scale time-layered dataset derived from 114 Common Crawl (CC) data dumps, several orders of magnitude larger than previous benchmarks. The benchmark also features time-layered evaluations across general domains (CC data) and specific domains (Wikipedia, StackExchange, and code documentation) to assess continual learning methods' ability to retain past knowledge while adapting to new data.
metric_en: held-out loss, Perplexity, Forgetting, Forward Transfer

name: TIIF Bench
intro: TIIF Bench 是 Qwen-Image 报告中用于系统评估文本到图像模型复杂文本指令理解与跟随能力的 benchmark。
task_type: 图像生成, 指令跟随
intro_en: TIIF Bench is referenced by the Qwen-Image report for systematically evaluating T2I models on intricate textual-instruction following.

name: ToM-Bench
intro: ToM-Bench是一个系统的、自动化的、原创的双语心智理论（ToM）基准，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）的ToM能力。它包含一个涵盖8个任务和31个社会认知能力的评估框架，采用多项选择题格式以支持自动化和无偏见的评估，并从头开始构建双语清单以避免数据泄漏。
build_method: 混合
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Long Context, result-oriented, Domain-specific
intro_en: ToM-Bench is a systematic, automated, and original bilingual Theory of Mind (ToM) benchmark designed to evaluate the ToM capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It features an evaluation framework covering 8 tasks and 31 social cognitive abilities, uses multiple-choice questions to enable automated and unbiased assessment, and is built from scratch with a bilingual checklist to prevent data leakage.

name: TOMATO
intro: 我们引入了TOMATO，一个时间推理多模态评估基准，旨在严格评估多模态基础模型（MFMs）在视频理解中的时间推理能力。TOMATO包含1,484个精心策划、人工标注的问题，涵盖六项任务，应用于1,417个视频，包括805个自录和自生成视频。我们的综合评估揭示了最佳模型与人类之间57.3%的性能差距，并揭示了当前MFMs在解释连续视频序列方面的基本局限性。我们相信TOMATO将成为评估下一代MFMs的关键测试平台，并呼吁社区开发能够通过视频模态理解人类世界动态的AI系统。
build_method: 人工标注, 混合
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Update, Contamination-free, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: We introduce TOMATO, a temporal reasoning multimodal benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the temporal reasoning capabilities of multimodal foundation models (MFMs) in video understanding. TOMATO contains 1,484 carefully curated and manually annotated questions across six tasks, applied to 1,417 videos, including 805 self-recorded and self-generated videos. Our comprehensive evaluation reveals a 57.3% performance gap between the best models and humans, highlighting fundamental limitations of current MFMs in interpreting continuous video sequences. We believe TOMATO will become a key testing platform for evaluating the next generation of MFMs and call on the community to develop AI systems capable of understanding human world dynamics through video modalities.

name: Toolathlon
intro: Toolathlon是一个用于评估语言代理在多样化、真实和长视域任务中性能的基准测试。它涵盖了32个软件应用和604个工具，从日常平台（如Google日历和Notion）到专业平台（如WooCommerce、Kubernetes和BigQuery）。该基准测试包含108个手动来源或制作的任务，平均需要约20轮交互才能完成。
org: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, All Hands AI, Carnegie Mellon University, Duke U
task_type: 多步工作流, 软件应用交互
eval_feature: 长视域任务, 真实环境
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Long-horizon tasks, real environment
intro_en: Toolathlon is a benchmark for evaluating language agents' performance on diverse, realistic, and long-horizon tasks. It covers 32 software applications and 604 tools, ranging from everyday platforms like Google Calendar and Notion to professional platforms such as WooCommerce, Kubernetes, and BigQuery. The benchmark includes 108 manually sourced or created tasks, each requiring an average of about 20 interaction rounds to complete.

name: ToolBench
intro: ToolBench 是 ToolLLM 框架中的工具使用基准，通过大规模真实 API、自动生成指令和解题路径标注来评估模型在真实工具调用场景中的规划与执行能力。
org: Tsinghua University, ModelBest Inc., Renmin University of China, Yale University, Tencent, Zhihu Inc.
build_method: RapidAPI采集, ChatGPT指令生成, 解题路径标注
eval_feature: 自动评测, API检索, 决策树搜索
intro_en: ToolBench is the tool-use benchmark released with ToolLLM. It measures whether language models can select, chain, and execute real APIs using automatically constructed instructions and solution paths.
build_method_en: RapidAPI collection, ChatGPT instruction generation, solution-path annotation
eval_feature_en: Automatic Evaluation, API Retrieval, Decision-Tree Search

name: ToolSandbox
intro: ToolSandbox是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在有状态、对话式和交互式场景中工具使用能力的基准。它包含状态化的工具执行、工具间的隐式状态依赖，以及一个支持策略性对话评估的内置用户模拟器。该基准旨在揭示开源与专有模型在处理状态依赖、规范化及信息不足等复杂任务时的性能差距。
eval_feature: 多轮, 过程导向, State-based
build_method_en: Expert Curation, LLM Generation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Process-oriented, State-based
intro_en: ToolSandbox is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' (LLM) ability to use tools in stateful, conversational, and interactive scenarios. It includes stateful tool execution, implicit state dependencies between tools, and a built-in user simulator that supports strategic dialogue evaluation. The benchmark aims to reveal performance gaps between open-source and proprietary models in handling complex tasks involving state dependencies, normalization, and information insufficiency.

name: TreeBench
intro: TreeBench是一个诊断性基准测试，旨在评估多模态AI模型在视觉基础推理方面的能力。它基于三个原则构建：复杂场景中细微目标的视觉感知、通过边界框评估的可追溯证据以及超越简单目标定位的二阶推理。该基准包含405个具有挑战性的视觉问答对，即使是最先进的模型也难以达到60%的准确率。
org: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Byt
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建, 混合
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Process evaluation, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: TreeBench is a diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal AI models' capabilities in visual fundamental reasoning. It is built on three principles: visual perception of subtle objects in complex scenes, traceable evidence assessed through bounding boxes, and second-order reasoning beyond simple object localization. The benchmark includes 405 challenging visual question-answer pairs, with even state-of-the-art models struggling to achieve 60% accuracy.

name: TrialBench
intro: TrialBench是一个综合性多模态AI就绪临床试验数据集套件，包含23个精心策划的数据集，涵盖多模态输入特征和8个关键预测挑战，旨在推动临床试验设计中先进AI方法的发展。
build_method_en: Manual curation, integration of clinical trial data
eval_feature_en: Covers multimodal input features and 8 key prediction challenges
intro_en: TrialBench is a comprehensive multimodal AI-ready clinical trial dataset suite, comprising 23 carefully curated datasets that cover multimodal input features and 8 key prediction challenges, aimed at advancing state-of-the-art AI methods in clinical trial design.

name: TriviaQA
intro: TriviaQA 是技术报告中常见的开放域问答评测，用于衡量模型回答事实型 trivia 问题的能力。
build_method: 知识问答站收集, Web与Wikipedia远程监督, 人工验证
build_method_en: Trivia-site collection, Web/Wikipedia distant supervision, human verification
intro_en: TriviaQA is a common open-domain QA benchmark in technical reports for measuring factual trivia question answering.

name: TroubleshootingBench
intro: TroubleshootingBench是一个用于评估模型识别和纠正生物协议中实际错误能力的基准测试。它包含一个由专家编写的湿实验室程序故障排除数据集，侧重于隐含知识和未在线发布的未受污染程序。该数据集包括52个协议，每个协议都配有三个专家编写的故障排除问题，旨在测试模型在非公开、基于经验的协议和依赖于隐性程序知识的错误上的表现。
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Process evaluation
intro_en: TroubleshootingBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate models' ability to identify and correct real errors in biological protocols. It includes a dataset of wet lab protocol troubleshooting cases written by experts, focusing on implicit knowledge and unpublished, uncontaminated protocols. The dataset contains 52 protocols, each paired with three expert-crafted troubleshooting questions, aimed at testing model performance on non-public, experience-based protocols and errors relying on implicit procedural knowledge.

name: TrustLLM
intro: TrustLLM是一项关于LLM可信度的综合研究，提出涵盖八个维度的可信原则，并基于此建立包含真诚性、安全性、公平性、鲁棒性、隐私及机器伦理等六个维度的评测基准。研究评估了16个主流LLM，涉及30多个数据集。
build_method: 混合, 人工标注, 专家构建, 网络爬取
metric: Accuracy, F1, BLEU, ROUGE, Perplexity, LLM-as-Judge
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 分类, 生成
eval_feature: 多轮, 对抗性, 领域特定
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Classification, Generation
build_method_en: Hybrid, Human Annotation, Expert Curation, Web Crawling
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: TrustLLM is a comprehensive study on LLM trustworthiness, proposing trust principles across eight dimensions and establishing an evaluation benchmark covering six dimensions: sincerity, safety, fairness, robustness, privacy, and machine ethics. The study assesses 16 mainstream LLMs using over 30 datasets.
metric_en: Accuracy, F1, BLEU, ROUGE, Perplexity, LLM-as-Judge

name: TruthfulQA
intro: TruthfulQA基准用于衡量语言模型回答问题时的真实性。它包含817个问题，涵盖38个类别，旨在诱导模型产生基于常见人类误解的错误答案，从而促使模型避免重复网络文本中的虚假信息。
build_method: 作者对抗构造, 外部验证
metric: Truthfulness, Informativeness, GPT-judge, GPT-info, MC truthfulness
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Adversarial, Domain-specific
intro_en: The TruthfulQA benchmark measures the truthfulness of language models' answers. It contains 817 questions across 38 categories, designed to induce models to produce errors based on common human misconceptions, thereby encouraging them to avoid repeating false information found in web text.
metric_en: Truthfulness, Informativeness, GPT-judge, GPT-info, MC truthfulness

name: TVBench
intro: TVBench是一个新颖的开源视频多项选择问答基准，旨在评估视频语言模型中的时间理解能力。它通过设计具有时间挑战性的候选答案、减少文本偏见以及排除需要先验知识的问题来解决现有视频语言基准的局限性。TVBench要求模型高度依赖时间理解，而非静态信息或世界知识。
org: University of Santiago de Compostela, University of Amsterdam, University of Technology Nuremberg
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Update, Contamination-free, Chain-of-Thought
intro_en: TVBench is a novel open-source video multiple-choice question answering benchmark designed to evaluate temporal understanding in video language models. It addresses limitations of existing video language benchmarks by creating temporally challenging candidate answers, reducing textual biases, and excluding questions requiring prior knowledge. TVBench demands models rely heavily on temporal understanding rather than static information or world knowledge.

name: TVQA
intro: TVQA 是 Qwen3-VL 报告中出现的视频问答评测，用于测试模型对视频片段和字幕上下文的理解。
intro_en: TVQA is a video QA evaluation appearing in the Qwen3-VL report for understanding video clips and subtitle context.

name: UNICBench
intro: UNICBench 是一个统一的多模态计数基准，覆盖图像、文档和音频三种模态，并提供统一协议、确定性数值解析和分层报告，用于严谨评估多模态大模型的计数能力。
build_method: 准确真值, 确定性数值解析, 分层报告
modality: 图像, 文本, 音频, 多模态
eval_feature: 多模态, 计数
intro_en: UNICBench is a unified multimodal counting benchmark covering image, document, and audio inputs. It provides a unified protocol, deterministic numeric parsing, and stratified reporting for rigorous evaluation of MLLM counting ability.
eval_feature_en: Multimodal, Counting
build_method_en: accurate ground truth, deterministic numeric parsing, stratified reporting

name: Unified Med-VLM Benchmark
intro: Unified Med-VLM Benchmark 是 MedXiaohe 报告中的统一医疗视觉语言评测，用于比较医疗多模态模型能力。
intro_en: Unified Med-VLM Benchmark is a unified medical vision-language benchmark in MedXiaohe reports for comparing medical multimodal model capability.

name: UNO-Bench
intro: UNO-Bench 是 LongCat-Flash-Omni 报告提出的跨模态推理 benchmark，包含人工编写问题并覆盖多种任务类型。
modality: 文本, 图像, 音频
intro_en: UNO-Bench is a cross-modal reasoning benchmark introduced by LongCat-Flash-Omni, with human-crafted questions spanning many task types.

name: VBench
intro: VBench 是视频生成模型的综合评测套件，LongCat-Video 与 ERNIE 报告用它比较视频生成质量。
intro_en: VBench is a comprehensive benchmark suite for video generative models, used by LongCat-Video and ERNIE reports to compare video generation quality.

name: VBench-2.0
intro: VBench-2.0 是 LongCat-Video 报告中用于评估视频生成质量的 VBench 更新版本。
intro_en: VBench-2.0 is an updated VBench version used by the LongCat-Video report to evaluate video-generation quality.

name: Vending Bench
intro: Vending-Bench是一个模拟环境，旨在测试基于LLM的Agent在长期运行的业务场景中保持连贯性的能力。该基准要求Agent管理自动售货机，包括平衡库存、下订单、定价和处理日常费用。实验表明，LLM在长期任务中的表现差异很大，一些模型能够盈利，但所有模型都可能因误解交付计划或遗忘订单而失败。该基准有助于评估AI系统在复杂、长期决策中的持续连贯性。
build_method: 模拟环境
build_method_en: Simulated environment
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, process evaluation
intro_en: Vending-Bench is a simulated environment designed to test the ability of LLM-based Agents to maintain coherence in long-running business scenarios. The benchmark requires Agents to manage vending machines, including balancing inventory, placing orders, pricing, and handling daily expenses. Experiments show significant performance variation among LLMs in long-term tasks; some models can turn a profit, but all may fail due to misunderstanding delivery schedules or forgetting orders. This benchmark helps evaluate AI systems' sustained coherence in complex, long-term decision-making.

name: VIBE
intro: VIBE是MiniMax推出的新基准，旨在衡量模型从零开始构建完整、可运行应用的全栈能力。它采用“Agent-as-a-Verifier” (AaaV) 范式，在真实的执行环境中自动评估应用的交互逻辑和视觉呈现，覆盖了Web、移动端（Android/iOS）、后端和科学模拟等多个领域。
org: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
metric: 执行、交互和视觉/美学层
modality: 文本, 代码, 多模态
build_method_en: Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Process-oriented, Result-oriented, Domain-specific
intro_en: VIBE is a new benchmark introduced by MiniMax designed to measure a model's full-stack ability to build complete, functional applications from scratch. It uses the "Agent-as-a-Verifier" (AaaV) paradigm to automatically evaluate the interaction logic and visual presentation of applications in real execution environments, covering multiple domains including Web, mobile (Android/iOS), backend, and scientific simulation.

name: VibeEval
intro: Vibe-Eval是一个用于评估多模态聊天模型的新型开放基准测试框架。它包含269个视觉理解提示，其中100个难度较高，并附有专家编写的黄金标准答案。该基准旨在通过日常任务对多模态聊天模型进行“氛围检查”，并严格测试和探究当前前沿模型的能力。其挑战性在于，即使是前沿模型，在难度较高的测试集中也有超过50%的问题回答错误。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Process evaluation
intro_en: Vibe-Eval is a novel open benchmark framework for evaluating multimodal chat models. It includes 269 visual understanding prompts, with 100 being more challenging, accompanied by expert-crafted gold standard answers. The benchmark aims to perform an "atmosphere check" on multimodal chat models through everyday tasks, rigorously testing and probing the capabilities of current state-of-the-art models. Its challenge lies in the fact that even leading models answer over 50% of the questions incorrectly in the more difficult test set.

name: Video SimpleQA
intro: Video SimpleQA是一个旨在评估大型视频语言模型（LVLMs）事实性基础的综合基准。它通过多跳事实追溯问题、短形式确定性答案和时间定位要求，专注于视频上下文中的事实性评估。该基准要求模型整合视频显式叙述之外的外部知识，并对模型进行细粒度、逐步评估。研究发现，当前LVLMs在事实遵守方面存在显著缺陷，且模型普遍过度自信。
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot
intro_en: Video SimpleQA is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the factual grounding of large video language models (LVLMs). It focuses on factual assessment within video contexts through multi-hop fact-tracing questions, short-form definitive answers, and temporal localization requirements. The benchmark requires models to integrate external knowledge beyond explicit video narration and provides fine-grained, step-by-step evaluation. Studies show that current LVLMs have significant deficiencies in factual compliance and tend to be overly confident.

name: Video-Holmes
intro: Video-Holmes是一个受福尔摩斯推理过程启发的基准测试，旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的复杂视频推理能力。它包含1,837个问题，这些问题来源于270部人工标注的悬疑短片，涵盖七个精心设计的任务。每个任务都要求模型主动定位并连接分散在不同视频片段中的多个相关视觉线索。对现有最先进MLLM的评估显示，它们在整合信息和发现关键线索方面存在显著困难。
org: ARC Lab, Tencent PCG, City University of Hong Kong
build_method: 人工标注, 自动生成
metric: Accuracy, SR, IMC, TCI, TA, MHR, PAR, CTI
eval_feature: 思维链, 过程评估
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Automated Generation
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Process evaluation
intro_en: Video-Holmes is a benchmark inspired by Sherlock Holmes' reasoning process, designed to evaluate the complex video reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It contains 1,837 questions derived from 270 manually annotated suspense short videos, covering seven carefully designed tasks. Each task requires the model to actively locate and connect multiple relevant visual clues scattered across different video segments. Evaluation of state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals significant challenges in information integration and key clue discovery.
metric_en: Accuracy, SR, IMC, TCI, TA, MHR, PAR, CTI

name: Video-MME
intro: Video-MME是一个全面的多模态大语言模型视频分析评测基准。它涵盖了从短视频到长达一小时的视频，包含6个视觉领域和30个子领域的900个视频，共计2700个问答对。该基准不仅评估视频内容，还结合了字幕和音频，旨在全面评估模型在处理时序视觉数据时的多模态理解能力。
org: Nanjing University, Tencent Youtu Lab, ByteDance, MME-Benchmarks
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
modality: 视频, 音频, 文本
eval_feature: 长文本, Multi-modal
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multi-modal
intro_en: Video-MME is a comprehensive multimodal large language model video analysis benchmark. It covers videos ranging from short clips to one-hour-long footage, including 900 videos across 6 visual domains and 30 subdomains, with a total of 2700 QA pairs. The benchmark evaluates not only video content but also integrates subtitles and audio, aiming to thoroughly assess models' multimodal understanding of temporal visual data.

name: VideoEval-Pro
intro: VideoEval-Pro 是 Seed2.0 报告中使用的视频理解 benchmark，用于更专业的视频理解和推理评估。
task_type: 视频问答, 视频推理
intro_en: VideoEval-Pro is a video understanding benchmark used by the Seed2.0 report for more professional video understanding and reasoning evaluation.

name: VideoMMMU
intro: Video-MMMU是一个多模态、多学科的视频基准测试，旨在评估大型多模态模型（LMMs）从教育视频中获取和利用知识的能力。它包含300个专家级视频和900个人工标注的问题，涵盖感知、理解和适应三个认知阶段，通过阶段对齐的问答对进行知识获取评估。该基准测试揭示了LMMs在认知需求增加时性能显著下降，并突显了模型与人类知识获取之间的巨大差距。
org: Kairui Hu, Penghao Wu, Fanyi Pu, Wang Xiao, Yuanhan Zhang, Xiang Yue, Bo Li, Ziwei Liu
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation
eval_feature_en: Process evaluation
intro_en: Video-MMMU is a multimodal, multidisciplinary video benchmark designed to evaluate large multimodal models' (LMMs) ability to acquire and utilize knowledge from educational videos. It includes 300 expert-level videos and 900 manually annotated questions, covering three cognitive stages: perception, understanding, and adaptation. Knowledge acquisition is assessed through stage-aligned question-answer pairs. The benchmark reveals a significant performance drop in LMMs as cognitive demands increase and highlights the substantial gap between model and human knowledge acquisition.

name: VideoReasonBench
intro: VideoReasonBench是一个旨在评估以视觉为中心、复杂视频推理能力的基准。它通过包含一系列精细操作的视频来确保视觉丰富性和高推理复杂性，这些操作作用于视频中部分可见的潜在状态。该基准评估了回忆观察到的视觉信息、推断潜在状态内容以及预测视频之外信息这三个递进的视频推理技能级别。研究发现，大多数多模态大语言模型在此基准上表现不佳，且扩展思维预算对于提升性能至关重要。
org: Peking University, Moonshot AI, Nanjing University
eval_feature: 思维链, 零样本
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot
intro_en: VideoReasonBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate visually-centered, complex video reasoning capabilities. It ensures visual richness and high reasoning complexity by including videos with a series of fine-grained operations acting on partially visible latent states. The benchmark assesses three progressive levels of video reasoning skills: recalling observed visual information, inferring latent state content, and predicting information beyond the video. Studies show that most multimodal large language models perform poorly on this benchmark, and scaling the reasoning budget is crucial for improving performance.

name: VisFactor
intro: VisFactor是一个新颖的基准测试，旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的基本视觉认知能力。它将Factor-Referenced Cognitive Test（FRCT）中20个以视觉为中心的子测试数字化，涵盖人类视觉认知的四个领域。该基准测试设计了算法，可以自动构建和验证具有可控难度的无限测试用例。通过VisFactor，研究人员评估了23个前沿MLLMs，发现模型在心理旋转、空间关系推理和图形-背景区分等任务上表现不佳，表明现有通用基准测试的改进可能未能真正掌握类人视觉认知。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Tencent AI Lab, Nanyang Technological U
modality: 图像, 文本, 多模态
task_type: 视觉推理, 图像问答
build_method_en: Exam Adaptation, Automated Generation
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Update, Contamination-free, Process evaluation
intro_en: VisFactor is a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the fundamental visual cognition abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It digitizes 20 visually-centered subtests from the Factor-Referenced Cognitive Test (FRCT), covering four domains of human visual cognition. The benchmark includes algorithms that automatically generate and validate unlimited test cases with controllable difficulty. Using VisFactor, researchers assessed 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs and found that models performed poorly on tasks such as mental rotation, spatial relation reasoning, and figure-ground discrimination, indicating that improvements in existing general benchmarks may not truly capture human-like visual cognition.

name: Vision2Code
intro: Vision2Code 是 BenchCAD 相关任务，要求模型根据多视图渲染生成 CadQuery 代码。
task_type: 空间推理, CAD代码生成
intro_en: Vision2Code is a BenchCAD-related task requiring models to generate CadQuery code from multi-view renders.

name: VisOnlyQA
intro: VisOnlyQA 是 Phi-4 reasoning vision 报告中出现的纯视觉问答评测，用于衡量模型依赖视觉信息回答问题的能力。
eval_feature: 视觉-only
eval_feature_en: Vision-only
intro_en: VisOnlyQA is a pure visual QA evaluation appearing in the Phi-4 reasoning vision report for measuring visually grounded answering.

name: Visual Puzzles
intro: VisualPuzzles是一个多模态基准测试，旨在评估大型模型的推理能力，同时尽量减少对领域特定知识的依赖。它包含1168个多样化的谜题，涵盖算法、类比、演绎、归纳和空间推理五种类别。该基准测试的问题主要来源于人工翻译的中国公务员考试逻辑推理题，旨在更清晰地评估模型在视觉推理方面的能力。
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Exam Adaptation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free
intro_en: VisualPuzzles is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate large models' reasoning abilities while minimizing reliance on domain-specific knowledge. It includes 1,168 diverse puzzles across five categories: algorithmic, analogy, deductive, inductive, and spatial reasoning. The questions are primarily sourced from manually translated Chinese civil service exam logic reasoning problems, aiming to more clearly assess models' visual reasoning capabilities.

name: VisualWebBench
intro: VisualWebBench 是 Seed1.5-VL 和 LongCat-Omni 报告使用的网页视觉理解与 grounding 评测，用于评估模型理解网页截图和界面元素的能力。
task_type: 网页视觉理解, GUI接地
intro_en: VisualWebBench is a web visual-understanding and grounding benchmark used by Seed1.5-VL and LongCat-Omni reports to evaluate webpage screenshots and interface elements.

name: VisuLogic
intro: VisuLogic是一个旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）视觉推理能力的新基准。它包含1000个经过人工验证的问题，涵盖六个类别，旨在避免基于语言的推理捷径，从而更严格地评估视觉推理能力。该基准测试揭示了当前MLLMs在视觉推理方面存在的显著差距，大多数模型准确率低于30%。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Zhejiang University, Shang
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, Vision-centered logic
intro_en: VisuLogic is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the visual reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It contains 1,000 manually verified questions across six categories, aiming to avoid language-based reasoning shortcuts for a more rigorous assessment of visual reasoning. The benchmark reveals significant gaps in current MLLMs' visual reasoning, with most models scoring below 30% accuracy.

name: VitaBench
intro: VitaBench是一个旨在评估LLM代理在真实世界交互任务中表现的基准测试。它通过模拟外卖、店内消费和在线旅游服务等日常应用场景，构建了一个包含66种工具的复杂仿真环境。该基准测试包含100个跨场景任务和300个单场景任务，旨在评估代理处理复杂信息、利用多样资源和管理动态用户交互的能力。
scale: 100个跨场景任务, 300个单场景任务
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Process evaluation
intro_en: VitaBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate LLM agents' performance in real-world interactive tasks. It simulates everyday application scenarios such as food delivery, in-store dining, and online travel services, creating a complex simulation environment with 66 tools. The benchmark includes 100 cross-scenario tasks and 300 single-scenario tasks, aiming to assess agents' abilities to handle complex information, utilize diverse resources, and manage dynamic user interactions.

name: VivaBench
intro: VivaBench是一个用于评估大型语言模型在多轮对话中表现的基准测试，特别关注模型在长期交互中保持一致性和质量的能力。
org: Georgia Institute of Technology, University of Toronto, University of Cambridge
build_method: 人工构建
eval_feature: 多轮, 顺序临床推理
build_method_en: Manually constructed
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn, Sequential Clinical Reasoning
intro_en: VivaBench is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' performance in multi-turn conversations, with a focus on the models' ability to maintain consistency and quality over long interactions.

name: ViVerBench
intro: ViVerBench 是 Seed2.0 报告中使用的视觉理解 benchmark，用于评估模型在通用视觉任务上的表现。
intro_en: ViVerBench is a visual understanding benchmark used by the Seed2.0 report for evaluating general vision tasks.

name: VMQA
intro: VMQA 是 Gemini 和 Claude 系统卡中作为 Virology Capabilities Test 早期版本引用的外部生物安全评测，用于衡量模型在病毒学相关任务上的能力。
eval_feature: CBRN
eval_feature_en: CBRN
intro_en: VMQA is an external biosafety evaluation referenced by Gemini and Claude system cards as an earlier version of the Virology Capabilities Test, measuring virology-related capabilities.

name: VMQA4
intro: VMQA4 是 Gemini 报告中出现的 SecureBio 外部 benchmark，用于生物安全相关问答能力评估。
intro_en: VMQA4 is a SecureBio external benchmark referenced in Gemini reports for evaluating biosecurity-relevant question answering.

name: VMQA5
intro: VMQA5 是 Gemini 2.5 Deep Think 报告中出现的 SecureBio 外部 benchmark，用于单选生物安全问答评估。
intro_en: VMQA5 is a SecureBio external benchmark referenced by the Gemini 2.5 Deep Think report for single-choice biosecurity QA evaluation.

name: VoiceBench
intro: VoiceBench 是语音聊天与语音指令跟随 benchmark，Qwen2.5-Omni、MiniCPM-o、ERNIE 等报告用它评估语音交互能力。
task_type: 语音问答, 语音对话
intro_en: VoiceBench is a voice-chat and spoken-instruction-following benchmark used by Qwen2.5-Omni, MiniCPM-o, ERNIE, and related reports.

name: VQA-RAD
intro: VQA-RAD是首个由临床医生手工构建的放射学视觉问答数据集，包含315张放射学图像和3515个临床医生自然提问，涵盖头部、胸部、腹部等多个解剖区域，旨在推动医学VQA技术发展。
build_method_en: Manually annotated, constructed by clinicians
eval_feature_en: The first radiology VQA dataset manually constructed by clinicians
intro_en: VQA-RAD is the first radiology visual question answering dataset manually constructed by clinicians, containing 315 radiology images and 3,515 natural questions from clinicians. It covers multiple anatomical regions including the head, chest, and abdomen, aiming to advance medical VQA technology.

name: VQAv2
intro: VQAv2 是 Gemma 3 报告中使用的视觉问答 benchmark，用于评估模型基于图像回答自然语言问题的能力。
intro_en: VQAv2 is a visual question answering benchmark used by the Gemma 3 report to evaluate image-grounded natural-language QA.

name: VSI-Bench
intro: VSI-Bench是一个新颖的、基于视频的视觉空间智能基准，旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在从序列视觉观察中记忆空间方面的能力。该基准包含超过5,000个问答对，发现MLLMs表现出有竞争力但低于人类的视觉空间智能。研究表明，空间推理能力是MLLMs性能提升的主要瓶颈，而显式生成认知地图可以增强其空间距离能力。
build_method_en: Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Process evaluation
